Panel 5 (Transcendence): Final form — a luxurious sculptural perfume bottle or abstract glass statue inspired by the scent’s essence, polished, reflective, with glowing highlights, sitting on a minimal pedestal. Style: ultra-detailed, photorealistic to abstract progression, deep black background, gold and silver accents, soft glow, high contrast lighting, glossy reflections, cinematic luxury aesthetic, perfume ad style, 4K quality, sharp focus.

银河倾泻于沙漠之上的那个夜晚，

围绕任意主体对象，生成极简信息视觉：以大面积高亮净底建立第一印象，仅保留微弱的纸感或柔雾浅肌理，让空气感与静谧成为主体的一部分。不要填满视觉重心；将主题内容拆分为清晰的上层信息与下层实体锚点：上半部以端正、纤细、书卷气的中文字体编排主标题、副信息与极小字注释，字距疏朗、行高克制，居中的主标题形成庄重的停顿，日期/备注/符号线条以精准的水平秩序辅助阅读；下半部放置由主题语义转化而来的简洁主形体，体量小巧、边缘干净、细节写实但不加修饰，如同落入留白中的安静物证。主体与文字之间保持宽阔的呼吸区，让留白承载高级感、距离感与仪式感，而非暗示内容缺失。色彩从主体的材质、情绪与文化语义中提取：背景占据最大面积并保持明亮清澈，主体色作为低饱和的温柔支撑，文字与结构线使用清晰而不沉重的深色信息层，点缀色仅在关键细节或视觉节点微量出现；整体维持清静、高亮、低噪、色阶干净、对比柔和，避免浑浊、做旧、烟熏与灰黄沉闷。最终效果应如一张经过精密设计的展览公告或产品纪念视觉，一眼看阅读顺序与留白，二眼看主体实体与微小信息，质感克制、明亮、自然、可信。

明亮清澈的深棕色杏仁眼，自然双眼皮，卧蚕细节清晰，睫毛纤长卷翘，浅粉棕色眼影，眼线纤细柔和、眼尾微微上扬。

[发型 - 核心]

浓密顺滑的深黑茶色及腰长发，泛着自然的深巧克力棕光泽。

头顶蓬松，采用慵懒半扎发造型，额头自然中分，垂落几缕细碎的八字刘海。

佩戴小巧的白色水滴形珍珠耳环与极细银色锁骨链。

人物坐在床沿，上半身自然挺直，身体正面微侧向镜头。

头部轻轻倾斜，下巴自然微收，眼神温柔地直视镜头。

左手自然抬起，掌心轻贴脸颊，手指顺着下颌线柔和舒展，形成温柔的托腮姿势。

另一只手抬至肩侧，轻轻拨弄垂落的长发，手指自然弯曲。

双肩放松，体态慵懒自然，手部结构真实合理。

[背景环境]

简约温馨的现代奶油风卧室，人物身后是一张铺着纯白床品与柔软白枕的大床。

柔和的冷白正面自然补光照亮面部、鼻梁、双颊与锁骨。

深黑茶色长发泛着柔和的深棕色高光，背景保留微弱的暖白环境光。

将这张照片重新创作成一幅迷人的插画作品。请保留原有的构图、可辨识的面部特征、服装细节、身体姿态及人物互动关系。切勿随意替换或凭空捏造主要拍摄对象。

艺术风格：
- 纯正的手绘彩色铅笔与蜡笔插画风格。
- 清晰可见的铅笔笔触、颗粒质感以及略带随性的手绘线条。
- 柔和的水彩般上色效果，搭配浓郁的彩铅阴影。
- 细腻的交叉排线与层层叠加的手绘细节。
- 略带粗糙感、充满怀旧气息的儿童绘本插画美学。
- 温暖、梦幻、惬意且充满童趣的氛围。
- 奶油色纹理纸张背景。
- 柔和的光线，带有温暖的亮部与轻柔的阴影。
- 浓郁却略带褪色感的复古色调。

拼贴装饰：

在主插画四周点缀俏皮的手工拼贴画边框，包含以下元素：
- 粉色与红色的闪粉爱心贴纸。
- 小巧的彩色宝石与珍珠串珠。
- 金色星星与水晶装饰。
- 精致的手绘小花与蝴蝶。
- 可爱的涂鸦、笑脸和小星星。
- 小巧的装饰叶片与应季元素。
- 多彩的手绘轮廓线与俏皮的符号。

让这些装饰看起来就像真实贴在画作边缘的实体贴纸和微小饰物。

构图：

保持主体位于视觉中心。运用细腻的彩铅质感还原原始场景。装饰性拼贴元素主要分布在画面外缘，切勿遮挡照片中的重要部分。

整幅作品应呈现出精美个人日记本的一页，或是怀旧图文回忆录般的视觉效果。

最终美学效果：

极致细腻、可爱温馨、怀旧文艺、柔和复古的拼贴画美学，纯手工插画质感，清晰可见的蜡笔颗粒与彩铅肌理，自然的手绘瑕疵美，温暖的柔和色调，迷人的装饰点缀，高品质的插画日记页面。

重要提示：最终效果必须呈现为纯手绘插画，而非套用卡通滤镜的照片。请避免照片级写实、3D 渲染、塑料质感以及过度平滑的数字绘画效果。

一张照片级写实的竖版全身照，画面中是一台巨大的双足人形机器人，伫立在户外一座现代日本区立体育馆前。机器人由重型工业机械构造而成，配有黑白相间的分块装甲板、裸露的液压活塞以及复杂的机械关节。它的头部是一个矩形传感器阵列，带有多个摄像头镜头，肩部则装有发着红光的应急灯。机器人为万圣节做了精心装扮：身披一件飘逸的橙色斗篷，上面印满黑蝙蝠与南瓜灯的图案；机体上缠绕着紫色亮丝花环，点缀着小塑料南瓜和三角彩旗。胸前的几块装甲板上标有“警視庁”（东京都警察总部）和“MPD”字样。

前景中，两名身穿深蓝色制服、战术背心和头盔的警察背对镜头站立，他们的背心上同样印有“警視庁 MPD”字样。右侧的人群里有几位市民，其中一名女性正用智能手机拍照，还有一个孩子穿着橙色女巫服、戴着尖顶帽。背景是一座带玻璃窗的大型混凝土建筑，醒目的标牌上写着“区立総合体育館”（区立综合体育馆）。建筑右侧悬挂着一幅高大的竖幅海报，上面画着卡通南瓜，并写有“ハロウィン スポーツ フェスティバル”（万圣节运动节）字样。整个场景沐浴在晴朗蓝天下的明亮自然日光之中。

嘴角微微上扬，呈现自然温柔的闭嘴微笑，双眼直视镜头，神态甜美放松。

保留真实的皮肤微肌理与自然五官比例。

极其浓密蓬松的及腰深栗棕色长发，带有自然的巧克力棕光泽。

颈部佩戴极细的银色锁骨链，中间点缀一颗小水晶吊坠。

头部微侧，下巴自然微收，温柔地注视镜头。

人物居中，取景范围从头顶留白处到腰部，完整展现面部、双手、长发和白色 T 恤。

采用夜晚手机直闪或柔和的正面 LED 补光，面部明亮清晰，冷白皮与暗黑夜景形成强烈对比。

闪光灯照亮额头、鼻梁、脸颊、长发和双手，产生真实柔和的近距离补光效果。

背景保留自然的城市霓虹环境光，湿润的街道泛着红蓝光影。

人物锐利清晰，背景带有轻微的真实动态模糊和夜景数码噪点。

真实的手机夜景质感，曝光自然，保留皮肤纹理、细腻的发丝以及环境光影。

清透冷白皮透着淡淡的蜜桃粉腮红，鼻梁纤细挺直，鼻头小巧自然。

明亮清澈的深灰棕色杏眼，自然双眼皮，柔和卧蚕，睫毛纤长卷翘，浅粉棕色眼影，自然平眉。

双唇饱满柔软，呈玫瑰豆沙粉色，带有细腻自然的润泽光泽。

嘴角微微上扬，神态温柔恬静，双眼直视镜头，流露自然亲切感。

保留真实皮肤微肌理，避免夸张美颜滤镜与过度幼态化特征。

[发型 - 核心]

浓密蓬松的深栗棕色长发，泛有自然巧克力棕光泽，长度垂至胸部以下、接近腰部。

头顶发量丰盈蓬松感明显，发根松散不贴头皮，整体发量充足。

自然中分造型，部分头发在脑后随意拢起，形成轻微的半扎发效果。

几缕细碎发丝自然垂落在额头与脸颊两侧。

画面左侧的头发自然别至耳后，露出耳朵与小巧珍珠耳环。

画面右侧大量浓密长发自然披散于肩头与胸前，形成柔和松散的大波浪。

发丝需具备真实粗细变化、自然光泽及细微碎发；切勿使用过于整齐的卷发或假发质感。

[服装与首饰]

身穿奶油白/浅燕麦色一字领修身针织上衣。

面料为柔软细密的针织材质，宽松的一字领口自然滑落至肩部以下，露出一侧肩膀与清晰柔和的锁骨。

长袖设计，袖口自然贴合手腕，面料呈现细腻真实的编织纹理与柔软褶皱。

颈部佩戴极细银色锁骨链，一侧耳朵戴着小巧的白色珍珠耳钉。

整体穿搭简约、温柔、优雅。

[姿势 - 重点]

人物坐在卧室床沿，上半身微微转向镜头，双肩自然放松下沉。

头部轻轻偏向画面右侧，下巴微收，目光温柔地直视镜头。

画面左侧的一只手自然抬起，掌心轻触脸颊与耳下，手指顺着下颌线自然舒展，形成温柔的托腮姿势。

另一只手抬至肩侧，手指轻轻拨弄胸前的长发，指尖自然弯曲。

长发自然垂落于身体右侧，双手位置高低错落，构成自然柔和的画面构图。

保持真实的手指数量、自然的手腕角度以及合理的肩颈比例。

[背景环境]

温馨简约的现代卧室或酒店房间。

画面左侧是一扇大型落地窗，挂着半透明白色纱帘，窗帘带有柔和自然的垂直褶皱。

人物身后是一张铺着纯白床品的柔软大床。

画面右后方可见浅米色床头板与暖黄色床头灯光。

墙面为奶油白与浅米色，室内干净整洁，无繁杂杂物。

整体营造出真实居家夜晚休憩的温暖氛围。

[镜头与光影]

9:16 竖版，上半身特写人像构图，等效 35-50mm 镜头，平视视角，人物居中。

头顶预留少量空间，长发自然延伸至画面底部。

采用柔和冷白正面补光，均匀照亮眼部、脸颊与嘴唇，使肌肤呈现干净通透的冷白质感。

右侧背景的床头灯散发柔和暖黄环境光，形成自然的冷暖色温对比。

头发受光面呈现细腻的栗棕色高光，暗部保留浓郁的深棕色。

整体亮度适中，对比度略微降低，保留自然阴影、真实发丝、细腻面料纹理以及轻微的智能手机摄影颗粒感。

[负面提示词]

动漫，插画，3D 渲染，CG 假脸，塑料感皮肤，过度磨皮，夸张网红脸，眼睛异常偏大，下巴过尖，五官错位，双眼不对称，浓妆，假发，头发结块，过于规则的卷发，手指畸形，多指，手部融合，手腕扭曲，肩膀脱臼，身体比例失调，针织纹理错误，衣服穿模，背景杂乱，强 HDR，严重过曝，过度锐化，商业影棚布光，明显 AI 生成痕迹，文字，水印，logo，拼贴画。

items.title: 手相解读信息图表
items.sub: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
items.prompt:
目标：创建一张竖版信息图风格的手相指南，标题为 {argument name="title text" default="你的个人指南"}。
画布：采用干净、现代的布局，白底黑字，分为三个主列。整体风格极简且富有科普感，类似于高端健康或自我提升类 App 的界面。
布局：
- 左列：顶部区域以大号粗体字显示标题“你的个人指南”，下方紧跟副标题“认识自己 · 专注成长 · 持续进化”。其下是一张张开的右手（掌心朝前）写实照片。再往下依次为：“你的手”板块，列出惯用手、元素、手型及手指特征等细节；“快速总结”板块；以项目符号列表呈现的“优势”板块；以及同样以项目符号列表呈现的“关键关注点”板块。
- 中列：顶部区域展示一张详细的黑白指纹扫描图像，标注为“掌印图”。其下是一幅手部线描示意图，标注为“主要掌纹图”，图中带有编号的线条（1-5）分别对应特定的掌纹。下方是“手型类型”柱状图板块，展示火、风、土、水四种元素的占比。底部是关于“掌丘”的图例，解释其各自含义。
- 右列：包含五张独立的卡片，详细解读特定掌纹：1. 感情线，2. 智慧线，3. 生命线，4. 命运线，5. 太阳线。每张卡片均包含描述与解析。这些卡片下方是“最终建议”提示框和“备注”区域。
视觉风格：卡片使用细黑边框。图标应为简约线条画（如心形、大脑、盾牌）。文字需采用清晰的无衬线中文字体。指纹图像应具备高对比度，纹路清晰可见。
文本内容：确保所有中文标签与提供的图片完全一致，包括“手相解读”、“掌印图”等标题，以及各条掌纹的具体解析内容。

items.title: 电影感夜市女剑客
items.prompt:
超宽幅 2.2:1，照片级真实电影感，年轻女剑客在灯笼照亮的夜市中回头张望，温暖的灯笼光晕与冷调的蓝色夜色形成对比。单人主体。

【构图】四分之三背影视角，位于画面中心偏左，面部处于宽度 41%、高度 38% 处，占画框高度 30%。右侧 55% 为背景：灯笼化作光球向远处虚化延伸。深色剑柄位于宽度 24% 处，低垂未举起。机位齐肩高，长焦镜头，浅景深。

【人物】年轻女子，鹅蛋脸，下颌线条柔和，下巴微尖，肌肤沐浴在温暖夜色中，泛着绸缎般光泽。深棕色眼眸，烟熏眼影，睫毛根根分明，眉毛平直英挺。双唇呈暗哑深红色，自然闭合，不带笑意。神情：平静、疏离、暗自警觉——宛如一位身手不凡的女剑客正在打量四周。身体正向前走去，头部越过肩膀回望，目光直视镜头，眼神清澈深邃，双眉平展。几缕黑色碎发自然垂落在额头与脸颊，被风吹拂，并不潮湿。

【发型/服饰】极长的黑发，半束半披，质感自然飘逸，发丝随夜风轻轻飘动，边缘被灯光勾勒出金色轮廓。素白游侠长袍，衣袖宽大，内搭深青黑色交领里衣，面料为哑光细织布，白色被暖光染成淡金。无首饰，无刺绣——低调内敛的雅致。长剑仅露出朴素的深色剑柄，缠着短绳。

【姿态】躯干朝向街道深处，双肩呈四分之三背影角度，重心前移，正处于迈步之中。仅头部与颈部回转，下巴保持水平，面庞越过肩膀直面镜头。双臂不作强调，长剑低垂于身后。脊柱至颈部的扭转连贯流畅。

【环境】古镇夜市：左侧木质店铺门面昏暗，顶部中央招牌模糊不清，成串的纸灯笼向右侧延伸，化作温暖的橙色光斑。远处街道与右下角笼罩在冷调蓝灰色阴影中，湿漉漉的石板泛着微光。无可辨识的文字。无其他行人。

【光影】所有光线均来自灯笼。右后方的一大片灯笼绽放出温暖的光球，为头发和肩膀镀上金边。较近的灯笼在左脸颊与下颌投下一道斜向暖光，面部其余部分则隐于冷蓝色阴影中——冷暖色调将面庞一分为二。背景左侧呈琥珀棕色，右侧为蓝灰色夜空。配色：灯笼琥珀色 #E8A04C，夜色蓝 #33455C，阴影棕 #241A14，长袍白 #E9DCC8，发丝黑 #14100E，唇红 #8E4A42，皮肤高光 #D9A37E。

【渲染】照片级真实电影感，无胶片颗粒的电影画质：肌肤细腻如缎，发丝自然飘逸且边缘带有高光反射，布料呈现哑光厚重质感。眼部与面部发丝清晰锐利；灯笼与街道融化为层次分明的散景光斑，空气中弥漫着淡淡的夜雾。

反向提示词：第二个人物，武器出鞘，可辨识文字，水印，logo，动漫，卡通，过度饱和，塑料感肌肤，多余肢体，居中构图，全身像，背景清晰对焦。

items.title: 樱花与纹理素材表
items.prompt:
在纯白背景上生成一张全面的素材表，整体划分为 7 个带编号的独立区域，标题使用浅灰色。风格为高分辨率数字水彩与肌理艺术。

Section 01（左上）：四种形态的粉色樱花枝条，分别标注为 'branch_01.png' 至 'branch_04.png'。应为细腻的水彩插画，深褐色枝干搭配柔和的粉色花瓣。

Section 02（右上）：约 30 片随机散落的樱花花瓣集合，标注为 'petals_transparent PNG'。在该组花瓣的右下角加入几朵完整的樱花。

Section 03（中左）：五个正方形蓝天纹理图块，标注为 'sky_01.png' 至 'sky_05.png'。画面应为蓝色背景上的白云，并呈现不同程度的半调网点图案或像素化噪点效果。

Section 04（中右）：十二个小型正方形纹理色卡，排列为两行、每行六个。标签包括 'dither_01-03'、'ink_red_01-02'、'ink_black_01-02'、'grunge_01-02' 和 'grain_01-03'。视觉效果应涵盖黑白抖动图案、红色墨迹飞溅以及米色纸张颗粒等。

Section 05（左下）：四个竖长矩形纸张纹理条，标注为 'paper_01.png' 至 'paper_04.png'。颜色分别为奶油色、浅灰色、深炭色和米白色，需清晰展现纤维细节。

items.title: 召唤仪式意外翻车
items.prompt:
请绘制一幅充满喜剧效果的画面：附图中的角色举行了一场盛大的召唤仪式，却意外召唤出了令人意想不到的东西。

[角色]
保留原有的面部特征、发型、基础配色和性格特点。根据当前场景调整表情与动作。

[召唤物]
不要照搬示例或候选物品，请为本次场景原创一个全新事物。要与宏大的仪式形成强烈反差，仅凭画面就能让人一眼看出召唤出了什么，并让观众忍不住吐槽“为什么要召唤这个？”。避免局限于与角色外貌或服装直接相关的物品，大胆尝试出人意料的组合。

[场景构图]
分别从不同角度确定召唤物及其大小与状态、角色的反应以及对周围环境的影响，然后将这些元素串联成一个逻辑通顺的完整事件。角色的反应不要只停留在“惊讶”上，要通过表情和肢体动作体现出他与召唤物之间的互动关系。

[表现手法]
让仪式过程显得真实且宏大，利用它与召唤物出现时的巨大落差来制造笑点。核心笑点只保留一个，通过道具和配角的布局来强化这一效果。不要依赖文字说明，要让角色、召唤物和反应在构图中一目了然。如果本次对话中已经生成过同一项目的图片，请勿重复使用之前的召唤物或笑点，需要另辟蹊径。

items.prompt:
创作一幅超写实、高细节的电影级人像，主角是一位美丽的年轻女性。她拥有温暖透亮的肌肤、富有表现力的榛棕色眼睛、自然的雀斑、柔软光泽的双唇，以及一头深棕色秀发，梳成随性优雅的盘发，几缕碎发散落脸庞两侧。她身穿一件奢华的黑色纹理露肩连衣裙，配有精致的细吊带，轻盈的薄纱面料自然垂落在双臂周围。身体微微侧转，面部直视镜头，神情自信而神秘。

采用戏剧性的电影级布光，温暖的橙金色高光映照在她脸部的一侧，另一侧则是冷调的烟熏蓝灰色光线。背景为暗调氛围感场景，弥漫着旋转的琥珀色烟雾与淡淡的薄雾，极具艺术纵深感。精致的面料细节、逼真的皮肤纹理、根根分明的发丝、自然的面部比例，专业时尚大片摄影风格，浅景深，85mm 人像镜头，HDR，超锐利对焦，丰富对比度，照片级真实感，8K 画质，4:5 竖版构图。

items.title: 太空图书馆三联对比
items.sub: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
items.prompt:
一张横向三联画对比图，深藏青色背景，被均分为三个垂直面板。每个面板展示一幅照片级逼真的 3D 渲染图，呈现奇幻的“太空图书馆”场景，以此体现提示词复杂度的差异。

左侧面板：底部以白色无衬线字体标注“5 WORDS”。画面为远景外观镜头，展现一座宏伟华丽的图书馆建筑漂浮在深邃太空中。建筑顶部是巨大的玻璃穹顶，内部可见星系景象，四周环绕着星云与繁星，下方如水面般的材质上映出倒影。

中间面板：底部标注“25 WORDS”。画面为室内视角，透过巨大的弧形窗户向外望去，可见一颗带光环的巨型行星（形似土星）。室内墙壁旁排列着高大的木质书架，摆放着一张舒适的皮质扶手椅、一张带台灯的小桌，光洁的地板上铺着一块花纹地毯。

右侧面板：底部标注“100 WORDS”。画面为室内细节特写，呈现一张木桌，桌上放着一本翻开的书、一盏黄铜银行家台灯和一个地球仪。后方是巨大的拱形窗户，窗外同样是那颗带光环的行星与星空，温暖的灯光与冷蓝色的太空背景形成鲜明对比。

items.title: 水循环科普海报设计
items.sub: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
items.prompt:
两个纵向相连的圆角矩形面板由极粗、略带起伏的黑色手绘轮廓线锚定，白色卡扣横跨面板边缘，构成醒目的成对模块与清晰的纵向节奏。内容依托格式塔邻近性与版面分区进行组织，每个面板内部划分为稳定的左图右文双栏，左右视觉比重均衡，标题与信息在右栏自上而下阅读；整体视觉重心落在两块面板的交界处及各自醒目的大标题上，页眉区域保持独立，放置 logo 与主标题。图文通过并置与衬底相互衔接：左侧预留给角色或主题插画，置于不规则的圆角浅色干净底座之上；右侧以醒目的大字引领多行说明文字，并在文本旁搭配小型线描符号以提示内容。文字层级始终分明，大标题粗重醒目，说明文字较细且行距宽松，小字与符号形成节奏点；字形结构端正易读，字怀清晰、收笔利落、字面紧凑，与手绘图像相得益彰，无论文字多少均维持该层级；文字不足时，则根据主题补充次要小字。文本边缘平整清晰，在手绘线条之外形成干净的排版层。留白涵盖面板间距、图像底座周围的衬底留白、文本行间的阅读间隙以及页眉与正文之间的停顿；各处均保持宽裕，使粗边框、插画与标题得以清晰凸显。插画内容由所附主题提供，在左栏内采用完整、集中、略微倾斜的手绘构图，主体轮廓简洁，动态细节轻盈，承重部位端正；内容密度约占半幅画面，主要集中在各面板的左栏，其余部分为白色或浅色圆角底座、平整的面板色块及底部留白，不生成任何场景。采用复合技法：以连贯、略带抖动的粗黑线条勾勒边框与角色；以干净平滑的数字平涂铺展大面积面板与局部插画色彩；以利落的文字排版压住信息区；整体呈现出由手绘线条、电脑平涂与清晰排版合成的插画编排效果。配色保持高明度基调，色彩鲜活、饱和而不刺眼，最浓烈的色面落在成对面板内，并与角色局部色彩相呼应；暖调浅色背景与不同明度的浅色色面相互搭配，以强烈的黑白线文对比稳定层次。整体温暖明快、亲切有活力，宛如哑光数字色块与密集马克笔线条的结合；色调随主题变化，但明暗、粗细、饱和度、偏暖倾向以及欢快亲切的心理感受不受主题影响，始终保持这一性格。整体气质轻盈、友好且有序。所附主题、准确文案、用途与宽高比优先；上下面板分组、左图右文、粗黑手绘边框、图像衬底、清晰的文字层级以及高明度暖厚配色方案保持不变。

items.title: 动漫吉祥物版清水寺旅游 LP
items.sub: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
items.prompt:
目标：为京都清水寺打造一个内容丰富、信息密集的竖版旅游落地页（LP）。
画布：竖版比例（约 4:5），采用动漫插画与写实摄影的活力混搭风格，以干净的白色为背景，点缀橙色和紫色的笔触。
布局：
1. 头部导航：顶部导航栏左侧为 Logo“あぽろ塾 APOLLO JUKU”，中间为菜单项（Search、Model Course、Spot、Gourmet、Access），右侧为橙色 CTA 按钮“今すぐ旅に出る”。
2. 首屏区域（Hero Section）：大标题“清水寺 Kiyomizu-dera”使用粗体黑色衬线字体。副标题为“京都・東山の絶景と歴史をめぐる”。画面中央是一位动漫角色（橙色头发、猫耳、印有“KYOTO”字样的街头风外套）手指向右方，身旁伴有一只燕尾服猫。背景是京都红叶与古塔交相辉映的全景图。悬浮的手写文字：“見たことのない京都に、きっと出会える。”和“ここにしかない景色がある。”。地点信息区块：“京都・東山”、“早朝散策がおすすめ”、“春は桜、秋は紅葉が人気”。世界遗产徽章及坐标“34.9945, 135.7843”。
3. 亮点区域（“見どころ”）：横向可滑动卡片，展示“清水の舞台”、“音羽の滝”、“三年坂・二年坂”、“京都の街並みを一望”、“世界遺産”的照片。每张卡片包含一张照片、标题和简短描述。
4. 应用与功能区域：左侧是一部智能手机样机，屏幕显示地图应用界面，标注了清水寺、音羽瀑布等地点的图钉。中间一列列出“アプリの主な機能”（App 主要功能）并配有图标：Spot Search、Model Course、Favorites、Offline Map。右侧为“モデルコース”（推荐路线），用编号步骤 01-04 展示路线缩略图。
5. 季节推荐区域（“おすすめの季節”）：四个鲜明的季节区块（春、夏、秋、冬），分别配有对应的风景照片和简短的文字描述。
6. 交通指南区域（“アクセス”）：右下方区域列出交通方式（电车、公交、自驾），并标明具体车站名称和步行时间。包含一个小小的古塔剪影和“Kyoto”字样。
视觉风格：现代日式网页设计美学。色彩丰富的动漫吉祥物与宁静写实的摄影作品形成强烈对比。使用橙色（约 #FF5722）和紫色作为点缀色。正文采用干净的无衬线字体，标题则使用优雅的衬线字体。
文本内容：请完全按照图片所示保留所有日文文本，包括“見どころ”、“モデルコース”、“アクセス”等版块标题以及具体的地名。

items.title: 照片七重纹理双联画
items.sub: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
items.prompt:
为每张上传的照片生成一张 3:4 竖版双联画，上下两半等分且无缝衔接。无需分隔线、边框或拼贴效果。整体风格融合瑞士平面设计、实验摄影与复古印刷美学。

上半部分 —— 原始照片
完整保留原图的人物特征、姿态、场景、构图、透视、光影与色彩。仅允许进行细微的调色和背景延展。不添加任何文字。

下半部分 —— 七个实验性纹理区域
完整重复一次原图。在图像像素上直接叠加七个大小不一的非对称矩形区域，可覆盖非关键细节。确保每个区域内外的视觉连贯性。严禁对图像进行裁剪、缩放、位移、复制或重绘。务必保留所有重要的视觉焦点。

七种编号技法

01. Reeded Glass（竖纹玻璃）：垂直光学折射效果。

02. Black-and-White Engraving（黑白雕版）：精细蚀刻线条与交叉排线。

03. American Stipple（美式点刻）：黑白微点纹理。

04. Vintage Halftone（复古半调）：CMYK 印刷网点。

05. Pixel Mosaic（像素马赛克）：方形像素块。

06. Transparent Overlay（透明叠层）：2–4 层半透明叠加。

07. Duotone Screen Print（双色调丝网印）：双色丝网印刷效果。

设计细节
添加极细边框、微小角标方块以及精细指引线，以标示各个矩形区域。为每种技法标注对应的编号与英文名称。七个区域之外的画面须保持真实的摄影质感。

严格要求
不得出现 logo、水印、多余图片或无谓的装饰元素。维护原图的完整性，呈现干净、高级的杂志排版风格。

输出：一张高清 3:4 竖版海报，上下两半等分。

items.prompt:

items.title: 赛博舞台角色概念设定图
items.sub: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
items.prompt:
为 {argument name="character name" default="Cyber Stage Yuna"} 创建一份详尽的角色概念设定图，采用未来感偶像战士的设计风格。版面布局需包含以下内容：

1. **主立绘**：角色全身插画，身着精致的赛博朋克舞台装，融入全息元素、水晶配饰与飘逸的布料点缀。
2. **服装展示**：多角度视图（正面、侧面、背面），全方位呈现服装设计细节。
3. **表情集**：九种面部表情，包括咧嘴笑、自信、科技达人范、舞台突发状况、严肃、坚定、眨眼、喜悦和坏笑。
4. **细节特写**：局部放大展示靴子与领口、肩甲、背部细节、眼部细节以及发型细节。
5. **材质与纹理**：色卡展示全息银、珍珠白网纱、电光蓝水晶以及霓虹紫点缀效果。
6. **配饰与武器**：展示光环头冠、水晶长枪变体、全息披风及声波耳麦。
7. **战斗姿态**：剪影插画，展现充满张力的动态动作姿势。
8. **武器特效**：攻击动画演示，包括破晓斩击、穿刺突刺以及终极数字和声特效。
9. **概念总览**：核心元素板块，包含配色色卡与主题图标。
10. **风格备注**：文字描述着重突出未来感光效、舞台偶像张力，以及科技与梦幻交织的美学氛围。
11. **角色简介**：定位为偶像/治疗者，属性为水/数字，性格自信且极具标志性。
12. **专属台词**：“当旋律化作你的利刃，连潮汐也将为你臣服。”

整体视觉美学应将赛博朋克科技与空灵奇幻元素完美融合，配色以深蓝、紫色、银色为主调，并辅以发光点缀效果。图中需包含五星评级标识，且全程保持专业游戏美术文档的制作标准。

items.title: 东方茶商业海报设计
items.prompt:
输出一张 4:5 竖版商业海报，不要拼贴，不要多宫格。使用原创虚构品牌，不得模仿现有品牌的包装、标志或广告。文字仅限提示词中明确列出的品牌名、主标题和品类；不得添加价格、奖项、参数、日期、产地或宣传语。画面完成度须达到可供创意总监审核的标准：结构写实、材质可信、排版清晰、无水印。

主题：东方茶品鉴样品。原创品牌“岚虚”，产品“岩茶”（Yancha），主标题“山田入盏”。

一张暖白色宣纸长卷自底部向上折叠为三折高度不一的页面，形似抽象山脊，同时保留真实纸张的厚度、纤维与折痕。最底层放置一把深褐色小茶壶，中层放置一只白瓷茶杯，最高层仅放几片干岩茶叶；物体比例写实且互不重叠。

核心构图：“折页相连—山路层叠—茶烟贯通”。一缕琥珀色茶烟自壶嘴升起，沿着连接茶杯的折叠山路蜿蜒而行，宛如克制的写意水墨笔触，带有局部浓淡变化，但不构成具体文字或龙凤图案。主标题“山田入盏”以现代宋体在右侧留白处竖向排列，顶部小字“岚虚”，底部小字“岩茶”。配色方案：暖白、岩褐、茶汤琥珀色及极少量墨黑。

画面中不得出现人物、古装、真实茶室场景、满屏风景、大幅书法、金色边框、禅意陈词滥调、复杂包装或多图拼贴。

items.title: 矿泉水轮廓折射海报
items.prompt:
制作一张 4:5 竖版、完成度极高的瓶装矿泉水宣传海报。以“等高线折射谷”作为唯一核心构图，采用略微俯视的垂直视角。一个无标签、结构简约的透明玻璃水瓶竖直立于画面中下方，瓶盖为雾银色金属材质。整个背景铺满极细、等距且连续的冰蓝色水平等高线。线条在靠近瓶身处向内凹陷，形成被瓶身重量压出的柔和峡谷，向远处延伸后恢复平直。线条不得断裂、交叉或产生杂乱的波纹。

水瓶并非悬浮的抠图素材，底部需真实压在浅灰蓝色的矿物表面上，瓶身与线条场处于同一空间。只有透过瓶内清水看到的等高线才会发生真实的折射、轻微放大和水平位移，外部线条保持精准连续。左侧凝结少量自然水珠，右侧带有清晰的高光边缘。整体质感对标高端饮用水广告摄影，杜绝塑料感的 CGI 效果。

将窄体无衬线大标题“{argument name="title" default="FLOW"}”置于上方安静的留白区域，字间距拉宽，颜色为深海军蓝。标题下方仅保留小字“{argument name="subtitle" default="MINERAL WATER"}”。文字不得嵌入瓶身，也不能与线条争夺视觉中心。色彩严格限制在冰蓝、雾白、深海军蓝及少许银色之间。

使用柔和的顶部天光与左后方轮廓光，让瓶身通透而不隐形。整体氛围精准、利落、极简，呈现当代编辑设计风格。采用全不透明的矩形背景覆盖整个画布，不得出现透明像素、黑角、Alpha 蒙版、边缘羽化或不规则裁切。禁止加入山景照片、人物、悬浮水花、冗余文案、现有品牌 Logo 或水印。

items.title: 灯光投影海报
items.prompt:
创作一张 4:5 竖版高端台灯宣传海报。核心构图采用“光束字母槽”设计。画面左下方放置一盏极简金属台灯，灯杆纤细，搭配哑光深红色半圆柱形灯罩，逼真的电源线沿桌面自然延伸。灯头向右上方投射出暖白色锥形光束，光斑边缘清晰但不过于锐利。

四块深靛蓝色哑光薄板在画面中央等距垂直排列。薄板本身不印任何文字；只有当光束穿过四块板上精确的镂空切口时，后方暖灰色墙面上的投影才会拼出完整的单词“{argument name="word" default="BEAM"}”。每个字母均由光线投射而成，而非贴在墙上的普通发光字体。光束穿过不同切口后，宽度会产生细微变化，并呈现真实的柔和边缘。薄板边缘的高光需克制处理，表面保留清晰的投影方向感。

除标题外，仅在右下角添加小字信息“{argument name="subtitle" default="ARC LAMP / LIGHT SHAPED BY FORM"}”。不使用任何图标、参数卡片或装饰线条。色彩严格限定为深靛蓝、哑光红、暖灰与暖白光。

整体呈现静谧的室内夜景摄影质感。台灯材质需逼真写实。光学关系必须严谨：光源、镂空切口与墙面投影须处于同一直线上。构图简洁且富有空间纵深感。背景为覆盖整个画布的不透明矩形，无透明像素、无黑角、无 Alpha 蒙版、无边缘羽化。不得出现霓虹灯牌、舞台烟雾、赛博朋克元素、人物、现有品牌 Logo 或水印。

items.prompt:
目标：为《电锯人》中的 {argument name="character name" default="Makima"} 创建详细的动漫角色设计表和服装分解。
画布：垂直肖像布局，背景为略带纹理的米白色纸张。风格简洁、专业，类似概念艺术参考页。
布局：角色全身插图位于中心。周围环绕着带有线条草图和中英文描述文本的标注部分。细红线将她的服装特定部位连接到相应的细节框。
主体细节：Makima 自信地站立，身穿黑色长尾外套，内搭挺括的白色纽扣衬衫，系着细黑领带，穿着高腰黑色长裤和擦亮的黑色皮鞋。她留着齐肩的红棕色头发，有直刘海和两缕垂在脸侧的发辫。她的眼睛是金黄色的，具有明显的同心圆环。
部分：
- 左上角：标题 "真纪真 MAKIMA" 和副标题 "角色设定 · 服饰解析 / CHARACTER SETTING · COSTUME BREAKDOWN"。下方有一句引言："人类……终极的滋味是绝望。"
- 左列（从上到下）：五个矩形面板，详细说明服装单品：衬衫（白色长袖）、领带（黑色窄款）、西装外套（黑色长尾）、西装裤（高腰）、皮鞋（黑色）。每个面板包含该单品的草图和双语描述。
- 右列（从上到下）：六个面板，详细说明特征：档案（隶属：公安对魔特异课，身份：支配恶魔，能力：支配）；发型（红发，脑后编成单股辫）；瞳色（深邃的金黄色眼睛）；武器/锁链（由支配之力具现化的锁链）；历史参考（灵感源自中世纪锁链和手铐）；配饰（极简主义风格）。
- 左下角：一个名为 "Historical Reference" 的部分，展示三张穿职业装女性的照片小图，参考昭和时代的美学风格。
- 底部中央：Logo "チェンソーマン CHAINSAW MAN"。
- 右下角：最后两个面板：道具（带印章的合同文件）和配色方案（红色、米色、白色、黑色、金色的色块）。下方是一个关键词部分，列出：Control, Rationality, Calm, Mystery, Danger。
视觉风格：高质量数字插画与技术图表美学相结合。英文文本使用衬线字体，中文标签使用标准无衬线字体。

items.title: 尼莫点信息图
items.sub: 信息图 / 教育视觉图
items.prompt:
目标：创建一张教育性信息图，解释 {argument name="topic" default="尼莫点，地球上位于海洋中的最偏远地点"}。

画布：垂直肖像布局，采用深海军蓝背景，顶部带有微妙的星空夜空纹理。风格简洁、现代且信息丰富，使用金色和白色文字以确保高对比度。

布局：
1. **标题：** 大号衬线字体标题 "THE MOST REMOTE PLACE ON EARTH IS IN THE OCEAN"（其中 "IN THE OCEAN" 以浅蓝色高亮显示）。下方是一个简短的介绍段落，将尼莫点定义为距离陆地最远的位置，并提及距离为 2,688 km (1,671 miles)。
2. **中心地图：** 以南太平洋为中心的风格化世界地图。大陆以柔和的大地色调（绿色、棕色）渲染，与深蓝色海洋形成对比。标签包括 NORTH AMERICA, SOUTH AMERICA, EUROPE, ASIA, AFRICA, AUSTRALIA 和 ANTARCTICA。
3. **数据可视化：** 一个明亮的黄色圆点在复活节岛南部的海洋中标记出 "POINT NEMO"。三条虚线黄色箭头从该点辐射至最近的陆地，并标注了距离：到南极洲 "2,688 km (1,671 miles)"，到南美洲 "2,754 km (1,711 miles)"，到澳大利亚 "2,966 km (1,843 miles)"。
4. **信息框（左侧）：** 一个包含指南针图标的矩形框，内含坐标 "48°52.6'S 123°23.6'W" 和昵称 "oceanic pole of inaccessibility"。
5. **底部部分：** 标题为 "WHY IS IT INTERESTING?" 的部分，包含三列带有图标和文本的内容：
   - 图标：卫星天线。文本："它是距离任何陆地最远的点，使其成为地球上最孤立的地方。"
   - 图标：空间站/卫星。文本："航天器和国际空间站将其用作重新进入大气层或投放物体的最安全地点。"
   - 图标：船只。文本："它如此偏远，以至于最近的人类通常是宇航员——而不是水手。"
6. **页脚：** 地球图标旁边的结语："尼莫点向我们展示，即使在我们探索充分的星球上，也有比陆地上任何地方都更偏远的地方。"

视觉风格：专业信息图设计。正文使用清晰的无衬线字体，标题使用衬线字体。确保地图投影清晰地突出中心点的孤立性。

items.title: 初音白底超大道具照
items.prompt:
{argument name="character" default="Hatsune Miku"} 成人化写实版本，真人实拍角色摄影，古怪可爱氛围 x 冷面幽默 x 极简白色背景产品照构图。

保留 [Character] 最核心的身份识别特征：发型轮廓、发色、眼睛主色调、面部特征、角色主色、标志性配饰、服装轮廓、头饰、耳朵/角/尾巴/面部符号以及其他关键视觉锚点。整体并非普通的 Cosplay 摆拍，而是将 [Character] 转化为一张极简、干净、荒诞且带有轻微商业感的肖像产品照。人物必须明显是成年人。

人物位于画面中下部，展示半身或四分之三身，面向镜头或略微侧身，单手或双手持握 [Prop]。如果 [Prop] 适合饮用、拥抱、展示、举起、咬住、拿持或倚靠，让 [Character] 与 [Prop] 形成简单、直接、一眼可懂的互动动作。动作要少，但必须清晰，例如：高举、捧持、递向镜头、吸吸管、拥抱、背负、支撑、举至胸前、倚靠面部。重点在于“角色认真地与物品互动”，以此产生幽默感。

[Prop] 占据画面较大比例，接近人物头部或上半身的尺寸，形成超大道具互动效果。道具材质清晰，形状完整，轮廓分明，视觉上成为与人物并列的重要主体。人物与道具的关系应简单、直接、可爱且略带荒诞。

人物表情以冷面（Deadpan）为核心：眼神略显空洞、冷淡、呆滞、轻微疲惫或严肃，仿佛极其认真地做着非常普通的事情。没有夸张的大笑，没有强烈的戏剧性表演。整体氛围为尴尬可爱、柔和荒诞、可爱的商业形象。

构图采用：
底部重心构图 x 大面积留白。
人物和道具集中在画面下方或中下部，上方保留大量纯白空间。背景为白色或极浅灰白色的无缝影棚背景布，极简空间，类似产品广告或角色周边海报。

摄影采用：
高调产品摄影 x 柔和影棚灯光 x 极简影棚肖像。
柔和的前向漫射光，略带影棚感，明亮、干净、阴影极淡。人物皮肤、衣物、头发、配饰与 [Prop] 之间的材质差异必须清晰：布料、金属、塑料、玻璃、纸张、液体、食物等，都应具有明显的质感。

整体视觉要求：
极简，
干净，
大留白，
人物居中偏下，
超大道具比例，
简单清晰的动作，
幽默感源自表情与道具比例，
像高端但轻松的角色广告。

成像清晰，现代商业摄影品质，但非奢华时尚大片，而是更简洁、轻松，如同“角色拿着大物件拍摄产品照”。最终效果类似极简白底真人角色海报：一个写实的 [Character] 站在纯白背景前，认真手持超大 [Prop]，神情呆滞，动作简单，画面大面积留白，笑点直接，外观既可爱又荒诞。

竖版格式。
右下角仅有极小的 "voxcat" 签名，无其他文字。

items.title: 稚拙画风角色扭打
items.prompt:
[角色 A] 和 [角色 B]，新天真绘画 × 局外人艺术 × 原始具象绘画 × 儿童绘画风格的角色转译。

两个角色由少量不规则的几何色块构成，仅保留其最强烈的身份标识：主色调、头部轮廓、发型或耳朵、眼睛、代表性服装色块、标志性配饰。

两人正在激烈但滑稽地打斗，身体紧贴并纠缠在一起。根据角色随机设计动作，如抓脸、推头、拥抱、拉扯、扇耳光、压制或互相扑倒；手部接触清晰，肢体交叉，重心失衡，使打斗关系一目了然。

幼稚且不准确的人体解剖结构：细长的躯干，僵硬笔直的四肢，比例失调，头部倾斜，夸张的手脚，错误的透视。面部特征压缩成几个粗糙的色块，表情愤怒、震惊、龇牙咧嘴、尖叫或委屈，具有荒诞的喜剧感。

粗糙的不透明颜料平涂，干笔痕迹，边缘磨损，填充不均，颤抖的手绘轮廓，局部底色暴露；身体和服装直接以平涂色块表现。

暖灰白色或米白色纸张背景，大面积留白。两个角色位于中心，相互纠缠形成紧凑的动作团，画面专注于表达角色之间的关系。

就像一个未经训练的人凭记忆快速画出的打斗瞬间：原始、笨拙、直接、荒诞、可爱。

竖版格式，右下角有极小的 "voxcat" 签名。

格式锁定 — 不可协商
垂直 3:4 宽高比。
全身产品构图。
所有人仔必须从头到脚完全可见。
不要生成方形、横向、宽屏、特写、裁剪或半身构图。

人数锁定 — 不可协商
检测上传图片中所有可见人物。

参考图像中可见的每个人都必须作为独立的 LEGO 风格人仔出现。

参考锁定 — 不可协商

items.title: 暗黑哥特魔女海报
items.prompt: A dark fantasy gothic poster in a vertical composition, painted in a highly detailed anime-inspired style with dramatic lighting and rich texture. At the center is a beautiful young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair, pale skin, and an elegant, calm but dangerous presence. Her face is mostly obscured in shadow and mystery. She wears an ornate black-and-deep-blue crystalline dress with lace, feathered and jagged organic details, semi-transparent flowing sleeves, and glowing blue highlights across the bodice and collar, as if infused with magic. Her right hand is raised slightly with an open gesture, while her left hand rests lower near her waist. Surrounding and partly growing from her are luminous blue butterflies and shard-like petals, creating a sense of transformation and corruption. Behind her looms a gigantic monstrous entity made of darkness, ink, smoke, and cosmic texture, with exactly 7 glowing blue eyes visible and a huge fanged grin packed with sharp icy-blue teeth. The creature feels Lovecraftian, predatory, and intimate, curling around her like a guardian, curse, or inner demon. The palette is dominated by black, midnight navy, indigo, and electric blue, with sparkling highlights like stars or wet paint splatter. Add a decorative antique silver filigree border in all 4 corners and along the edges, making it feel like a sinister book cover or exhibition poster. Place large Japanese title text at the top: {argument name="title text" default="私の中のバケモノ"}. Add 8 blocks of vertical Japanese copy around the figure, 4 on the left and 4 on the right, in elegant white Mincho-style type. Left side text blocks, top to bottom: 「創造の源、すべてを壊し、すべてを生む。」, 「正しさよりも、心が動く瞬間を信じる。」, 「美しいものに飢えている。」, 「静けさの中で、世界をかき混ぜる。」. Right side text blocks, top to bottom: 「感情を深く、人の痛みも、希望も、まるごと抱きしめる。」, 「枠を壊し、誰も見たことのない景色を描きたい。」, 「怖い、危ない、それでも止められない。」, plus a short atmospheric handwritten-style accent near the mid-right edge. At the lower center, add a large Japanese question line: {argument name="bottom question" default="これは、力？それとも、呪い？"}. At the very bottom, add a smaller Japanese line: {argument name="tagline text" default="私の中のバケモノは、私だけの物語を待っている。"}. Make the whole image feel obsessive, beautiful, unsettling, and emotionally intense, like a high-end dark art poster about inner monsters and creative power.

items.title: Japanese Elephant Day Magazine Feature
items.titleZh: Create a soft, elegant Japanese lifestyle magazine editorial page in a warm bota…
items.prompt: Create a soft, elegant Japanese lifestyle magazine editorial page in a warm botanical watercolor style, formatted as a full-page A4 portrait layout with a cream paper background, thin beige border, muted sage-green accents, and a refined nature-themed design. The page is a single cohesive magazine spread design with 6 distinct content sections: 1 large main illustration panel on the left, 1 tall title-and-article column on the upper right, 3 stacked informational point boxes on the mid-to-lower right, 2 small photo-card style image panels along the lower left, 1 circular quote badge near the lower left of the main panel, and 1 summary box at the lower right. The theme is elephant appreciation day in Japan. At the top left, place small editorial header text reading "LIFESTYLE / FEATURE / TOPIC" with a short Japanese subtitle beneath it. Across the upper right, add the large date heading "4.28 EVENT" and the main Japanese headline "象の日特集" in an elegant serif style, with a short subheading line beneath it and a tiny elephant icon. Below that, set 3 short Japanese body paragraphs in a clean magazine column, explaining elephant day. The main illustration panel shows a gentle elephant standing on the left, rendered in delicate watercolor with realistic wrinkles, large ears, soft ivory-gray skin, and a lowered trunk reaching toward a small child standing beside it. The child is an androgynous anime-style boy with messy wavy dark purple-black hair, pale skin, large eyes, a black graphic T-shirt with a purple emblem, loose brown knee-length cargo shorts, and bare feet, standing casually with one hand in a pocket while touching the elephant’s trunk with the other. Behind them is a sunny zoo walkway with a wooden fence, soft green trees, dappled light, and leafy branches hanging from above. Near the elephant, include a small wooden sign reading "Elephant 4.28". Add a circular text badge in Japanese near the lower left of the main image. On the lower left area, place exactly 2 small bordered snapshot-style panels with taped-corner scrapbook presentation: the first labeled "Feeding Time" showing the child in side profile offering leaves to the elephant’s trunk across a fence; the second labeled "Peaceful Time" showing the child seated on a wooden bench in profile with elephants in the background, in a calm reflective scene. Each small panel has a short Japanese caption underneath. On the right side, stack exactly 3 informational boxes labeled "POINT 01", "POINT 02", and "POINT 03" in olive green circles, each with a simple line icon and Japanese text: box 1 features an elephant icon and discusses memory, box 2 features a trunk or elephant-face icon and discusses delicacy despite size, box 3 features a zoo building icon and discusses what can be learned at the zoo. At the bottom right, add 1 bordered summary box with a ribbon-like header reading "まとめ", a small elephant silhouette, and 2 short Japanese summary paragraphs. Along the bottom margin, include the page number "068", the date "APRIL 2025", and a row of small walking elephant silhouettes. Add subtle botanical flourishes, leaves, and light decorative strokes throughout. Overall mood: gentle, educational, heartwarming, airy, natural, child-friendly, and sophisticated, like a premium seasonal magazine feature.

items.promptZh: 柔和的灯光背景上的干净 2x2 概念实体模型信息图，显示四个独立的浮动等距立体模型图块，以精美的 3D 插图风格拟人化 {argument name="theme" default="science"} 的分支，具有柔和的渐变、光泽材质、柔和的环境照明、微妙的阴影、圆形的未来主义形式和高细节。左上：BIOLOGY，一座郁郁葱葱的生物实验室岛，拥有大型中央 DNA 双螺旋塔、弧形玻璃温室建筑、螺旋楼梯、分层有机通道、绿化、植物床和流体生物形态结构； “BIOLOGY”一词集成在平台的前端。该图块周围有 4 个与生物学相关的小图标：显微镜、DNA 符号、发芽植物和圆形细胞或培养皿符号。右上：PHYSICS，冷蓝色调的高科技能源实验室瓷砖，中央发光平台，圆形加速环，铜质电磁线圈，通往核心的楼梯，带有波形图形的监视器屏幕，以及标有“PHYSICS”的未来工业基地；添加 4 个周围的物理主题图标：原子、马蹄形磁铁、闪电和折线图波形。左下：CHEMISTRY，一种紫色和银色的模块化分子研究结构，由球棒晶格框架、实验室柱、烧杯、烧瓶和发光的晶体核心组成；该平台在两个可见侧面上显着地写着“CHEMISTRY”。该图块周围有 4 个与化学相关的图标：两个分子图、一对实验室试管或烧瓶以及一个小燃烧器。右下：天文台，一座岩石月球观测台岛，地形布满陨石坑，有一个圆顶天文台、一台望远镜、刻在岩石上的楼梯，后面还有一个圆形的宇宙星空背景；前沿写着“天文”。围绕这块图块的是 4 个天文学主题的图标：一个有环的行星、火花状的星星、一个小火箭和一个新月。将所有 4 个图块均匀分布在一个象限布局中，每个图块都有自己柔和的几何背景形状、按学科调整的有凝聚力的柔和调色板以及优质的 gpt-image-2 风格，使每个概念感觉就像一个可收藏的微型世界。除了四个学科标签之外，没有人，没有额外的文字。
items.prompt: A clean 2x2 conceptual entity model infographic on a soft light background, showing four separate floating isometric diorama tiles that personify branches of {argument name="theme" default="science"} in a polished 3D illustration style with pastel gradients, glossy materials, soft ambient lighting, subtle shadows, rounded futuristic forms, and high detail. Top left: BIOLOGY, a lush bio-lab island with a large central DNA double helix tower, curved glass greenhouse architecture, spiral stairways, layered organic pathways, greenery, plant beds, and fluid biomorphic structures; the word "BIOLOGY" is integrated on the front edge of the platform. Surrounding this tile are 4 small biology-related icons: a microscope, a DNA symbol, a sprouting plant, and a circular cell or petri-dish symbol. Top right: PHYSICS, a high-tech energy laboratory tile in cool blue tones with a central glowing platform, circular accelerator rings, copper-like electromagnetic coils, stairs leading up to the core, a monitor screen with waveform graphics, and a futuristic industrial base labeled "PHYSICS"; add 4 surrounding physics-themed icons: an atom, a horseshoe magnet, a lightning bolt, and a line graph waveform. Bottom left: CHEMISTRY, a modular molecular research structure in purple and silver, built from spheres-and-rods lattice frameworks, lab columns, beakers, flasks, and a glowing crystalline core; the platform prominently reads "CHEMISTRY" on two visible sides. Surrounding this tile are 4 chemistry-related icons: two molecular diagrams, a pair of lab test tubes or flasks, and a small burner. Bottom right: ASTRONOMY, a rocky lunar observatory island with cratered terrain, a dome observatory, a telescope, stairs carved into the rock, and a circular cosmic starfield backdrop behind it; the front edge reads "ASTRONOMY". Surrounding this tile are 4 astronomy-themed icons: a ringed planet, spark-like stars, a small rocket, and a crescent moon. Keep all 4 tiles evenly spaced in a quadrant layout, each with its own muted geometric backdrop shape, cohesive pastel palette tuned per discipline, and a premium gpt-image-2 style that makes each concept feel like a collectible miniature world. No people, no extra text beyond the four discipline labels.

items.title: Childlike Crayon Portrait on Paper
items.promptZh: 一张逼真的俯视照片，上面是一张童趣的蜡笔，在一张放在木桌面上的略带皱纹的白纸上画画。图中是一张朴素的小学风格的{argument name="character" default="Donald Trump"}肖像，凌乱的黄色蜡笔头发，桃色的皮肤，大耳朵，蓝色西装外套，白色衬衫领子和红色领带。脸部朝前，占据了大部分页面，一只举起的手在纸的左侧做出了伸出中指的粗鲁手势。线条是不均匀的黑色铅笔或蜡笔轮廓，色彩粗糙、潦草、故意笨拙，线条之外有明显的童趣笔触。页面右侧有黑色竖排手写日文，内容为{argument name="side text" default="とらんぷさん"}。该构图是智能手机的偷拍快照，而不是干净的扫描，显示了整张纸、轻微的透视变形、柔和的室内灯光以及页面周围木质表面的纹理。强调正宗的手工蜡笔质感、尴尬的比例以及令人信服的“坏但迷人”的儿童艺术审美。
items.prompt: A realistic overhead photo of a childlike crayon drawing on a slightly wrinkled white sheet of paper placed on a wooden tabletop. The drawing shows a simple portrait of {argument name="character" default="Donald Trump"} in a naive elementary-school style, with messy yellow crayon hair, peach-colored skin, large ears, a blue suit jacket, white shirt collar, and a red necktie. The face is front-facing and fills most of the page, with one raised hand on the left side of the paper making a rude gesture with the middle finger extended. The linework is uneven black pencil or crayon outline, and the coloring is rough, scribbly, and intentionally clumsy, with visible childlike strokes that go outside the lines. On the right side of the page, there is vertical handwritten Japanese text in black that reads {argument name="side text" default="とらんぷさん"}. The composition is a candid smartphone snapshot, not a clean scan, showing the entire sheet of paper, slight perspective distortion, soft indoor lighting, and the texture of the wooden surface around the page. Emphasize the authentic handmade crayon texture, awkward proportions, and convincing “bad but charming” children’s artwork aesthetic.

Snowflakes of many sizes are falling across the entire image, with some large soft blurred flakes close to the lens and many smaller sharp flakes scattered deeper in the scene, creating a dreamy atmospheric depth. At the very bottom edge, faint silhouettes of shorter winter trees and a subtle warm amber streetlight glow appear near the lower right, while the rest of the image stays cold, muted, and dim like dusk or early evening. Across the center, overlay large emotionally expressive Japanese handwritten brush-pen style text in white, slightly uneven and natural, reading {argument name="quote" default="また、この季節がやってくる。"}, with a human handwritten feel, soft edges, moderate stroke variation, and casual line breaks spread over the middle of the sky. Emphasize melancholic nostalgia, poetic Japanese winter atmosphere, cinematic minimalism, realistic photography, and authentic hand-drawn lettering integrated cleanly over the snowfall.

items.promptZh: 全身奇幻动漫风格插图，描绘了一位迷人的年轻偶像般的女性在宏伟的巴洛克宫殿大厅内华丽的镀金舞台上表演。她以戏剧性的低角度姿势站在雕花的金色阳台或平台上，一条腿向前，稍微交叉，左臂以强烈的透视方式伸向观众，另一只手轻轻地放在胸前。她身材苗条、优雅，长长的深棕色头发在空中飘逸，戴着装饰性花卉和丝带头饰。她的表情应该充满自信、戏剧性和迷人。她穿着一件精致的褶边表演连衣裙，颜色为{argument name="dress Colors" default="宝蓝色、深红色、白色和金色"}：合身的紧身胸衣，带有金色镶边和红色前幅、白色蕾丝胸围和袖子、分层荷叶边短裙、宽大的漩涡罩裙和斗篷式织物镶片，镶有金色刺绣，在她周围戏剧性地翻滚。添加华丽的脚踝配饰，搭配相配的丝带花朵、白色高跟鞋或短靴，以及奢华细致的面料纹理。背景是一个装饰华丽的内部空间，左边有一扇发光的哥特式拱形窗户，顶部和左侧有一张厚重的深红色天鹅绒窗帘，右墙上有一幅华丽画框的大型古典油画，她身后有一根高高的雕刻柱，左下角有一朵丰富的玫瑰和浅色花朵，前景有一根镀金栏杆。温暖的金色背光透过彩色玻璃般的窗户，营造出明亮的光环、柔和的薄雾、头发和服装上的边缘光以及深邃的电影阴影。几片玫瑰花瓣飘散在空中。高度细致、超精致、浪漫、雄伟、动感的构图、丰富的纹理、绘画般的动漫插画、逼真的灯光和奢华的幻想偶像美学。
items.prompt: A full-body fantasy anime-style illustration of a glamorous young idol-like woman performing on an ornate gilded stage inside a grand baroque palace hall. She stands in a dramatic low-angle pose on a carved gold balcony or platform, one leg forward and slightly crossed, with her left arm thrust toward the viewer in strong foreshortening and her other hand resting lightly at her chest. She has a slim, elegant build, very long flowing dark brown hair streaming in the air, and a decorative floral and ribbon headpiece. Her expression should feel confident, theatrical, and captivating. She wears an elaborate frilled performance dress in {argument name="dress colors" default="royal blue, crimson red, white, and gold"}: a fitted corset bodice with gold trim and red front panel, white lace bust and sleeves, layered short ruffled skirt, and large swirling overskirts and cape-like fabric panels edged with gold embroidery that billow dramatically around her. Add ornate ankle accessories with matching ribbon flowers, white heeled shoes or short boots, and luxurious detailed fabric textures. The setting is a richly decorated interior with 1 large glowing gothic arched window on the left, 1 heavy dark red velvet curtain framing the top and left side, 1 large classical oil painting in an ornate frame on the right wall, 1 tall carved column behind her, 1 abundant arrangement of roses and pale flowers at the lower left, and 1 gilded balustrade across the foreground. Warm golden backlight streams through the stained-glass-like window, creating a luminous halo, soft haze, rim light on her hair and costume, and deep cinematic shadows. A few rose petals drift in the air. Highly detailed, ultra-polished, romantic, majestic, dynamic composition, rich textures, painterly anime illustration with realistic lighting and luxurious fantasy idol aesthetics.

items.title: 龙女王悬崖奇幻插画
items.promptZh: 一幅雄伟的奇幻插图，描绘了一位站在悬崖边缘的富丽堂皇的龙女王，以全身和面向左侧的侧面轮廓显示。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"}长发，层次分明，长发垂过腰际，表情平静严肃，头戴精致的皇冠头饰，头饰上有数根向后掠过的角状金色长刺。她的服装是皇家礼服和铠甲紧身衣的华丽融合，采用{argument name="primary Palette" default="黑色、象牙色和古董金色"}，上面覆盖着复杂的花丝、藤蔓状镀金窗饰和优雅的裂纹大理石风格图案。该服装有 4 个主要的可见服装元素：合身的黑色和象牙色装甲躯干、带有飘逸镶片的分层长裙、带有金色镶边的深色斗篷，以及大腿高的合身腿甲或靴子。她手持一把长礼仪剑，垂直插在身侧，纤细且极具装饰性。在她的身后和周围升起一条巨大的黑龙的轮廓，它有长长的咆哮头和巨大的弧形翅膀，它的身体像守护者的影子一样包围着她；翅膀上饰有微妙的金色纹理图案。背景呈现出苍白、极简主义的奇幻景观，下方是远处的哥特式城堡尖顶建筑群、开阔的平原、淡淡的水或沼泽地，以及柔和的奶油色天空下的远山。构图是垂直的、优雅的、电影般的，人物居中稍偏右，龙头位于左上方，长长的丝带和织物在风中飘扬。风格是精致的动漫奇幻概念艺术，超细致的线条、内敛的色彩、发光的象牙负空间、奢华的黑金装饰、空灵的氛围、锐利的轮廓设计和高贵的神圣龙的情绪。
items.prompt: A majestic high-fantasy illustration of a regal dragon queen standing on the edge of a cliff, shown in full body and side profile facing left. She has {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair flowing in long layered strands far past her waist, a calm stern expression, and an elaborate crown-like headdress with multiple long horn-shaped golden spines sweeping backward. Her outfit is an ornate fusion of royal gown and armored bodysuit in {argument name="primary palette" default="black, ivory, and antique gold"}, covered with intricate filigree, vine-like gilded tracery, and elegant cracked-marble style patterns. The costume has 4 major visible garment elements: a fitted black-and-ivory armored torso, a long layered split skirt with flowing panels, a dark sweeping cape with gold trim, and thigh-high fitted leg armor or boots. She holds 1 long ceremonial sword planted vertically at her side, slim and highly decorative. Behind and around her rises the silhouette of 1 enormous black dragon with a long snarling head and vast arcing wings, its body framing her like a guardian shadow; the wings are detailed with subtle gold vein patterns. The background shows a pale, minimalist fantasy landscape with 1 distant gothic castle spire complex below, open plains, faint water or marshland, and far mountains under a soft cream sky. Composition is vertical, elegant, and cinematic, with the character centered slightly right, the dragon head to the upper left, and long ribbons and fabric streaming in the wind. Style is refined anime-inspired fantasy concept art with ultra-detailed linework, restrained colors, luminous ivory negative space, luxurious black-and-gold ornamentation, ethereal atmosphere, sharp silhouette design, and a noble sacred-draconic mood.

items.promptZh: 一张智能手机的偷拍照片，照片中一位年轻的东亚女性坐在一家繁忙的老式台湾早餐店的小圆桌旁。她是主要拍摄对象，从大腿中部向上取景，以随意的坐姿面向镜头。她的脸故意被柔和的矩形模糊所遮挡。她有一头齐肩的黑色直发，中间戴着小金圈耳环，还有一条精致的金项链，上面有一个小心形吊坠。她穿着一件合身的白色细肩带背心和带有轻微做旧效果的高腰蓝色牛仔短裤。她一只手把一块炸油条放在嘴边，另一只手把另一块碎油条放在桌子上。桌子上摆着四件看得见的食物和饮料：一盘炸油条、一份裹着黑芝麻的葱油饼、一个白色泡沫外卖托盘，里面有两块煎饼，其中一块是用老抽和葱花覆盖的，还有一大杯带有红色吸管和红色中文标志的外卖豆浆。餐厅内部空间紧凑，光线明亮，配有荧光天花板灯、水磨石风格的地板，背景中的食客挤得水泄不通。她身后是大窗户和墙上的标牌，上面有醒目的红色繁体字，包括豆浆、油条、肠粉、烧饼和蛋饼等早餐食品。有几位坐着的顾客在吃饭，工作人员在金属柜台后面工作，一台小型壁挂式电视上显示着一位女新闻主播，还有一个悬挂着的菜单板，上面写着红色的中文文字和价格。写实的摄影，自然的室内光线，浅景深，热闹的当地气氛，轻微的广角手机镜头视角，纪实的美食旅行美学。
items.prompt: A candid smartphone photo of a young East Asian woman seated at a small round table inside a busy old-fashioned Taiwanese breakfast shop. She is the main subject, framed from mid-thigh upward, facing the camera in a casual seated pose. Her face is intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur. She has straight shoulder-length black hair with a center part, small gold hoop earrings, and a delicate gold necklace with a tiny heart pendant. She wears a fitted white spaghetti-strap tank top and high-waisted blue denim cutoff shorts with light distressing. In one hand she holds a piece of fried cruller near her mouth, and in the other hand she holds another broken piece over the table. On the table are 4 visible food and drink items: a plate with fried cruller pieces, a wrapped scallion pancake with black sesame seeds, a white foam takeout tray containing 2 pancakes including one covered with dark soy-based sauce and chopped scallions, and a large takeaway cup of soy milk with a red straw and red Chinese logo. The restaurant interior is compact and brightly lit with fluorescent ceiling lights, terrazzo-style flooring, and tightly packed diners in the background. Behind her are large windows and wall signage with bold red traditional Chinese characters, including breakfast items such as soy milk, youtiao, rice rolls, shaobing, and egg pancake. There are several seated customers eating, staff working behind a metal counter, a small wall-mounted television showing a female news anchor, and a hanging menu board with red Chinese text and prices. Realistic photography, natural indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, lively local atmosphere, slight wide-angle phone camera perspective, documentary food-travel aesthetic.

items.promptZh: 一张在一家狭窄的老台湾早餐店里拍摄的街头小吃咖啡馆的照片，以逼真的智能手机照片风格拍摄，柔和的自然光和略带温暖的纪录片外观。一位年轻的东亚女性，留着{argument name="hair color" default="black"}齐肩直发，坐在红色层压板桌子旁的红色小塑料凳上，面对镜头，双手举着热腾腾的葱油饼，与胸同高。她的脸被故意用一个大的柔软模糊的矩形遮挡。她穿着带有细肩带和小蝴蝶结细节的白色吊带背心、浅蓝色高腰牛仔短裤和银色心形吊坠项链。她的姿势很放松，坐姿略微倾斜，桌子下裸露的双腿清晰可见。桌上正好有两盘白色的葱油饼、一个热气腾腾的红字纸杯、一碗白色的青菜豆腐或凝乳汤和一个白色的汤勺，还有散落的面包屑和包装纸。杯子和碗旁边应该有明显的蒸汽上升。她手里的保鲜膜看起来塞满了鸡蛋、葱油饼，馅料都露出来了。背景展示了一个繁忙、正宗的当地餐馆内部：玻璃展示柜后面正好有两名工人、一台可口可乐冰箱、头顶上的日光灯管、一台电风扇、瓷砖墙，以及几张中文菜单标志和标有新台币价格的食品海报。包括葱油饼、蛋卷、豆浆等可见的传统中式招牌，价格约为 30 至 55 元/新台币。右侧展示一个玻璃柜，里面堆放着油条或糕点。在左侧，将部分开放式店面暴露在街道上，摩托车和邻近的建筑物依稀可见。构图是垂直的，从头到膝盖的全身坐式裁剪，主题居中，景深较浅，但有足够的细节来保持商店的可读性，逼真的肤色，休闲的早餐氛围，熙熙攘攘的日常台北街头美食美学。
items.prompt: A candid street-food cafe photo in a narrow old Taiwanese breakfast shop, shot in a realistic smartphone-photo style with soft natural daylight and a slightly warm documentary look. A young East Asian woman with {argument name="hair color" default="black"} shoulder-length straight hair sits on a small red plastic stool at a red laminate table, facing the camera and holding a hot scallion pancake wrap with both hands at chest height. Her face is intentionally obscured with a large soft blurred rectangle. She wears a white camisole with thin straps and tiny bow details, light blue high-waisted denim shorts, and a silver heart pendant necklace. Her pose is relaxed, seated slightly angled, with bare legs visible under the table. On the table are exactly 2 white plates of sliced stuffed scallion pancakes, 1 steaming paper cup with red Chinese text, 1 white bowl of soup with dark greens and tofu or curd pieces and a white soup spoon, plus scattered crumbs and paper wrappers. Steam should be clearly rising beside the cup and bowl. The food wrap in her hands looks overstuffed with egg, scallion pancake layers, and fillings peeking out. The background shows a busy, authentic local eatery interior: exactly 2 workers behind a glass display case, a Coca-Cola refrigerator, fluorescent tube lights overhead, an electric fan, tiled walls, and several Chinese menu signs and food posters with prices in New Taiwan dollars. Include visible traditional Chinese signage such as scallion pancakes, egg pancake rolls, soy milk, and prices around 30 to 55 yuan/TWD. Show a glass case on the right containing stacked fried dough sticks or pastries. On the left side, reveal part of the open storefront to the street with scooters and neighboring buildings faintly visible. Composition is vertical, full-body seated crop from head to knees, centered subject, shallow depth of field but enough detail to keep the shop readable, realistic skin tones, casual morning breakfast atmosphere, bustling everyday Taipei street-food aesthetic.

items.title: 早餐店饭团奶茶人像
items.promptZh: 一张街边咖啡馆的偷拍照片，照片中一位年轻的东亚女性坐在一家朴素的台湾早餐店的小圆桌旁，在明亮的自然光下拍摄，采用逼真的智能手机相机风格。她有一头深棕色到黑色的波浪长发披在肩膀和背部，身材苗条，曲线优美，穿着一件合身的白色罗纹低圆领短款背心和浅灰色抽绳运动裤，还有一条非常精致的项链。她坐得稍微前倾，朝向镜头，一只手拿着一个用透明塑料包裹的台湾肠粉，靠近嘴，好像要咬一口。她的脸被以脸部为中心的大矩形模糊块故意遮挡。左下前景的桌子上放着1个带密封盖和吸管的大塑料外卖杯，里面装着浅米色的奶茶或豆奶饮料，印有可爱的卡通人物和小中文文字。桌子上还有 1 个带有橙色印花的白色食品纸袋。场景是真正的休闲早餐店内部：最左边是一扇通向街道的窗户，阳光充足，绿树成荫，停着摩托车，外面可见一辆白色汽车；左墙上有一个垂直的老式菜单标志，上面有彩色汉字，列出了早餐食品和饮料；沿着顶部背景是一个宽的水平菜单板，上面有许多行蓝色和红色的中文文字和价格；右后方是一个开放式的不锈钢厨房柜台区域，后面站着一名模糊的工人，金属固定装置上还有额外的中文标牌。构图为中景，以坐着的女性为中心，柔和的自然阴影，略带温暖的色调，逼真的皮肤纹理，日常纪实氛围，以及正宗的台湾当地饮食美学。
items.prompt: A candid street-side cafe photo of a young East Asian woman seated at a small round table inside a modest Taiwanese breakfast shop, shot in bright natural daylight with realistic smartphone-camera styling. She has long dark brown to black wavy hair draped over her shoulders and back, a slim curvy figure, and wears a fitted white ribbed scoop-neck crop tank top and light gray drawstring sweatpants, plus a very delicate necklace. She is sitting slightly leaned forward toward the camera, with one hand holding a Taiwanese rice roll wrapped in clear plastic close to her mouth as if about to take a bite. Her face is intentionally obscured by a large rectangular blur block centered over the face. On the table in the lower left foreground is 1 large plastic takeaway cup with a sealed lid and straw, filled with a light beige milk tea or soy milk drink, printed with cute cartoon characters and small Chinese text. Also on the table is 1 white paper food bag with orange printing. The setting is a real casual breakfast shop interior: at the far left is a window opening to the street with daylight, leafy shadows, parked scooters, and a white car visible outside; on the left wall is 1 vertical vintage menu sign with multicolored Chinese characters listing breakfast items and drinks; along the top background is 1 wide horizontal menu board filled with many rows of blue and red Chinese text and prices; in the back right is an open stainless-steel kitchen counter area with 1 blurred worker standing behind it and additional Chinese signage on the metal fixtures. Composition is medium shot, centered on the seated woman, with soft natural shadows, slightly warm tones, realistic skin texture, everyday documentary atmosphere, and an authentic Taiwanese local eatery aesthetic.

items.title: 房地产投资宣传海报
items.promptZh: 以干净、现代的社交媒体广告风格、4:5 海报构图创建精美的垂直房地产促销传单。使用明亮的白天户外主题，淡蓝色的天空、柔软的云彩和绿叶茂盛的树枝构成左上角和右上角。布局应该感觉像是一个优质的房地产投资广告，具有大胆的排版、光滑的营销设计以及青色、红色、白色和灰色调色板。在左上角放置一个大写小标题：{argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}。在其正下方，添加一个非常大的堆叠主标题：深青色的 {argument name="main title line 1" default="OWN YOUR"} 和鲜红色的 {argument name="main title line 2" default="DREAM HOME"}，使用粗体压缩无衬线字体。在其下方，添加一个青色丝带横幅，上面写有白色大写文本：{argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}。在标语下方，恰好显示 3 个水平排列的圆形功能图标，它们之间有细小的垂直分隔符：一个标题为“保障您的未来”的盾牌图标，一个标题为“高价值投资”的上升条形图图标，以及一个标题为“现代与优雅”的房屋图标。在左中下中心，有一座大型逼真的当代豪华住宅，有 2 层楼，白色和灰色的外墙，黑色装饰，大玻璃窗，阳台，景观灌木和铺砌的车道，从前面的四分之三角度显示。在右侧，放置一个腰部以上的成年黑人，穿着绿色针织毛衣，面朝前，直接指向观众，摆出自信的销售海报姿势；他的身体与房子重叠并延伸到前景。在他的下躯干附近，添加一个带有轻微 3D 效果的光亮红色圆形徽章，其中包含大型白色大写文本 {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}，并在其底部边缘贴上一个小的深青色倾斜横幅，上面写着“LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!”。在底部创建一个深青色面板，其中正好包含 3 个带有白色边框和等间距的圆角矩形属性卡。卡 1 应显示一排现代联排别墅和标签“MODERN TERRACES”；在它的下面正好有 2 个小功能：“宽敞的房间”和“24/7 安全”。卡 2 应显示一座带泳池的豪华别墅，并带有“LUXURY VILLAS”标签；在它的下面正好有 2 个小功能：“高级便利设施”和“黄金地点”。卡3应显示独立的高档现代住宅和“EXCLUSIVE HOMES”标签；在它的下面正好有 2 个小功能：“注册标题”和“受信任的开发人员”。在最底部，包括一个大的空白白色圆角矩形，跨越大部分宽度，作为联系人详细信息或页脚信息的占位符区域。使整体图像清晰、高对比度、商业化、有抱负且经过专业设计，就像优质的房地产营销海报一样。
items.prompt: Create a polished vertical real-estate promotional flyer in a clean, modern social-media ad style, 4:5 poster composition. Use a bright daytime outdoor theme with a pale blue sky, soft clouds, and leafy green tree branches framing the top left and top right corners. The layout should feel like a premium property investment advertisement with bold typography, glossy marketing design, and a teal, red, white, and gray color palette. At the upper left, place a small uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}. Directly below it, add a very large stacked main headline: {argument name="main headline line 1" default="OWN YOUR"} in deep teal and {argument name="main headline line 2" default="DREAM HOME"} in vivid red, using a bold condensed sans-serif font. Beneath that, add a teal ribbon banner with white uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}. Under the tagline, show exactly 3 circular feature icons arranged horizontally with thin vertical separators between them: a shield icon with the caption "SECURE YOUR FUTURE", a rising bar-chart icon with the caption "HIGH VALUE INVESTMENT", and a house icon with the caption "MODERN & ELEGANT". In the middle left and lower center, feature a large photorealistic contemporary luxury house with 2 stories, white and gray exterior walls, black trim, large glass windows, a balcony, landscaped shrubs, and a paved driveway, shown from a front three-quarter angle. On the right side, place a waist-up adult Black man in a green knit sweater, facing forward and pointing directly at the viewer with an assertive sales-poster pose; his body overlaps the house and extends into the foreground. Near his lower torso, add a glossy red circular badge with a slight 3D effect containing large white uppercase text {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}, and attach a small dark teal angled banner across its bottom edge reading "LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!". Across the bottom, create a dark teal panel containing exactly 3 rounded rectangular property cards with white borders and equal spacing. Card 1 should show a row of modern townhouses and the label "MODERN TERRACES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Spacious Rooms" and "24/7 Security". Card 2 should show a luxury villa with a pool and the label "LUXURY VILLAS"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Premium Amenities" and "Prime Locations". Card 3 should show a detached upscale modern home and the label "EXCLUSIVE HOMES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Registered Title" and "Trusted Developer". At the very bottom, include one large empty white rounded rectangle spanning most of the width as a placeholder area for contact details or footer information. Make the overall image crisp, high-contrast, commercial, aspirational, and professionally designed like a premium real-estate marketing poster.

items.title: 茨城旅行指南杂志封面
items.titleZh: 茨城旅行指南杂志封面
items.prompt: A refined Japanese travel guide magazine cover illustration in a soft watercolor-and-ink editorial style, vertical A4 layout, airy pastel palette, elegant tourism-poster composition. The cover headline is dominated by very large serif blue text reading {argument name="main title" default="IBARAKI"}, with large Japanese title text below reading "茨城県 旅行ガイド" and a pale pink cursive English subtitle reading "Ibaraki Travel Guide". At the top left, include two lines of small Japanese copy about nature, history, scenery, and gourmet travel in Ibaraki, accented with a tiny pink cherry blossom icon. At the top right, place a large circular badge with fine dotted border containing Japanese text and the phrase "完全保存版" in the center with a small ribbon flourish underneath. The main subject is a young Japanese woman shown from the chest up, placed slightly right of center, facing left in three-quarter view. She has a chin-length wavy bob in deep dark brown to black, delicate loose strands, soft natural texture, and a calm neutral expression. She wears a light blue cardigan over a white ruffled blouse with a high gathered neckline, plus a thin beige shoulder bag strap. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain vertical rectangular gray censor block centered over the face area. Surround her with a collage of iconic Ibaraki scenery blended seamlessly into the cover art: a vast field of blue nemophila flowers across rolling hills in the upper right with a Ferris wheel in the distance and tiny visitors along the ridge; a traditional temple or pavilion among pink cherry blossoms at mid-right; a bright waterfall and landscaped stream at lower right; a torii gate standing in shallow ocean water at sunset in the lower left; and a mountain landscape near the bottom left center. Add abundant blue flowers in the foreground along the bottom edge and soft pink cherry blossoms framing the right side. Along the left side, include exactly 7 vertically stacked destination list entries in Japanese, each with a colored heading line and smaller descriptive subtext: "国営ひたち海浜公園", "偕楽園", "袋田の滝", "大洗磯前神社", "筑波山", "水郷・霞ヶ浦", and "グルメ・カフェ・おみやげ". At the lower left, place a blue circular badge with white Japanese text reading "モデルコース 4" and smaller itinerary copy below. At the lower right, include exactly 3 horizontal white label tabs with Japanese text and small icons: "絶景スポット", "ご当地グルメ", and "おみやげセレクション". Add a pink ribbon banner near the bottom right with small Japanese promotional text. Use a clean white background for the upper left, elegant magazine typography, delicate linework, dreamy spring atmosphere, polished tourism-cover design, high detail, premium print look.

items.promptZh: 一张超现实的高级时尚社论照片，拍摄于空荡荡的路边，在平坦的灰色阴天下，风景如画的冰岛荒凉。构图以一个小型野兽派混凝土公交车站候车亭为中心，候车亭内有污迹斑斑的风化墙壁和一张简单的长凳，并在候车亭内放置了一名苗条的成年男子，穿着定制的黑色西装、黑色衬衫和黑色鞋子，随意地站着，看着旁边。覆盖整个公交车站的是一件巨大的超大羽绒服，颜色为鲜艳的焦橙色，充气后呈帐篷状，在候车亭上方形成了一个巨大的雕塑天篷；衣领在屋顶上方张开，袖子从两侧垂落到潮湿的路面上，光滑的绗缝尼龙展现出逼真的皱纹、膨胀的腔室、接缝、按扣和时尚产品细节。前景中的道路黑暗且被雨水打湿，有微妙的反射和寒冷潮湿的气氛。背景中，显示出低矮的荒山，上面有积雪的痕迹，还有遥远的海风吹过的海岸线的感觉。像豪华杂志时尚广告一样拍摄，具有电影现实主义、居中取景、柔和的自然光、单色环境和橙色外套之间的强烈对比、最小的调色板、轻微的巨大比例失真和清晰的编辑摄影细节。
items.prompt: A surreal high-fashion editorial photograph on an empty roadside in a bleak Icelandic-looking landscape under a flat gray overcast sky. Center the composition on a small brutalist concrete bus stop shelter with stained weathered walls and a simple bench inside, and place 1 slender adult man inside the shelter wearing a tailored black suit, black shirt, and black shoes, standing casually and looking to the side. Draped over the entire bus stop is 1 enormous oversized puffer jacket in vivid burnt orange, inflated and tent-like, forming a monumental sculptural canopy over the shelter; the collar gapes open above the roof, the sleeves slump down on both sides to the wet pavement, and the glossy quilted nylon shows realistic wrinkles, puffed chambers, seams, snaps, and fashion-product detail. The road in the foreground is dark and rain-slick, with subtle reflections and a cold damp atmosphere. In the background, show low barren hills with traces of snow and a remote windswept shoreline feel. Shoot it like a luxury magazine fashion campaign with cinematic realism, centered framing, muted natural light, strong contrast between the monochrome environment and the orange coat, minimal color palette, slightly monumental scale distortion, and crisp editorial photography detail.

The scene is drenched in explosive neon magenta, cyan, violet, and electric blue lighting, with a glossy high-contrast finish and dense sparkling particle effects. The character has long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white hair with cyan and pink highlights"}, large furry cat ears, and layered windswept strands glowing with rim light. Her face is mostly hidden by a flat rectangular censorship block in muted purple placed over the eye area. She wears futuristic clubwear: a black strappy top with a small cat-symbol detail, a translucent iridescent jacket slipping off the shoulders, shiny dark armwear or gloves, metallic accessories, and dangling earrings. Her nails are painted vivid pink. In the foreground, she grips a clear bottle labeled {argument name="drink label" default="NYAN EXTREME SODA"}, with a stylized cat face logo on a dark label. The bottle is filled with bright blue and pink fizzy liquid, and the cap is off as a dramatic geyser of sparkling pink soda erupts upward and outward, splashing across the frame. Surround the character with floating translucent ice cubes, droplets, glitter, and bokeh-like highlights. The background is an abstract nightlife energy burst of swirling liquid, neon splashes, and luminous particles rather than a realistic location. Emphasize exaggerated perspective, motion, sensual pop-art attitude, hyper-detailed reflections, glossy skin and fabric, and a bold gpt-image-2 polished anime illustration aesthetic.

items.prompt: A bright anime-style fantasy travel scene in front of Niseko View Plaza in Hokkaido, with a clear blue sky, scattered white clouds, and a huge snow-capped mountain rising in the background. items.title: 森林昆虫村庄相遇
items.promptZh: 黄金时段的温馨风格 3D 动画森林村庄场景，展示了 2 个可爱的昆虫角色在蘑菇屋顶小屋之间的鹅卵石小路上相遇。在左侧前景中，一只可爱的{argument name="main昆虫类型" default="ladybug"}蹲在低处，有着超大的光滑黑色头部、富有表现力的棕色大眼睛、微笑的小嘴、带有圆形尖端的短触角，以及一根天线附近的小{argument name="accessory color" default="red"}蝴蝶结。它的外壳明亮{argument name="shell color" default="red"}，有明显的黑点，身体呈深炭黑色，四肢柔软圆润。在右中景，一只欢快的小{argument name="第二昆虫类型" default="bee"}盘旋在略高于地面的位置，面对着较大的昆虫，它有着同样超大的头、闪闪发光的大眼睛、精致的半透明翅膀、微小的触角和抬起的小前腿，好像在兴奋地说话。场景是一个迷人的虫子大小的林地小村庄，有 3 间可见的小屋、圆形木门、弯曲的石墙、苔藓、藤蔓、花朵和绿叶植物构成了小路。温暖的电影阳光从右上角穿过树木，产生发光的边缘光、柔和的散景和漂浮的萤火虫般的颗粒。使用浅景深、昆虫眼睛水平的低摄像机角度、丰富的秋绿和金色色调、高度细致的纹理、柔和的全局照明、异想天开的家庭电影氛围、皮克斯风格的现实主义，以及微妙的梦幻双重曝光感觉，在画面的某些部分有微弱的重叠光线或重影高光。
items.prompt: A heartwarming stylized 3D animated forest village scene at golden hour, showing 2 adorable insect characters meeting on a cobblestone path between tiny mushroom-roof cottages. In the left foreground, a cute {argument name="main insect type" default="ladybug"} crouches low with an oversized glossy black head, huge expressive brown eyes, a small smiling mouth, short antennae with rounded tips, and a tiny {argument name="accessory color" default="red"} bow near one antenna. Its shell is bright {argument name="shell color" default="red"} with distinct black spots, and its body is dark charcoal black with soft rounded limbs. In the right midground, a cheerful small {argument name="second insect type" default="bee"} hovers slightly above the ground facing the larger insect, with a similarly oversized head, big sparkling eyes, delicate translucent wings, tiny antennae, and little forelegs lifted as if speaking excitedly. The setting is an enchanted bug-sized woodland hamlet with 3 visible cottages, rounded wooden doors, curved stone walls, moss, vines, flowers, and leafy plants framing the path. Warm cinematic sunlight filters through the trees from the upper right, creating glowing rim light, soft bokeh, and floating firefly-like particles. Use a shallow depth of field, low camera angle at insect eye level, rich autumn-green and golden tones, highly detailed textures, soft global illumination, whimsical family-film mood, Pixar-like stylized realism, and a subtle dreamy double-exposure feel with faint overlapping light or ghosted highlights in parts of the frame.

items.prompt: A dramatic Brazilian political campaign poster in a square social-media format, hyper-stylized and cinematic, with a dark blue and black color grade, intense contrast, gritty textures, and heroic propaganda-poster composition. On the right half, a middle-aged man wearing a bright royal-blue polo shirt faces the camera from the chest up, extending one hand toward the viewer and prominently holding a blue ballpoint pen upright as the central symbolic object. His pose is confident, assertive, and campaign-like, with the pen close to the lens for forced perspective. Behind him, two large waving flags fill the upper background: the Puerto Rico flag on the upper left side behind the subject and the Brazil flag on the upper right side. The lower background shows a dark crowd silhouette and a distant city skyline at sunset with glowing orange light on the horizon, adding a rally atmosphere. On the left side, create a vertical stack of 4 bold campaign statements, each preceded by a large blue X marker. The 4 text blocks must read exactly: "ELE NÃO TEM A MIDIA", "ELE NÃO TEM PROJETOS", "ELE TAMBÉM NÃO TEM O POVO", and "O RESTO ELE VAI DESCOBRIR NA HORA". Use condensed uppercase typography, mixing white and electric blue emphasis words, with each statement separated by thin horizontal blue divider lines. At the bottom, place an oversized distressed headline in uppercase reading "CANETA AZUL", with "CANETA" in weathered white and "AZUL" in vivid blue, spanning almost the full width. Below it, add a secondary subtitle in uppercase blue italic condensed text reading "PARA DEPUTADO", flanked by thin blue horizontal lines. The overall design should feel like a viral meme campaign ad, bold, satirical, aggressive, and highly shareable, with dramatic rim lighting, sharpened details, realistic skin and fabric texture, and polished poster-quality compositing.

items.promptZh: 一张真实的有机自拍照，照片中一位{argument name="subject Age" default="middle-ged"}女人在黄金时段坐在自家门廊上，用休闲智能手机的前置摄像头在一臂距离处拍摄。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="auburn Brown"}齐肩的柔软卷发，蓬松而略显凌乱，阳光下温暖的皮肤，以及自然、未经打磨的日常外观。她穿着一件简单的{argument name="top color" default="black"}背心，裸露的肩膀可见。这张构图是一张特写的胸部肖像，居中但有点不平衡，就像真正的手持自拍一样，前景中的一只手臂部分可见。灯光是低角度温暖的傍晚阳光，在脸部、胸部和手臂上投射出柔和的高光和柔和的阴影。背景显示左侧是一个带有白色壁板的户外住宅门廊，右侧是一个苍白的垂直门廊柱，以及一个装满粉红色和紫色小花和绿色叶子的吊篮或壁式花盆。图像应该给人坦诚、真实、经过最少处理的感觉，具有真实的皮肤纹理、自然飞扬的毛发、轻微的不对称和微妙的智能手机镜头畸变，避免魅力修饰、美颜滤镜或过度打磨的人工智能美学。
items.prompt: A realistic organic selfie of a {argument name="subject age" default="middle-aged"} woman sitting on a house porch during golden hour, photographed at arm’s length with a casual smartphone front camera. She has {argument name="hair color" default="auburn brown"} shoulder-length softly wavy hair with volume and slightly tousled texture, warm sunlit skin, and a natural unpolished everyday appearance. She wears a simple {argument name="top color" default="black"} tank top with bare shoulders visible. The composition is a close chest-up portrait, centered but slightly off-kilter like a real handheld selfie, with one arm partially visible in the foreground. The lighting is low-angle warm evening sunlight casting soft highlights and gentle shadows across the face, chest, and arms. The background shows an outdoor residential porch with white siding on the left, a pale vertical porch column on the right, and a hanging basket or wall planter filled with small pink and purple flowers and green foliage. The image should feel candid, authentic, and minimally processed, with realistic skin texture, natural flyaway hairs, slight asymmetry, and subtle smartphone lens distortion, avoiding glamour retouching, beauty filters, or overly polished AI aesthetics.

items.prompt: A realistic organic smartphone selfie of a {argument name="subject age" default="middle-aged"} woman sitting outdoors on a porch or patio in warm late-afternoon golden-hour sunlight, framed from the chest up in a casual slightly imperfect front-facing composition. She has shoulder-length softly wavy auburn hair with a center part, natural texture, and a few loose flyaways, light skin with visible freckles and real skin texture on the chest and neck, and an everyday relaxed presence. She wears a light gray open-front cardigan over a pale lace-trim camisole. The setting shows a white exterior door and wall behind her, with a dark blue fabric-covered chair or cushion visible on the left side and strong sun casting soft warm highlights and natural shadows across her clothing and skin. The image should feel unfiltered, candid, and convincingly real rather than polished: subtle asymmetry, normal phone camera perspective, slightly tight crop, authentic household background, natural color, gentle contrast, and documentary-level photographic realism.

items.prompt: A high-fashion studio portrait of a young woman reclining sideways on the floor against a seamless light gray background, cropped from about the hat down to the hands, with the face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She wears an elegant white dress with sheer ruched fabric, sculpted floral appliqués along both shoulder straps and the bodice, and a fitted, ethereal silhouette. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown to black"} and styled in 2 long bubble braids, one on each side, each tied off with multiple white bands creating rounded segments. She wears a dramatic white fascinator hat tilted to one side, made of layered mesh, netting, ribbon loops, lace trim, and several airy feather sprays. Pose her leaning on one forearm with the other hand extended near the lower edge of the frame, torso angled diagonally for a refined editorial composition. Use soft diffused studio lighting, smooth skin tones, minimal shadows, luxury bridal-fashion styling, monochrome white wardrobe accents, and a clean polished magazine aesthetic.

items.prompt: A high-fashion studio portrait of a seated woman in an ethereal bridal look against a seamless light gray background, framed vertically from headpiece to the trailing ends of her hair. She wears a flowing sleeveless white gown with a high gathered neckline, sheer pleated chiffon over the bodice, delicate white floral appliqué clustered at the neck, chest, waist, and upper skirt, and a soft draped skirt spread around her on the floor. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="deep dark brown"} and styled into 2 extremely long oversized bubble ponytails, one on each side, each segmented with white ties; the left ponytail shows 4 visible bubble sections and the right ponytail shows 3 visible bubble sections, with both tails extending onto the floor in thick glossy loops. She also wears an elaborate white fascinator hat tilted to one side, made of lace, netting, and sculptural floral details. Pose her leaning diagonally with one hand braced on the floor and the torso angled, creating an elegant editorial fashion posture. Keep the mood refined, bridal, and avant-garde, with soft diffused lighting, realistic skin texture, crisp textile detail, minimal shadows, and a clean luxury magazine aesthetic.

items.promptZh:
超干净的汽车海报，其中的汽车与稍后提供的照片完全相同。人工智能必须从上传的照片中复制汽车，使其具有相同的车身形状、比例、姿态、颜色、装饰、车轮以及所有可见的外部细节。
汽车以面向右侧的前四分之三角呈现，与原始参考布局的视角相匹配，但现在以微妙的{argument name="action" default="drifting action"}进行描绘。漂移通过真实的重量转移、轻微的车身升力、后轮胎的受控烟羽以及车辆后面微弱的弯曲轮胎痕迹来表达，而不会扭曲原车的几何形状。
车头灯遵循汽车参考照片中的确切样式，如果提供的汽车有可选的暖雾灯，则会发光。所有贴花、标志、车牌和车窗色调必须与上传照片中的汽车相匹配。
汽车在光滑的白色反光工作室般的地板上漂移，保持柔和的反射和逼真的阴影，并通过光漂移防滑反射和定向污迹增强。
背景仍然是干净的白色到浅灰色渐变，带有巨大的半透明粗体汽车型号名称（从上传的照片中自动提取）垂直主导背景。
最顶部：干净的品牌文本“{argument name="brand name" default="CAR COMPANY NAME"}”（或从上传的汽车照片中检测到的品牌）。在其下方，间隔开的风格化跟踪文本包含相同的品牌和型号名称。
汽车下方：上传照片中确切型号名称的居中标题。
下面是关于汽车特性（效率、风格、可靠性）的简短描述性段落。
底部显示了清晰的规格网格布局。如果从检测到的汽车模型中得知真实规格，则生成准确的值；如果没有，则以相同的布局样式生成占位符（4 列：马力、0–100 km/h、最高速度、发动机排量/燃料类型）。
整张海报采用简约、社论、高调的工作室灯光，具有超锐利的反射、清晰的阴影、现代的排版和 4K 可信度，将干净的设计与动态漂移的能量融为一体，比例 9:16

The studio has large windows revealing a city skyline at night, hanging ceiling lights, amps including a visible Marshall stack, a drum kit with a band logo on the bass drum, cables, and a wall sign reading “Beat Box.” Compose it as a printed manga spread with 7 panels total across 2 pages, including gutters, page borders, and page numbers 13 and 14 at the bottom. Left page: 3 panels — top panel with the shocked boy turning toward the girls and a large Japanese speech bubble saying “え!?”; middle panel is a close-up of the long-haired guitarist girl with a calm expression and a Japanese speech bubble saying “……別にいいよ”; bottom panel is a wider full-band rehearsal shot with all 4 members in the studio. Right page: 4 panels — top panel is an explosive performance shot with the boy singing and playing while the long-haired girl plays guitar, with large sound-effect text “ジャッ”; middle panel is a dynamic close-up of the long-haired guitarist playing intensely, with flowing hair, musical note symbols, radiant speed lines, and the keyboard girl visible in the back; bottom panel is a close-up of the boy’s stunned face with soft bokeh and a vertical Japanese speech bubble saying “……あれ”. Emphasize the emotional contrast: awkward surprise turning into admiration as the girl’s guitar performance changes the mood. Use monochrome only, no color, authentic manga lettering, cinematic framing, layered depth, and highly detailed hair and instrument strings.

Main subject: a slender high school girl with very long straight light hair and blunt bangs, delicate features, and a serious introspective expression, wearing a Japanese school uniform consisting of a white button-up shirt, loosened striped ribbon tie, and plaid skirt, seated and playing a solid-body electric guitar that resembles a Stratocaster. In the lower-right panel, show a closer view of the same boy from the chest up against a soft bokeh screentone background; his face is again obscured by a large gray censor block. Add printed page numbers centered at the bottom margins: "5" under the left page and "6" under the right page. 名称：{参数名称=“角色名称”默认=“Nyra Vale”}
年龄：{参数名称=“年龄”默认=“23”}
身高：{参数名称=“高度”默认=“170 厘米”}

“她不追随潮流，而是定义潮流。安静的力量，敏锐的视野，以及无言的存在。”

信心

超详细、4K 质量、光泽杂志表面、电影灯光、锐利焦点、平衡对比度、现代编辑布局、完美对齐的网格。

The composition is densely packed and whimsical, designed as a hidden-object scene titled on a decorative sign in the upper right that reads {argument name="headline text" default="Find the duck! 🐤"}. Show a charming Venice setting with a central arched stone bridge crossing a narrow canal, multiple gondolas in the water, and dozens of small travelers and locals in colorful outfits, hats, sunglasses, cameras, and shopping bags. Place a souvenir kiosk with postcards and signs, a flower stall overflowing with bright bouquets, a café terrace with red-and-white checkered tables, a carnival mask shop display, stacked vintage suitcases near the canal, striped mooring poles, laundry hanging between buildings, wrought-iron street lamps, and old pastel buildings in peach, ochre, and cream with green shutters and terracotta roofs. Include visible storefront signs reading “MASCHERE,” “CAFFÈ,” “SOUVENIRS,” “FIORI,” and “VENEZIA.” Hide exactly {argument name="duck count" default="4"} small yellow rubber ducks throughout the scene as a playful search challenge, with one especially noticeable duck perched near the stacked suitcases and the others subtly blended among the busy market details. Add one tiny fluffy white dog near the flower stall. The overall style should feel like a premium collectible toy-city illustration, richly layered, joyful, cozy, and travel-themed, with soft depth of field, crisp miniature textures, and a bustling storybook atmosphere. Use {argument name="city" default="Venice"} as the location inspiration, and make the crowd feature {argument name="character style" default="cute chibi travelers"} in varied poses such as walking, chatting, taking photos, shopping, sitting at the café, standing on the bridge, and riding in gondolas.

items.titleZh: 赤壁威尼斯的隐藏鸭子
items.promptZh: 高度详细的威尼斯等距微型立体模型，采用异想天开的赤壁风格，设计为繁忙的隐藏角色拼图场景。背景是阳光明媚的威尼斯运河区，挤满了小可爱的旅行者和当地人，从稍微升高的角度观看，运河、桥梁、广场、店面和上层立面都可以立即看到。温暖的赤土建筑拥有风化的灰泥墙壁、花箱、条纹遮阳篷、百叶窗、阳台、屋顶烟囱和常春藤，环绕着狭窄的绿松石运河两侧。远处，优雅的威尼斯建筑包括一座大型拱桥、圆顶、塔楼和钟楼，营造出深度和明信片般的天际线。街道和运河上挤满了超过150个赤壁角色，每个角色都头大身小，眼睛有光泽，肤色各异，服装、发型、帽子和配饰各异，或走、或聊天、或购物、或坐、或划船、或观光。许多人戴着草帽、穿着条纹衬衫、裙子、背心、夹克和颜色欢快的旅行服。几艘贡多拉在运河中行驶，每艘贡多拉都载着小小的乘客，船夫们穿着经典的威尼斯条纹服装。包括 3 座横跨运河的石制人行桥、多个吊船、许多运河柱、华丽的绿色路灯、咖啡桌、市场摊位、人行道上的鸽子和纪念品展示。添加俏皮的寻宝游戏氛围，右上角有一个小悬挂标志，上面写着 {argument name="headline text" default="Find the duck!"} 并显示一个可爱的黄色橡皮鸭图标。在场景中隐藏两只小黄鸭，巧妙地放置在人群和运河区域之间，以便观众可以寻找它们。可见的商店和街道标志应包括左侧建筑上的“HOTEL CA' DEL SORRISO”、条纹遮阳篷店面上的“GELATO”、右侧的“TRATTORIA alla Gondola”、靠近中心前景的绿色运河标志上的“SERVIZIO GONDOLE”、纪念品摊位上的“VENEZIA MASK”以及右下角海报展示上的“CARNEVALE DI VENEZIA”。包括出售的狂欢节面具、咖啡馆座位、市场雨伞以及随处可见的微小装饰细节。将其渲染为超详细、精美的 3D 故事书艺术，具有玩具般的纹理、柔和的全局照明、充满活力的地中海色彩、清晰的焦点以及以 {argument name="city" default="Venice"} 为中心的迷人旅行海报氛围，并在 {argument name="series name" default="Ruhia"} 的俏皮世界中隐藏吉祥物搜索 {argument name="hidden object" default="yellow duck"}。
items.prompt: A highly detailed isometric miniature diorama of Venice in a whimsical chibi style, designed as a busy hidden-character puzzle scene. The setting is a sunlit Venetian canal district packed with tiny cute travelers and locals, viewed from a slightly elevated angle so the canal, bridges, piazza, storefronts, and upper facades are all visible at once. Warm terracotta buildings with weathered stucco walls, flower boxes, striped awnings, shuttered windows, balconies, rooftop chimneys, and ivy frame both sides of a narrow turquoise canal. In the distance, elegant Venetian architecture includes a large arched bridge, domes, towers, and a clock tower, creating depth and a postcard-like skyline. The streets and canal are extremely crowded with exactly over 150 chibi characters, each with oversized heads, small bodies, glossy eyes, varied skin tones, and distinct outfits, hairstyles, hats, and accessories, posed walking, chatting, shopping, sitting, rowing, or sightseeing. Many wear straw boater hats, striped shirts, dresses, vests, jackets, and travel clothes in cheerful colors. Several gondolas move through the canal, each carrying tiny passengers, with gondoliers in classic Venetian striped attire. Include exactly 3 stone pedestrian bridges crossing the canal, multiple gondolas, many canal posts, ornate green street lamps, café tables, market stands, pigeons on the pavement, and souvenir displays. Add a playful scavenger-hunt mood with a small hanging sign in the upper right that reads {argument name="headline text" default="Find the duck!"} and shows a cute yellow rubber duck icon. Hide exactly 2 small yellow ducks in the scene, subtly placed among the crowd and canal area so viewers can search for them. Visible shop and street signs should include HOTEL CA' DEL SORRISO on the left building, GELATO on a striped awning storefront, TRATTORIA alla Gondola on the right, SERVIZIO GONDOLE on a green canal sign near the center foreground, VENEZIA MASK on a souvenir stall, and CARNEVALE DI VENEZIA on a poster display at the lower right. Include carnival masks for sale, café seating, a market umbrella, and tiny decorative details everywhere. Render it as ultra-detailed, polished 3D storybook art with toy-like textures, soft global illumination, vibrant Mediterranean colors, crisp focus, and a charming travel-poster atmosphere centered on {argument name="city" default="Venice"}, featuring a hidden mascot search for {argument name="hidden object" default="yellow duck"}, in the playful world of {argument name="series name" default="Ruhia"}.

items.title: 威尼斯运河寻鸭立体模型
items.titleZh: 威尼斯运河寻鸭立体模型
items.promptZh: 一个非常详细的等距玩具立体模型插图，以可爱的赤壁风格描绘了拥挤的威尼斯运河区，设计为隐藏物体“找到鸭子”场景。展示一条熙熙攘攘的古老威尼斯街道和运河，挤满了数百个风格化的小人物，他们有着超大的头、闪亮的眼睛和各种各样的服装，几乎填满了每条走道、桥梁、阳台、缆车和咖啡馆的座位。构图是垂直俯视四分之三视图，俯视一条穿过中心的狭窄运河，中上部有一座横跨运河的石制人行桥，两侧是密集的暖色调历史建筑。建筑应采用赤土瓦屋顶、褪色橙色、赭石色、奶油色和砖红色的灰泥墙、绿色百叶窗、花箱、条纹遮阳篷、悬挂标志、灯笼和细节丰富的店面。包括左上角有一个高大的钟楼，上面写着“PONTE DEI SOSPIRI”的标志，在靠近桥的右侧有一个写着“Cafe Venezia”的红色遮阳篷，在右上角建筑上有一个巨大的“TRATTORIA”标志，一个写着“AL VAPORETTO San Marco - Rialto”的绿色标志，一个左边写有“GELATO”的条纹遮阳篷，一个小的“FOTO”标志，左下广场上有一个标有标签的售货亭“CARNEVALE DI VENEZIA”，右下角有一家发光的商店，标有“MURANO GLASS”，右侧运河边缘附近有一个小“SUPRI”标志。运河里正好停满了 7 艘贡多拉，每艘贡多拉都载有身穿条纹衬衫、戴着草帽的乘客和船夫，水中还有红白条纹的系泊杆。在广场和运河边缘摆满集市桌、两把大遮阳伞下的咖啡桌、嘉年华面具、气球、镶框艺术品、糕点、玻璃器皿、纪念品、鲜花和路灯。在窗户、阳台和门口，放置更多赤壁人物观看场景。将一只黄色小鸭子藏在“TRATTORIA”建筑旁边的右上方窗户中，这样就可以看到但很容易错过。在右上角添加一个装饰性标牌，上面写着“找到鸭子！”带有鸭子图标。以超密集的手工微型美学渲染一切，具有清晰的细节、饱和的暖色调、柔和的电影灯光、有趣的旅行海报魅力和异想天开的假期拼图书感觉。
items.prompt: A highly detailed isometric toy-diorama illustration of a crowded Venetian canal district in a cute chibi style, designed as a hidden-object “find the duck” scene. Show a bustling old Venice street and canal packed with exactly hundreds of tiny stylized people with oversized heads, glossy eyes, and varied outfits, filling nearly every walkway, bridge, balcony, gondola, and café seat. The composition is a vertical overhead three-quarter view looking down a narrow canal running through the center, with a stone footbridge crossing the canal in the upper middle and dense warm-toned historic buildings on both sides. Architecture should feature terracotta roof tiles, stucco walls in faded orange, ochre, cream, and brick red, green shutters, flower boxes, striped awnings, hanging signs, lanterns, and richly detailed shopfronts. Include a tall bell tower on the upper left with a sign reading “PONTE DEI SOSPIRI,” a red awning reading “Cafe Venezia” on the right side near the bridge, a large “TRATTORIA” sign on the upper right building, a green sign reading “AL VAPORETTO San Marco - Rialto,” a striped awning with “GELATO” on the left, a small “FOTO” sign, a kiosk in the lower left plaza labeled “CARNEVALE DI VENEZIA,” a glowing shop on the lower right labeled “MURANO GLASS,” and a small “SUPRI” sign near the right canal edge. Fill the canal with exactly 7 gondolas, each with passengers and gondoliers in striped shirts and straw hats, plus red-and-white striped mooring poles in the water. Populate the square and canal edges with market tables, café tables under exactly 2 large parasols, carnival masks, balloons, framed art, pastries, glassware, souvenirs, flowers, and streetlamps. In windows, balconies, and doorways, place more chibi figures watching the scene. Hide exactly 1 small yellow rubber duck in an upper-right window beside the “TRATTORIA” building so it is visible but easy to miss. Add a decorative signboard in the top-right corner that reads “Find the duck!” with a duck icon. Render everything in an ultra-dense handcrafted miniature aesthetic with crisp detail, saturated warm colors, soft cinematic lighting, playful travel-poster charm, and a whimsical vacation puzzle-book feeling.

items.title: 法拉利超跑广告海报
items.promptZh:
优质汽车广告海报，采用明亮的{argument name="color" default="red"} {argument name="car model" default="Ferrari SF90 Stradale"}，以引人注目的后 3/4 角度视图显示。汽车放置在干净、无缝的工作室环境中，具有大胆的单色深{argument name="background color" default="red"}背景。

巨大的拉伸版式“FERRARI”以现代粗体字体占据背景，略微褪色并融入背景，营造出深度和奢华品牌感。

该车细节极其丰富，有光泽的油漆反射、可见的碳纤维装饰、激进的后扩散器、双排气管、空气动力学翼子板和锋利的 LED 尾灯。灯光具有电影感和定向性，突出轮廓、曲线和以性能为中心的设计。

在顶部中心，包括一个最小的法拉利风格品牌区域，带有小徽标和文字：
“SF90 斯特拉代尔”
带有细分隔线，打造干净优质的外观。

在汽车下方，放置一个精致的文本框：
“法拉利——力量与完美的结合”
包括一段简短而优雅的段落，描述速度、精密工程和赛车传统。

在右侧，以干净的布局对齐性能规格：
“530 千瓦/720 马力”
“2.9 秒内 0-100 公里/小时”
“最高时速 340 公里/小时”

在车下使用微妙的阴影以获得真实感。保持简约但富有侵略性的构图，具有强烈的视觉层次感。

超写实、8K分辨率、锐利对焦、豪华商业海报设计、高对比度、充满活力的法拉利红色调、专业汽车摄影风格、电影灯光、优质品牌美学。

items.promptZh: 由 12 张照片拼贴而成的{argument name=" Couple" default="一对年轻的日本夫妇"}在{argument name="location" default="日本东京"}旅行的照片。这些图像感觉是自发的，就像用手机随意拍摄的一样，带有情感和怀旧的基调。整体美感有褪色的胶片感，就像记忆的碎片。场景包括：{argument name="scenes" default="一起骑着滑板车沿着海岸路、远眺鹅銮鼻灯塔、垦丁夜市街上的霓虹灯、白沙湾的日落"}。每一帧都类似于电影时刻，有轻微的相机抖动、不完美的构图以及充满颗粒和噪音的原始、日常感觉。
items.prompt: A collage of 12 photos capturing {argument name="couple" default="a young Japanese couple"} traveling in {argument name="location" default="Tokyo, Japan"}. The images feel spontaneous, as if casually taken on a phone, with an emotional and nostalgic tone. The overall aesthetic has a faded film look, like fragments of memories. Scenes include: {argument name="scenes" default="riding a scooter together along a coastal road, a distant view of the Eluanbi Lighthouse, neon lights on Kenting Night Market street, and a sunset at Baisha Bay"}. Each frame resembles cinematic moments, with slight camera shake, imperfect composition, and a raw, everyday feel filled with grain and noise.

items.title: 紫红植物超现实人像
items.promptZh: 一幅超现实的中画幅肖像，画中一名女子站在一条狭窄的花园小路上，周围环绕着极其茂密的树叶，以梦幻般的假彩色胶片效果拍摄。她穿着一件朴素、明亮、饱和的{argument name="shirt color" default="red"}圆领 T 恤和深黑色合身裤，齐肩的深色头发稍微凌乱且偏离中心。她的姿势轻松自然，手臂松弛地垂在身体两侧，身体以微妙的角度面向镜头，从大腿中部向上取景。场景是一个杂草丛生的植物园，小路两边长满了蕨类植物、常春藤、灌木和开花植物；所有植被都发生了戏剧性的色彩变化，从绿色变为鲜艳的洋红色、薰衣草色、粉色和深紫色，营造出一种不自然的 LomoChrome Purple XR 美学。使拍摄对象的衬衫在变换后的环境中保持高度饱和和逼真，以获得强烈的视觉对比。使用柔和的阴天光、浅至中等景深和中画幅渲染，营造出{argument name="camera" default="Mamiya RB67"}的感觉，使用{argument name="lens" default="90mm lens"}在{argument name="aperture" default="f/5.6"}拍摄。包括有机胶片颗粒、轻微边缘光晕、柔和的晕影、高光中的柔和绽放以及微妙的复古胶片边框边缘。构图应在{argument name="aspect Ratio" default="6:7"}框架中垂直，主体位于路径稍左侧的中心，前景和背景树叶柔和模糊，同时保持郁郁葱葱和细节丰富，产生怪异、浪漫、超凡脱俗的肖像。
items.prompt: A surreal medium-format portrait of a woman standing on a narrow garden path surrounded by extremely dense foliage, photographed in a dreamlike false-color film look. She wears a plain bright saturated {argument name="shirt color" default="red"} crew-neck T-shirt and dark black fitted pants, with shoulder-length dark hair that is slightly tousled and parted off-center. Her pose is relaxed and natural, arms hanging loosely at her sides, body facing the camera with a subtle turn, framed from about mid-thigh upward. The setting is an overgrown botanical garden packed with ferns, ivy, shrubs, and flowering plants on both sides of the path; all vegetation is dramatically color-shifted from green into vivid magenta, lavender, pink, and deep purple, creating an unnatural LomoChrome Purple XR aesthetic. Keep the subject's shirt intensely saturated and realistic against the transformed environment for strong visual contrast. Use soft overcast daylight, shallow to moderate depth of field, and medium format rendering with a {argument name="camera" default="Mamiya RB67"} feel, shot with a {argument name="lens" default="90mm lens"} at {argument name="aperture" default="f/5.6"}. Include organic film grain, slight edge halation, gentle vignette, soft bloom in highlights, and subtle vintage film border edges. Composition should be vertical in a {argument name="aspect ratio" default="6:7"} frame, with the subject centered slightly left of the path, foreground and background foliage softly blurred while remaining lush and detailed, producing an eerie, romantic, otherworldly portrait.

items.prompt: Ultra-realistic conceptual portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young man with curly hair and light stubble"}, wearing {argument name="accessories" default="yellow-tinted rectangular sunglasses"}, a beige minimal t-shirt, blue jeans, and off-white sneakers. items.titleZh: 绘画蒸汽朋克女孩肖像
items.promptZh: 这是一幅绘画般的蒸汽朋克奇幻肖像，描绘了一位年轻女子大腿以上的侧面轮廓，面朝左侧，站在一个充满机械零件和发条装置的狭窄车间里。她有一头又长又浓密的卷发{argument name="hair color" default="golden silver"}从背上垂下来，几缕松散的发丝在背景的映衬下闪闪发光。她的头顶上戴着一副带有虹彩蓝紫色镜片的大号黄铜飞行员护目镜。她的服装是一件浪漫的蒸汽朋克连衣裙：丰富的{argument name="dress color" default="deep cobalt blue"}紧身胸衣和裙子，一件带有荷叶边饰边和泡泡袖的高领白色衬衫，衣领和下摆处有分层褶边，腰部和躯干上有多个棕褐色皮带和搭扣。她肩上背着一个中号棕色皮革背包，带有圆形翻盖和可见的搭扣。场景两侧都充满了工业细节：裸露的管道、阀门、悬挂的仪器、圆形仪表和几个可见的齿轮，包括右上角的 1 个大齿轮和沿墙壁的多个环形金属部件。使用富有表现力的油画风格，厚重的笔触、柔和的边缘和梦幻般的手工纹理。调色板应将背景中的冷灰蓝色和青色与机器和头发上的暖黄铜色、红铜色、琥珀色和蜂蜜色亮点形成对比。气氛异想天开，充满冒险精神，还略带怀旧，就像故事书蒸汽朋克发明家的工作室一样。垂直构图，人物稍微位于画面右侧中心，背景柔和抽象，但充满了机械形式，没有可读的文本，没有现代元素，并通过一个简单的居中矩形模糊块以柔和的棕褐色色调遮住脸部。
items.prompt: A painterly steampunk fantasy portrait of a young woman shown from about thigh-up in side profile, facing left, standing in a narrow workshop filled with mechanical parts and clockwork. She has long, voluminous, curly {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair cascading down her back, with a few loose strands glowing against the background. A pair of large brass aviator goggles with iridescent blue-purple lenses rests on top of her head. Her outfit is a romantic steampunk dress: a rich {argument name="dress color" default="deep cobalt blue"} bodice and skirt, a high-necked white blouse with ruffled trim and puffed sleeves, layered frills at the collar and hem, and multiple tan leather straps and buckles cinched around the waist and torso. She carries a medium brown leather backpack with rounded flap and visible buckles over one shoulder. The setting is dense with industrial details on both sides: exposed pipes, valves, hanging instruments, circular gauges, and several visible gears, including 1 large gear in the upper right and multiple ring-like metal components along the walls. Use an expressive oil-painting style with thick impasto brushstrokes, soft edges, and a dreamy handcrafted texture. The palette should contrast cool dusty blues and teals in the background with warm brass, copper, amber, and honey highlights on the machinery and hair. The mood is whimsical, adventurous, and slightly nostalgic, like a storybook steampunk inventor’s atelier. Vertical composition, character centered slightly right of frame, background softly abstracted but packed with mechanical forms, no readable text, no modern elements, and keep the face obscured by a simple centered rectangular blur block in a muted tan-brown tone.
