In the background, show 1 large red torii gate, 1 stone shrine path, dense green forest, blooming {argument name="tree type" default="cherry blossom"} trees, and 1 warm lantern on the right side. Use brilliant cinematic lighting with sunbeams filtering through the trees, sparkling particles, glossy highlights, saturated colors, depth, and a polished premium gacha-game key visual aesthetic. items.title: 东京街头时尚人像
items.promptZh: 这是一张街头时尚肖像，白天，一位年轻女子站在繁忙的东京人行横道上，从上半身向上取景，稍微转离镜头，使她裸露的肩膀显得突出。她留着凌乱的短发，{argument name="hair color" default="白金金发"}，质地柔软，身材精致。她穿着一件透气的露肩衬衫，采用{argument name="clothing color" default="white"}材质，采用薄薄的半透明面料制成，具有宽松的垂坠感和浪漫、轻盈的感觉。将她放置在前景中偏左的位置，景深较浅，背景是拥挤的城市背景，充满了过马路的行人。在她身后，有一座巨大的弧形玻璃建筑，上面有可见的标志{argument name="background sign" default="TSUTAYA"}，让人想起涩谷。使用温暖的复古胶片美学，褪色、明显的颗粒、轻微的模糊、柔和的阳光、柔和的对比度和怀旧的模拟快照情绪。整体基调应该给人时尚、自然、电影般的感觉，就像在繁华城市中拍摄的时尚照片一样。
items.prompt: A candid street-fashion portrait of a young woman standing at a busy Tokyo crosswalk in daylight, framed from the upper torso up and turned slightly away from the camera so her bare shoulder is prominent. She has a short messy bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"}, soft wispy texture, and a delicate build. She wears an airy off-shoulder blouse in {argument name="clothing color" default="white"}, made of thin semi-sheer fabric with loose drape and a romantic, lightweight feel. Place her in the foreground left-of-center, with a shallow depth of field and a crowded urban background full of pedestrians crossing the street. Behind her, include a large curved glass building with the visible sign {argument name="background sign" default="TSUTAYA"}, evoking Shibuya. Use a warm vintage film aesthetic with faded colors, noticeable grain, slight blur, soft sunlight, muted contrast, and a nostalgic analog snapshot mood. The overall tone should feel stylish, spontaneous, and cinematic, like a fashion photo captured in the middle of a bustling city.

items.title: 极简动漫侧颜肖像
items.promptZh: 一幅极简主义动漫风格的年轻女子肖像，从胸部向上显示侧面轮廓，面朝左侧，头部稍微转动，因此只能看到一只眼睛和耳朵的一部分。她留着短直波波头，发尾柔软向内弯曲，发丝浅色凌乱，{argument name="hair color" default="platinum金色"}头发。她的皮肤白皙光滑，穿着露肩宽松的白色上衣或毛衣从一侧肩膀滑落，露出锁骨和上背部。构图干净、图形化，具有细细的深海军蓝线条、平坦柔和的颜色、几乎没有阴影，以及平静的编辑插图感觉。使用纯色{argument name="background color" default="bright青色蓝色"}背景，没有任何物体、没有风景、没有文字。将半身像置于画面稍左侧的中心，在人物周围留下负空间。保持心情安静、时尚、现代、优雅，就像日本社交媒体动漫女孩插画一样。请勿添加配饰、珠宝或额外的背景元素。
items.prompt: A minimalist anime-style portrait of a young woman shown from the chest up in side profile, facing left, with her head slightly turned so only part of one eye and ear are visible. She has a short straight bob haircut with soft inward-curving ends, light tousled strands, and {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair. Her skin is pale and smooth, and she wears an off-shoulder loose white top or sweater slipping down one shoulder, exposing the collarbone and upper back. The composition is clean and graphic, with thin dark navy linework, flat muted colors, almost no shading, and a calm editorial illustration feel. Use a solid {argument name="background color" default="bright cyan blue"} background with no objects, no scenery, no text. Center the bust portrait slightly left of frame, leaving negative space around the figure. Keep the mood quiet, stylish, modern, and elegant, like a Japanese social-media anime girl illustration. Do not add accessories, jewelry, or extra background elements.

items.title: Chibi Tetsuzankou Impact Attack
items.titleZh: A dynamic anime action illustration in a comedic chibi style, showing a tiny but…
items.prompt: A dynamic anime action illustration in a comedic chibi style, showing a tiny but fierce girl performing a powerful Chinese martial arts shoulder strike, tetsuzankou, into the side of a startled boy. The girl is the main focus: {argument name="character name" default="red-haired martial artist girl"}, with long vivid {argument name="hair color" default="crimson red"} hair streaming violently backward, sharp red eyes, and a determined angry expression. She is lunging from right to left at extreme speed, body low and compact, one shoulder and upper back driving into the boy’s torso, one fist pulled back and the other arm tucked for balance, with one knee bent forward and one leg trailing behind. She wears a short red Chinese-style qipao dress with gold floral embroidery, gold trim, side slit, and black flat shoes. The boy is a chibi black-haired teenager in a dark navy Chinese kung fu outfit with gold piping and black shoes, recoiling from the impact with a shocked open mouth, blank white eyes, sweat drops, and his body thrown backward to the left. Emphasize the exact moment of collision with a bright explosive impact burst at his side, flying debris, sparks, and strong speed-line distortion across the entire background. Add dust clouds and ground streaks near the girl’s trailing foot to show explosive forward momentum. Use a manga-inspired composition with exaggerated motion, foreshortening, and a diagonal rush from lower right to upper left. Include 3 large Japanese sound-effect text elements integrated into the art: one vertical right-side callout reading "鉄山靠!!", one smaller vertical annotation beside it reading "てつざんこう", and one large lower-left impact sound effect reading "ドガッ!!". The overall mood is fast, funny, aggressive, and high-impact, with polished modern anime rendering, glossy hair highlights, crisp line art, and dramatic red-white-black contrast.

items.title: 纱世里梦幻教室横幅
items.promptZh: 一幅宽幅动漫横幅插图，展示了明亮梦幻教室中的{argument name="character name" default="Sayori"}，以精美的高端视觉小说风格渲染，具有柔和的绘画灯光、温暖柔和的色彩和闪闪发光的氛围。图中是一位开朗的少女女学生，留着蓬松的珊瑚粉色短发，凌乱的波波头层次，头右侧有一个红色大蝴蝶结，穿着日本校服，浅棕色西装外套、白色衬衫、红色丝带领带、棕色毛衣背心和海军蓝百褶裙。她站在中间稍偏左的位置，张开双臂，摆出一种诱人、快乐的姿势，仿佛在欢迎观众，她的头发和衣服充满活力的视角和柔和的动作。她的脸被一个扁平的矩形肤色检查块故意遮挡。在她身后，高高的教室窗户展现出鲜艳的蓝天，柔和的白云和温暖的阳光倾泻进来。图像的右半部分有一个大型装饰性手写脚本，上面写着{argument name="headline text" default="Sayori"}，乳白色的字体带有柔和的橙金色轮廓和光芒，融入剪贴簿般的墙壁背景中。在场景周围挂上挂在绳子上的照片，包括天空照片和向日葵照片，以及手绘的云朵、星星、心形和太阳涂鸦。添加蓝色和黄色的纸星星、丝带、漂浮的五彩纸屑、蓝色纸飞机、笔记本页、螺旋素描本和分散的文具元素。将向日葵放在前景和边缘的显着位置，具有温暖的金色散景和柔和的景深。使构图充满活力、可爱、怀旧和情感振奋，就像优质的动漫主题 YouTube 横幅或角色致敬标题一样，超详细、干净、时尚、明亮且具有影响力。
items.prompt: A wide anime banner illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Sayori"} in a bright dreamy classroom, rendered in a polished, high-end visual novel style with soft painterly lighting, warm pastel colors, and sparkling atmosphere. Show a cheerful teenage schoolgirl with short fluffy coral-pink hair, messy bob layers, and a large red bow on the right side of her head, wearing a Japanese school uniform with a light brown blazer, white shirt, red ribbon tie, brown sweater vest, and pleated navy skirt. She stands slightly left of center with arms open wide in an inviting, joyful pose, as if welcoming the viewer, with dynamic perspective and gentle motion in her hair and clothes. Her face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular skin-tone censor block. Behind her, tall classroom windows reveal a vivid blue sky with soft white clouds and warm sunlight streaming in. The right half of the image features a large decorative handwritten script reading {argument name="headline text" default="Sayori"}, cream-white lettering with a soft orange-gold outline and glow, integrated into a scrapbook-like wall background. Surround the scene with hanging photo prints clipped to string, including sky photos and a sunflower photo, plus hand-drawn doodles of clouds, stars, hearts, and a sun. Add blue and yellow paper stars, ribbons, floating confetti, a blue paper airplane, notebook pages, a spiral sketchbook, and scattered stationery elements. Place sunflowers prominently in the foreground and edges, with warm golden bokeh and soft depth of field. Make the composition energetic, cute, nostalgic, and emotionally uplifting, like a premium anime-themed YouTube banner or character tribute header, ultra-detailed, clean, stylish, luminous, and impact-focused.

items.promptZh: 光滑的粉红色动漫横幅，采用宽阔的电影布局，以可爱的浪漫和糖果为主题。在右侧放置一个自信的十几岁动漫女孩，从大腿以上开始，留着{argument name="hair color" default="soft Pink"}蓬松的鲍勃短发，粉红色的大眼睛，温柔的小微笑，双臂交叉。她穿着日本校服：一件棕色西装外套、一件白衬衫、领子上有一个红色丝带蝴蝶结、以及一条深海军蓝和紫色格子裙。添加 2 个红色丝带发饰、侧面一个较大的蝴蝶结和一个较小的丝带装饰。在左半部分，采用粗体光泽 3D 草书、白色到粉色填充的大手写脚本名称 {argument name="character name" default="Natsuki"}，并带有亮粉色轮廓、柔和的斜角、微妙的阴影、闪光和融入字体的小心形花体。背景应该是腮红粉色调的分层剪贴簿拼贴，带有笔记本纸纹理、淡淡的网格和撕碎的纸张细节、散落的涂鸦心形、花瓣、闪光和可爱的面包店图案。在右上方和右中位置放置 4 张固定或粘贴的素描风格肖像卡，照片上是她身后的同一个女孩，排列得像重叠的宝丽来照片一样。在靠近左下角和中左下角的前景添加 2 个纸杯蛋糕，两者都带有粉红色糖霜、条纹包装纸和小心形装饰或糖果装饰。用飘逸的缎带和蝴蝶结构图构图：正好有 4 个主要丝带元素可见，包括左上方附近的 1 个蝴蝶结、左下角附近的 1 个蝴蝶结，以及扫过顶部和右边缘的 2 条长卷曲丝带。使用柔和的高细节动漫插画风格、精美的灯光、梦幻般的花朵、浪漫的情人节调色板、精致的纹理以及干净而有影响力的缩略图般的构图。
items.prompt: A glossy pastel pink anime banner in a wide cinematic layout, themed around cute romance and sweets. Place a confident teenage anime girl on the right side, shown from about thigh-up, with short fluffy bob hair in {argument name="hair color" default="soft pink"}, large pink-magenta eyes, a small gentle smile, and arms crossed. She wears a Japanese school uniform: 1 brown blazer, 1 white shirt, 1 red ribbon bow at the collar, and 1 dark navy-and-purple plaid skirt. Add 2 red ribbon hair accessories, one larger bow on the side and one smaller ribbon accent. On the left half, feature the large handwritten script name {argument name="character name" default="Natsuki"} in bold glossy 3D cursive, white-to-pink fill with bright pink outline, soft bevel, subtle drop shadow, sparkles, and a small heart flourish integrated into the lettering. The background should be a layered scrapbook collage in blush pink tones with notebook paper texture, faint grid and torn paper details, scattered doodled hearts, flower petals, sparkles, and cute bakery motifs. Include exactly 4 pinned or taped sketch-style portrait cards of the same girl behind her on the upper-right and mid-right, arranged like overlapping polaroids. Add exactly 2 cupcakes in the foreground near the bottom left and lower center-left, both with pink frosting, striped wrappers, and tiny heart toppers or candy accents. Frame the composition with flowing satin ribbons and bows: exactly 4 major ribbon elements visible, including 1 bow near the top left, 1 bow near the bottom left, and 2 long curling ribbons sweeping across the top and right edges. Use a soft high-detail anime illustration style, polished lighting, dreamy bloom, romantic Valentine palette, delicate textures, and a clean impactful thumbnail-like composition.

items.promptZh: 以明亮的夏季广告风格为柑橘汽水瓶制作充满活力的热带商业海报。展示一个大塑料瓶{argument name="product name" default="Soda"}，稍微向右居中，稍微向左倾斜，有一个黄色的瓶盖和覆盖着冷凝结水滴的透明瓶子，里面装满了发光的金橙色苏打水。标签应采用切片橙子和柑橘艺术品，并带有品牌文字“{argument name="product name" default="Soda"}”、短语“aux agrumes d'été”以及一个小的绿色“500 ml”标记。使用阳光明媚的海滩背景，生动的蓝天、碧绿的海洋、柔软的云彩和从右上角进入的模糊的热带棕榈叶。在瓶子底部添加戏剧性的水花，散落的透明冰块，以及前景中 5 个可见的柑橘片：2 个橙子、1 个酸橙、1 个柚子和最右边缘的 1 个部分橙片。将大的法语促销文字放在左侧：一个巨大的白色标题“{argument name =“headline text”default =“Soda”}”，上面有一个小的泼溅口音，然后是黄色脚本文字“aux agrumes d'été”在下面。在中间左侧添加黄色描边徽章，并附有文字“LA FRAÎCHEUR QUI PÉTILLE !”。在左下角添加一个垂直功能列表，其中包含 3 个圆形图标和法语标题：“SAVEURS NATURELLES”、“SANS COLORANTS ARTIFICIELS”和“EXTRA RAFRAÎCHISSANT”。在左下角添加绿色笔触横幅，上面写着“FORMAT PRATIQUE 500 ml”。在右下角添加圆形米色生态风格印章，带有绿色轮廓和叶子图案，包含文本“{argument name="seal text" default="PLAISIR FRUITÉ À CHAQUE GORGÉE"}”。灯光应该是有光泽和高能量的，具有来自左上方的强烈太阳耀斑、饱和的柑橘色、清晰的包装细节、逼真的水滴和精美的超市广告现实感。
items.prompt: Create a vibrant tropical commercial poster for a citrus soda bottle, in a bright summer advertising style. Show a single large plastic bottle of {argument name="product name" default="Soda"} centered slightly to the right, tilted a little left, with a yellow cap and transparent bottle covered in cold condensation droplets, filled with glowing golden-orange soda. The label should feature sliced oranges and citrus artwork with the brand text "{argument name="product name" default="Soda"}", the phrase "aux agrumes d'été", and a small green "500 ml" mark. Use a sunny beach background with vivid blue sky, turquoise ocean, soft clouds, and blurred tropical palm leaves entering from the upper right corner. Add dramatic water splashes around the base of the bottle, scattered clear ice cubes, and 5 visible citrus pieces in the foreground: 2 orange wedges, 1 lime half, 1 grapefruit half, and 1 partial orange slice at the far right edge. Place large French promotional text on the left: a huge white headline "{argument name="headline text" default="Soda"}" with a small splash accent above it, then yellow script text "aux agrumes d'été" underneath. Add a yellow paint-stroke badge at mid-left with the text "LA FRAÎCHEUR QUI PÉTILLE !". Add a vertical feature list on the lower left with 3 round icons and French captions: "SAVEURS NATURELLES", "SANS COLORANTS ARTIFICIELS", and "EXTRA RAFRAÎCHISSANT". Add a green brushstroke banner at the bottom left reading "FORMAT PRATIQUE 500 ml". Add a round beige eco-style seal at the bottom right with green outline and leaf motif, containing the text "{argument name="seal text" default="PLAISIR FRUITÉ À CHAQUE GORGÉE"}". Lighting should be glossy and high-energy with strong sun flare from the upper left, saturated citrus colors, crisp packaging detail, realistic droplets, and polished supermarket-ad realism.

items.title: 地景档案立体模型图
items.prompt:
请根据{argument name="主题" default="中国长城 / 珠穆朗玛峰 / 上海外滩 / 广州珠江"}创作一张高完成度、高质感、适合系列化发布的「地景档案模型 / Landscape Archive Model」视觉图。

这不是普通地图，也不是普通风景插画或城市效果图，而是一张结合“二维地图图纸 + 三维立体区域模型 + 专业说明系统 + 博物馆展陈感”的高端档案式视觉图。画面需要像一件被真实制作出来的地理研究模型、城市规划沙盘、建筑提案模型或世界观设定展品，具有专业、克制、精密、可触摸的高级质感。

【基础设定】
主题：{argument name="主题内容" default="火山口湖 / 广州 / 重庆山城"}
主题类型：【自然地貌 / 城市空间 / 混合景观】
核心主体：【核心主体，例如火山口、峡谷、山脉、湖泊、CBD、老城区、地标群、岛屿城市、遗址群、主城区域】
内容重点：【内容重点，例如地形高差 / 城市地标 / 路网结构 / 水系关系 / 自然与城市关系 / 设定集展示】
风格方向：{argument name="风格" default="地理测绘风、纸雕模型风、建筑提案风、博物馆档案风、城市规划风"}
主色调：【主色调，例如米白、浅灰、羊皮纸白、沙色、雪白】
辅助色：【辅助色，例如土褐、岩灰、冷灰、淡蓝、苔绿】
点缀色：【点缀色，例如黑色细线、红色路线、蓝色水文线、黄色编号标记】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，例如16:9横版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 1:1方图】

【画面结构】
画面主体是一块放置在干净桌面或白色布面上的矩形地图模型板。底板具有真实厚度，边缘可见剖面结构，像一块精致的地图切片或模型底座。地图表面覆盖清晰但克制的信息层，包括等高线、道路网络、水文线、分区边界、地理纹理、坐标感、轻微标注和图纸边框。

在地图中央或偏中心区域，从二维地图中立体“生长”出一个三维主体模型，成为整张图的视觉核心。

如果【主题类型】为自然地貌：
主体可由山体、峡谷、火山口、湖泊、盆地、岛屿、冰川、断层、海岸线等构成，强调地形高差、层叠等高线结构、岩壁纹理和自然地貌起伏。

如果【主题类型】为城市空间：
主体可由核心城区、CBD、老城街区、地标建筑群、滨水区、路网节点、桥梁、水系、公园绿地等构成，强调建筑体块、城市识别度、空间层次与规划结构。

如果【主题类型】为混合景观：
需同时整合自然地形与人工建成环境，例如山城、海岛城市、古城遗址、末日废墟、幻想主城、科幻基地等，让自然地貌与城市结构共同构成核心视觉。

【细节要求】
- 模型表面保留地图图纸感与专业信息感
- 地形区域应有等高线、坡面层次、凹陷与起伏关系
- 建筑区域应有体块感、街区关系 and 清晰层次
- 水域使用低饱和淡蓝色表现
- 绿地、森林、公园、山体可用苔绿色或低饱和绿色表现
- 路网、路径、交通轴线或探索线路可用细线表现，但不要喧宾夺主
- 若有地标建筑或重点结构，应具备明确识别度
- 若有幻想、科幻或游戏设定元素，应保留档案模型和图纸展示感，而不是做成纯场景插画

【说明系统】
地图板边缘需要设计完整而克制的说明模块，包括：
- 外框线和内框线
- 比例尺
- 图例区
- 标题区
- 档案编号
- 索引标记
- 注释标签
- 简洁的符号说明
文字不必全部可读，但整体必须呈现真实、清晰、精密、有秩序的档案式排版结构。

【构图与镜头】
采用斜俯视等轴测或沙盘式构图，镜头从上方约30到45度观察整块模型板，让观众同时看到地图平面、立体主体高度、边缘厚度和说明区。视觉重心集中在中央主体模型，阅读路径为：先看核心主体，再看周边地形/路网/水系/街区信息，最后看图例、比例尺和说明区。

【材质与光影】
整体需要具有真实模型摄影质感：
- 纸张纹理
- 地图印刷质感
- 纸雕或沙盘模型感
- 建筑模型或地形切片质感
- 柔和自然光
- 细腻真实阴影
- 干净背景
- 低饱和、高级、克制
避免卡通化、廉价游戏UI感、过度杂乱、过度炫技，重点突出“地图底板 + 立体主体 + 专业说明系统”的统一视觉。

最终效果应像一张可以用于地理科普、城市研究、建筑提案、文旅视觉专题、世界观设定集或高端系列封面的地景档案模型图。

items.title: 害羞少女被戳姿势
items.prompt: A soft pastel anime illustration in a cute VTuber fanart style, showing a shy petite teenage girl with light brown hair in two short braids, fluffy bangs, a small ahoge, and tiny hair clips including a heart-shaped clip. She has large warm brown eyes, a deeply embarrassed expression, flushed cheeks, teary sweat drops, and a small trembling mouth. She is sitting hunched awkwardly on a tiny wooden stool in the center of a cozy streamer bedroom, knees together, hands clenched nervously in her lap, clearly self-conscious about her posture. She wears an oversized cream hoodie, a dark short skirt, black socks, and black low-top sneakers with white laces. From the left edge of the frame, only one large hand and forearm in a dark blue sleeve enters the scene, pointing at her accusingly or teasingly. Add comic-style stress symbols around the girl: 1 red scribble frustration cloud near her head, 2 wavy trembling marks near her body, and 6 blue sweat-drop marks floating around her. On the lower right, include 1 white speech bubble with Japanese text that reads "あうぅ…！姿勢…悪い？". The background is a softly lit pastel room with a cream beanbag chair on the left, a bookshelf filled with books, small figures, plush toys, and framed items, and on the right a desk with 1 monitor, 1 PC tower, and 1 microphone arm. Add wall art and character sketches behind the desk, a pink blanket draped over furniture on the far right, a pale rug on a wooden floor, and warm indoor lighting. Use a gentle pink-beige color palette, clean line art, subtle cel shading, slightly chibi proportions, and a wholesome but comedic embarrassed mood.

items.title: 鬼族女剑士银发肖像
items.promptZh: 精致的动画插图，以平静、优雅的全身肖像描绘了一位身材高大的成年鬼女人，以四分之三的视角站立，双手交叉放在一把直立的大剑的鞍头上。她有一头长直的头发，垂过膝盖，苍白的皮肤，尖尖的精灵般的耳朵，狭长的深红色眼睛，额头上升起两只光滑弯曲的红色角。她的表情冷漠、孤傲，还带着一丝忧郁。她穿的是{argument name="outfit style" default="white ceremonial kimono with black and red sexys"}：合身的白色礼服式内层，深领口，黑色腰带和分层腰饰，半透明图案外袍，带有微妙的几何图案，宽袖为红色衬里，短裙下摆饰有烟熏暗色火焰形状。她的前臂覆盖着抛光的银色铠甲手套，增添了战士的感觉。这把剑又大又重，垂直地插在她面前，剑刃和剑柄都是黑色的，护手是金属的，中间有生动的红色火焰状图案。构图优雅而平衡，将日本传统美学与黑暗幻想融为一体。背景是柔和的淡紫灰色装饰拼贴画，圆形窗户勾勒出富士山和蜿蜒的河流景观，精致的花卉剪影和盛开的树枝，抽象的云图案，悬挂的流苏装饰品，几何纺织图案，以及右侧红色太阳般的圆圈。使用柔和的白色、紫丁香色、灰紫罗兰色、黑色和深红色作为主要调色板。添加微妙的纸张纹理、干净的线条、柔和的卡通阴影、精致的高光和华丽的高细节动漫风格。使整体气氛宁静、高贵、神秘、略带不祥，就像奢华的日式奇幻主视觉中的{argument name="character name" default="Oni Alter"}。
items.prompt: A refined anime illustration of a tall adult oni woman in a calm, elegant full-body portrait, standing in three-quarter view with her hands folded over the pommel of a large upright sword. She has very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair flowing past her knees, pale skin, pointed elf-like ears, narrow crimson eyes, and two smooth curved red horns rising from her forehead. Her expression is cool, aloof, and slightly melancholic. She wears a {argument name="outfit style" default="white ceremonial kimono with black and red accents"}: a fitted white dress-like inner layer with a deep neckline, a black obi and layered waist ornaments, a translucent patterned outer robe with subtle geometric motifs, wide sleeves lined in red, and a short skirt hem decorated with smoky dark flame shapes. Her forearms are covered in polished silver armor gauntlets, adding a warrior feel. The sword is oversized and heavy, planted vertically before her, with a black blade and hilt, metallic guard, and vivid glowing red flame-like patterns running down the center. The composition is graceful and balanced, mixing Japanese traditional aesthetics with dark fantasy. The background is a soft pale lavender-gray decorative collage with a circular window framing Mount Fuji and a winding river landscape, delicate floral silhouettes and blooming branches, abstract cloud motifs, hanging tassel ornaments, geometric textile patterns, and a red sun-like circle on the right. Use muted whites, lilacs, gray-violets, black, and deep crimson as the main palette. Add subtle paper texture, clean linework, soft cel shading, delicate highlights, and an ornate high-detail anime style. Make the overall mood serene, noble, mystical, and slightly ominous, like {argument name="character name" default="Oni Alter"} in a luxurious Japanese fantasy key visual.

items.title: 新拟态UI控件展示
items.promptZh: 干净的拟态 UI 组件展示在柔和的浅灰色背景上，排列为由 18 个独立界面元素组成的平衡设计板，具有微妙的阴影、磨砂半透明白色塑料表面、圆角和光滑玻璃般的深度。采用优质简约的产品设计美学，包括白色分层、柔和的环境光遮挡、精致的内部阴影以及深青色和鲜艳橙色的内敛色调。包括 18 个不同的组件：左上角有 1 个大圆形旋钮，中心有深青色光泽，有精细的径向刻度线和一个小的橙色位置指示器； 1 个小型圆形方向控制板，带有青色中心按钮和周围四个小箭头图标； 1 个圆形播放按钮，边缘有一个青色三角形图标和一个橙色的进度弧线；右上角有 1 个水平药丸拨动开关，右侧有一个青色旋钮； 1 个圆形方形心形按钮，带有简单的青色轮廓心形； 1 个小圆形指示器按钮，中心有一个橙色点； 1 个药丸状正负对照，左侧为青色减号，右侧为青色加号，由垂直分隔线隔开； 1 个长水平音量滑块，左侧有一个青色扬声器图标，精细的滑块刻度，一个青色轨道，右侧附近有一个青色旋钮，最右侧有一个微弱的波形图标； 1 个圆形百分比刻度盘，显示 60%，带有放射状刻度线和右上角附近的一些橙色高亮标记； 1 个圆形方形响铃通知按钮，带有青色轮廓响铃图标； 1 张紧凑型音乐播放器卡，左侧有一个薄雾常青树的小方形专辑图片，标题 {argument name="track title" default="Forest Drive"}，副标题 {argument name="track subtitle" default="Ambient Journey"}，右侧有一个细长的进度条和一个圆形播放按钮；一排 4 个小圆形实用图标按钮，显示滑块/设置、搜索、共享和省略号； 1 个大圆形指南针，带有基本字母 N、E、S、W 以及对角线标签、青色和橙色指针以及金属中心；右侧有 1 个高垂直滑块，带有青色轨道、中间青色旋钮、小侧点、底部附近的橙色口音以及下方的小扬声器图标； 1 个长圆形药丸状底部导航栏，包含 4 个由微妙分隔符分隔的图标：主页、条形图、指南针和用户配置文件，其中主页选项卡呈青色； 1 个大圆形药丸号召性用语按钮，采用光滑的深青色，标记为 {argument name="button text" default="Explore"}，右侧附有圆形橙色箭头按钮；和 1 个带有青色指纹图标的圆角方形指纹按钮。保持宽敞的间距，基于网格的对齐，以及整体渲染高度抛光、触觉和未来感，就像豪华智能设备 UI 套件模型一样。
items.prompt: A clean neumorphic UI component showcase on a soft light gray background, arranged as a balanced design board of 18 separate interface elements with subtle shadows, frosted translucent white plastic surfaces, rounded corners, and glossy glass-like depth. Use a premium minimal product-design aesthetic with white-on-white layering, soft ambient occlusion, delicate inner shadows, and a restrained accent palette of deep teal green and vivid orange. Include 18 distinct components: 1 large circular rotary knob in the upper left with a dark teal glossy center, fine radial tick marks, and a small orange position indicator; 1 small circular directional control pad with a teal center button and four tiny arrow icons around it; 1 circular play button with a teal triangle icon and a short orange progress arc on the rim; 1 horizontal pill toggle switch at the top right with a teal knob positioned to the right; 1 rounded square heart button with a simple teal outline heart; 1 small circular indicator button with a single orange dot in the center; 1 pill-shaped plus-minus control with a teal minus on the left and teal plus on the right separated by a vertical divider; 1 long horizontal volume slider with a teal speaker icon on the left, fine slider ticks, a teal track, a teal knob near the right side, and a faint waveform icon on the far right; 1 circular percentage dial showing 60% with radial ticks and a few orange highlight marks near the upper right; 1 rounded square bell notification button with a teal outline bell icon; 1 compact music player card with a small square album image of misty evergreen trees on the left, the title {argument name="track title" default="Forest Drive"}, the subtitle {argument name="track subtitle" default="Ambient Journey"}, a thin progress bar, and a circular play button on the right; 4 small circular utility icon buttons in one row showing sliders/settings, search, share, and ellipsis; 1 large circular compass with cardinal letters N, E, S, W plus diagonal labels, a teal-and-orange needle, and metallic center; 1 tall vertical slider on the right with a teal track, teal knob around the middle, small side dots, an orange accent near the bottom, and a tiny speaker icon below; 1 bottom navigation bar in a long rounded pill containing 4 icons separated by subtle dividers: home, bar chart, compass, and user profile, with the home tab active in teal; 1 large rounded pill call-to-action button in glossy dark teal labeled {argument name="button text" default="Explore"} with a circular orange arrow button attached on the right; and 1 rounded square fingerprint button with a teal fingerprint icon. Keep spacing generous, alignment grid-based, and the overall render highly polished, tactile, and futuristic, like a luxury smart-device UI kit mockup.

items.title: Neumorphic Smart Dashboard UI
items.promptZh: 一个干净的拟态移动仪表板 UI 模型直接显示，以柔和的浅灰色背景为中心，位于白色圆形智能手机框架内，具有微妙的浮雕阴影和光滑的柔和高光。界面采用简约的白底白字设计，搭配青绿色和暖橙色强调色。在手机的最顶部，左侧有一个小圆形菜单按钮、居中的扬声器狭缝和前置摄像头点，右侧的状态图标显示 Wi-Fi、信号、100% 和电池。主布局包含 12 个不同的 UI 模块：左上角有 1 个大时间卡，显示“AM”、“10:24”和“Friday, May 24”，下面有三个小分页点；右上角有一张天气卡，显示柔和的 3D 晴间多云太阳图标、“24°”、“晴间多云”和“纽约”；时间卡下方排成一排 4 个小圆形操作按钮，显示网格图标、心形、铃铛和齿轮，网格按钮填充为深青色；这些按钮右侧有 1 个细长的水平滑块卡，带有水滴图标“40%”和青色进度条； 1 个大型圆形音量控制，占据左侧中间区域，带有一个厚斜面银色旋钮，周围的刻度环分为左侧青色和右侧橙色，右上角附近有一条短橙色指示线，两侧有微小的扬声器图标，以及一个写有“音量”的药丸标签；右侧中间有 1 个音乐播放器卡，带有深青色波浪的方形专辑封面、标题“Ocean Drive”、副标题“Miami Nights”、带有时间“1:45”和“3:48”的细橙色播放进度线，以及三个用于上一首、播放和下一首的圆形传输控件，播放按钮填充青色；音乐播放器下方排成一排的 3 个小圆形按钮，显示青色的均衡器图标、广播图标和滑块图标；左下角有 1 个指南针卡，顶角有小圆形按钮，上方有标题文字“320° NW”，以及带有 N、E、S、W 字母的详细模拟指南针以及指向西北的青色和橙色指针；右下角有1个均衡器卡，有四个垂直滑块，刻度标记“+12”、“0”、“-12”，底部频率标签“60”、“250”、“1K”、“4K”、“16K”，使用橙色滑块杆和白色旋钮；和 5 个底部底座控件：一个橙色圆形电源按钮、一个小蓝牙按钮、一个中央药丸波形面板、一个新月按钮和一个太阳亮度按钮。使用柔和的环境阴影、柔和的内部浮雕、圆角、精确的间距以及受高端运球同态性启发的高级未来派智能家居或控制中心美学、超详细、清晰的矢量 UI、逼真的深度、精美的产品演示。
items.prompt: A clean neumorphic mobile dashboard UI mockup shown straight-on, centered on a soft light gray background, inside a white rounded smartphone frame with subtle embossed shadows and glossy soft highlights. The interface uses a minimalist white-on-white design with teal green and warm orange accent colors. At the very top of the phone, include a small circular menu button on the left, a centered speaker slit and front camera dot, and status icons on the right showing Wi‑Fi, signal, 100%, and battery. The main layout contains 12 distinct UI modules: 1 large time card at upper left showing “AM”, “10:24”, and “Friday, May 24” with three tiny pagination dots beneath; 1 weather card at upper right showing a soft 3D partly cloudy sun icon, “24°”, “Partly Cloudy”, and “New York”; 4 small circular action buttons in one row under the time card, showing a grid icon, heart, bell, and gear, with the grid button filled in dark teal; 1 slim horizontal slider card to the right of those buttons with a droplet icon, “40%”, and a teal progress bar; 1 large circular volume control occupying the left middle area, with a thick beveled silver knob, a surrounding tick-mark ring split into teal on the left and orange on the right, a short orange indicator line near the upper right, tiny speaker icons on both sides, and a pill label reading “VOLUME”; 1 music player card on the right middle with square album art in dark teal waves, the title “Ocean Drive”, subtitle “Miami Nights”, a thin orange playback progress line with times “1:45” and “3:48”, and three circular transport controls for previous, play, and next, with the play button filled teal; 3 small rounded buttons in a row beneath the music player, showing an equalizer icon filled teal, a broadcast icon, and sliders icon; 1 compass card at lower left with small circular buttons in the top corners, heading text “320° NW” above, and a detailed analog compass with N, E, S, W letters and a teal-and-orange needle pointing northwest; 1 equalizer card at lower right with four vertical sliders, scale markings “+12”, “0”, “-12”, and bottom frequency labels “60”, “250”, “1K”, “4K”, “16K”, using orange slider stems and white knobs; and 5 bottom dock controls: an orange circular power button, a small Bluetooth button, a central pill waveform panel, a crescent moon button, and a sun brightness button. Use soft ambient shadows, gentle inner embossing, rounded corners, precise spacing, and a premium futuristic smart-home or control-center aesthetic inspired by high-end dribbble neumorphism, ultra-detailed, crisp vector UI, realistic depth, polished product presentation.

items.promptZh: 在干净的浅灰色背景上创建优质的拟态智能家居和媒体控制 UI 套件，排列为平衡的仪表板式组合，由浮动圆形卡片和圆形控件组成，具有柔和的挤压阴影、微妙的内部高光、磨砂白色表面以及优雅的青色和橙色装饰。整体风格极简、未来感、触感、高度打磨，就像高端移动界面概念。包括 18 个独立的 UI 模块和图标：左上角有 1 个大型圆形音量旋钮卡，中心有光泽的深青色，周边有虚线，加号和减号，以及文字“VOLUME 67%”； 1 个垂直音量滑块卡，带有标签“VOLUME”、白色旋钮、橙色音量条、小扬声器图标和“67%”； 1 个大圆形平衡转盘，位于顶部中央偏右，带有数字标记 25、50、75、100，中心值“72%”，标签“BALANCE”，以及一个橙色小指示点；右上角有 1 个圆形指南针小部件，带有 N、E、S、W 标签、金属青色指南针，边缘有一个橙色小点；左侧中间有 1 个较小的圆形最小-最大旋钮，中心为青色，带纹理的白色表盘边缘，橙色指示点以及“MIN”和“MAX”标签；其下方有 3 个小圆形实用按钮，排成一排，显示电源符号、连接或无线符号以及心形轮廓；这些按钮下方有 1 个水平切换开关，带有青色旋钮和文字“ON”；中间有 1 个大型媒体播放器卡，带有方形专辑封面，显示抽象的分层青色沙丘或波浪、曲目标题“Beyond The Horizo​​n”、艺术家姓名“Aurora Nights”、右上角的心形图标、波形进度显示、时间戳“1:45”和“3:58”，以及底行的 4 个播放控件：随机播放、上一个、中央橙色播放按钮、下一个和重复；右侧两列有 6 个圆角方形应用程序图标，排成 3 行，准确显示了这些符号：纸飞机箭头、堆叠图层、带复选标记的盾牌、云、带有橙色小通知点的铃铛和齿轮；左下角有 1 个矩形时钟卡，带有圆形模拟钟面、大数字时间“10:58 AM”、日期线“星期四，5 月 23 日”以及日出/日落时间“06:15 AM”和“08:24 PM”；底部中心有一张天气卡，其中包含位置“旧金山”、当前温度“18°”、天气“晴间多云”、最高/最低“H: 21° L: 13°”、大型太阳云后插图以及标有“上午 11 点”、“下午 12 点”、“下午 1 点”、“下午 2 点”、“下午 3 点”的 5 栏每小时天气预报；右下角有 1 个药丸状选项卡选择器，有 3 个选项卡，其中左侧选项卡处于青色状态，带有音频波形图标，另外 2 个选项卡显示用户图标和文件夹图标；正下方有 1 个搜索栏，带有放大镜和占位符文本“搜索...”；搜索栏下方有 1 个水平滑块，带有青色进度线和白色旋钮；右下角有 1 个大的圆形 CTA 按钮，内容为“{argument name="button text" default="EXPLORE"}”，带有向右的橙色箭头； 5 个圆形底部导航图标位于底部边缘中央，显示主页、条形图、带有“23”的日历、聊天气泡和用户个人资料，以及旁边的 2 个浮动操作按钮：相机图标和橙色加号。使用带有白色和极浅灰色表面的内敛调色板，针对活动状态使用深青绿色渐变，针对高亮显示和通知使用暖橙色。通过柔和的环境阴影、微妙的斜角、光泽反射和逼真的材质渲染来强调深度。保持布局宽敞、对称但不死板，适合豪华移动应用概念演示。
items.prompt: Create a premium neumorphic smart-home and media control UI kit on a clean light gray background, arranged as a balanced dashboard-style composition of floating rounded cards and circular controls with soft extruded shadows, subtle inner highlights, frosted white surfaces, and elegant teal-and-orange accents. The overall style is minimalist, futuristic, tactile, and highly polished, like a high-end mobile interface concept. Include exactly 18 discrete UI modules and icons: 1 large circular volume knob card in the upper left with a glossy deep teal center, dotted perimeter, plus and minus symbols, and the text “VOLUME 67%”; 1 vertical volume slider card with the label “VOLUME”, a white knob, orange level bars, small speaker icons, and “67%”; 1 large circular balance dial at the top center-right with numeric markings 25, 50, 75, 100, the central value “72%”, the label “BALANCE”, and a small orange indicator dot; 1 circular compass widget in the upper right with N, E, S, W labels, a metallic teal compass needle, and a small orange accent dot on the rim; 1 smaller circular min-max knob on the left middle with a teal center, textured white dial edge, orange indicator dot, and “MIN” and “MAX” labels; 3 small circular utility buttons beneath it in one row, showing a power symbol, a connectivity or wireless symbol, and a heart outline; 1 horizontal toggle switch below those buttons with a teal knob and the text “ON”; 1 large media player card in the center with a square album cover showing abstract layered teal dunes or waves, the track title “Beyond The Horizon”, the artist name “Aurora Nights”, a heart icon in the top right, a waveform progress display, timestamps “1:45” and “3:58”, and 4 playback controls along the bottom row: shuffle, previous, central orange play button, next, and repeat; 6 rounded-square app icons in two columns on the right side, arranged in 3 rows, showing exactly these symbols: paper plane arrow, stacked layers, shield with check mark, cloud, bell with a small orange notification dot, and gear; 1 rectangular clock card at the bottom left with a circular analog clock face, large digital time “10:58 AM”, the date line “Thursday, May 23”, and sunrise/sunset times “06:15 AM” and “08:24 PM”; 1 weather card at the bottom center with the location “San Francisco”, current temperature “18°”, condition “Partly Cloudy”, high/low “H: 21°  L: 13°”, a large sun-behind-cloud illustration, and a 5-column hourly forecast labeled “11 AM”, “12 PM”, “1 PM”, “2 PM”, “3 PM”; 1 pill-shaped tab selector at the lower right with 3 tabs, where the left tab is active in teal with an audio waveform icon, and the other 2 tabs show a user icon and a folder icon; 1 search bar directly beneath it with a magnifying glass and placeholder text “Search...” ; 1 horizontal slider below the search bar with a teal progress line and a white knob; 1 large rounded CTA button at the bottom right reading “{argument name="button text" default="EXPLORE"}” with a right-facing orange arrow; and 5 circular bottom navigation icons centered along the bottom edge, showing home, bar chart, calendar with “23”, chat bubble, and user profile, plus 2 floating action buttons beside them: a camera icon and an orange plus sign. Use a restrained palette with white and very light gray surfaces, deep teal-green gradients for active states, and warm orange for highlights and notifications. Emphasize depth through soft ambient shadows, subtle bevels, glossy reflections, and realistic material rendering. Keep the layout spacious, symmetric but not rigid, and suitable for a luxury mobile app concept presentation.

items.title: 玻璃巨人编织世界
items.promptZh: 超详细的电影数字艺术中的一个巨大的宇宙奇幻场景：一个由透明玻璃和液晶制成的巨大坐姿人形人物占据了构图的左侧中心，其身体充满了发光的内部细丝、折射高光和表面下精致的漩涡图案。这个人物的姿势就像一位神圣的工匠或现实编织者，两只举起的手伸展并捏住图像右侧的巨大的发光金线面纱。脸部光滑而模糊，几乎像人体模型，没有任何可读的表情，强调雕塑般的身体和光线透过半透明皮肤的作用。编织的光片就像一张活生生的挂毯或薄膜，在它的内部呈现出一个完整的奇幻世界：一座高架桥、一座拥有细长塔楼和圆顶的光芒四射的未来城市、多个露台、发光的建筑，以及生长在漂浮或高架地貌上的 3 个突出的深绿色树木丛。巨人周围的环境是一个巨大的天体大厅，里面有华丽的拱门和由金光制成的分支、羽毛状的金丝结构，通向深邃的午夜蓝色、布满星星的天空。地板是黑色抛光镜面石，人物、金线和建筑都有强烈的反射。在前景中，将 5 个不同大小的反光金属或玻璃球放在地板上，捕捉周围的金色和蓝色光线。强调通过玻璃体的戏剧性折射、闪烁的焦散、复杂的线状光迹以及光滑地面上的丰富反射。调色板：深海军蓝、黑色、银蓝色和亮金色。情绪：令人敬畏、神秘、神圣、富有远见。高度复杂的巴洛克科幻奇幻美学、广角构图、史诗般的规模、锐利的细节、体积发光、超现实主义。
items.prompt: A monumental cosmic fantasy scene in ultra-detailed cinematic digital art: a giant seated humanoid figure made of transparent glass and liquid crystal occupies the left-center of the composition, its body filled with luminous internal filaments, refractive highlights, and delicate swirling patterns under the surface. The face is smooth and indistinct, almost mannequin-like, with no readable expression, emphasizing the sculptural body and the play of light through translucent skin. The woven sheet of light acts like a living tapestry or membrane, and inside it appears an entire fantastical world: 1 elevated bridge, 1 radiant futuristic city with slender towers and domes, multiple terraces, glowing architecture, and 3 prominent clusters of dark green trees growing on floating or elevated landforms. The environment around the giant is a vast celestial hall with ornate archways and branching, feather-like filigree structures made of gold light, opening into a deep midnight-blue, star-filled sky. The floor is black polished mirror stone with strong reflections of the figure, the golden threads, and the architecture. In the foreground, place 5 reflective metallic or glass spheres of varying size resting on the floor, catching the surrounding gold and blue light. Emphasize dramatic refraction through the glass body, shimmering caustics, intricate threadlike light trails, and rich reflections on the glossy ground. Color palette: deep navy, black, silver-blue, and radiant gold. Mood: awe-inspiring, mystical, divine, and visionary. Highly intricate, baroque sci-fi fantasy aesthetic, wide-angle composition, epic scale, razor-sharp detail, volumetric glow, surreal realism.

The main silhouette is the left-side profile of a young boy wearing large swim goggles pushed up on his head, his face turned to the right, with the silhouette filled by a dreamlike montage of memories and fantasy scenes. Inside the upper center of the silhouette, show 8 children from behind standing together on a ridge and looking toward a glowing, distant crystalline tower beneath a circular celestial portal in a cloudy blue-violet sky; include 7 small creature companions among them. On the upper right inside the silhouette, place a large dragon-like monster emerging from the clouds. Near the center, add a glowing round handheld digital device with a small screen, radiating light. In the middle-lower area, depict 2 iconic small dinosaur-like creatures sitting above an old shrine approach, one purple horned creature and one small yellow reptilian creature. In the lower area, show a mossy torii gate, overgrown stone steps, utility poles, and a small rural train on the right, all wrapped in mist and foliage. At the very bottom, include the 8 children again as tiny silhouettes walking away together along a path, reinforcing the theme of friendship and remembrance. Use soft ink-and-watercolor washes, muted blues, indigo, lavender, sepia, and warm golden highlights, with splattered pigment edges and painterly cloud textures. Keep the composition airy and elegant, with a refined modern poster-design sensibility and almost no generic AI gloss. Add vertical Japanese text on the right side reading あの日、僕たちは選ばれた。あの日、デジモンと出会った。 and place a Japanese title logo at the lower left reading デジモンアドベンチャー, with a small English subtitle “DIGIMON ADVENTURE” and the date line “1999 - 永遠の冒険”.

items.promptZh: 一张戏剧性的复古动漫海报，采用坚韧的科幻机甲主视觉风格，三名青少年飞行员背靠背站在前景中，一个高耸的紫色生物力学机器人隐约出现在他们身后。中间的飞行员是一名身材苗条的十几岁男孩，身穿深海军蓝和黑色插头套装，肩部镶有白色，胸前有一个发光的红色圆形核心，面朝前方站立，表情严肃。左边是一个面色苍白的少女，留着冰蓝色的鲍勃短发，穿着白色的未来派紧身衣，侧面稍微转过身。右边是一名赤褐色长发披散在侧的少女，穿着鲜艳的红色塞子套装，目光坚定地看着外面。在这三个人的身后，巨大的机甲头部占据了构图的主导地位，居中且对称，有一个角，发光的橙色眼睛，棱角分明的装甲，以及像黑色翅膀一样升起的巨大肩部结构。背景是外太空，有 2 个可见的天体：机甲头部正后方有 1 个巨大的陨石坑月亮，右侧有 1 个较小的行星。海报的底部展示了一个被毁坏的未来城市景观，其中有破碎的建筑物、瓦砾、火花和碎片。在最底部的中心，有两个微小的人类轮廓在毁灭中向前奔跑，周围是左右弧形的粉红色能量条纹。使用深靛蓝、黑色、紫色、铁锈红和灰灰色调色板，具有厚重的胶片颗粒、仿旧的墨水纹理、风化的纸张磨损、油漆飞溅、划痕的印刷损坏和粗糙的丝网印刷海报表面。将其组成完整的戏剧单页，边缘集成密集的排版：左侧较大的垂直英文标题文字为“NEON GENESIS EVANGELION”，旁边较小的垂直红色文字为“HIRANO OF EVANGELION”，红色 NERV 徽章和左下角附近的“NERV”一词，左下角的盒装标签为“TOKYO-3”和“JAPAN”，右上角的红色警告框为“ANGEL”攻击”下方有日语字符，左右边框上有多个垂直的日语标语。电影般的、喜怒无常的、世界末日般的、高度详细的、标志性的 20 世纪 90 年代动漫海报设计，具有优质的现代插图质量。
items.prompt: A dramatic vintage anime poster in the style of a gritty sci-fi mecha key visual, featuring three teenage pilots standing back-to-back in the foreground and a towering purple biomechanical robot looming directly behind them. The center pilot is a slim teenage boy in a dark navy and black plug suit with white shoulder panels and a glowing red circular core on the chest, standing front-facing with a serious expression. On the left is a pale teenage girl with short icy blue bob-cut hair and a white futuristic bodysuit, turned slightly away in profile. On the right is a teenage girl with long auburn hair flowing to the side, wearing a vivid red plug suit, looking outward with determination. Behind all three, the giant mecha head dominates the composition, centered and symmetrical, with a single horn, glowing orange eyes, angular armor, and massive shoulder structures rising like black wings. The background is outer space with 2 visible celestial bodies: 1 huge cratered moon directly behind the mecha’s head and 1 smaller planet at the right side. The bottom of the poster shows a ruined futuristic cityscape with broken buildings, rubble, sparks, and debris. At the very bottom center, include 2 tiny human silhouettes running forward through destruction, framed by pink energy streaks arcing left and right. Use a dark indigo, black, purple, rust red, and ash gray palette with heavy film grain, distressed ink texture, weathered paper wear, paint splatter, scratched print damage, and a rough screen-printed poster finish. Compose it as a full theatrical one-sheet with dense typography integrated into the edges: large vertical English title text on the left reading "NEON GENESIS EVANGELION", smaller vertical red text beside it reading "HIRANO OF EVANGELION", a red NERV insignia and the word "NERV" near the lower left, a boxed label at bottom left reading "TOKYO-3" and "JAPAN", a red warning box at the upper right reading "ANGEL ATTACK" with Japanese characters beneath, and multiple vertical Japanese taglines along the left and right borders. Cinematic, moody, apocalyptic, highly detailed, iconic 1990s anime poster design with premium modern illustration quality.

items.title: 犯罪悬疑电影海报
items.prompt: A dark, gritty Chinese crime-thriller movie poster in a vertical one-sheet layout, with a moody neo-noir aesthetic and heavy cinematic contrast. The composition centers on a half-length portrait of a menacing middle-aged East Asian man with wavy black hair, wearing a dark textured overcoat over a black shirt, his face mostly swallowed by shadow, shown from chest up and slightly off-center to the right. His hands are visible in the lower-right area, calmly holding a string of dark wooden prayer beads, suggesting power, danger, and ritual. The background is a dim urban alley or old city street at night, layered with grunge textures, wet pavement reflections, decayed walls, and faint architectural silhouettes. In the lower center, place 1 small back-facing seated figure in a chair under a harsh spotlight, surrounded by 9 standing human silhouettes in the darkness, creating a tense interrogation or underworld confrontation scene. Use an almost monochrome palette of black, charcoal, and dirty gray, with deep blood-red accents and distressed white typography. On the left side, add 1 huge vertical column of expressive red Chinese brush-calligraphy title text, painted with rough splashes and dry-brush texture, dominating nearly the full height of the poster. Along the far left edge, add 2 vertical lines of smaller Chinese text in white and red: "我叫高启强，" and "风浪越大，鱼越贵". On the right side, add 1 vertical cast credit line in white Chinese text with a red circular separator: "张颂文 饰 高启强". In the lower-right quadrant, add 1 bold white brushstroke Chinese subtitle/title mark reading "狂飙", with the small English subtitle "THE KNOCKOUT" in red serif capitals beneath it. Add tiny faint Chinese release or tagline text along the bottom edge. The overall feeling should be oppressive, violent, prestigious, and highly designed, like a premium streaming-platform crime drama key art poster, with layered depth, dramatic shadows, textured smoke and grime, and realistic photographic detail.

items.promptZh: 干净的 2x2 肖像拼贴画，照片为{argument name="subject" default="a young East Asian Woman"}，在简约的工作室环境中，背景柔和，采用高端美容编辑风格拍摄。所有四个面板都是紧密框架的特写或裁剪的半身肖像，具有柔和的漫射灯光、逼真的皮肤纹理、清晰的毛孔、微妙的自然雀斑、光泽的眼睛以及睫毛、嘴唇和发丝周围的锐利细节。整体调色板是苍白、通风和中性的，带有柔和的粉红色调，而大多数面板中的主题都是直发和纤细的刘海。在左上图中，她面朝前方，双手按在脸颊上，肘部超出画面，形成一个可爱的对称姿势；她的脸大部分被双手遮住，只能看到头发、耳朵和脸的两侧。右上角的面板中，展示了最清晰的美女肖像：直接的眼神交流，平静略带忧郁的表情，交叉的手指放在唇前，长长的半透明淡粉色美甲，手指上正好有4个厚实的粉色塑料花环，妆容精致，嘴唇轻轻分开。左下画面中，她倚在白色桌面上，一只手臂前屈，左侧头发上正好戴着两个粉色发夹，造型休闲青春，姿态轻松。在右下方的面板中，展示了一张剪裁后的肖像，头发绑在脑后，一只手支撑着下巴，穿着一件蓬松的米白色夏尔巴拉链夹克，外面套着浅粉色上衣，化着简约的妆容，表情安静自然。保持构图的编辑性和平衡性，每个面板都由白色细线分隔，超逼真的美容摄影，增强的图像清晰度，去模糊的细节，自然的皮肤，柔和的阴影和优质的化妆品广告质量。
items.prompt: A clean 2x2 portrait collage of {argument name="subject" default="a young East Asian woman"} in a minimal studio setting with a soft white background, photographed in a high-end beauty editorial style. All four panels are tightly framed close-up or cropped bust portraits with soft diffused lighting, realistic skin texture, crisp pores, subtle natural freckles, glossy eyes, and sharp details around the eyelashes, lips, and hair strands. The overall color palette is pale, airy, and neutral with gentle pink accents, while the subject has straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair and wispy bangs in most panels. In the top-left panel, she faces forward with both hands pressed to her cheeks, elbows out of frame, creating a cute symmetrical pose; her face is largely covered by her hands, only the hair, ears, and sides of the face visible. In the top-right panel, show the clearest beauty portrait: direct eye contact, calm slightly melancholic expression, crossed fingers held in front of the lips, long translucent pale pink manicure, and exactly 4 chunky pink plastic flower rings across the fingers, with delicate makeup and softly parted lips. In the bottom-left panel, she leans on a white tabletop with one arm folded forward, wearing exactly 2 pink hair clips on the left side of her hair, casual and youthful styling, relaxed posture. In the bottom-right panel, show a cropped portrait with the hair tied back, one hand supporting the chin, wearing a fluffy off-white sherpa zip jacket over a light pink top, minimal makeup, and a quiet natural expression. Keep the composition editorial and balanced, with each panel separated by thin white gutters, ultra-realistic beauty photography, enhanced image clarity, deblurred details, natural skin, soft shadows, and premium cosmetics campaign quality.

items.title: 吹泡泡破裂微距瞬间
items.promptZh: 阳光明媚的花园中肥皂泡破裂的高速微距照片，水平取景。在最左侧边缘，显示一个幼儿的侧面轮廓，可以看到脸颊、鼻子、嘴唇以及一只闭着或半闭着的眼睛的一部分，轻轻地向气泡吹气。将 1 个大肥皂泡放在框架的中左附近。气泡的左半部分完好无损，是一个光滑、有光泽、虹彩的球体，具有鲜艳的彩虹色和强烈的反光亮点，包括上部区域附近明亮的阳光闪烁以及表面树木和花园风景的倒影。气泡的右半部分向外爆炸，变成无数微小的水滴、薄雾和细小的网状液体细丝，在半空中急剧冻结，并向图像的右侧扩散。强调完整球体和破碎喷雾之间的戏剧性过渡线。使用明亮的直射阳光、非常高的快门速度、清晰的微距细节、高对比度、饱和的色彩、渲染为柔和散景的深绿叶背景以及柯达 Ektar 100 胶片外观。逼真、超详细、及时冻结的动态运动、浅景深。
items.prompt: A high-speed macro photograph of a soap bubble bursting in a sunlit garden, framed horizontally. On the far left edge, show the side profile of a young child with visible cheek, nose, lips, and part of one closed or half-closed eye, gently blowing toward the bubble. Place 1 large soap bubble near the center-left of the frame. The left half of the bubble remains intact as a smooth, glossy, iridescent sphere with vivid rainbow colors and strong reflective highlights, including a bright sun glint near the upper area and reflections of trees and garden scenery on the surface. The right half of the bubble is exploding outward into countless tiny droplets, mist, and thin web-like liquid filaments, frozen sharply in mid-air and spreading to the right side of the image. Emphasize the dramatic transition line between the intact sphere and the shattered spray. Use bright direct sunlight, very high shutter speed, crisp macro detail, high contrast, saturated color, dark green leafy background rendered as soft bokeh, and a Kodak Ektar 100 film look. Photorealistic, ultra-detailed, dynamic motion frozen in time, shallow depth of field.

items.title: 中世纪正反打镜头
items.promptZh: 电影般的中世纪镜头与反镜头组合呈现为一部坚韧的历史电影，仍然采用超宽的 21:9 宽高比、阴暗的自然光、柔和的大地色调、潮湿的秋天气氛、逼真的泥泞纹理、浅景深和强烈的前景肩部取景。场景设置在一条布满车辙的泥泞乡间小路上，穿过乡村山谷，两边都是粗糙的木栅栏，远处覆盖着稀疏树木的低矮山丘，开阔的田野，最右边的山坡上有一座浅色石砌的小农舍或教堂。两个角色在路上面对面。其中一个是一个疲惫的中世纪农民，穿着肮脏的棕色外衣和帽子，身材中等，肩上扛着一把木柄斧头，胸前绑着皮带。另一个是骑士或武装旅行者，身穿深色风化链甲和破旧的连帽外套，以戒备的姿势一动不动地站着。将其创建为电影语法反镜头演示：第一帧在右前景的后面显示了{argument name="foreground character" default="peasant man with axe"}，他的肩膀和背部占据了画面的近右侧，而{argument name="background character" default="knight in chainmail"}则在泥泞的道路上面向摄像机的左中景中站立；第二帧反转角度，左侧前景中骑士的肩膀和带兜帽的背部模糊，而农民站在右侧中景，肩上扛着斧头。使两个镜头在地点、天气、服装连续性、镜头感觉和角色间距上保持一致，并具有柔和的戏剧现实主义和紧张的对话对峙。
items.prompt: A cinematic medieval shot-reverse-shot pair presented as a gritty historical film still in an ultrawide 21:9 aspect ratio, overcast natural light, muted earth tones, damp autumn atmosphere, realistic muddy textures, shallow depth of field, and strong foreground shoulder framing. Set the scene on a rutted muddy country road running through a rural valley with rough wooden wattle fences on both sides, low rolling hills covered with sparse trees in the distance, open fields, and a small pale stone farmhouse or chapel on the far right hillside. The two characters face each other on the road. One is a weary medieval peasant man in a dirty brown tunic and cap, average build, carrying a wood-handled axe resting on his shoulder with a leather strap across his chest. The other is a knight or armed traveler in dark weathered chainmail and a worn hooded surcoat, standing still with a guarded posture. Create this as a grammar-of-cinema countershot demonstration: first frame shows the {argument name="foreground character" default="peasant man with axe"} from behind in the right foreground, his shoulder and back occupying the near right side of the frame, while the {argument name="background character" default="knight in chainmail"} stands full figure in the left midground facing camera on the muddy road; second frame reverses the angle and shows the knight’s shoulder and hooded back blurred in the left foreground while the peasant stands in the right midground holding the axe on his shoulder. Keep both shots consistent in location, weather, costume continuity, lens feel, and character spacing, with subdued dramatic realism and a tense conversational standoff.

items.title: 宝蓝礼服巴洛克群像
items.promptZh: 一张奢华的社论时尚肖像，描绘了 4 位优雅的年轻女性在深宝蓝色巴洛克风格的室内摆姿势，风格就像高级时装集体照。场景是深蓝宝石色、午夜蓝和银色的单色，背景是厚重的天鹅绒窗帘、花卉布置、古典柱子和华丽的金属容器。所有 4 名女性都穿着独特的海军蓝和钴蓝色晚礼服，配有精致的装饰：水晶珠、亮片、刺绣花卉贴花、分层薄纱、缎子和透明蕾丝。左上角的女人有一头很长的黑发，穿着一件引人注目的带有花卉刺绣的长袖透明蕾丝礼服和紧身胸衣般的紧身胸衣，将一只手臂举过头顶，摆出帝王般的姿势。右上角的女人有一头浅棕色或金色的长卷发，身穿无袖细肩带缎面长袍，胸前和腰部饰有蓝色花朵贴花，端坐，表情泰然自若。左下角的女人有一头黑色的长直发，穿着一件有结构的细肩带缎面连衣裙，上身和裙子上饰有宝石花卉装饰，还有一条宽大的褶皱裙子。右下角的女人留着长长的黑发，穿着一件带有半透明刺绣袖子的露肩透明礼服，微微前倾，一只手靠近下巴，摆出一种柔和、沉思的姿势。四人均佩戴协调的蓝宝石珠宝，包括耳环、项链和装饰性发饰。构图是一幅框架紧凑的垂直肖像，具有分层的坐姿、前景中丰富的织物、柔和的漫射工作室灯光、高细节、迷人的奢华活动造型、喜怒无常的阴影、抛光的皮肤和精致华丽的氛围。
items.prompt: A luxurious editorial fashion portrait of 4 elegant young women posed together in a dark royal-blue baroque interior, styled like a haute couture group photoshoot. The scene is monochromatic in deep sapphire, midnight blue, and silver tones, with heavy velvet drapery, floral arrangements, a classical column, and ornate metallic vessels in the background. All 4 women wear distinct navy and cobalt evening gowns with elaborate embellishment: crystal beading, sequins, embroidered floral appliqué, layered tulle, satin, and sheer lace. The top-left woman has very long black hair and wears a dramatic long-sleeved sheer lace gown with floral embroidery and a fitted corset-like bodice, raising one arm above her head in a regal pose. The top-right woman has long wavy light brown or blonde hair and wears a sleeveless spaghetti-strap satin gown with blue flower appliqués at the bust and waist, seated upright with a poised expression. The bottom-left woman has long straight black hair and wears a structured satin dress with thin straps, jeweled floral ornaments across the bodice and skirt, and a voluminous gathered skirt. The bottom-right woman has long dark hair and wears an off-shoulder sheer glittering gown with translucent embroidered sleeves, leaning forward slightly with one hand near her chin in a soft, contemplative pose. items.title: 精灵游侠卡牌
items.promptZh: 一款高度详细的奇幻集换式卡牌，采用优质收藏卡牌游戏风格，垂直布局，华丽的古董金色框架，深翠绿色珐琅面板，以及复杂的藤蔓和叶子装饰。顶部的卡片标题为 {argument name="character name" default="AELION"}，采用大号优雅的衬线大写字母，副标题为“ELF OF THE GREENWOOD”。在中央插图中，描绘了一位现实的奇幻精灵游侠站在阳光斑驳的森林中。他有一头长{argument name="hair color" default="golden blond"}头发，尖耳朵，穿着带有雕刻细节的分层深绿色皮革和金属盔甲、连帽斗篷、腰带、护腕和林地主题的装饰。他一手拿着一把华丽的反曲弓，背上背着一袋箭，摆出警惕的姿势，仿佛在树林中追踪猎物。森林背景郁郁葱葱，大气，电影般，温暖的光线穿过树枝和树叶。整体色调为绿色、古铜色、金色、土棕色，具有喜怒无常的英雄色调和写实的绘画渲染。左上角有一个圆形派系徽章，上面有 3 个金叶。右上角有一个带有白色树图标的小盾牌标志。沿着左边缘，将 4 个垂直堆叠的统计图标放置在圆形奖章中，旁边有大量数字：一把带有 3 的剑，带有 2 的盾牌，带有 3 的心，带有 2 的靴子。在左下角，添加一个带有数字 4 的大型绿色宝石状徽章。在右下角，添加一个显示弓箭符号的圆形类别或武器图标。在下三分之一的羊皮纸文本框中，包含 2 个带有装饰性叶项目符号和衬线字体的能力条目。第一个能力名称是“WOODLAND PRECISION”，后面是规则文本：“当 Aelion 攻击时，如果目标距离 2 个或更多空间，他会造成 +1 伤害。”第二个能力名称是“自然的脚步”，后面是规则文本：“每回合一次，艾利昂可以通过森林地形移动最多 2 个额外的空间。”在能力下方居中，添加斜体风格引用：{argument name="quote" default="树叶中的风是我的向导，森林是我的沉默。"} 在最底部的深绿色铭牌上，写下类型行“ALLY • ELF • RANGER”。使用清晰易读的文本、精美的卡牌游戏 UI 设计、平衡的利润以及看起来类似于高级奇幻策略卡牌的专业 TCG 产品。

items.promptZh: 一幅超详细的赛博朋克特写肖像，描绘了一位未来主义女性机器人，从肩膀向上拍摄，并以 3/4 侧面旋转，用一只可见的强烈的翠绿色眼睛直视观众。她有一头凌乱、稀疏的{argument name="hair color" default="bright teal"}头发，松散地绑在脑后，零散的发丝垂落在脸上。她的下半张脸被半透明的霓虹石灰头骨形状的呼吸面罩覆盖，面罩上有可见的牙齿结构、光滑的丙烯酸材料和内部发光的绿色亮点。她的头部和颈部部分暴露了机械解剖结构：黑色金属板、活塞、电缆、微电路、螺钉和机器人关节集成到下巴、太阳穴、耳朵区域和喉咙中。包括 5 个可见的耳洞和耳朵周围的工业控制论细节。在额头和眼睛附近的脸颊上添加微妙的印刷技术标记和微小的黑色纹身样贴花。她穿着一件黑色的未来主义高领夹克，肩部附近有一个小警告风格的标签。背景是柔焦、饱和的{参数名称=“背景颜色”默认=“橙色”}霓虹灯面板，带有模糊的界面状光块，与青色头发和酸绿色面罩形成强烈的色彩对比。灯光具有电影般的光泽，面具和金属部件上有锐利的反射，浅景深，超逼真的皮肤纹理，高对比度，喜怒无常的科幻氛围，高级概念艺术，照片真实，极其细致，85毫米肖像镜头外观。
items.prompt: A hyper-detailed cyberpunk close-up portrait of a futuristic woman cyborg, framed from the shoulders up and turned in 3/4 profile, looking directly at the viewer with one visible intense emerald-green eye. She has messy, wispy {argument name="hair color" default="bright teal"} hair tied loosely back with stray strands falling across her face. The lower half of her face is covered by a translucent neon-lime skull-shaped respirator mask with visible teeth structure, glossy acrylic material, and internal glowing green highlights. Her head and neck are partially exposed mechanical anatomy: black metal plates, pistons, cables, micro-circuitry, screws, and robotic joints integrated into the jawline, temple, ear area, and throat. Include 5 visible ear piercings and industrial cybernetic details around the ear. Add subtle printed tech markings and tiny black tattoo-like decals on the forehead and cheek near the eye. She wears a black futuristic jacket with a high collar and a small caution-style label near the shoulder. Background is a soft-focus, saturated {argument name="background color" default="orange"} neon panel glow with blurred interface-like light blocks, creating strong color contrast against the teal hair and acid-green mask. Lighting is cinematic and glossy with sharp reflections on the mask and metal parts, shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic skin texture, high contrast, moody sci-fi atmosphere, premium concept art, photoreal, extremely detailed, 85mm portrait lens look.

items.promptZh: 一幅电影般的赛博朋克肖像，描绘了一位未来派街头战士夜间站在被大雨浸透的亚洲大城市一条狭窄的霓虹灯小巷中央的情景。从胸部向上拍摄的中特写镜头，拍摄对象面向前方，脸部部分被一个大的中心矩形检查块遮挡，呈柔和的青绿色。该角色有一头凌乱的发光{argument name="hair color" default="bright blue"}头发，一个可见的控制论右眼区域，面部有金属植入物，脖子和下巴周围有电缆和机械细节，还有一件坚固的高科技装甲夹克，上面有带子、带扣、管子、分段镀层，以及发光的青色和橙色灯光。使用引人注目的青色和橙色调色板、光滑的湿路面反射、空气中的细雨、浓密的大气雾霾以及背景中霓虹灯标牌的严重散景。巷子里应该包含 8 个可见的发光标志组，大部分是垂直和水平的汉字标志，加上未来派的店面灯光和工业墙细节。使气氛坚韧、时尚、反乌托邦和超详细，主题清晰，背景模糊，仿佛来自高端科幻电影剧照。
items.prompt: A cinematic cyberpunk portrait of a futuristic street warrior standing in the center of a narrow neon-lit alley at night in a rain-soaked Asian megacity. Medium close-up framing from the chest up, subject facing forward, with the face partially obscured by a large centered rectangular censor block in muted teal-green. The character has messy glowing {argument name="hair color" default="bright cyan"} hair, a visible cybernetic right eye area with metallic facial implants, cables and mechanical details around the neck and jaw, and a rugged high-tech armored jacket with straps, buckles, tubes, segmented plating, and luminous cyan and orange light accents. Use a dramatic teal-and-orange color palette, glossy wet pavement reflections, soft rain in the air, dense atmospheric haze, and heavy bokeh from neon signage in the background. The alley should contain 8 visible glowing sign clusters, mostly vertical and horizontal signs with Chinese characters, plus futuristic storefront lights and industrial wall details. Make the mood gritty, stylish, dystopian, and ultra-detailed, with sharp focus on the subject and a blurred background, as if from a high-end sci-fi film still.

items.title: 最后晚餐历史场景
items.promptZh: 以电影化、历史性的方式描绘{argument name="scene subject" default="最后的晚餐期间耶稣和他的门徒"}，在一间简陋的古老中东餐厅里，从桌子高度的近距离、身临其境的视角进行展示，就好像观众坐在他们中间一样。其中包括 13 名男子，他们紧紧地围坐在一张又长又窄的餐桌周围，中间的人物冷静地看着耶稣，他留着齐肩的深棕色头发，留着胡须，穿着柔软的米白色长袍，搭配浅米色披肩。十二名弟子的年龄和外貌各不相同，留着卷曲或波浪形的深色头发、胡须，穿着奶油色、棕色、棕褐色、淡蓝色和灰灰色的大地色长袍，在谈话和注意力时身体向内倾斜。房间应该有粗糙的灰泥墙、深色外露的木质天花板横梁、后面的厚重木门、简单的壁龛、小油灯或烛台，发出温暖的琥珀色灯光。桌子上展示着适合乡村时期的食物和器皿：圆形面包、葡萄、橄榄、浅碗、粘土盘、陶瓷杯和铜或陶制高脚杯，中心附近有一根小蜡烛，形成焦点发光。构图应该宽阔而亲密，前景边缘稍微拥挤，一些人物被部分裁剪以增强真实感和沉浸感。灯光应该是低沉的、金色的、引人注目的，具有柔和的阴影、虔诚的情绪、逼真的肤色、自然的织物褶皱和丰富的电影对比度。以逼真的风格进行渲染，具有超详细的纹理、微妙的景深以及历史圣经电影剧照的情感基调。
items.prompt: A cinematic, historically grounded depiction of {argument name="scene subject" default="Jesus with his disciples during the Last Supper"} inside a modest ancient Middle Eastern dining room at night, shown from a close, immersive viewpoint at table height as if the viewer is seated among them. Include exactly 13 men gathered tightly around a long narrow supper table, with the central figure reading clearly as Jesus through calm presence, shoulder-length dark brown hair, a beard, and a soft off-white robe with a light beige shawl. The 12 disciples should vary in age and appearance, with curly or wavy dark hair, beards, and earth-toned robes in cream, brown, tan, muted blue, and dusty gray, leaning inward in conversation and attention. The room should have rough plaster walls, dark exposed wooden ceiling beams, a heavy wooden door at the back, simple wall niches, and small oil lamps or candle sconces casting warm amber light. On the table, show rustic period-appropriate food and vessels: round flatbread, grapes, olives, shallow bowls, clay plates, ceramic cups, and copper or earthenware goblets, with one small candle near the center creating a focal glow. Composition should be wide and intimate, slightly crowded at the foreground edges, with several figures partially cropped to enhance realism and immersion. Lighting should be low, golden, and dramatic, with soft shadows, a reverent mood, realistic skin tones, natural fabric folds, and rich cinematic contrast. Render in a photorealistic style with ultra-detailed textures, subtle depth of field, and the emotional tone of a historical biblical film still.

items.promptZh: 以电影般、逼真的方式将《最后的晚餐》重新想象成一个昏暗古老石屋内的现代不合时宜的自拍场景。展示 {argument name="centralfigure"default="Jesus"} 坐在一张质朴的长木桌中央，穿着深色大地色的圣经长袍，将一只手臂伸向镜头，拿着一部现代的黑色智能手机来拍摄集体自拍照。他周围正好有 12 个弟子，紧紧地围在桌子周围，总共 13 个人，都穿着简单的一世纪长袍，有米色、棕色、灰褐色、淡蓝色和奶油色。构图应该让人感觉亲密、略带幽默，但仍然可信，每个人都向手机倾斜，就像摆姿势拍照一样。使用温暖的烛光和柔和的火光照明，在桌子和墙壁壁龛上放置几支可见的蜡烛，营造出琥珀色的高光、深邃的阴影和神圣的旧世界氛围。包括质朴的陶器、粘土杯、木碗、撕碎的大饼和桌子上的简单食物。背景应以粗糙的灰泥石墙、悬挂的布窗帘、木钉和稀疏的历史装饰为特色。从手机摄像头的角度将其拍摄为中广角群像，具有浅景深、电影般的真实感、细致的织物纹理、自然的肤色和丰富的暖棕色调色板。
items.prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic reimagining of the Last Supper as a modern anachronistic selfie scene inside a dim ancient stone room. Show {argument name="central figure" default="Jesus"} seated at the center front of a long rustic wooden table, wearing dark earth-toned biblical robes, extending one arm toward the camera and holding a modern black smartphone to take a group selfie. Surround him with exactly 12 disciples crowded closely around the table, making 13 people total, all dressed in simple first-century robes in beige, brown, taupe, muted blue, and cream. The composition should feel intimate and slightly humorous but still believable, with everyone leaning inward toward the phone as if posing for the photo. Use warm candlelight and soft firelit illumination, with several visible candles on the table and wall niches, creating amber highlights, deep shadows, and a sacred old-world atmosphere. Include rustic pottery, clay cups, wooden bowls, torn flatbread, and simple food on the table. The background should feature rough plastered stone walls, hanging cloth drapes, wooden pegs, and sparse historical decor. Frame it as a medium-wide group portrait from the phone camera’s point of view, with shallow depth of field, cinematic realism, detailed fabric textures, natural skin tones, and a rich warm brown color palette.

items.promptZh: 以精美的编辑风格、垂直肖像方向创建高级时尚杂志封面照片，展示一位美丽的年轻成年女性在日落时分在现代金融区的中心自信地走向镜头。她以全身为中心，在街道上拍摄，具有电影般的景深，两侧是高大的玻璃办公楼，反射着温暖的金色夜光。整体氛围优雅、都市、有力、精致，就像一本关于下班后风格的高档时尚杂志封面。这位女士有一头深色的长发，在一侧编成一条粗辫子，披在肩上，身材修长精致，迈着跑道般的步伐。她身穿一件{argument name="top color" default="burnt Orange"}合身罗纹高领毛衣，肩上饰有装饰性金色纽扣，身着一件{argument name="skirt color" default="warm Brown"}高腰铅笔裙，系着一条带金色搭扣的黑色腰带，一只手拎着一个挺括的黑色手提包。她的表情应该感到平静、自信和优雅。使用讨人喜欢的柔和的黄金时段灯光、逼真的皮肤和织物纹理、服装上清晰的时尚摄影细节以​​及在广场上行走的背景中稍微模糊的商人来暗示繁忙的城市夜晚。背景应该正好包括 4 名远处的办公室职员，他们散布在走道上，逐渐失焦。添加集成在图像上的逼真杂志封面排版：左上角有一个非常大的优雅衬线报头，上面写着{argument name =“magazine title”default =“CITY POISE”}；在其左侧的下方，封面上写着“掌控夜晚的下班后风格”、“现代优雅”、“适合办公室及其他场合的精致外观。”、“工作、散步、放松。”、“与你的一天一起移动的多功能单品。”、“中性的力量”和“温暖的色调、简洁的线条、安静的自信。”；右上角有小文字“STYLE & CULTURE”和“MAY 2024”；右下方是预告片“日落会议和城市灯光。你最好的造型从这里开始。”；右下角，封面行“EVENING ELEVATED”，并附有较小的文字“从办公桌到晚餐计划——轻松的风格，完美过渡。”；右下角有一个真实的条形码框，其中包含“2024 年 5 月”、美国和加拿大价格、小发行编号和条形码行。使整体构图干净、优质、平衡，令人信服地像真正的当代时尚杂志封面。
items.prompt: Create a high-fashion magazine cover photo in a polished editorial style, vertical portrait orientation, showing a beautiful young adult woman walking confidently toward the camera in the middle of a modern financial district at sunset. She is centered full-body, photographed at street level with cinematic depth of field, framed by tall glass office towers on both sides reflecting warm golden evening light. The mood is elegant, urban, powerful, and refined, like an upscale fashion magazine cover about after-work style. The woman has long dark hair styled in a thick side braid over one shoulder, a slim sophisticated silhouette, and a poised runway-like stride. She wears a fitted ribbed turtleneck sweater in {argument name="top color" default="burnt orange"} with decorative gold buttons on one shoulder, a high-waisted pencil skirt in {argument name="skirt color" default="warm brown"}, a black belt with a gold buckle, and carries a structured black handbag in one hand. Her expression should feel calm, self-assured, and graceful. Use flattering soft golden-hour lighting, realistic skin and fabric textures, crisp fashion-photography detail on the outfit, and slightly blurred businesspeople in the background walking through the plaza to suggest a busy city evening. The background should include exactly 4 distant office workers, softly out of focus, spread across the walkway. Add realistic magazine cover typography integrated over the image: a very large elegant serif masthead on the upper left reading {argument name="magazine title" default="CITY POISE"}; beneath it on the left, the cover lines "AFTER-WORK STYLE THAT COMMANDS THE EVENING", "MODERN ELEGANCE", "Polished looks for the office and beyond.", "WORK. WALK. WIND DOWN.", "Versatile pieces that move with your day.", "THE POWER OF NEUTRALS", and "Warm tones, clean lines, Quiet confidence."; on the upper right, small text "STYLE & CULTURE" and "MAY 2024"; below that on the right, the teaser "Sunset meetings and city lights. Your best look starts here."; in the lower right, the cover line "EVENING ELEVATED" with the smaller text "From desk to dinner plans— effortless style that transitions beautifully."; and a realistic barcode box at the bottom right with "MAY 2024", US and CAN prices, small issue numbers, and barcode lines. Make the overall composition clean, premium, balanced, and convincingly like a real contemporary fashion magazine cover.

items.title: 零八公园家庭合影
items.promptZh: 一张偷拍的家庭快照，风格类似于 {argument name="year" default="2008"} 左右的消费者数码相机照片，展示了一个中国三口之家在春天的一个公园里紧密地合影。母亲在左边，蹲着，身体前倾，深色图案上衣外罩紫色开衫，蓝色牛仔裤，背着黑色单肩包。孩子位于中间，站立或半蹲在父母中间，身穿海军蓝拉链夹克，袖子有白红条纹，胸前有大号“86”印花，下身搭配橄榄色或棕色裤子。父亲在右边，蹲在孩子身边，穿着黑色长袖衬衫、蓝色牛仔裤、手表和带有可见肩带的灰色背包。三个人紧紧地靠在一起，看着镜头，摆出了典型的休闲家庭合影姿势。将它们放在一条轻石走道上，旁边是一个平静的池塘，池塘边有大型装饰性岩石。背景中，郁郁葱葱的绿树和新鲜的树叶、灰瓦屋顶的传统中式凉亭以及沿着小路和桥梁区域散布的三五成群的公园游客。白天的光线柔和明亮，有轻微的薄雾，真实的早春色彩，以及老式紧凑型相机的中等图像质量：对比度略平，轻微模糊，自然噪点，以及真实的傻瓜式快照感觉。在右下角添加黄色数码相机时间戳：{argument name="timestamp text" default="2008/04/26 10:25"}。构图应该感觉像是2000年代末在中国非正式拍摄的真实家庭旅行照片，水平取景，眼睛水平视角，纪实现实主义，没有风格化。
items.prompt: A candid family snapshot styled like a consumer digital camera photo from around {argument name="year" default="2008"}, showing a Chinese family of three posing closely together in a public park in springtime. The mother is on the left, crouching and leaning in, wearing a purple cardigan over a dark patterned top, blue jeans, and carrying a black shoulder bag. The child is in the center, standing or half-squatting between the parents, wearing a navy zip-up jacket with white and red striped sleeves and a large "86" print on the chest, with olive or brown pants. The father is on the right, crouching close to the child, wearing a black long-sleeve shirt, blue jeans, a wristwatch, and a gray backpack with visible shoulder straps. All three are gathered tightly and looking toward the camera in a typical casual family-photo pose. Place them on a light stone walkway beside a calm pond edged with large ornamental rocks. In the background, show lush green trees with fresh leaves, a traditional Chinese pavilion with a gray tiled roof, and small groups of park visitors scattered along the path and bridge area. Lighting is soft bright daytime with slight haze, realistic early-spring colors, and the modest image quality of an older compact camera: slightly flat contrast, mild blur, natural noise, and an authentic point-and-shoot snapshot feel. Add a yellow digital camera timestamp in the bottom right corner reading {argument name="timestamp text" default="2008/04/26 10:25"}. Composition should feel like a real family travel photo taken informally in China in the late 2000s, horizontal framing, eye-level perspective, documentary realism, no stylization.

items.title: 北京公园家庭合影
items.prompt: A candid-looking consumer digital camera photo from around {argument name="year" default="2008"}, showing a {argument name="family size" default="three-person"} Chinese family posing in a public park in Beijing on a mild sunny day. The father stands on the left, tall and slightly leaning in, wearing a navy jacket over a dark striped polo shirt, blue jeans, sneakers, and a brown backpack. The mother stands in the center wearing a pink knit sweater, dark jeans, and sneakers, holding a small child on her right side. The child wears a bright red hooded jacket, patterned brown pants, and small shoes, and holds a festive red cartoon helium balloon on a stick. All three face the camera in a relaxed snapshot pose. The setting is a lakeside park with a wide stone walkway sloping down toward the water, many casually dressed visitors walking or standing around, several small pedal boats and rowboats on the lake, drooping willow trees, and a traditional Chinese pavilion on the right with a dark green signboard and gold Chinese characters reading {argument name="park sign text" default="童尤公园"}. In the far background, faint mid-rise city buildings are visible beyond the trees. Use natural midday lighting, soft shadows, slightly muted colors, realistic skin tones, and the look of an ordinary family photo taken with a mid-2000s compact camera. The composition should feel authentic and unstaged, with the family centered in the foreground and the busy park scene behind them. Add a glowing orange digital camera date stamp in the bottom right corner reading {argument name="date stamp" default="'08 10 12"}. Photorealistic, documentary snapshot aesthetic, shallow to moderate depth of field, subtle lens softness, slight compression artifacts, and nostalgic late-2000s China atmosphere.

items.title: 公园家庭游客照
items.promptZh: 一张偷拍的家庭快照，风格类似于 2008 年左右在中国拍摄的消费者数码相机照片，展示了一个三人家庭一起站在中国传统的公园花园里。垂直构图，略显随意的取景，写实而不雕琢。这个家庭由 3 个人组成：左边是父亲，中右是母亲，右边是站在母亲面前的小儿子。父亲身材高大，肩膀宽阔，穿着白色短袖polo衫和浅蓝色牛仔裤，一只手臂搭在母亲的肩膀上。母亲穿着简单的白色短袖上衣和浅米色及膝裙子，以轻松的姿势靠近父亲站着。孩子穿着一件明亮的石灰绿色 T 恤，上面有红色、黄色和蓝色的大型彩色卡通风格图案，以及带有白色侧条纹的深色短裤。他们的表情很中性，摆出一张休闲的公园照片。背景充满了郁郁葱葱的绿树、修剪过的灌木丛、开着黄色和红色花朵的花坛、石头边框，左右边缘有两个可见的中国传统亭阁屋顶。白天的灯光，略显刺眼但自然的夏日午后光线，浓郁的绿色植物，温和的傻瓜相机柔和度，饱和的色彩，轻微的闪光照片感觉，微妙的数码噪点，真实的早期数码摄影外观。在右下角添加橙色数码相机时间戳：{argument name="timestamp" default="2008.05.18 14:32"}。融入了 2000 年代末中国日常家庭的淡淡怀旧之情。面孔应该是通用的、非名人的、普通中国家庭的长相。
items.prompt: A candid family snapshot styled like a consumer digital camera photo from around 2008 in China, showing a three-person family standing together in a traditional Chinese park garden. Vertical composition, slightly casual framing, realistic and unpolished. The family consists of 3 people: a father on the left, a mother in the center-right, and a young son standing in front of the mother on the right. The father is tall and broad-shouldered, wearing a white short-sleeve polo shirt and light blue jeans, with one arm resting around the mother’s shoulder. The mother wears a simple white short-sleeve blouse and a light beige knee-length skirt, standing close to the father with a relaxed posture. The child wears a bright lime green T-shirt with large colorful cartoon-style graphics in red, yellow, and blue, and dark shorts with a white side stripe. Their expressions are neutral, posed for a casual park photo. Background filled with lush green trees, trimmed bushes, flowerbeds with yellow and red flowers, stone borders, and 2 visible traditional Chinese pavilion roofs at the left and right edges. Daytime lighting, slightly harsh but natural summer afternoon light, strong greenery, mild point-and-shoot camera softness, saturated colors, slight flash-photo feel, subtle digital noise, authentic early digital photography look. Add an orange digital camera timestamp in the bottom right corner reading {argument name="timestamp" default="2008.05.18 14:32"}. Include a faint sense of everyday family nostalgia from late-2000s China. Faces should be generic and non-celebrity, ordinary Chinese family appearance.

items.title: 神经元解剖科普海报
items.promptZh: 在干净、温暖的灰白色纸背景上创建一张非常详细的{argument name="subject" default="neuron"}科学解剖海报，以博物馆品质的 3D 铅笔画和超现实生物插图的混合形式呈现。该构图以四分之三视图中的一个大神经元为中心，在有纹理的细胞体内有一个超大的球形紫色核，许多分支树突像冬天的树枝一样向外伸展，还有一个长轴突向右斜向下延伸。轴突被部分切除以显示其内部结构，并包裹在分段的蓝灰色髓鞘中，朗飞结处有可见的间隙。在远端，轴突精确地分支成 15 根细末端纤维，每根纤维末端都是一个带有浅桃色和粉红色尖端的圆形突触球。主要的中心人物应该看起来像雕塑、有机的、略带光泽，具有复杂的膜纹理、微妙的米色、象牙色、银色、棕色和紫色，以及远端分支的极其精细的线条。中心装饰周围有 6 个带标签的教育插图部分，排列得像教科书信息图：左上角有一个标题栏，上面写着 {argument name="title text" default="NEURON (NERVE CELL)"}，有一个简短的解释段落和一个包含 10 个项目的编号结构列表；右上角是一个较小的单色全神经元草图，标记为 {argument name="style note" default="3D PENCIL DRAWING"}；左下是细胞体体细胞详细图，标签指向内部细胞器；左下为髓鞘圆柱截面图；下部中心是一个带有 4 个标签的方形灰度显微视图面板；右中心是电信号部分，其中有一个小动作电位图，显示膜电位与时间的关系；右下是带有受体和神经递质标记的突触特写图。包括精细的衬线字体、精致的引导线、主神经元上的小圆圈数字，以及优雅的古老科学板块与现代生物医学可视化相结合的感觉。保持布局通风和平衡，中央神经元主导大部分画布，横向，极高分辨率，清晰的教育海报设计，以及精致的中性美学。
items.prompt: Create a highly detailed scientific anatomical poster of a {argument name="subject" default="neuron"} on a clean warm off-white paper background, presented as a museum-quality hybrid of 3D pencil drawing and ultra-realistic biological illustration. The composition centers on one large neuron in three-quarter view, with an oversized spherical purple nucleus inside a textured cell body, many branching dendrites spreading outward like winter tree branches, and a long axon extending diagonally down to the right. The axon is partially cut away to reveal its internal structure and is wrapped in segmented blue-gray myelin sheaths with visible gaps at the nodes of Ranvier. At the far end, the axon branches into exactly 15 thin terminal fibers, each ending in a rounded synaptic bulb with pale peach and pink tips. The main central figure should look sculptural, organic, and slightly glossy, with intricate membrane textures, subtle beige, ivory, silver, brown, and violet coloration, and extremely fine linework for the distal branches. Surround the centerpiece with 6 labeled educational inset sections arranged like a textbook infographic: top left a title block reading {argument name="title text" default="NEURON (NERVE CELL)"} with a short explanatory paragraph and a numbered structure list containing exactly 10 items; upper right a smaller monochrome full-neuron sketch labeled {argument name="style note" default="3D PENCIL DRAWING"}; lower left a cell body soma detail diagram with labels pointing to internal organelles; bottom left a myelin sheath cross-section cylinder diagram; lower center a square grayscale microscopic view panel with 4 labels; right center an electrical signal section with a small action potential graph showing membrane potential versus time; lower right a synapse close-up drawing with receptor and neurotransmitter labeling. Include fine serif typography, delicate leader lines, small circled numbers on the main neuron, and the feel of an elegant old scientific plate mixed with modern biomedical visualization. Keep the layout airy and balanced, with the central neuron dominating most of the canvas, landscape orientation, extremely high resolution, crisp educational poster design, and a refined neutral aesthetic.

items.title: 蒙娜丽莎泰迪熊
items.promptZh: 这是一幅莱昂纳多·达·芬奇《蒙娜丽莎》风格的超现实油画，被重新想象为泰迪熊混合肖像。画中人物以同样的半身正面姿势，双手合十，穿着原画中文艺复兴时期的深色连衣裙，披着柔软的披肩，映衬着蜿蜒的流水、远山和柔和的大气透视的经典朦胧风景。该人物头顶有 2 个毛茸茸的泰迪熊圆形耳朵，底部有 2 个折叠的毛绒毛茸茸的爪子，温暖的米色泰迪熊毛皮胸部取代了领口和双手的可见皮肤。深棕色的长发顺滑地披散在双肩上。脸部区域被故意留下为平坦的、无特征的棕色矩形块，创造出一种不可思议的审查或未完成的效果。使用裂纹的清漆纹理、古老的博物馆绘画铜绿、烟熏晕染过渡、低饱和度的棕色和橄榄色调、柔和的金色灯光、居中构图、高度细致的毛皮纹理融入古典肖像画笔法，异想天开但令人毛骨悚然的美术模仿。
items.prompt: A surreal oil painting in the style of Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa, reimagined as a teddy-bear hybrid portrait. The subject sits in the same half-length frontal pose with folded hands, wearing the dark Renaissance dress and soft draped shawl of the original painting, against the classic hazy landscape with winding water, distant mountains, and muted atmospheric perspective. The figure has 2 round fluffy teddy bear ears on top of the head and 2 plush furry paws folded at the bottom, with a warm beige teddy-bear fur chest replacing the visible skin of the neckline and hands. Long dark brown hair falls smoothly over both shoulders. The face area is intentionally left as a flat featureless brown rectangular block, creating an uncanny censored or unfinished effect. Use cracked varnish texture, aged museum-painting patina, smoky sfumato transitions, low-saturation brown and olive tones, soft golden lighting, centered composition, highly detailed fur texture blended into classical portrait brushwork, whimsical yet eerie fine-art parody.

items.title: 戴珍珠耳环泰迪熊
items.promptZh: 这是一幅 17 世纪荷兰大师风格的古典油画，其构图灵感源自维米尔 (Vermeer) 的构图，以一只泰迪熊为正式肖像的主题。熊的四分之三视图显示在深黑色背景下，从肩膀向上，它的头稍微转向观众。它有着柔软的金棕色毛绒皮毛，一只圆形的毛茸茸的耳朵清晰可见，另一只耳朵在包裹着头部的蓝色和金色大头巾下部分可见，一条长长的织物尾巴垂在右侧。这只小熊的耳朵上挂着一只超大的珍珠耳环，呼应了标志性的“戴珍珠耳环的女孩”造型。服装包括两件可见服装：一件温暖的金棕色长袍或外套，以及领口的白色小领子。使用左侧戏剧性的明暗对比灯光、丰富的绘画质感、微妙的画布纹理、逼真的织物褶皱、珍珠上柔和的高光以及博物馆品质的老大师氛围。构图简洁、居中、优雅，泰迪熊的脸被渲染成毛绒玩具版的高贵肖像主题，将可爱的玩具质感与美术写实融为一体。
items.prompt: A classical oil painting in the style of a 17th-century Dutch master, closely inspired by Vermeer’s composition, showing a teddy bear posed as the subject of a formal portrait. The bear is shown in three-quarter view from the shoulders up against a deep black background, turning its head slightly toward the viewer. It has soft golden-brown plush fur, one rounded fuzzy ear clearly visible and the other partially visible beneath a large blue-and-gold turban wrapped around its head, with a long fabric tail draping down the right side. The bear wears a single oversized pearl earring hanging from the visible ear area, echoing the iconic “girl with a pearl earring” look. The clothing includes 2 visible garments: a warm golden-brown robe or coat and a small white collar at the neckline. Use dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from the left, rich painterly texture, subtle canvas grain, realistic fabric folds, gentle highlights on the pearl, and a museum-quality old master atmosphere. Keep the composition simple, centered, and elegant, with the teddy bear’s face rendered as a plush toy version of a noble portrait subject, blending cute toy texture with fine-art realism.

items.title: 泰迪熊版创造亚当
items.promptZh: 这是一幅异想天开的高细节油画，模仿米开朗基罗的《创造亚当》，但所有人物都被泰迪熊取代。左边，一只毛绒泰迪熊斜坐在岩石斜坡上，摆出亚当的姿势，有着柔软的金棕色卷毛、圆耳​​朵、闪亮的黑眼睛、黑色的小鼻子和微张的嘴巴。它的左臂支撑着身体，右臂向外伸展，食爪伸向另一只熊。在右边，一只更大的泰迪熊摆出上帝般的姿势，从深红紫红色的旋转斗篷中出现，穿着一件飘逸的白色长袍，身体向前倾，伸出一只手臂，尖爪伸向左边的泰迪熊，几乎碰到指尖。披风内的长袍熊周围还有 8 只较小的泰迪熊，紧紧地聚集在一起，从不同的角度窥视，就像侍者的身影。该构图完全呼应了标志性的近触双手场景，指尖之间的间隙居中。使用温暖米色色调的裂纹壁画墙背景、柔和的文艺复兴调色板、柔和的定向光、逼真的织物褶皱、细致的毛绒纹理、微妙的阴影和博物馆品质的涂漆表面。将古典文艺复兴时期的壁画美学与迷人的超现实幽默融为一体，使场景保持优雅而不是卡通化。
items.prompt: A whimsical high-detail oil-painting parody of Michelangelo’s Creation of Adam, but all human figures are replaced by teddy bears. On the left, a single plush teddy bear sits reclined on a rocky slope, posed like Adam, with soft golden-brown curly fur, round ears, shiny black eyes, a small dark nose, and a slightly open mouth. Its left arm supports its body while its right arm stretches outward, index paw extended toward the other bear. On the right, a larger central teddy bear posed like God emerges from a deep reddish-burgundy swirling mantle, wearing a flowing white draped robe, leaning forward with one outstretched arm and pointed paw reaching toward the left bear, almost touching fingertips. Surrounding the robed bear inside the mantle are 8 additional smaller teddy bears clustered tightly together, peeking from different angles like attendant figures. The composition exactly echoes the iconic near-touching hands scene, with the gap between fingertips centered. Use a cracked fresco wall background in warm beige tones, muted Renaissance palette, soft directional light, realistic fabric folds, detailed plush texture, subtle shadows, and a museum-quality painted surface. Blend classical Renaissance fresco aesthetics with charming surreal humor, keeping the scene elegant rather than cartoonish.

items.title: 泰迪熊最后的晚餐
items.promptZh: 这是对《最后的晚餐》的一种异想天开而又虔诚的文艺复兴风格模仿，在一座宏伟的古典餐厅中，13只拟人化的泰迪熊坐在长长的宴会桌的一侧。中央的熊是明显的焦点，它的姿势像耶稣，面朝前方，表情平静、庄严，穿着一件带有深蓝色垂褶的柔和红色长袍。另外 12 只泰迪熊则聚集在左右两侧，每只泰迪熊的皮毛色调都略有不同，从蜜棕色到奶油色，都具有柔软的毛绒质地、圆圆的耳朵、黑色珠子般的眼睛和富有表现力的爪子。给周围的熊穿上带有泥土红色、灰蓝色、赭色和绿色的绘画圣经长袍。再现了与列奥纳多·达·芬奇的《最后的晚餐》非常接近的构图：对称的透视、格子木制天花板、三扇后窗，可以看到外面柔和的蓝色山景、两侧墙壁上的深色壁挂毯、以及悬挂在栈桥支撑上的白色长桌布。桌子上放着散落的小面包卷、盘子、碗，以及多个小玻璃杯，里面盛满了整个桌子。使用温暖的博物馆般的灯光、古老的壁画色调、柔和的阴影、细致的油画纹理和高度抛光的古典大师外观，平衡幽默与真正的艺术美。没有现代物体，没有文字，没有多余的字符，直接宽构图，完整的表格可见。
items.prompt: A whimsical yet reverent Renaissance-style parody of The Last Supper, with exactly 13 anthropomorphic teddy bears seated along one side of a long banquet table in a grand classical dining hall. The central bear is the clear focal point, posed like Jesus, facing forward with a calm, solemn expression, wearing a muted red robe with a deep blue drape. The other 12 teddy bears cluster in animated conversational groups to the left and right, each with slightly different fur tones from honey brown to cream, all with soft plush texture, rounded ears, black bead-like eyes, and expressive paws raised in discussion. Dress the surrounding bears in painterly biblical robes in earthy reds, dusty blues, ochres, and greens. Recreate the composition closely to Leonardo da Vinci’s Last Supper: symmetrical perspective, coffered wooden ceiling, three rear windows with soft blue mountain landscape visible outside, dark wall tapestries on both side walls, and a long white tablecloth hanging over trestle supports. On the table, include scattered small bread rolls, plates, bowls, and multiple small glasses of dark red wine spaced across the full length. Use warm museum-like lighting, aged fresco tones, soft shadows, detailed oil-paint texture, and a highly polished old-master look, balancing humor with genuine artistic beauty. No modern objects, no text, no extra characters, straight-on wide composition, full table visible.
