items.title: AI网页设计冲刺电影海报
items.titleZh: AI网页设计冲刺电影海报
items.promptZh: 创意编码活动的风格化电影海报，设计类似于迪士尼-皮克斯风格的单页动画电影。垂直构图，夜间温暖舒适的室内装饰，左侧的大阁楼窗户展示了日落时的城市天际线，裸露的砖墙和霓虹灯照亮的创意工作室氛围。在顶部中心，大的光滑立体排版在主标题“人工智能网页设计冲刺”上方以巨大的粗体白色 3D 字母写着“Disney•PIXAR”。正下方，较小的明亮文字写着“快速构建。打破规则。大声分享。”在中心前景中，两名成年男子并排坐在一张木桌旁，中间放着一台笔记本电脑，一派休闲的初创公司创始人氛围，其中一人穿着深色连帽衫，另一人穿着浅色运动衫，戴着棒球帽，两人都面向镜头摆出友好的促销姿势。他们的面孔应该是通用的、不引人注目的，重点是活动海报的构图而不是肖像现实主义。笔记本电脑盖上有 3 个可见贴纸：紫色代码括号贴纸、带有白色爆裂符号的黑色贴纸以及写有“快速构建。打破规则。大声分享”的矩形标语贴纸。场景周围包括 4 个异想天开的动画吉祥物元素：左上角有一个小型悬停机器人无人机灯，有发光的蓝眼睛和向下照射的锥形温暖光；右上角有一个微笑的卡通太阳图标；附近漂浮着一个微小的红色像素字符；笔记本电脑前的桌子上立着一个发光的蓝色猫状数字吉祥物。在右侧，垂直显示器显示一个深色编码界面，其中包含可读文本，包括“//欢迎回来，朱利安！”、“Opus 4.6”、“Minimal Playground”、“Agency 976”、“Cyber​​punk Cafe”、“Surfers (late set)”，以及标题为“Sprint Plan”的清单，其中包含 4 个项目：“DISCOVER”、“IDEATE”、“BUILD”、“SHIP”。左侧有一个手写纸质招牌，上面钉着 4 个告示：“4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE”、“DOORS 7PM”、“SHOW 8PM”和“$10 ADV / $12 DOS”。在左下方的前景中，一个白色咖啡杯上写着“THE SOUTH SIDE DIY 218 W. 31ST ST. CHICAGO, IL”，上面有一个小骷髅图标。在右下方的前景中，一个带有绿叶的陶土花盆上写着“创意碰撞”。在底部中心，大粗体文字写着“4 月 27-30 日”，下方写着“直播。仅在网络上”。以经典电影海报风格在底部边缘添加一小行人造字幕，引用 Julian Lopez 和 Harvey Spectre 等名字，Minimal Playground、Agency 976、Cyber​​punk Cafe 和 Surfers 等项目，以及有趣的制作字幕。使用引人注目的暖橙色和冷蓝色灯光、精美的动画电影渲染、柔和的景深、光滑的表面、丰富的对比度、高度详细的海报设计、迷人的科技初创公司能量以及优质的活动广告效果。
items.prompt: A stylized cinematic poster for a creative coding event, designed like a Disney-Pixar-inspired animated movie one-sheet. Vertical composition, warm cozy interior at night with a large loft window on the left showing a city skyline at sunset, exposed brick walls, and a neon-lit creative studio atmosphere. At the top center, big glossy dimensional typography reads "Disney•PIXAR" above the main title "The AI Web Design Sprint" in huge bold white 3D letters. Directly underneath, smaller bright text reads "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." In the center foreground, 2 adult men sit side by side at a wooden table with a laptop between them, casual startup-founder vibe, one in a dark hoodie and one in a light sweatshirt and baseball cap, both facing camera in a friendly promotional pose. Their faces should be generic and unobtrusive, with the emphasis on the event-poster composition rather than portrait realism. The laptop lid has 3 visible stickers: a purple code-brackets sticker, a black sticker with a white burst symbol, and a rectangular slogan sticker reading "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." Around the scene, include 4 whimsical animated mascot elements: a small hovering robot drone lamp in the upper left with glowing blue eyes and a cone of warm light shining downward; a smiling cartoon sun icon in the upper right; a tiny red pixel character floating nearby; and a glowing blue cat-like digital mascot standing on the table in front of the laptop. On the right side, a vertical monitor displays a dark coding interface with readable text including "// Welcome back, Julian!", "Opus 4.6", "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", "Surfers (late set)", and a checklist titled "Sprint Plan" with 4 items: "DISCOVER", "IDEATE", "BUILD", "SHIP". On the left side, a hand-lettered paper signboard contains 4 notices pinned together: "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", and "$10 ADV / $12 DOS". In the lower left foreground, a white coffee mug reads "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY 218 W. 31ST ST. CHICAGO, IL" with a small skull icon. In the lower right foreground, a terracotta plant pot with green leaves reads "CREATIVE COLLISION". At the bottom center, large bold text reads "APRIL 27–30" and below it "LIVE. ONLY ON THE WEB." Add a tiny line of faux credits along the bottom edge in classic movie-poster style, referencing names like Julian Lopez and Harvey Specter, projects such as Minimal Playground, Agency 976, Cyberpunk Cafe, and Surfers, and a playful production credit. Use dramatic warm-orange and cool-blue lighting, polished animated-film rendering, soft depth of field, glossy surfaces, rich contrast, highly detailed poster design, charming tech startup energy, and a premium event-advertisement finish.

items.title: 瑞士风AI设计冲刺海报
items.promptZh: 为实时人工智能和网页设计冲刺创建一张大胆的瑞士现代主义活动海报，纵向，具有温暖的灰白色纸张背景、纯黑色版式和鲜艳的红色强调块。构图是不对称的和编辑性的，具有强大的网格和宽敞的负空间。在左上角，放置一条小的红色大写文本行：{argument name="date text" default="LIVE APRIL 27–30"}，后面是一条向右延伸的细水平黑色线。在其下方，设置一个超大的堆叠标题，采用超粗体黑色无衬线字体，左对齐，内容为{argument name="headline text" default="The AI Web Design Sprint"}，以戏剧性的比例分成 4 行，这样文字就占据了海报的左半部分。在右上象限中，添加 1 个大的红色实心矩形作为图形块。在该红色块下方，放置一个紧凑的黑色大写副标题，分为 3 行：{argument name="tagline text" default="4 DAYS. REAL PROJECTS. SHIP TOGETHER."}。中下部分，包括两张裁剪后的男性胸部以上的灰度肖像照片，并排，纪实风格，与排版区域略有重叠；左边的男人留着深色的向后梳的头发和短胡子，右边的男人戴着深色的绣字棒球帽，留着胡须。使用以每个面为中心的 2 个垂直软边灰色审查器矩形来遮挡两个面。沿着右侧，创建一个垂直特征列，其中包含 4 个黑色方形图标，每个图标均由细水平分隔线分隔，并与大写标签配对。这 4 个项目是：带有“创意碰撞”标签的星爆图标、带有“AI-POWERED WORKFLOWS”标签的连接节点图标、带有“代码运行”标签的代码括号图标以及带有“实时设计”标签的终端提示图标。在底部附近，添加一个全角页脚，并用细水平黑色线分隔。在页脚内，创建 4 个由细垂直线分隔的文本块：第 1 块显示“快速构建。打破规则。大声分享。”，第 2 块列出“MINIMAL PLAYGROUND & AGENCY 976”，下方有一条小红线，上面写着“LIVE ON THE WEB”，第 3 块列出“CYBERPUNK CAFE SURFERS (LATE SET)”，下面列出“4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE”和然后“THE SOUTH SIDE DIY”，第 4 块将门票信息列为“门票 $10 ADV $12 DOS”。在最右下边缘，添加垂直红色文本：{argument name="location text" default="CHICAGO, IL"}。使用类似于 Helvetica 或 Akzidenz-Grotesk 的简洁 Neo-Grotesk 字体，标题采用粗体字，用于支撑文本的压缩大写字母，清晰的对齐方式，微妙的纸张纹理以及高对比度的黑红奶油色调色板。整体外观应该感觉像是一张当代设计会议海报，融合了朋克科技文化和野兽派编辑品牌。
items.prompt: Create a bold Swiss-modernist event poster for a live AI and web design sprint, portrait orientation, with a warm off-white paper background, stark black typography, and vivid red accent blocks. The composition is asymmetrical and editorial, with a strong grid and generous negative space. In the top left, place a small red uppercase line of text reading {argument name="date text" default="LIVE APRIL 27–30"}, followed by a thin horizontal black rule stretching toward the right. Below it, set an oversized stacked headline in ultra-bold black sans serif, left aligned, reading {argument name="headline text" default="The AI Web Design Sprint"}, broken across 4 lines with dramatic scale so the words dominate the left half of the poster. In the upper right quadrant, add 1 large solid red rectangle as a graphic block. Beneath that red block, place a compact black uppercase subhead in 3 lines: {argument name="tagline text" default="4 DAYS. REAL PROJECTS. SHIP TOGETHER."}. In the lower middle, include 2 cropped grayscale portrait photos of men from the chest up, side by side, documentary style, slightly overlapping the typography area; the left man has dark slicked-back hair and a short beard, the right man wears a dark baseball cap with embroidered lettering and has facial hair. Obscure both faces with 2 vertical soft-edged gray censor rectangles centered over each face. Along the right side, create a vertical feature column with 4 black square icons, each separated by thin horizontal divider lines and paired with uppercase labels. The 4 items are: a starburst icon with the label "CREATIVE COLLISION", a connected-nodes icon with the label "AI-POWERED WORKFLOWS", a code brackets icon with the label "CODE IN MOTION", and a terminal prompt icon with the label "REAL-TIME DESIGN". Near the bottom, add a full-width footer separated by a thin horizontal black rule. Inside the footer, create 4 text blocks divided by slim vertical lines: block 1 says "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD.", block 2 lists "MINIMAL PLAYGROUND & AGENCY 976" with a small red line beneath reading "LIVE ON THE WEB", block 3 lists "CYBERPUNK CAFE SURFERS (LATE SET)" and below it "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE" and then "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY", block 4 lists ticket info as "TICKETS $10 ADV $12 DOS". On the far lower right edge, add vertical red text reading {argument name="location text" default="CHICAGO, IL"}. Use a clean neo-grotesk typeface similar to Helvetica or Akzidenz-Grotesk, heavy weight for the headline, condensed uppercase for supporting text, crisp alignment, subtle paper texture, and a high-contrast black-red-cream palette. The overall look should feel like a contemporary design-conference poster mixed with punk tech culture and brutalist editorial branding.

items.promptZh: 为名为 {argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"} 的活动创建原始、高对比度的朋克摇滚演出海报拼贴画。设计应该感觉像是一张粘贴在城墙上的复印地下传单：粗糙的撕破纸边、复印颗粒、墨水污迹、仿旧的黑白纹理、热洋红色油漆泼溅、DIY 杂志美学以及用胶带粘在一起并钉在一起的混乱的分层纸屑。使用垂直海报构图，黑色背景和中央超大的撕裂白色矩形，以小角度设置，主标题填充巨大的浓缩黑色仿旧字体。在最顶部，添加一条较小的黑色撕裂条，上面有霓虹灯洋红色的手写毛笔字样：{argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"}。在左侧放置一块亮粉色撕纸，上面有手绘黑色文本，列出日期 {argument name="event days" default="April 27-30"}，然后是较小的堆叠线，上面写着“4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE”、“DOORS 7PM”、“SHOW 8PM”、“$10 ADV”和“$12 DOS”。在右侧添加一张灰白色撕破纸条，顶部带有洋红色“WITH：”，并以黑色手写文字列出四位支持者：“Minimal Playground”、“Agency 976”、“Cyber​​punk Cafe”和“Surfers (Late Set)”。在中下区域，恰好展示了两名朋克乐队成员从胸部以上的黑白影印版，肩并肩站立，两人都穿着带有补丁和别针的皮夹克；左边戴着圆框眼镜，右边戴着棒球帽。他们的脸应该是通用的，并被拼贴风格部分遮挡，因此海报的焦点仍然是印刷和图形，而不是特定的肖像。在右中添加一个亮粉色尖刺星爆，其中包含一个黑色圆圈和一个简单的白色放射状符号。在右下角附近，放置一张米色遮蔽胶带状的纸片，上面写着粗体手写黑色文字，上面写着“快速构建。打破规则。大声分享。”。在左下角附近，添加一个带有洋红色手写字样的黑色矩形场地块 {argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"} 和较小的白色地址文本“218 W. 31st Street”和“Chicago, IL”，以及附近的一个白色小骷髅图标。包括 2 个银色安全别针，一个靠近左上角，一个靠近左下区域，以及主标题纸左边缘上的 1 条深色胶带。用横跨整个宽度的黑白棋盘条完成底部边缘。整体氛围：叛逆、大声、年轻、无政府主义、街头粘贴的朋克传单与科技活动宣传片的结合，具有强烈的对比、坚韧的半色调噪音、丝网印刷的缺陷和手工拼贴的能量。
items.prompt: Create a raw, high-contrast punk rock gig poster collage for an event called {argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"}. The design should feel like a xeroxed underground flyer pasted on a city wall: rough torn paper edges, photocopy grain, ink smudges, distressed black-and-white textures, hot magenta paint splashes, DIY zine aesthetics, and chaotic layered paper scraps taped and pinned together. Use a vertical poster composition with a black background and a central oversized torn white rectangle set at a slight angle, filled with huge condensed black distressed lettering for the main title. At the very top, add a smaller black torn strip with handwritten brush lettering in neon magenta reading {argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"}. On the left side, place a hot pink torn paper block with hand-drawn black text listing the date {argument name="event dates" default="April 27-30"}, then smaller stacked lines reading "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", "$10 ADV", and "$12 DOS". On the right side, add an off-white torn note with magenta "WITH:" at the top and four supporting acts listed in black handwritten text: "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", and "Surfers (Late Set)". In the center-lower area, show exactly 2 black-and-white photocopied punk band members from the chest up, standing shoulder to shoulder, both wearing leather jackets with patches and pins; the left one has round glasses, the right one wears a baseball cap. Their faces should be generic and partially obscured by the collage styling so the poster focus remains typographic and graphic rather than portrait-specific. Add a hot pink spiky starburst on the mid-right containing a black circle with a simple white radial symbol. Near the bottom right, place a beige masking-tape-like paper scrap with bold handwritten black text reading "Build Fast. Break Rules. Share Loud.". Near the bottom left, add a black rectangular venue block with magenta hand lettering for {argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"} and smaller white address text "218 W. 31st Street" and "Chicago, IL", plus a small white skull icon nearby. Include exactly 2 silver safety pins, one near the upper left corner and one near the lower left area, and exactly 1 strip of dark duct tape on the left edge of the main title paper. Finish the bottom edge with a black-and-white checkerboard strip spanning the full width. Overall mood: rebellious, loud, youthful, anarchic, street-pasted punk flyer meets tech event promo, with intense contrast, gritty halftone noise, screen-print imperfections, and hand-made collage energy.
items.author: Ran Segall

items.title: 星空图书馆炼金术师
items.promptZh: 一幅高度装饰的全身动漫奇幻插图，描绘的是一位年轻优雅的女炼金术士{argument name="character name" default="SOPHIE"}，她站在一座巨大的天体图书馆实验室的中心。她有一头{argument name="hair color" default="platinumblond"}头发，留着柔软的短波波头，扎着侧马尾辫，戴着大水晶花发饰，尽管她的脸被一个扁平的、苍白的方形审查块遮住了。她穿着华丽的白色和冰蓝色连衣裙，饰有银色细丝、紧身胸衣系带、分层荷叶边、半透明拖尾镶片、独立飘逸袖子、宝石吊坠、大腿吊袜带装饰，以及带有金属饰边的白色高跟踝靴。她的臀部挂着两个发光的蓝色药水瓶。她的姿势优雅而自信：一只手举起，手掌上方悬浮着一块漂浮的多面蓝色水晶，另一只手拿着一本打开的魔法书，上面投射出透明的全息页面和霓虹蓝色的神秘界面图。环境是一个宏伟的圆形天文台般的图书馆，里面有高耸的书架、炼金仪器、星盘、悬挂装饰品、玻璃器皿、蜡烛和发光的魔法符号。她身后一扇巨大的背光拱形窗户投射出凉爽的天堂般的光线。她脚下的地板上覆盖着发光的同心魔法阵和反射，周围环绕着水晶般的蓝色花朵和闪闪发光的颗粒。构图垂直、居中、极其抛光，具有密集的装饰细节、空灵的灯光、分层的半透明、闪烁的亮点，以及以白色、银色、蓝宝石和浅紫色为主的调色板。在左侧添加大的装饰性标题文本{argument name="title text" default="SOPHIE"}，在下方添加较小的日文文本{argument name="subtitle text" default="ソfuィー"}，下面有一个小“CV:”行，在左下角添加一小块英文风格的小文本，在右侧添加发光的蓝色全息图面板，其中包含单词{argument name="panel text" default="SOPHIC"}。让它感觉像是神奇科学女主角的豪华角色主视觉或宣传海报，超详细、有光泽、容光焕发，并且故意夸张。
items.prompt: A highly embellished full-body anime fantasy illustration of {argument name="character name" default="SOPHIE"}, a young elegant female alchemist-mage standing in the center of a vast celestial library laboratory. She has {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair in a soft short bob with a side ponytail and a large crystalline flower hair ornament, though her face is obscured by a flat pale square censor block. She wears an ornate white and icy-blue dress with silver filigree, corset lacing, layered ruffles, translucent trailing panels, detached flowing sleeves, gemstone pendants, thigh garter ornaments, and white high-heeled ankle boots with metallic trims. Two glowing blue potion bottles hang at her hip. Her pose is graceful and confident: one hand raised with a floating faceted blue crystal hovering above her palm, the other holding an open magic book that projects transparent holographic pages and arcane interface diagrams in neon blue. The environment is a grand circular observatory-like library with towering bookshelves, alchemical instruments, astrolabes, hanging ornaments, glassware, candles, and luminous magical symbols. A huge backlit arched window behind her casts cool heavenly light. The floor beneath her is covered in glowing concentric magic circles and reflections, surrounded by crystalline blue flowers and sparkling particles. The composition is vertical, centered, and extremely polished, with dense decorative detail, ethereal lighting, layered translucency, shimmering highlights, and a palette dominated by white, silver, sapphire, and pale violet. Include large decorative title text on the left reading {argument name="title text" default="SOPHIE"}, smaller Japanese text beneath reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="ソフィー"}, a small "CV:" line below, a short block of tiny English flavor text on the lower left, and a luminous blue hologram panel on the right with the word {argument name="panel text" default="SOPHIC"}. Make it feel like a luxurious character key visual or promotional poster for a magical science heroine, ultra-detailed, glossy, radiant, and intentionally over-the-top.

items.promptZh: 一张高度详细的电影级第三人称武侠 MMORPG 游戏截图，背景设定在黄昏时分繁华的中国古代水乡市场街道上，从站在中央前景的玩家角色后面观看。玩家角色是一位流浪剑客，身着深灰蓝叠层绣花汉服，一头黑色长发扎成低马尾，背负一把入鞘剑，面朝拥挤的街道。环境是一个浓郁的明宋风格小镇，有传统的木制店面、瓦片屋顶、悬挂的红灯笼、粉红色的樱花树、潮湿的反光石路面、柔和的金色傍晚灯光，以及穿着历史服装的城镇居民。右前景正好是三位身着半透明粉彩汉服的优雅女妓，坐在装饰华丽的茶馆或青楼外，挂着红色的丝绸窗帘；一位在弹奏琵琶，一位穿着淡绿色和奶油色的袍子坐着，一位穿着飘逸的玫瑰粉色袍子站着。他们上方最大的商店招牌在黑色牌匾上刻有大型金色中国书法，街道上还悬挂着带有汉字的垂直商店横幅。构图应该感觉像是一款优质的 AAA 奇幻中国角色扮演游戏，具有逼真的角色比例、密集的环境故事讲述、戏剧性但自然的灯光、大气深度和复杂的服装材料。包括一个完整的中文游戏 HUD 覆盖：左上角的圆形人物肖像，等级为 36 级，2 个水平条表示生命值和法力；左侧任务跟踪器面板，选项卡式标题下正好有 4 个任务条目；左下半透明聊天框，多行中文世界聊天；右上角带有位置文本的圆形小地图；右侧垂直菜单正好有 6 个图标按钮；底部中心技能栏，正好有 10 个插槽，包括 8 个方形技能图标和 2 个标有键盘按键的圆形末端插槽；底部菜单行正好有 6 个导航图标。超详细、逼真的奇幻游戏界面模型，精美的UI，身临其境的拥挤街道场景，16:9的宽高比。
items.prompt: A highly detailed cinematic third-person wuxia MMORPG gameplay screenshot set in a bustling ancient Chinese water-town market street at dusk, viewed from behind the player character standing in the center foreground. The player character is a wandering swordsman in layered dark gray and blue hanfu-style robes with embroidered fabric, long black hair tied in a low ponytail, and a sheathed sword on his back, facing forward into a crowded street. The environment is a richly rendered Ming- or Song-inspired town with traditional wooden shopfronts, tiled roofs, hanging red lanterns, pink cherry blossom trees, damp reflective stone pavement, soft golden evening light, and a lived-in crowd of townsfolk in historical clothing. On the right foreground, exactly 3 elegant female courtesans in translucent pastel hanfu sit and stand outside a richly decorated teahouse or brothel draped with red silk curtains; one is playing a pipa, one is seated in pale green and cream robes, and one stands in flowing rose-pink robes. The largest shop sign above them features large gold Chinese calligraphy on a black plaque, and additional vertical shop banners with Chinese characters hang along the street. The composition should feel like a premium AAA fantasy Chinese RPG, with realistic character proportions, dense environmental storytelling, dramatic but natural lighting, atmospheric depth, and intricate costume materials. Include a complete game HUD overlay in Chinese: top left circular character portrait with level 36 and 2 horizontal bars for health and mana; a left-side quest tracker panel with exactly 4 quest entries under tabbed headings; a bottom left semi-transparent chat box with multiple lines of Chinese world chat; a top right circular minimap with location text; a right-side vertical menu with exactly 6 icon buttons; a bottom center skill bar with exactly 10 slots including 8 square skill icons plus 2 circular end slots labeled with keyboard keys; and a bottom menu row with exactly 6 navigation icons. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic fantasy game interface mockup, polished UI, immersive crowded street scene, 16:9 aspect ratio.
items.author: jimifan

items.title: 武侠RPG古城市集截图
items.promptZh: 电影般的第三人称奇幻 RPG 游戏截图，背景设定在中国古代集市的黄金时刻，从一小群前景角色的稍后方观看，俯视一条繁忙的石头铺成的街道，眺望远处一座宏伟的多层宝塔。场景十分密集，恰好有一名中心男性英雄穿着华丽的深红色和黑色长袍，带有金色的盔甲，手持一把向下的出鞘剑，而他身边恰好有一名女性同伴，穿着优雅的白色汉服，红色饰边和金色配饰。他们周围正好有 4 个模糊的前景旁观者或警卫在取景，其中 2 个在左边，2 个在右边，再加上一大群穿着古装的城镇居民挤满了街道。两侧是传统的木结构建筑，带有弧形瓦顶，悬挂着灯笼、红色横幅、织物遮阳篷、市场摊位和温暖的窗灯。添加空气中漂浮的花瓣或发光的颗粒、柔和的大气雾霾、强烈的深度、以及带有长阴影的丰富温暖的阳光。图像应该感觉像是一款经过精心打磨的 AAA 开放世界武侠动作游戏，高度细节、戏剧性、身临其境、真实且具有风格化的幻想美感。包含完整的游戏内 HUD 叠加层：带有图标的右上角方形小地图、带有 3 个可见条目的右侧任务列表，其中 1 个为{argument name="quest Objective" default="探索西门府"}，2 个为重复的战斗相关任务、左下角带有生命值和耐力条的圆形玩家状态区域以及位置文本 {argument name="location name" default="定和县"}，底部中心的操作栏恰好有 6圆形技能图标，右下角一排恰好有 8 个小菜单或系统图标。采用宽广的16:9构图、超细致的环境艺术、电影般的灯光、浅浅的前景模糊，以及雄伟的中国历史奇幻氛围。
items.prompt: A cinematic third-person fantasy RPG gameplay screenshot set in an ancient Chinese market city at golden hour, viewed from slightly behind a small group of foreground characters and looking down a busy stone-paved street toward a grand multi-tier pagoda in the distance. The scene is dense with exactly 1 central male hero in ornate dark red and black robes with gold armor accents, holding a drawn sword pointed downward, and exactly 1 female companion beside him in elegant flowing white Hanfu with red trim and gold accessories. Around them are exactly 4 blurred foreground onlookers or guards framing the shot, 2 on the left and 2 on the right, plus a large crowd of townspeople in period clothing filling the street. Traditional wooden buildings with curved tiled roofs line both sides, with hanging lanterns, red banners, fabric awnings, market stalls, and warm window lights. Add drifting flower petals or glowing particles in the air, soft atmospheric haze, strong depth, and rich warm sunlight with long shadows. The image should feel like a polished AAA open-world wuxia action game, highly detailed, dramatic, immersive, and realistic with stylized fantasy beauty. Include a full in-game HUD overlay: a top-right square minimap with icons, a right-side quest list with exactly 3 visible entries where 1 reads {argument name="quest objective" default="Explore Ximen Mansion"} and 2 are repeated combat-related quests, a bottom-left circular player status area with health and stamina bars and the location text {argument name="location name" default="Dinghe County"}, a bottom-center action bar with exactly 6 circular skill icons, and a bottom-right row of exactly 8 small menu or system icons. Use a wide 16:9 composition, ultra-detailed environment art, cinematic lighting, shallow foreground blur, and a majestic historical Chinese fantasy atmosphere.
items.author: jimifan

items.title: 四大凶兽神态姿势图
items.prompt: 饕餮：眼神{argument name="眼神1" default="贪婪凶恶"}，{argument name="神态1" default="凶猛"}的神态，攻击型的姿势，混沌：眼神{argument name="眼神2" default="半开半合"}，{argument name="神态2" default="懵懂"}的神态，慵懒的姿势，穷奇：眼神狡诈，凶狠，厌恶良善的神态，徘徊狡猾的姿势，梼杌：眼神目空一切，傲慢的神态，顽固、蛮不讲理、横行霸道的姿势。
items.author: liuhuofeiyan

items.title: 雨夜车窗边的女子
items.promptZh: 大雨中电影般的夜间街景，从车外拍摄，可近距离观看后侧窗的四分之三景色。一名留着齐肩湿发的年轻女子，双臂交叉靠在敞开的车窗框上，头靠在上面，凝视着外面，心情安静而忧郁。她穿着一件{argument name="top color" default="white"}长袖衬衫。车身占据了画面的右半部分，上面布满了密密麻麻的闪闪发光的雨滴，车窗饰板和车门表面的细节十分清晰。女人的脸部分被阴影和取景所遮挡，营造出匿名性和神秘感。图像的左半部分显示了一条失焦的城市街道，在顶部和中距离附近正好有 2 个温暖的琥珀色路灯，可以看到发光的球体，再加上交通和红色、蓝色、白色和橙色标牌的彩色散景。潮湿的沥青以长条纹反射灯光。现场可见雨丝。使用浅景深、强烈的橙色和青色对比、光泽反射、喜怒无常的黑色氛围、逼真的摄影、高对比度、柔和的电影绽放以及稍微过度处理的人工智能照片感觉，偶尔出现高频闪光和雨噪。方形构图。
items.prompt: A cinematic night street scene in heavy rain, shot from outside a car with a close three-quarter view of the rear side window. A young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length wet hair leans her folded arms on the open car window frame and rests her head on them, gazing outward with a quiet, melancholic mood. She wears a {argument name="top color" default="white"} long-sleeve blouse. The car body fills the right half of the frame, covered in dense sparkling raindrops, with the window trim and door surface sharply detailed. The woman’s face is partially obscured by shadow and framing, creating anonymity and mystery. The left half of the image shows an out-of-focus city street with exactly 2 warm amber streetlights visible as glowing orbs near the top and middle distance, plus multicolored bokeh from traffic and signage in red, blue, white, and orange. Wet asphalt reflects the lights in long streaks. Visible rain streaks fall through the scene. Use a shallow depth of field, strong orange-and-teal color contrast, glossy reflections, moody noir atmosphere, realistic photography, high contrast, soft filmic bloom, and a slightly overprocessed AI-photo feel with occasional high-frequency sparkle and rain noise. Square composition.
items.author: DynamicWang

items.title: 雨夜街头公交行人
items.promptZh: 从低街道角度观看大雨中的电影城市夜街场景。在前景中，一名孤独的行人以近乎黑色的轮廓出现，从左到右，大步跨过，头顶上撑着一把打开的雨伞，穿着一件深色外套，背着背包。人的脸被阴影和逆光遮挡。在右侧的中场，一辆城市公交车驶近，车头灯明亮而温暖，琥珀色的 LED 路线显示屏因雨水和运动而显得有些模糊。最左侧，1 个行人过路灯呈红色亮起，并带有举起的手图标。街道上布满了反光的大水坑，在沥青上形成了红色、蓝色、橙色和白色霓虹灯和红绿灯的强烈镜面条纹。高大的建筑排列在街道两侧，形成一条密集的市中心走廊，散落的照明标志和窗户融入深蓝黑色的雨天氛围中。强调光滑的湿路面、闪闪发光的雨滴、散景光散射、强烈的对比度、戏剧性的背光、喜怒无常的黑色情绪、逼真的摄影、浅景深和充满活力的过饱和反射。使用宽屏构图，步行者的轮廓位于左中，巴士位于右中。
items.prompt: A cinematic urban night street scene in heavy rain, viewed from a low street-level angle. In the foreground, 1 solitary pedestrian appears as a nearly black silhouette crossing left to right, mid-stride, holding 1 open umbrella overhead and wearing a dark coat with a backpack. The person’s face is obscured by shadow and backlighting. In the midground on the right, 1 city bus approaches with bright warm headlights and an amber LED route display, slightly blurred by rain and motion. On the far left, 1 pedestrian crossing signal glows red with a raised hand icon. The street is soaked with large reflective puddles, creating intense mirrored streaks of red, blue, orange, and white neon and traffic lights across the asphalt. Tall buildings line both sides of the street as a dense downtown corridor, with scattered illuminated signs and windows fading into a deep blue-black rainy atmosphere. Emphasize glossy wet pavement, sparkling raindrops, bokeh light scatter, strong contrast, dramatic backlighting, moody noir mood, realistic photography, shallow depth of field, and vibrant over-saturated reflections. Use a widescreen composition, with the silhouetted walker centered-left and the bus positioned mid-right.
items.author: DynamicWang

items.title: 黑色穆勒鞋产品照
items.promptZh: 一张温馨的社论风格生活方式产品照片，在室内以低特写角度拍摄，重点关注一位女士试穿一双带有棕褐色人造毛皮衬里的黑色皮革露背乐福鞋时的小腿和脚部。右脚穿着一只乐福鞋，左脚裸露，悬停在带纹理的奶油色粗毛地毯上方，而第二个配套的乐福鞋则位于左下方前景的地毯上。该鞋款采用光滑的黑色皮革鞋面、圆形杏仁形鞋头、开放式穆勒鞋跟、开口周围溢出的毛绒棕色皮毛，鞋面饰有小型抛光金色马衔扣硬件细节。模特穿着中蓝色九分牛仔裤，毛边下摆。环境是舒适的简约内饰，奶油色地毯上有两条不规则的黑色细线，中性墙壁，右上方背景中带有中等木框的倾斜矩形镜子，柔和地反射地毯和部分场景。使用柔和的自然窗户光、浅景深、微妙的胶片颗粒、逼真的皮肤纹理、柔和的米色和黑色调色板、轻松坦率的构图、高级时尚目录情绪、高细节、逼真。
items.prompt: A warm, editorial-style lifestyle product photo shot indoors from a low close-up angle, focused on a woman's lower legs and feet as she tries on 1 pair of black leather backless loafers with tan faux-fur lining. One loafer is worn on the right foot and the left foot is bare, hovering just above the textured cream shag rug, while the second matching loafer lies on the rug in the lower left foreground. The shoes have smooth black leather uppers, a rounded almond toe, open mule-style heel, plush brown fur spilling out around the opening, and a small polished gold horsebit hardware detail across the vamp. The model wears cropped medium-blue denim jeans with a raw frayed hem. The setting is a cozy minimalist interior with a cream rug featuring 2 thin irregular black lines, a neutral wall, and a leaning rectangular mirror with a medium wood frame in the upper right background, softly reflecting the rug and part of the scene. Use soft natural window light, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, realistic skin texture, muted beige and black palette, relaxed candid composition, premium fashion catalog mood, high detail, photorealistic.
items.author: DynamicWang

items.title: 老照片去黄除污修复
items.prompt: 配置・文字・構図・デザインは一切変更せず, 経年劣化（黄ばみ・汚れ・色褪せ・折れ・擦れ）のみ補正してください。
items.author: プチpony

items.title: Studio Portrait From Vacation Selfie
items.titleZh: 度假自拍照的工作室肖像
items.promptZh: 使用提供的参考图像，保留同一个人和同一件蓝色 Polo 衫，但将休闲的池畔自拍照转换为干净的专业工作室头肩肖像。删除整个户外度假村背景，并用纯色暖橙色背景替换。重新构图，使拍摄对象居中，正对相机，从胸部中部向上裁剪，摄影室灯光均匀，照片质量清晰、抛光。消除自拍的感觉、背景干扰和其他人，并在右下角添加一个小的白色四点闪光图标。
items.prompt: Using the provided reference image, keep the same person and the same blue polo shirt, but transform the casual poolside selfie into a clean professional studio head-and-shoulders portrait. Remove the entire outdoor resort background and replace it with a solid warm orange backdrop. Reframe the shot so the subject is centered, facing the camera straight-on, cropped from mid-chest upward, with even soft studio lighting and a sharp, polished photo quality. Eliminate the selfie feel, background distractions, and other people, and add a small white four-point sparkle icon in the bottom-right corner.
items.author: Ramón G. Bárcena

items.title: 泳池自拍改职业头像
items.promptZh: 使用提供的参考图像，将休闲的池畔自拍照转变为干净的专业头肩工作室肖像。保留同一个人和同一件 Polo 衫，但删除户外度假村背景、其他人、家具、游泳池和所有度假背景。重新构图为居中的肖像裁剪，拍摄对象面向相机，肩膀可见，并将自拍角度校正为正式的直立构图。添加光滑的深青色工作室背景，带有微妙的渐晕和柔和、讨人喜欢的肖像照明，打造精美的企业简介照片外观。
items.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the casual poolside selfie into a clean professional head-and-shoulders studio portrait. Keep the same person and the same polo shirt, but remove the outdoor resort background, other people, furniture, pool, and all vacation context. Reframe to a centered portrait crop with the subject facing the camera, shoulders visible, and the selfie angle corrected into a formal straight-on composition. Add a smooth dark teal studio backdrop with subtle vignetting and soft, flattering portrait lighting for a polished corporate profile-photo look.
items.author: Ramón G. Bárcena

items.title: 足球赛事海报改造
items.promptZh: 您是一位具有人情味的高级平面设计师。改造这张无聊的海报，使其成为{argument name="event" default="upcoming Football event"}的大胆而有吸引力的海报。
items.prompt: You are a premium graphic designer with a human feel. Transform this boring poster and make it a bold and attractive poster for an {argument name="event" default="upcoming soccer event"}.
items.author: MrDejie

items.title: 九宫格生活感人像
items.prompt: 参考图片的人物面部特征 ,生成九宫格拼图，生活感抓拍，摄影写真，85mm镜头。浅景深，背景虚化，高分辨率，细节清晰 穿着{argument name="服装" default="白色衬衫，白色短裤"}，简约干净穿搭， 室内拍摄，白色背景墙，靠窗，自然光，阳光柔和，高调光，明亮通透，柔和阴影。{argument name="风格" default="日系清新风格，韩系写真风"}，空气感，干净画面，极简风，多姿态拍摄，站立、坐姿、回头、近景特写、半身、全身。
items.author: Biteye小师妹｜KiKi

items.title: 汉堡王韩文新品海报
items.promptZh: 汉堡王的戏剧性快餐海报广告，垂直构图，逼真的工作室食品摄影与大胆的韩国促销图形设计相结合。将汉堡王官方徽标置于顶部中央。在其下方，以堆叠布局添加巨大的仿旧韩文标题文本，内容为“신제품 와퍼 출시!” “와퍼”为鲜艳的深红色，其他文字为纹理灰白色，全部位于深烟熏黑色背景上。在中间，展示了一个巨大的英雄汉堡，从稍低的前角拍摄，完美居中并填充了大部分画面。汉堡有8个清晰可见的层次和元素：光滑的芝麻面包、卷曲的绿叶生菜、厚厚的红色番茄片、厚厚的白洋葱圈、切片泡菜、番茄酱条、融化的美国奶酪、带有严重焦痕的火焰烤牛肉饼和软底面包。添加一个漂浮在顶部发髻上方的小金色皇冠图标。汉堡放在一个深色质朴的木树桩基座上。用戏剧性的橙色火焰、炽热的余烬、热火花和烟熏气氛围绕下半部和侧边缘，以强调火焰烧烤。在底部附近，以粗体文字居中放置第二条韩语标语，内容为“불맛의 정점을 경험하라”，“불맛”为红色，其余文字为暖米色金色，上方由一个小火焰图标分隔。在最底部添加一个带有深色边框的红色徽章形状标签，其中包含粗体黑色的韩文文本“한정 판매”。使用高对比度的黑色、红色、橙色和烤棕色调色板、强烈的电影灯光、光泽的食物亮点、清爽的成分质地、优质的商业广告效果和火热的放纵情绪。
items.prompt: A dramatic fast-food poster advertisement for Burger King, vertical composition, photorealistic studio food photography mixed with bold Korean promotional graphic design. Place the official Burger King logo centered at the very top. Below it, add huge distressed block Korean headline text in a stacked layout reading "신제품 와퍼 출시!" with "와퍼" in vivid deep red and the other words in textured off-white, all on a dark smoky black background. In the center, show one massive hero burger shot from a slightly low front angle, perfectly centered and filling most of the frame. The burger has 8 clearly visible layers and elements: a glossy sesame seed top bun, curly green leaf lettuce, thick red tomato slices, thick white onion rings, sliced pickles, streaks of ketchup, melted American cheese, a flame-grilled beef patty with heavy char marks, and a soft bottom bun. Add a tiny golden crown icon floating just above the top bun. The burger sits on a dark rustic wooden stump pedestal. Surround the lower half and side edges with dramatic orange flames, glowing embers, heat sparks, and smoky atmosphere to emphasize flame grilling. items.title: 恶魔女助理职场海报
items.prompt: Create a dramatic Chinese social-media poster in a warm amber office setting, featuring a stylish demon-themed female assistant character seated at a desk. The composition is a single vertical poster with dense graphic design, cinematic lighting, and a premium glossy illustration style mixing anime realism and commercial advertising. At the top, place a huge bold red Chinese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="龙虾夏夏"}, with an elegant handwritten script overlay reading {argument name="signature text" default="Xia Xia"}. Under it, add a strong black Chinese slogan: {argument name="subtitle text" default="嘴欠，但能交付"}. The character is centered, upper body visible behind a desk, with messy vivid red hair in a loose bun and many flyaway strands, small dark red devil horns, pale skin, black layered clothing, a lanyard ID badge, long red metallic claw gloves, and a tired but dangerous office-worker aura. Her face is intentionally obscured by a square censor block in the center. She props her cheek with one clawed hand and holds a branded black takeaway coffee cup in the other hand. Add subtle lobster-inspired details in the outfit and props, including segmented glossy red shell-like forms behind and around her chair. The desk contains exactly 7 visible items: 1 open laptop with a red lobster logo and the words "XIA XIA", 1 closed dark book stack beneath the laptop, 1 open notebook with handwritten sketches and Chinese notes, 1 black fountain pen, 1 rectangular black desk nameplate with Chinese text, 1 takeaway coffee cup with matching lobster logo, and 1 hanging employee badge card. In the left background, show a computer or presentation screen displaying a Feishu-style document interface with the Chinese title "内容创作流程" and a simple 3-step flowchart labeled exactly "场景", "流程", "资产", plus the sentence "Agent 是放大器，不是方向盘。" Add a sticky note near that screen reading "扣瑞芋". In the upper left, include a yellow annotation box with the Chinese text "黄叔雇来的毒舌但能干的AI实习生" and a playful doodled face beside it. In the right background, pin up 3 office notes: 1 clipboard-style intern profile card titled "实习生档案" with multiple bullet lines of Chinese profile text and a handwritten sign-off, 1 checklist board titled "今日待办" with 5 checkbox items and a red star on the final line, and 1 yellow sticky note reading "老板别演". Make all Chinese typography feel intentionally designed, as if for a meme ad campaign and character branding poster. At the bottom, add a bold centered Chinese footer slogan reading {argument name="footer slogan" default="不演龙虾，我就是龙虾。"}. Use orange sunset backlight, warm shadows, glossy reflections on the claws, a cluttered but stylish startup office atmosphere, black and burnt-orange color grading, and a humorous yet competent "sharp-tongued AI intern" vibe. Include visible branding text "XIA XIA" on the cup and laptop, and make the whole image feel like a high-end character promo poster for an assistant persona used in workplace AI marketing.

items.prompt: A minimalist fine-art poster portrait of a woman in clean side profile facing right, shown from about mid-torso up, with her face partially obscured by a soft rectangular blur over the front of the head. She has dark black hair styled in a low loose bun with gentle volume and wispy strands, and wears 1 dangling silver earring on the visible ear. Dress her in a structured black blazer or tailored coat with a deep neckline. The lower half of the figure dissolves into elongated dripping black ink trails, with many uneven vertical streaks extending downward like wet paint pulled by gravity, creating a dramatic melting silhouette. Place 1 large, perfectly round vivid red disc directly behind her head and upper shoulders, centered like a halo or rising sun. Use a strictly limited palette of black, red, and warm off-white. Set the background to a soft cream paper or canvas texture with subtle grain. Light the subject like a high-end noir editorial portrait with strong contrast, sculpted highlights on the ear, jaw, neck, and cheek contour, and deep shadow across the clothing. Keep the composition tall and centered with generous negative space, elegant poster-like balance, moody contemplative atmosphere, and crisp, refined photographic detail blended with painterly graphic design.

items.promptZh: 创作一张极简主义垂直艺术海报，其中一名男子侧面轮廓简洁，面向左侧，从大腿中部向上显示，穿着定制的深色西装外套、挺括的白衬衫和 1940 年代风格的复古黑色软呢帽，配有丝带。他的姿势挺拔、沉稳、自信，让人想起经典的黑色主角。以精致的单色摄影风格渲染人物，具有清晰的编辑细节、丰富的色调对比和伦勃朗风格的戏剧性灯光，用深阴影塑造脸颊、耳朵、下巴、帽檐和肩膀。将 1 个粗体完美圆形红色圆盘直接放在头部和上躯干后面，像光环或升起的太阳一样居中，形成鲜明的图形焦点。背景应该是干净的灰白色或奶油色纸张纹理表面，在主题周围有微妙的纹理和宽敞的负空间。人物的下半部分应该溶解成细长的黑色墨滴：数12条不同粗细的明显主要滴迹，从夹克下摆和下半身垂下，有的长而直，有的逐渐变细，有一些小飞溅，仿佛身体正在渗入画布。将调色板严格限制为黑色、红色和暖灰白色。整体情绪应该是喜怒无常、沉思、优雅、略显不祥和现代主义，就像一张高端画廊海报，将黑色电影肖像与超现实水墨抽象融为一体。
items.prompt: Create a minimalist vertical art poster featuring a single man in clean side profile facing left, shown from about mid-thigh upward, wearing a tailored dark suit jacket, crisp white shirt, and a vintage 1940s-style black fedora with a ribbon band. Render the figure in a refined monochrome photographic style with crisp editorial detail, rich tonal contrast, and dramatic Rembrandt-inspired lighting that sculpts the cheek, ear, jawline, hat brim, and shoulder with deep shadow. Place 1 bold perfectly round red disc directly behind the head and upper torso, centered like a halo or rising sun, creating a stark graphic focal point. The background should be a clean off-white or cream paper-textured surface with subtle grain and generous negative space around the subject. The lower half of the figure should dissolve into elongated black ink drips: count 12 distinct major dripping trails of varying thickness, hanging from the jacket hem and lower body, some long and straight, some tapering, with a few small splatters, as if the body is bleeding into the canvas. Keep the color palette strictly limited to black, red, and warm off-white. The overall mood should be moody, contemplative, elegant, slightly ominous, and modernist, like a high-end gallery poster blending film noir portraiture with surreal ink-paint abstraction.

items.prompt: 生成一张 9:16 竖版手机截图风格的真实抖音直播间画面，主题是{argument name="直播主题" default="《凡人修仙传》三位人物直播卖法宝"}。三人同框，从左到右的人物气质分别参考韩立、紫灵、玄骨，但不要显示角色名字，也不要做成二次元立绘，要像真人感很强的修仙主播。服装、妆造和气质保留东方修仙风格，同时符合真实直播镜头效果。当前展示商品是{argument name="展示商品" default="“天雷竹”"}，放在画面中央偏前景重点展示，商品卡或直播信息区清楚显示“天雷竹”和{argument name="商品价格" default="“9999块灵石”"}。天雷竹要有珍稀灵宝质感，竹体细节清晰，带轻微真实的雷电气息，不要夸张特效。直播间氛围非常热闹，要有真实抖音直播 UI、弹幕、点赞、在线人数、直播标识和商品卡。弹幕里大量出现《凡人修仙传》相关人物昵称刷屏，像真实粉丝互动。整体效果必须像中国真实热门抖音带货直播截图，真实、热闹、有手机截图感。不要像动漫插画，不要像电影海报，不要像游戏宣传图，不要英文 UI，不要过强魔法爆炸特效。
items.author: 水木易

items.title: 奢华口红广告海报
items.promptZh: 一张奢侈化妆品广告海报，其中一个直立的{argument name="product type" default="lipstick"}以光滑的黑色立方体底座为中心，衬托出丰富的单色{argument name="background color" default="deep crimson red"}工作室背景。该产品是一款大胆的缎面唇膏，其子弹头完全伸展，具有戏剧性的雕刻尖端和双色管：鲜艳的红色上壳和哑光黑色下壳。在黑色底座的正面，垂直的白色品牌文字为 {argument name="brand name" default="BOBBI BROWN"}。将优雅的社论副本放在左侧，采用精致的高级时尚衬线布局，分成多行，阅读{argument name =“headline text”default =“It’s not just a唇膏，这是一种态度。”}，最后一个词采用斜体样式，并比文本的其余部分稍微明亮的珊瑚红色调。在右上角添加 1 个白色小徽标水印，内容为 {argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"}。使用具有柔和但高对比度高光的电影产品照明、底座上的微妙反射、清晰的边缘、优质的美容广告造型、简约的构图、方形格式、干净的负空间以及精美的电子商务就绪豪华广告美学。
items.prompt: A luxury cosmetics advertisement poster featuring a single upright {argument name="product type" default="lipstick"} centered on a glossy black cube pedestal against a rich monochrome {argument name="background color" default="deep crimson red"} studio background. The product is a bold satin-finish {argument name="product shade" default="true red"} lipstick with the bullet fully extended, dramatic sculpted tip, and a two-tone tube: vivid red upper casing and matte black lower casing. On the front of the black base, vertical white brand text reads {argument name="brand name" default="BOBBI BROWN"}. Place elegant editorial copy on the left side in a refined high-fashion serif layout, split across multiple lines, reading {argument name="headline text" default="It’s not just a lipstick, it’s an attitude."}, with the final word styled in italic and a slightly brighter coral-red tone than the rest of the text. Add 1 small white logo watermark in the top-right corner reading {argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"}. Use cinematic product lighting with soft but high-contrast highlights, subtle reflections on the pedestal, crisp edges, premium beauty-campaign styling, minimalist composition, square format, clean negative space, and a polished ecommerce-ready luxury ad aesthetic.

items.title: 未来感墨镜促销海报
items.promptZh: 时尚的高端电子商务产品广告，以一副光滑的黑色设计师太阳镜为中心，以带有圆角和发光蓝白色边缘照明的未来派金属底座为中心。太阳镜以四分之三正面视图展示，略微倾斜，配有厚实的超大方形猫眼镜框、深灰色渐变镜片，镜腿上有微妙的金色品牌字样“TOUS”，以及铰链附近的金色小熊形标志。背景是一个黑暗的科幻工作室，具有反光的黑色和青铜色表面、垂直的建筑灯带、柔和的体积发光和酷炫的霓虹灯装饰。在右上角，添加一个粗体的促销文字布局，其中品牌标记 {argument name="brand name" default="Pollo.ai"} 位于一个大的堆叠标题上方，上面写着 {argument name="headline text" default="SUMMER SALE"}，SUMMER 为白色，SALE 为亮电蓝色，后面是一个巨大的白色折扣数字 {argument name="discount" default="50%"}。在标题区域的一部分周围添加一条细细的未来派蓝色框线。使用戏剧性的商业照明、锐利的反射、奢侈品摄影造型、浅景深、超干净的构图、优质的在线商店广告美学、逼真的渲染、高对比度和清晰的细节。
items.prompt: A sleek high-end ecommerce product advertisement featuring a pair of glossy black designer sunglasses centered on a futuristic metallic pedestal with rounded corners and glowing blue-white edge lighting. The sunglasses are shown in a three-quarter front view, slightly angled, with thick oversized square-cat-eye frames, dark gray gradient lenses, and subtle gold branding on the temples reading TOUS, plus a small gold bear-shaped logo near the hinge. The setting is a dark sci-fi studio with reflective black and gunmetal surfaces, vertical architectural light strips, soft volumetric glow, and cool neon accents. In the upper right, add a bold promotional text layout with the brand mark {argument name="brand name" default="Pollo.ai"} above a large stacked headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="SUMMER SALE"}, with SUMMER in white and SALE in bright electric blue, followed by a huge white discount figure {argument name="discount" default="50%"}. Include a thin futuristic blue frame line around part of the headline area. Use dramatic commercial lighting, sharp reflections, luxury product photography styling, shallow depth of field, ultra-clean composition, premium online store ad aesthetic, photorealistic rendering, high contrast, and crisp detail.

items.title: 奢华香水广告大片
items.promptZh: 一张豪华电子商务广告照片，展示的是抛光灰白色大理石梳妆台上的高级香水瓶，以温暖的电影摄影棚风格拍摄，具有柔和的金色灯光、浅景深和优雅的反射。构图呈方形且高端，香水瓶位于框架稍偏右的位置，促销文字位于左侧。瓶子是一个高大的雕刻沙漏形玻璃瓶，底部有烟熏透明灰色玻璃，颜色逐渐变深，有光泽的金色球形瓶盖，刻有精美品牌的金色颈圈，正面有一个大型金属金色联锁字母组合。保持品牌风格的感觉，但不要添加额外的产品。在左前景中，包括 1 个带有金边的切割水晶碗，部分剪裁。在右侧背景中，包括 1 个拉丝金色圆柱形花瓶，其中装有 1 束柔软的白色花朵，模糊。在瓶子后面，添加 1 个黑色大理石矩形盒子，带有微妙的白色纹理和金色镶边。在右下前景中，包括一块悬垂的香槟色缎布，柔和地失焦。背景应该是深色的、奢华的、柔和模糊的，具有丰富的棕黑色色调和左侧的垂直阴影面板以支持排版。在左上角添加优雅的衬线标题文本：{argument name="headline text" default="Premium Perfume,"}，采用大号暖米色字母，下方有一个较小的衬线副标题：{argument name="tagline" default="Subtlety and Elegance"}，在副标题下方添加一条细短的金色水平线。在右上角放置一个白色小徽标，内容为 {argument name="brand logo" default="Pollo.ai"}。强调优质材料、逼真的玻璃折射、金色金属亮点、奢侈品摄影、精致的构图、柔和的散景和高档的美容广告美学。
items.prompt: A luxury e-commerce advertising photo of a premium perfume bottle on a polished gray-and-white marble vanity, shot in a warm cinematic studio style with soft golden lighting, shallow depth of field, and elegant reflections. The composition is square and high-end, with the perfume bottle centered slightly right of frame and promotional text on the left. The bottle is a tall sculpted hourglass-shaped glass flacon with smoky transparent gray glass fading darker at the base, a glossy gold spherical cap, a gold collar engraved with fine branding, and a large metallic gold interlocking monogram on the front. Keep the branding-inspired feel but do not add extra products. In the foreground left, include 1 cut-crystal bowl with a gold rim, partially cropped. In the background right, include 1 brushed gold cylindrical vase holding 1 bouquet of soft white flowers, blurred. Behind the bottle, add 1 black marble rectangular box with subtle white veining and gold trim. In the lower right foreground, include 1 draped piece of champagne-colored satin fabric, softly out of focus. The background should be dark, luxurious, and softly blurred, with rich brown-black tones and a vertical shadowed panel on the left to support typography. Add elegant serif headline text on the upper left reading {argument name="headline text" default="Premium Perfume,"} in large warm beige letters, with a smaller serif subheading beneath reading {argument name="tagline" default="Subtlety and Elegance"}, plus a thin short gold horizontal line below the subheading. Place a small white logo in the top-right corner reading {argument name="brand logo" default="Pollo.ai"}. Emphasize premium materials, realistic glass refraction, gold metallic highlights, luxury product photography, refined composition, soft bokeh, and upscale beauty-ad aesthetics.
items.author: Miguel Ángel | Educador en IA

items.title: 南航A380起飞实拍
items.promptZh: 一张高度逼真的航空照片，显示一架{argument name="airline" default="China Southern"}空客{argument name="aircraft model" default="A380"}在{argument name="airport" default="上海浦东国际机场"}旋转准备起飞，以长焦观察员风格从侧面拍摄。飞机正在跑道上方略微向上爬升，起落架仍处于伸出状态，所有四个发动机都可见，白色机身带有深蓝色的辅助线，前机身上有大型中国航空公司字样，侧面有英文航空公司名称，以及带有红色木棉花标志的亮蓝色尾翼。显示背景中的机场航站楼和右侧高大的空中交通管制塔，在晴朗的日光下，有轻微的雾霾和逼真的机场氛围。包括跑道边缘细节、滑行道标志、干草前景以及航站楼附近至少 2 架小型背景飞机，其中一架似乎类似于旧东航的制服。自然纪实摄影，锐利的细节，准确的比例，真实的灯光，3:2的构图，没有插画造型，没有戏剧性的日落色彩。
items.prompt: A highly realistic aviation photograph of a {argument name="airline" default="China Southern"} Airbus {argument name="aircraft model" default="A380"} rotating for takeoff at {argument name="airport" default="Shanghai Pudong International Airport"}, captured from the side in a telephoto spotter style. The aircraft is climbing slightly nose-up just above the runway with landing gear still extended, all four engines visible, white fuselage with a deep blue cheatline, large Chinese airline lettering on the forward fuselage, English airline name along the side, and a bright blue tailfin with a red kapok flower logo. Show the airport terminal buildings in the background and a tall air traffic control tower on the right side, under clear daylight with mild haze and realistic airport atmosphere. Include runway edge details, taxiway signs, dry grass foreground, and at least 2 small background aircraft near the terminal, one plausibly resembling an older China Eastern livery. Natural documentary photography, sharp detail, accurate proportions, realistic lighting, 3:2 composition, no illustration styling, no dramatic sunset colors.

items.prompt: A realistic documentary-style photo of the entrance area inside {argument name="station name" default="Jing'an Temple Station"} on {argument name="subway line" default="Line 2"} in Shanghai Metro, viewed from a passenger's eye level while walking toward the fare gates. The scene is a wide indoor station concourse with a modern ceiling made of dark brown curved wooden slats and long linear white lights. In the center hangs a large dark overhead wayfinding sign with a green square route marker showing the number 2 and the text “2号线 / Line 2,” the main station name “静安寺站 / Jing'an Temple Station,” and a service center icon with the bilingual text “服务中心 / Service Center.” Below the sign are multiple stainless steel fare gates, with exactly 6 visible gate lanes in the foreground, some showing green arrow indicators and at least one showing a red no-entry symbol. Show a busy but orderly flow of commuters, around 10 to 15 adults in everyday autumn clothing, seen mostly from behind, walking into the station through the gates; include jackets, jeans, backpacks, shoulder bags, and neutral colors. On the left wall, include ticket or vending machines and another smaller green Line 2 sign. On the right wall, create a decorative white station wall with large black Chinese calligraphy reading “静安寺” and subtle wave-like graphic lines, plus a small green Line 2 marker nearby. Materials should feel authentic: polished gray speckled stone floor, metallic columns, tiled walls, and realistic transit fixtures. Lighting is bright, even, and fluorescent, with a clean public-transport atmosphere. Compose it as a slightly wide-angle smartphone photo, centered on the overhead sign and gate area, highly realistic, candid, detailed, and true to an actual Shanghai metro station interior.

items.title: 多哈海滨咖啡厅人像
items.promptZh: 为黄金时段坐在{argument name="location" default="多哈豪华海滨咖啡馆"}的{argument name="subject" default="年轻女子"}创作一幅超现实的电影肖像。 100% 准确度保留参考图像中准确的面部特征、比例、肤色和表情。她的造型就像一位优雅的阿拉伯女性，穿着{argument name="outfit" default="带有精致金色刺绣的黑色长袍"}，佩戴精致的珠宝，头戴自然垂坠的精致头巾。她坐在传统的户外议会风格的环境中，配有图案垫子、阿拉伯灯笼和木桌。她的姿势平静而自信，用手轻轻托着下巴，直视镜头。背景展示了多哈的天际线和海滨沿岸的传统木制单桅帆船，温暖的日落灯光反射在水面上。场景中任何地方都没有可见的文字、徽标或标牌。灯光：柔和的黄金时刻辉光、电影亮点、温暖的色调、脸上的自然阴影。相机：85mm镜头，浅景深，超细节，8K分辨率，单反画质。风格：写实、电影、奢华生活方式摄影、丰富的纹理、高度细致的面料和皮肤。
items.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} sitting at a {argument name="location" default="luxury waterfront café in Doha"} during golden hour. Preserve the exact facial features, proportions, skin tone, and expression from the reference image with 100% accuracy. She is styled as an elegant Arabian woman, wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="black abaya with intricate gold embroidery"}, delicate jewelry, and a subtle head covering draped naturally. She is seated at a traditional outdoor majlis-style setting with patterned cushions, Arabic lanterns, and a wooden table. Her pose is calm and confident, resting her chin gently on her hand while looking directly at the camera. Background shows the Doha skyline and traditional wooden dhow boats along the waterfront, with warm sunset lighting reflecting on the water. No visible text, logos, or signage anywhere in the scene. Lighting: soft golden hour glow, cinematic highlights, warm tones, natural shadows on face. Camera: 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed, 8K resolution, DSLR quality. Style: photorealistic, cinematic, luxury lifestyle photography, rich textures, highly detailed fabrics and skin.

items.prompt: A cinematic photorealistic portrait of a young woman sitting barefoot on a rectangular hay bale inside a rustic wooden barn at night, wearing a flowing mustard-yellow satin maxi dress with thin spaghetti straps, a deep neckline, a small bow-tie knot at the center of the bust, a fitted waist, and a long draped skirt pooling onto the straw-covered floor. She has long wavy auburn-brown hair styled half-up in a loose top knot, with soft strands falling over her shoulders. Her pose is elegant and demure: legs crossed at the ankles and extended forward, one hand resting near her lap, the other hand raised to partially cover her face. Warm golden light from the right side illuminates her skin and dress, creating soft highlights and deep shadows, while cool blue moonlight enters from a small open window on the left. Outside the window, show a bright full moon in a dark blue sky with silhouettes of pine trees. The barn interior is made of dark stained vertical wooden planks with built-in bench ledges along the walls, scattered loose straw on the floor, and 2 visible hay bales, including the one she sits on. Shot full body in a vertical composition, centered slightly right of frame, shallow depth of field, intimate moody atmosphere, high-detail skin and fabric texture, editorial fashion photography, soft cinematic contrast.

items.promptZh: 一幅黑色超详细动漫网络哥特式肖像，描绘了一个{argument name="character type" default="female elf Warriors"}的四分之三侧面轮廓，从大腿上部到头部，站在一座废弃的未来工业城市中。她有一头短而钝的鲍勃，{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"}，苍白的皮肤，长而尖的精灵耳朵，表情冷静冷酷，一只明显发光的{argument name="eye color" default="crimson red"}眼睛。她的头发被风吹过脸庞，太阳穴附近戴着黑色星形金属发饰。服装是一件时尚的黑色生物力学装甲连衣裙，具有光滑的黑曜石表面、尖刺和分层板、肩膀和胸部周围撕裂的蕾丝状纹理以及复杂的恶魔外骨骼细节。一只手臂被重装成巨大的有机机械手套。她握着或融合了一把巨大的锯齿状活剑，从左下前景斜向她的躯干；这把剑是黑色金属制成的，上面有发光的纹理，嵌入了红色的核心，猛烈的熔化能量像液体火焰一样在其中爆发。红色能量丝带、火花、烟雾和余烬状粒子在她的身体和武器周围旋转。背景是一个垂直的反乌托邦巨型结构，里面充满了黑色钢塔、电缆、悬挂的链条、红色全息代码的碎片、神秘技术徽章和微弱的工业符号，所有这些都被阴影吞没了。使用黑色和深红色调色板，具有极端的对比度、光泽高光、锐利的边缘光、头后戏剧性的背光、密集的细节、混乱的绘画效果和严峻的世界末日氛围。构图应该感觉像优质的黑暗幻想关键艺术，高度抛光，电影化，令人生畏，优雅且具有爆炸性。
items.prompt: A dark ultra-detailed anime cyber-gothic portrait of a {argument name="character type" default="female elf warrior"} in a three-quarter side profile, framed from upper thighs to head, standing in a ruined futuristic industrial city. The background is a vertical dystopian megastructure filled with black steel towers, cables, hanging chains, fragments of red holographic code, occult-tech insignias, and faint industrial symbols, all mostly swallowed by shadow. items.title: 赛博朋克女巫与恶魔
items.promptZh: 夜晚，一个戏剧性的动漫风格的赛博朋克女巫站在一座黑暗的屋顶上，高高地俯瞰着一座密集的未来城市，从稍微升高的角度观看。主角是一位身材娇小的年轻女巫，皮肤苍白，留着冰蓝色的短发，尖尖的耳朵，红红的眼睛，带着狡黠自信的微笑。她右手举起一根黑色魔杖，顶端悬挂着一个悬挂着的球体咒语，发出淡淡的紫色和红色光芒。她的超大号歪女巫帽是黑色的，带有紫色衬里，上面布满了缝制补丁、警告标签、带子和白色图形，包括一个大的“404”和一个骷髅徽章。她穿着一套黑色和紫色的科技服装：带有许多肩带和标签的超大连帽夹克、胸前带有“404”字样的黑色短上衣、分层腰带、短裤、一条腿上的渔网、黑色系带作战靴、颈链和金属配饰。一些吊带和标签上明显写有“WITCH 404”、“404”等字样，以及以故障为主题的标记。在她的下方和旁边，一个巨大的发光紫色魔法阵与黑客界面美学混合在一起投射在屋顶地板上，充满了神秘的戒指、印记、中央骷髅符号和分散的霓虹灯系统文本（如错误代码片段），创造了魔法和数字腐败的融合。从圆圈中出现的是一个巨大的装甲召唤人物：一个黑色的未来派恶魔骑士或机器人，熟悉锯齿状的反光盔甲，狭窄的紫色发光面罩，单手握着重型武器，部分溶解成紫色能量碎片和烟雾。背景展示了一座庞大的多雨大城市，里面有公寓楼和工业屋顶，到处都是窗户、阳台、电缆、标志和薄雾。附近的建筑墙上有一个巨大的垂直涂鸦式标牌，上面有 3 个可读元素：“404”、“女巫”和“错误未找到”，再加上一个较小的“E404”。额外的紫色霓虹灯故障文本和符号散布在屋顶和空中。使用黑色、靛蓝和深紫色的深色调色板，带有鲜明的洋紫色高光、电影对比度、反光湿表面、密集的细节和高端抛光插图风格。气氛神秘、前卫、时尚、危险，融合了都市奇幻、黑客美学和魔法召唤。
items.prompt: A dramatic anime-style cyberpunk witch standing on a dark rooftop high above a dense futuristic city at night, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The main subject is a petite young witch girl with pale skin, short icy blue bobbed hair, pointed elf-like ears, and glowing red eyes, wearing a sly confident smile. She raises a black wand overhead in her right hand, with a dangling orb charm at the tip glowing faintly purple and red. Her oversized crooked witch hat is black with purple lining and covered in stitched patches, warning labels, straps, and white graphics including a large “404” and a skull emblem. She wears a black and purple techwear outfit: oversized hooded jacket with many straps and tags, black crop top with “404” on the chest, layered belts, short bottoms, fishnet on one leg, black lace-up combat boots, chokers, and metallic accessories. Several hanging straps and tags visibly read words like “WITCH 404,” “404,” and glitch-themed markings. Beneath and beside her, a large glowing violet magic circle mixed with hacker interface aesthetics is projected on the rooftop floor, filled with occult rings, sigils, a central skull symbol, and scattered neon system text such as error-code fragments, creating a fusion of sorcery and digital corruption. Emerging from the circle is 1 large armored summoned figure: a black futuristic demon-knight or robotic familiar with jagged reflective armor, a narrow purple-lit visor, and a heavy weapon held in one hand, partially dissolving into purple energy shards and smoke. The background shows a sprawling rainy megacity of apartment towers and industrial rooftops, packed with windows, balconies, cables, signs, and haze. On a nearby building wall is a giant vertical graffiti-style sign with 3 readable elements: “404”, “Witch”, and “ERROR NOT FOUND”, plus a smaller “E404”. Additional purple neon glitch text and symbols are scattered across rooftops and in the air. Use a dark palette of black, indigo, and deep violet with sharp magenta-purple highlights, cinematic contrast, reflective wet surfaces, dense detail, and a high-end polished illustration style. The mood is occult, edgy, stylish, and dangerous, combining urban fantasy, hacker aesthetics, and magical summoning.

items.promptZh: 受本田 Super Cub 启发的定制老式步进摩托车的高度详细的概念插图，以纯浅灰色背景上干净的工作室式四分之三左侧视图显示。这款自行车具有粗犷的后世界末日街头建筑美学，采用黑色、白色和柔和的灰色配色方案，并配有粉红色小贴纸和贴花。强调严重风化：油漆剥落、划痕、油渍、污垢、锈斑、墨水飞溅、边缘磨损以及整个车身的分层贴纸残留。前部有 1 个带有 X 形光图案的方形头灯，其下方有 2 个较小的堆叠式辅助灯。使用辐条轮、厚实的全地形轮胎、可见的前悬架、暴露的机械细节、链条传动装置和接触地面的坚固中心支架。腿罩和侧板上覆盖着图形贴花、日式警告标签、数字、符号和仿旧版式，包括前整流罩上的粗体大汉字标记。在后部添加 2 个硬侧货箱，在远端添加 1 个较大的箱子，在较近的一侧添加 1 个带有额外贴纸的黑色箱子，再加上后箱附近附有 1 个悬挂式垂直标签饰物。包括 1 个黑色长肋状座椅、后架框架、外露接线、金属支架、螺栓和紧凑的实用配件，使其具有手工改装和实用的感觉。将其渲染为工业设计草图，与精美的动漫机甲概念艺术混合在一起：精确的线条、水彩水洗阴影、柔和的灰色地面阴影、高细节的机械现实主义、略显凌乱的墨迹边缘以及具有收藏价值的定制自行车插画感觉。

The front has 1 square headlight with an X-shaped light pattern and 2 smaller stacked auxiliary lights beneath it. The leg shield and side panels are covered in graphic decals, Japanese-style warning labels, numbers, symbols, and distressed typography, including a bold large kanji mark on the front fairing. Add 2 hard side cargo boxes on the rear, one larger box on the far side and 1 nearer black box with extra stickers, plus 1 hanging vertical tag charm attached near the rear case. Include 1 long black ribbed seat, rear rack framing, exposed wiring, metal brackets, bolts, and compact utility accessories that make it feel hand-modified and functional. Render it like an industrial design sketch mixed with polished anime mech concept art: precise linework, watercolor wash shadows, soft gray ground shadow, high-detail mechanical realism, slightly messy inked edges, and a collectible custom-bike illustration feel.

items.prompt: 在地铁车厢内，一位{argument name="人物" default="年轻女性"}坐在靠近车门的座位上，低头专注看手机，没有看向镜头，神态自然放松。她五官精致，皮肤细腻，气质干净清新。穿着{argument name="着装" default="简约的白色上衣、黑色短裙和白色运动鞋"}，长发自然垂落。人物位于画面右侧三分之一位置，左侧有轻微模糊的前景遮挡，类似随手抓拍的视角。地铁车门与扶手形成垂直线条，引导视线。整体为冷色调地铁灯光，柔和顶光，阴影自然不过分强烈。浅景深，主体清晰，背景略微虚化。画面带有真实相机的颗粒感、轻微构图不完美，类似街头摄影，非摆拍，高真实感，高细节。附加质量关键词：高清，超写实，真实皮肤纹理，自然肤色，真实光影，35mm镜头，人像摄影，电影感

items.title: 德国复古旅游海报
items.promptZh:
为{argument name="country name" default="Germany"}制作一张豪华复古风格的旅行海报，其设计类似于优质旅游活动广告。使用宏伟、对称的构图、优雅的编辑排版和精致的金色边框，并带有微小的装饰角细节。在顶部中心，在“DISCOVER”一词上方放置一个小的金色国徽，然后放置一个非常大的衬线标题，其为深海军蓝色的{argument name="headlinecountry"default="GERMANY"}。在其下方添加口号“历史之地。文化。灵感。”金色大写字母，后面是较小的经典衬线标语：“永恒的传统。难忘的旅程。”带有黑色、红色和金色的微小水平装饰。

在柔和的蓝天和零散的云彩下，展示黄金时段德国标志性风景的壮丽全景蒙太奇。左边是一座童话般的白色山顶城堡，类似新天鹅堡，坐落在秋天的树木上方。中心距离是引人注目的高山山脉。右侧展示的是一座历史悠久的欧洲河畔城市，有密集的红顶房屋、横跨水面的拱形石桥、圆顶大教堂和高耸的双尖塔哥特式大教堂。在右下角添加平静的河流倒影和一艘白色的小观光船。图像应该给人怀旧、浪漫和渴望的感觉，有温暖的阳光、清晰的建筑细节和丰富的电影色彩分级。

沿着中下方，正好包含 5 个金色线条艺术文化图标，其下方带有标签，水平排列均匀分布：“标志性地标”、“丰富的遗产”、“活力文化”、“真实的传统”和“令人惊叹的景观”。

在底部，创建一个深色水平食品展示条，中间带有金色标题“品尝德国的味道”。条带内包含 5 个带框食品面板，每个面板在图像下方均以白色大写字母标记：“BREZEL”、“BRATWURST”、“KARTOFFELSALAT”、“SCHWARZWäLDER KIRSCHTORTE”和“GERMAN BEER”。将每件物品都以令人胃口大开的特写镜头展示：盘子里有光泽的椒盐卷饼、酸菜烤香肠、奶油土豆沙拉、一片淋有奶油和樱桃的黑森林蛋糕，以及一个泡沫啤酒杯。保持整体设计精致、高端、海报般，适合豪华目的地活动。
items.prompt:
Create a luxurious vintage-style travel poster for {argument name="country name" default="Germany"}, designed like a premium tourism campaign advertisement. Use a grand, symmetrical composition with elegant editorial typography and a refined gold border frame with tiny ornamental corner details. At the top center, place a small gold national emblem above the word “DISCOVER”, then a very large serif title reading {argument name="headline country" default="GERMANY"} in deep navy blue. Under it, add the slogan “LAND OF HISTORY. CULTURE. INSPIRATION.” in gold uppercase, followed by a smaller classic serif tagline reading “Timeless Traditions. Unforgettable Journeys.” with a tiny horizontal accent in the colors black, red, and gold.

Show a majestic panoramic montage of iconic German scenery at golden hour under a softly glowing blue sky with scattered clouds. On the left, feature a fairy-tale white hilltop castle resembling Neuschwanstein, perched above autumn trees. In the center distance, place dramatic alpine mountains. On the right, show a historic European riverside city with dense red-roofed houses, an arched stone bridge crossing the water, a domed cathedral, and a towering Gothic cathedral with twin spires. Add calm river reflections and a small white sightseeing boat at the lower right. The image should feel nostalgic, romantic, and aspirational, with warm sunlight, crisp architectural detail, and rich cinematic color grading.

Along the lower middle, include exactly 5 gold line-art cultural icons with labels beneath them, evenly spaced in a horizontal row: “ICONIC LANDMARKS”, “RICH HERITAGE”, “VIBRANT CULTURE”, “AUTHENTIC TRADITIONS”, and “BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES”.

At the bottom, create a dark horizontal food showcase strip with the centered heading “SAVOR THE TASTE OF GERMANY” in gold. Inside the strip, include exactly 5 framed food panels, each labeled in white uppercase beneath the image: “BREZEL”, “BRATWURST”, “KARTOFFELSALAT”, “SCHWARZWÄLDER KIRSCHTORTE”, and “GERMAN BEER”. Show each item as an appetizing close-up: a glossy pretzel on a plate, grilled sausages with sauerkraut, creamy potato salad, a slice of Black Forest cake topped with cream and cherry, and a frothy beer mug. Keep the overall design polished, high-end, poster-like, and suitable for a luxury destination campaign.

items.title: 法国巴黎复古海报
items.promptZh:
奢华的复古旅行海报风格插图，以{argument name="country name" default="FRANCE"}为目的地，{argument name="city name" default="PARIS"}，设计得像一则优雅的旅游广告。在黄金时段的日落时分，欣赏宏伟、浪漫的巴黎城市景观，以及桃红色、粉红色、薰衣草色和淡金色的柔和天空。让埃菲尔铁塔成为占据主导地位的中心地标，高大而精致，矗立在城市之上。包括另外 4 个巴黎标志性地标：左侧的卢浮宫金字塔、中心背景附近的凯旋门、埃菲尔铁塔右侧的巴黎圣母院以及最右上山坡上的圣心大教堂。在前景中，用鲜艳的紫色茂密盛开的{argument name="flower field" default="lavender"}填充场景，营造出通往城市的梦幻般的绘画前景。在埃菲尔铁塔下方添加一条河流和优雅的石桥，反射温暖的日落光。构图应该给人一种理想化、电影般的感觉，并且略带幻想，将多个地标结合成一个和谐的全景视图。

在左上角到中上区域覆盖精致的编辑排版：一个非常大的衬线标题，阅读{argument name =“headline text”default =“FRANCE”}，带有较小间距的衬线副标题阅读{argument name =“subheadline text”default =“PARIS”}。在副标题上方放置一个金色的百合花小装饰品；在它的下面，添加一个微小的水平法国三色口音。在主标题下，准确地包含两行促销文案：“永恒的美丽。无尽的灵感。”以及优雅的小写字母和斜体字体的“Where Every Moment Been a Memory”。在整个海报周围添加细细的装饰性金色边框，并带有精致的装饰角细节。

在底部，创建一个与图像融为一体的软奶油雾面板，将短语“法国生活艺术”置于一排 3 个食品和饮料的上方：1 个放在盘子上的黄油羊角面包、1 杯红酒和 1 个酒瓶，以及 1 个放在模子里的焦糖布丁，上面有浆果。将它们标记为“羊角面包”、“美酒”和“焦糖布丁”。在右侧添加 4 个小金线图标，其下方带有标签：“标志性地标”、“丰富的遗产”、“正宗美食”和“难忘的体验”。整体风格：超细致、精美的旅游海报，浪漫的欧洲旅游广告，绘画写实，温暖的发光氛围，优质的印刷设计，平衡的构图，高端的杂志审美。

items.title: 北欧四国旅游海报
items.promptZh: 为{argument name="region name" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"}制作一张优雅的豪华旅行海报，其设计类似于优质旅游活动宣传册封面。使用宽对称布局，带有细金色装饰边框和精致的编辑排版。在顶部中心，在“DISCOVER”一词上方放置一个小罗盘星形图标，然后放置一个非常大的衬线标题，内容为深海军蓝色的{argument name="headline text" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"}。在其下方添加金色大写标语：{argument name="tagline" default="BREATHTAKING NATURE. RICH CULTURE. TIMELESS EXPERIENCES."}，在其下方添加一条较小的优雅斜体线：{argument name="subheading" default="Four Nations. Countless Memories."}。主图像区域分为 4 个相等的垂直风景面板，展示黄金时段的标志性目的地、柔和的发光天空和电影般的真实感。第一组：丹麦，哥本哈根，色彩缤纷的港口海滨，有历史建筑、船只、平静的水面倒影，背景是一个圆顶地标；在 DENMARK 和 COPENHAGEN 标签上方包含一面小丹麦国旗。第二组：瑞典斯德哥尔摩，海滨老城的天际线，教堂尖顶和温暖的夕阳光倒映在水中；在“瑞典”和“斯德哥尔摩”标签上方包含一面瑞典小国旗。展板三：芬兰赫尔辛基，明朗天空下蔚蓝海水中一座小石堡般的海岛堡垒；在 FINLAND 和 HELSINKI 标签上方添加一面小芬兰国旗。第四组：挪威，壮丽的峡湾，陡峭的锯齿状山脉，瀑布，以及水边的一个红顶沿海小村庄；在 NORWAY 和 FJORDS OF NORWAY 标签上方添加一面小挪威国旗。在 4 个国家/地区面板下方，添加一排 4 个带有标题的金线图标，间隔均匀：带有标志性景观的山峰图标、带有丰富遗产的维京船图标、带有野生自然的驼鹿图标、带有难忘旅程的相机图标。在底部中心附近，放置一个金色分隔板和标题“北方的味道”。在其下方，以水平条形显示 5 个食物缩略图面板，每个面板或碗上都有温暖的开胃灯光和深蓝色框架： 1) Smørrebrød — 丹麦，开面三明治，上面放有虾； 2）Köttbullar——瑞典，瑞典肉丸配奶油酱和越橘； 3) Gravad lax——芬兰，将腌制三文鱼切片放入碗中； 4）鱼汤——挪威，香草海鲜奶油鱼汤； 5) Kanelbulle——瑞典，盘子里放着光滑的肉桂面包。采用精致的高端旅游广告美学、逼真的风景、柔和的日落色彩分级、海军蓝和金色的图形设计、平衡的构图、清晰的文字放置以及怀旧的高档欧洲旅游氛围。
items.prompt: Create an elegant luxury travel poster for {argument name="region name" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"}, designed like a premium tourism campaign brochure cover. At the top center, place a small compass-star icon above the word DISCOVER, then a very large serif headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"} in deep navy blue. items.title: 动漫人群视角对比图
items.promptZh: 黑色背景上的两面板比较图形，展示了动漫风格的拥挤街道场景中摄像机角度的戏剧性变化。在顶部居中放置一个大的白色句子：“{argument name=”headline text”default=”将相机 POV 移动到人群中的地面位置。”}”。在左侧，添加两个与面板对齐的大白色标签：上面板旁边的“源”和下面板旁边的“输出”。创建 2 个以画布为中心的堆叠矩形图像面板。在顶部面板中，以手绘动漫电影风格展示了密密麻麻的历史街道人群的高角度俯视图，数十人挤在马车和车轮周围；包括捆绑的行李、帽子、柔和的大地色服装、蓝色和棕褐色的服装，以及人物在各个方向重叠的繁忙构图。在底部面板中，重新创建相同类型的场景，但将摄像机转移到人群内部的低地面视角，观察尸体之间以及右侧边缘的一个大马车车轮旁边。前景应该让人感觉身临其境和局促，有几个靠近镜头的弯腰或蹲着的人物，左边前景有一个穿着柔和紫色长袍的人，靠近中央底部有一个跪着或驼背的棕褐色人物，中间偏右有一个穿着浅蓝色连衣裙或外套的女人抱着一个小孩在人群中转身。将环境保持为混乱的旧世界市场或交通街道，有马匹、马车、戴着檐帽、穿着简单古装的人们、尘土飞扬的地面和温暖柔和的色彩。使用柔和的电影动画灯光、绘画式阴影以及经典吉卜力工作室人群序列的视觉感觉。整个图像应该被解读为相机实验前后的对比，上面的面板是原始的俯视构图，下面的面板是转换后的低角度透视图。
items.prompt: A two-panel comparison graphic on a black background demonstrating a dramatic camera-angle change in an anime-style crowded street scene. Place a large white sentence centered across the top: "{argument name="headline text" default="Move the camera POV to be at ground level in the crowd."}". On the left side, add two large white labels aligned with the panels: "Source" beside the upper panel and "Output" beside the lower panel. Create exactly 2 stacked rectangular image panels centered on the canvas. In the top panel, show a high-angle overhead view of a densely packed historical street crowd in a hand-painted anime film style, with dozens of people pressed together around horse-drawn carts and wagon wheels; include bundled luggage, hats, muted earth-tone clothing, blue and tan garments, and a busy composition where figures overlap in every direction. The foreground should feel immersive and cramped, with several bent or crouched figures close to the camera, a person in a muted purple robe on the left foreground, a kneeling or hunched figure in tan near the center bottom, and a woman in a light blue dress or coat toward the right-middle turning through the crowd while holding a small child. Use soft cinematic anime lighting, painterly shading, and the visual feel of a classic Studio Ghibli crowd sequence. The overall image should read as a before-and-after camera experiment, with the upper panel as the original overhead composition and the lower panel as the transformed low-angle perspective.

items.prompt:
Create a hyper-detailed comedic Japanese arcade fighting game screenshot styled like a versus battle scene, using a real-world photo aesthetic with game UI overlaid on top. The scene shows an intense mock battle between two groups of theme-park fans competing for the front row at an outdoor show plaza in Tokyo DisneySea. Use a wide 16:9 composition. In the background, clearly show Mediterranean Harbor and Mount Prometheus under bright daytime skies, with the waterfront and DisneySea architecture visible. In the foreground, show exactly 10 young adult people in winter casual clothing, split into 2 opposing teams of 5, physically leaning, grabbing, reaching, and shoving in a tug-of-war-like scrum over position, with exaggerated competitive body language and frozen action as if in a fighting game. Faces should be anonymized with soft blurred blocks. Add floating character labels above each person with levels and names in Japanese. The overall tone is absurdly realistic, like a real candid photo transformed into a polished arcade game battle screen.

Add a full Japanese fighting-game HUD with glossy blue-versus-red interface styling. At the very top, place a center stage title bar reading "東京ディズニーシー　ミッキー広場　ショー最前列バトル" and a large timer in the middle reading "TIME 89". In the top left, add a blue team header "PLAYER1" and team name "最前列ガチ勢A". In the top right, add a red team header "RIVAL" and team name "ライバルグループB". On the left side, stack exactly 5 blue player status panels with portraits, level, Japanese class-like nicknames, HP, SP, and BURST meters. The 5 left-side labels are: "Lv.25 ガチ勢リーダー ユウキ", "Lv.24 筋肉マン タケシ", "Lv.23 眼鏡オタク シンジ", "Lv.23 開角心MAX ケント", "Lv.22 サポート要員 リョウ". On the right side, stack exactly 5 red rival status panels with the labels: "Lv.27 ライバルリーダー ダイキ", "Lv.26 パワフル代表 マサル", "Lv.24 戦略家 コウジ", "Lv.23 熱血漢 リク", "Lv.22 サポート女子 サキ". Each panel should include numeric HP and SP values and segmented BURST gauges, styled like a Japanese arcade RPG-fighter interface.

Place exactly 10 in-battle nameplates above the fighters in the center scene, color-coded blue for the left team and red for the right team. The 10 labels are: "Lv.24 タケシ", "Lv.25 ユウキ", "Lv.23 シンジ", "Lv.23 ケント", "Lv.22 リョウ", "Lv.27 ダイキ", "Lv.26 マサル", "Lv.23 リク", "Lv.22 サキ", "Lv.22 ミサキ".

At the lower left, add a skill menu titled "スキル" listing exactly 5 skills with SP costs: "ダッシュ突撃 SP 20", "肩押し強奪 SP 25", "荷物で場所確保 SP 15", "ロープくぐり SP 10", "本気の根性 SP 50". Beneath that, add a dark description box explaining the highlighted skill "本気の根性" with the Japanese text: "気合で相手を威圧し、どかす！ 一定時間、相手が怯みやすくなる！ （バーストゲージを大きく消費する） 効果時間：10秒".

At the bottom center, add an item menu titled "アイテム" with exactly 5 item slots showing icons and counts: a water bottle "x3", a folded purple towel "x2", a blue drawstring bag "x1", a gray backpack "x1", and a boxed meal "x2". At the lower right, add a quest panel titled "クエスト" with the mission text "ショー開始までに最前列を死守しろ！" and condition text "条件：ライバルグループを全員後ろに押し戻せ！" and countdown text "ショー開始まで：02:30". Beside it, add a mini-map titled "ミッキー広場MAP" showing red and blue dots for both teams in the plaza. Along the very bottom edge, include small controller prompts in Japanese for actions such as skill use, item use, grab/push, and dash.

Use dramatic, saturated lighting, crisp detail, realistic clothing folds, authentic plaza stone pavement, and a high-end Japanese game screenshot look. items.prompt: A moody 4-by-3 photo collage made of 12 candid smartphone-style snapshots of a young couple during summer nights in Tokyo, shot with a nostalgic film look, soft grain, muted colors, slight blur, low contrast, dim ambient street lighting, and intimate casual framing. The man has messy dark hair, a slim build, and wears a dark overshirt or lightweight jacket over a white T-shirt; the woman has long dark brown hair, a slim build, and wears a white sleeveless top with thin black shoulder straps from a bag. In every panel, both faces are intentionally obscured by large soft-edged blur blocks for anonymity. Include exactly 12 images arranged in a tight seamless grid: top row panel 1, an extreme close-up side profile of the man at night; panel 2, the woman taking a mirror or phone selfie while standing beside the man outdoors at night; panel 3, the couple pressed close together near a street sign with Japanese text; panel 4, the couple kissing at a busy crosswalk in the city. Middle row panel 5, a pavement shadow photo of two people, one making a peace sign; panel 6, the couple standing close on a sidewalk in an urban shopping street; panel 7, a sunset skyline over water with Tokyo Tower visible, no people; panel 8, a high-angle shot looking down on the woman and the man close together on stairs or a walkway. Bottom row panel 9, a tight intimate close-up of the couple touching faces or kissing; panel 10, the man adjusting or touching the woman's hair on a city street; panel 11, the couple riding together on a scooter or motorcycle, both wearing helmets, captured in motion blur; panel 12, the couple embracing against a pale blue sky, framed from the shoulders up. items.promptZh: 以干净、专业的网页设计风格、桌面宽屏宽高比为印度尼西亚创建现代政府计划登陆页面 UI 模型。该页面使用白色背景，带有大胆的红色点缀、柔和的圆角、微妙的灰色分隔线以及抛光的前端运球演示外观。在最顶部，构建一个水平导航栏，其中包含 6 个可见元素：印度尼西亚 Garuda 标志和左侧的文本“PEMERINTAH REPUBLIK INDONESIA”，然后是 4 个居中的菜单项，标记为“Program”、“Dampak”、“Menu”和“Pemantauan”，最右侧是一个标记为“Program MBG”的红色圆形大按钮，带有一个小人物图标。在其下方，设计一个分为两列的英雄部分。左侧显示一个小程序标签线，其中包含红色碗图标、文本“MBG”、垂直分隔线和“Makan Bergizi Gratis”。在其下方，放置一个大的粗体标题，内容为深海军蓝“{argument name="headline text" default="Makan Bergizi, Anak Indonesia Kuat"}”，跨 3 行。下面用印尼语添加一个简短的段落：“Program MBG mendukung gizi harian siswa SD dan SMP melalui menu seimbang, pemantauan sekolah, dan laporan mudak yang transparan。”然后并排放置 2 个号召性用语按钮：一个带有右箭头标记为“Lihat Dampak”的实心红色按钮，以及一个带红色边框的带有右箭头标记为“Panduan Sekolah”的白色轮廓按钮。在英雄的右侧，放置一个圆形的大照片风格图像，由白色弧形分隔线和红色角背景框起来。该图片展示了一间印度尼西亚小学教室，里面有 5 名身穿白色校服、系着红色领带的小学生，坐在课桌旁，窗户射入温暖的日光，浅景深，纪实照片写实主义。在前景的木桌上，展示着一份不锈钢隔间托盘餐，其中恰好有 5 种食物：白米饭、什锦蔬菜、一块炸鸡、一根香蕉和西瓜块。在托盘旁边放置 1 个标有“SUSU SEGAR”的牛奶盒。在英雄下方，添加一个全角红色统计带，其中包含 4 个等距的公制卡，并由细垂直分隔线分隔开。每张卡片都有一个白色圆形图标和粗体白色文本。这 4 个指标是：带有标签“Sekolah Terlayani”的“245.000+”、带有标签“Siswa Penerima Manfaat”的“8,7 Juta+”、带有标签“Porsi Disalurkan”的“1,2 Miliar+”和带有标签“Kepuasan Siswa”的“98,6%”。在底部中心添加一个 3 点轮播指示器，其中左侧的点呈红色，其他 2 个点呈灰色。在左下背景中包含微弱的印度尼西亚地图纹理。使用清晰的排版、慷慨的空白、高端金融科技/政府网站美学、逼真的 UI 比例以及可立即投入生产的登陆页面模型外观。
items.prompt: Create a modern government program landing page UI mockup for Indonesia in a clean, professional web design style, desktop widescreen aspect ratio. The page uses a white background with bold red accents, soft rounded corners, subtle gray dividers, and a polished frontend-dribbble presentation look. At the very top, build a horizontal navigation bar with 6 visible elements: the Indonesian Garuda emblem and the text "PEMERINTAH REPUBLIK INDONESIA" on the left, then 4 centered menu items labeled "Program", "Dampak", "Menu", and "Pemantauan", and on the far right a large red rounded button labeled "Program MBG" with a small people icon. Below it, design a hero section split into two columns. On the left, show a small program label line with a red bowl icon, the text "MBG", a vertical divider, and "Makan Bergizi Gratis". Under that, place a large bold headline reading "{argument name="headline text" default="Makan Bergizi, Anak Indonesia Kuat"}" in dark navy, spanning 3 lines. Add a short paragraph in Indonesian below: "Program MBG mendukung gizi harian siswa SD dan SMP melalui menu seimbang, pemantauan sekolah, dan laporan dampak yang transparan." Then place 2 call-to-action buttons side by side: a solid red button labeled "Lihat Dampak" with a right arrow, and an outlined white button with red border labeled "Panduan Sekolah" with a right arrow. On the right side of the hero, place a rounded large photo-style image framed by a sweeping white curved divider and red corner background. The image shows an Indonesian elementary classroom with 5 visible schoolchildren in white uniforms with red ties, seated at desks, warm daylight from windows, shallow depth of field, documentary-photo realism. In the foreground, on a wooden desk, show a stainless steel compartment tray meal with exactly 5 food items: white rice, mixed vegetables, a piece of fried chicken, a banana, and watermelon cubes. Beside the tray, place 1 milk carton labeled "SUSU SEGAR". Under the hero, add a full-width red statistics band with 4 equally spaced metric cards separated by thin vertical dividers. Each card has a white circular icon and bold white text. The 4 metrics are: "245.000+" with label "Sekolah Terlayani", "8,7 Juta+" with label "Siswa Penerima Manfaat", "1,2 Miliar+" with label "Porsi Disalurkan", and "98,6%" with label "Kepuasan Siswa". At the bottom center, add a 3-dot carousel indicator with the left dot active in red and the other 2 dots gray. Include a faint Indonesia map texture in the lower-left background. Use crisp typography, generous whitespace, high-end fintech/government website aesthetics, realistic UI proportions, and a production-ready landing page mockup appearance.

items.title: AI音乐训练营海报
items.prompt: Create a dramatic Japanese anime-style promotional thumbnail poster for an event, vertical 4:5 composition, ultra-detailed, cinematic, neon-lit, high contrast, designed like a social media announcement image. The main subject is a beautiful anime girl centered slightly right, shown from the waist up, with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="deep blue"} hair blowing in the wind, decorated with small star hairpins, wearing a dark hoodie and large studio headphones around her neck, against a glowing sunset-to-night city skyline filled with sparkling lights, music-energy particles, lens flares, and flying glowing petals. Her face area is obscured by a soft rectangular blur block. Use a vivid palette of electric blue, violet, magenta, gold, and sunset orange. Fill the design with layered Japanese typography that is crisp, readable, and integrated into the art like a polished event advertisement. Include exactly 8 major text groups: top left copy reading 「始まるのは、キミと創る 音楽の物語。」 with a smaller subcopy beneath reading 「AIを使って、みんなで音楽をつくる特別な3日間。」; top right a glowing marquee sign reading 「GW連休!」 and a smaller neon box below reading 「みんなで最高の音楽をつくろう!」; center main title with small English text 「AI MUSIC BOOTCAMP 2」 above huge Japanese title text 「AI音楽 ブートキャンプ 2」; a gigantic gold metallic announcement across the middle reading 「開催決定!」; a date bar reading 「開催期間」 followed by 「5.2 SAT 土」 and 「5.4 MON 月」; a hashtag callout near the bottom reading 「参加はカンタン!! #AI音楽ブートキャンプ2 をつけて投稿するだけ!」; a lower encouragement line reading 「初心者も大歓迎! みんなで最高の音楽体験を!」; and 3 bottom feature captions with icons reading 「一緒に学ぶ 仲間とつながる」, 「AIで創る 新しい音楽体験」, and 「想いをカタチに 自分だけの1曲を」. On the left edge, add a vertical filmstrip with exactly 4 inset panels showing the same girl in music-related scenes: 1) performing on a stage before a crowd, 2) working at a music production desk with screens and equipment, 3) singing into a microphone, 4) playing an acoustic guitar. Add exactly 2 neon music-themed icon illustrations in the lower area: a tilted smartphone with a music note on the lower left and a glowing microphone with musical notes on the lower right. Make the text effects glossy, luminous, and embossed with gold and white highlights, with energetic streaks and spark explosions around the headline. The overall feeling should be inspiring, celebratory, futuristic, and emotionally uplifting, like a high-impact Japanese Golden Week music bootcamp ad for {argument name="event name" default="AI音楽ブートキャンプ 2"}.

items.title: 真人手持Q版迷你自己
items.promptZh: 照片中的{argument name="subject" default="woman"}超逼真电影肖像，完全保留了她的面部特征、自然的皮肤纹理、逼真的发丝和简单的日常服装。这位女士的手掌上握着一个自己的小型 3D 微缩模型。她带着明显的惊讶和轻微的愉悦看着这个模型，眉毛扬起，笑容柔和，眼神富有表情。她的面部表情显得自然而真实。微缩版在面部结构、发型和服装上与这位女士非常相似，但以流畅、高品质的方式渲染{argument name="style" default="3D卡通风格"}。该模型具有不成比例的大卡通头像和夸张、俏皮的表情。两个角色都穿着同样的休闲装——配色方案和面料纹理准确的{argument name="clothing" default="patterned Sweater"}。尺度上的差异很明显，而且视觉上很有趣。灯光具有专业的电影效果，物体分离清晰，皮肤上的亮点柔和，两个人物周围的轮廓灯光微妙。真实人物的超详细纹理。干净、逼真的微缩模型 3D 纹理。平衡的现实主义。
items.prompt: An ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="woman"} from a photo, fully preserving her facial features, natural skin texture, realistic hair strands, and simple everyday clothing. The woman holds a small 3D miniature of herself in the palm of her hand. She looks at the miniature with obvious surprise and slight pleasure, with raised eyebrows, a soft smile, and expressive eyes. Her facial expression appears spontaneous and authentic. The miniature version is very similar to this woman in facial structure, hairstyle, and clothing, but is rendered in a smooth, high-quality {argument name="style" default="3D cartoon style"}. The miniature features a disproportionately large cartoon head and an exaggerated, playful expression. Both characters are dressed in the same casual attire—a {argument name="clothing" default="patterned sweater"} with accurate color scheme and fabric texture. The difference in scale is obvious and visually playful. The lighting is professional cinematic, with clear object separation, soft highlights on the skin, and subtle contour lighting around both figures. Ultra-detailed textures for a real person. Clean, realistic 3D textures for the miniature. Balanced realism.

items.prompt: 请根据【主题：{argument name="角色名" default="写人物名字"}】创作一张高完成度、高叙事张力、适合系列化发布的「暗潮群像封面 / Shadow Ensemble Cover」。这不是普通角色插画，也不是简单的战斗海报，而是一张具有小说封面感、漫画主视觉感、游戏宣传感和暗黑奇幻插画感的“群像式动作封面”。画面需要通过一个巨大的精神核心人物、多个中景动作角色、背景威胁元素、局部能量光效和留白标题区，共同构成一个完整的角色阵营与世界观封面。【基础设定】主题：{argument name="场景主题" default="咒术战斗 / 暗黑西游 / 赛博猎人 / 山海经猎妖队 / 末日幸存者 / 魔法学院战斗团"}作品名：[作品名]系列名 / 品牌名：[品牌名或系列名]副标题：[副标题]风格方向：{argument name="风格" default="暗黑奇幻、复古漫画封面、手绘厚涂、奇幻小说封面、游戏主视觉"}主色调：墨绿黑灰 / 深蓝霓虹 / 暗棕金红 / 沙黄铁锈 / 深紫金色点缀色：血红能量、青绿色法术光、金色神光、蓝色雷电画幅比例：2:3竖版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 9:16竖版【画面结构】采用竖版封面构图。画面中必须有一个体量巨大的主视觉人物，作为整张图的精神核心和气质压场元素。这个人物可以是侧脸、半身像、背影、正面凝视或巨大轮廓，占据画面右侧、上方或背景主区域，表情冷静、神秘、有压迫感，不一定参与战斗，但必须统领整张图的气质。在中景安排3到6个动作角色，形成一个战斗阵营群像。角色之间需要有明确分工和姿态差异，例如冲锋、持刀、施法、防御、召唤、跳跃、警戒、远程攻击等。避免所有人物站桩，必须形成强烈的动作节奏和视觉动线。背景中加入敌方威胁或世界观元素，例如怪物、巨兽、反派阴影、机械军团、妖魔、废墟、森林、异空间、战场烟雾或城市灾难。背景威胁不应喧宾夺主，而应像阴影一样包裹角色，增强危机感和叙事深度。画面需要设置1到2个高饱和能量爆点，例如红色火焰拳、蓝色雷电、绿色诅咒气息、紫色魔法、金色神光或白色刀光。能量光效应集中在关键角色或关键武器上，形成视觉焦点，不要全画面平均发光。【构图方式】整体采用“大型精神核心人物 + 中景动作群像 + 背景威胁阴影 + 底部或侧边留白标题区”的结构。画面可以使用斜向动线组织角色，让角色群像从左上到右下、或从下方冲向中央，形成强烈推进感。保留一块明显的留白标题区，建议位于左下、底部或画面侧边。留白区域使用米白、灰白、浅纸色或低饱和背景色，用于放置【品牌名 / 作品名 / 副标题】。标题排版应具有出版物封面感，可以使用优雅衬线字体、复古标题字、漫画封面标题或高级杂志式排版。文字区要清晰，不要被角色和背景完全遮挡。插画边缘不要做成完整矩形铺满，可以使用不规则笔刷边缘、墨迹扩散、撕纸式留白或自然消散的方式，让角色和背景像从纸面中生长出来，增强手绘封面感和艺术质感。【视觉风格】整体风格应为手绘厚涂与漫画封面结合，具有纸张质感、笔触感、暗部层次和复古出版物气质。光影以低调暗光为主，背景压暗，人物轮廓清晰，局部能量光提供高对比焦点。画面不要过度干净，不要像普通AI光滑插画，应保留手绘纹理、纸张颗粒、边缘笔触和暗色雾气。色彩上采用低饱和暗调为主，辅以少量高饱和能量色。整体氛围应具有压迫感、神秘感、战斗感和世界观厚度。【画面目标】最终画面应像一张成熟的奇幻小说封面、漫画特别篇封面、游戏角色阵营主视觉或IP宣传海报。它需要同时具备：1. 清晰的主视觉人物；2. 有动作节奏的角色群像；3. 明确的敌方威胁或世界观背景；4. 强烈但克制的能量光效；5. 可阅读的标题文字区；6. 复古手绘封面的整体质感。请确保画面信息丰富但不混乱，角色层级清晰，视觉重心明确，阅读路径自然，适合后续替换主题继续生成同系列作品。

items.titleZh: 聊天 GPT 提示上的 GPT 图像 2.0：A stri
items.promptZh: 一幅引人注目的艺术肖像，描绘了一位魅力女性（附图），精确地捕捉到了她的面部表情，坐姿平静而有力。她盘腿坐在铺有装饰瓷砖的简约地板上，穿着带有简约印花的现代蓝色运动衫、宽松牛仔裤和黑色匡威运动鞋。她的表情平静而自信，带着温柔的微笑和轻松的眼神，微微凝视着漫射的光源。在她身后，矗立着一幅巨大的抽象壁画，画的是她自己的脸，用炭灰色、白色、金色和柔和的红色等大胆而富有表现力的笔触绘制。 ... 以超写实画质拍摄，使用 50 毫米人像镜头，浅景深、锐利的细节和优雅的色彩渐变，场景传达了创造力、内省和个人转变。负面：模糊、曝光过度、卡通化、扭曲的解剖结构、多余的肢体、画得不好的手、合并的脸、不切实际的颜色、水印、文本。 ar。 9:16
items.prompt: A striking artistic portrait of a charismatic woman (image attached) that precisely captures her face, seated in a serene yet powerful pose. She sits cross-legged on a minimalist floor with decorative tiles, wearing a modern blue sweatshirt with a minimalist print, loose-fitting jeans, and black Converse sneakers. Her expression is serene and subtly confident, with a gentle smile and relaxed eyes as she gazes slightly toward a diffused light source. Behind her rises a monumental abstract mural of her own face, painted with bold and expressive brushstrokes in charcoal gray, white, gold, and muted red. ... Photographed with ultra-realistic quality, using a 50mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, sharp details, and elegant color gradation, the scene conveys creativity, introspection, and personal transformation. Negative: blurry, overexposed, cartoonish, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, poorly drawn hands, merged faces, unrealistic colors, watermark, text. ar. 9 :16
