items.promptZh: 一幅引人注目的艺术肖像画，描绘了一位{argument name="subject" default="魅力女性"}（附图），精确地捕捉到了她的面部表情，她坐姿宁静而有力。她盘腿坐在铺有装饰瓷砖的极简主义地板上，穿着现代风格的{argument name="top" default="蓝色运动衫"}，带有极简主义印花、{argument name="bottom" default="loose-fitting jeans"}和黑色匡威运动鞋。她的表情平静而自信，带着温柔的微笑和轻松的眼神，微微凝视着漫射的光源。在她身后，矗立着一幅巨大的抽象壁画，画的是她自己的脸，用炭灰色、白色、金色和柔和的红色等大胆而富有表现力的笔触绘制。这幅壁画不是字面上的复制品，而是对她的风格化和情感化的诠释：敏锐的眼睛、支离破碎的纹理、宽阔的笔触，暗示着运动、野心和内心的复杂性。它的比例主导了背景，但又不掩盖主要人物，在现实与艺术表现之间创造了和谐的平衡。灯光具有电影般的效果，令人回味，边缘柔和的反射和头顶上微妙的光芒勾勒出她的轮廓。灰尘等细小颗粒巧妙地漂浮在空气中，捕捉闪光并增强气氛。该环境唤起了现代艺术工作室与梦幻般的展览空间的融合：干净、宽敞、简约，但充满情感。以超写实画质拍摄，使用 50 毫米人像镜头，浅景深、锐利的细节和优雅的色彩渐变，场景传达了创造力、内省和个人转变。负面：模糊、曝光过度、卡通化、扭曲的解剖结构、多余的肢体、画得不好的手、合并的脸、不切实际的颜色、水印、文本。 ar。 9:16
items.prompt: A striking artistic portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="charismatic woman"} (image attached) that precisely captures her face, seated in a serene yet powerful pose. She sits cross-legged on a minimalist floor with decorative tiles, wearing a modern {argument name="top" default="blue sweatshirt"} with a minimalist print, {argument name="bottom" default="loose-fitting jeans"}, and black Converse sneakers. Her expression is serene and subtly confident, with a gentle smile and relaxed eyes as she gazes slightly toward a diffused light source. Behind her rises a monumental abstract mural of her own face, painted with bold and expressive brushstrokes in charcoal gray, white, gold, and muted red. The mural is not a literal copy, but a stylized and emotive interpretation of her: intense eyes, fragmented textures, broad brushstrokes that suggest movement, ambition, and inner complexity. Its scale dominates the background without overshadowing the main figure, creating a harmonious balance between reality and artistic representation. The lighting is cinematic and evocative, with soft reflections at the edges and a subtle overhead glow that defines her silhouette. Fine particles, like dust, float subtly in the air, catching flashes of light and enhancing the atmosphere. The setting evokes the fusion of a modern art studio with a dreamlike exhibition space: clean, spacious, minimalist, yet charged with emotion. Photographed with ultra-realistic quality, using a 50mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, sharp details, and elegant color gradation, the scene conveys creativity, introspection, and personal transformation. Negative: blurry, overexposed, cartoonish, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, poorly drawn hands, merged faces, unrealistic colors, watermark, text. ar. 9 :16

Warm desk-lamp lighting illuminates her and the desk, with a mug in the foreground, scattered papers, shelves and a wall clock softly out of focus in the dark background, creating a late-night overwork mood. できます。"}. Beneath it, add 1 subheadline line in white reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="楽天専用 A/Bテスト自動化ツール"}, accented by a thin cyan underline. items.title: 杂志封面书本静物
items.promptZh: 逼真的高级杂志封面，采用国际设计和商业出版物的风格，以精致的社论静物形式拍摄。封面的特点是黑暗、喜怒无常的内部、浅景深和温暖的环境照明。中间偏右，直立在光滑的黑色大理石桌子上，是一本米色平装书，书名是{argument name="book title" default="The Pathless Path"}，作者是{argument name="author name" default="Paul Millerd"}。这本书稍微向左倾斜，因此封面和书脊都可见。封面插图是极简主义的海军蓝色线条艺术，展示了办公室内部，有一扇开着的门通向一条蜿蜒的户外小路，墙上挂着相框，有一个饮水机、一张堆满文件的桌子，以及一个瘫坐在办公椅上的人。作者姓名出现在封面左下角附近，标题也在书脊上垂直排列。大理石表面上的书的左侧是一小堆 4 本书，焦点模糊，左下前景的碟子上放着 1 个深色咖啡杯。他们身后是一间昏暗、优雅的房间，架子模糊，背景是柔和的绿色植物形状。杂志标头占据顶部：{argument name="magazine title" default="MONOCLE"}，宽度非常大的白色衬线字母，左上角有小的白色期刊文本，内容为{argument name="issue text" default="MAY 2024 • ISSUE 167"}，右上角有小的白色标语文本，内容为“THE ENTREPRENEURS’ MAGAZINE”。报头下方是一条细尺和一条金色小衬线文字的类别线，其中有 6 个类别，用点分隔：“事务•商业•文化•设计•娱乐•时尚”。左侧，大号白色衬线封面标题文字为“重新思考成功”。下面是一个白色衬线副标题，内容是关于抛弃默认路径并建立重要的生活和工作，后面是一个金色的小页码。左栏下方有 4 个编辑预告块，每个块都有一个金色圆形图标和金色大写标题、白色描述性文本和金色页码。四个标题分别是“摆脱默认”、“有目的工作”、“新故事”和盒装预告片“特别设计”。右下角是一个真实的条形码块，上面有小的定价文本，旁边有一个小的发行编号。整体布局应该感觉像一个真正的豪华杂志封面模型：清晰的排版、优雅的衬线字体、黑色、白色、奶油色和金色调色板、大理石上的光泽反射、电影阴影、书本下方微妙的产品反射以及高端编辑摄影风格。
items.prompt: A photorealistic premium magazine cover in the style of an international design and business publication, shot as a sophisticated editorial still life. The cover features a dark, moody interior with shallow depth of field and warm ambient lighting. Center-right, standing upright on a glossy black marble table, is a cream-colored paperback book titled {argument name="book title" default="The Pathless Path"} by {argument name="author name" default="Paul Millerd"}. The book is angled slightly to the left so both the front cover and spine are visible. The cover illustration is minimalist navy-blue line art showing an office interior with an open door leading into a winding outdoor path, framed pictures on the wall, a water cooler, a desk with stacked papers, and a person slumped in an office chair. The author’s name appears near the lower left of the front cover, and the title also runs vertically on the spine. To the left of the book on the marble surface is a small stack of 4 books, softly out of focus, and in the lower-left foreground sits 1 dark coffee cup on a saucer. Behind them is a dim, elegant room with blurred shelving and a soft green plant shape in the background. The magazine masthead dominates the top: {argument name="magazine title" default="MONOCLE"} in very large white serif letters across the width, with small white issue text at top left reading {argument name="issue text" default="MAY 2024 • ISSUE 167"} and small white tagline text at top right reading “THE ENTREPRENEURS’ MAGAZINE”. Beneath the masthead is a thin rule and a category line in small gold serif text with 6 categories separated by dots: “AFFAIRS • BUSINESS • CULTURE • DESIGN • ENTERTAINING • FASHION”. On the left side, large white serif cover headline text reads “Rethinking Success”. Below it is a white serif subheadline about leaving the default path behind and building a life and work that matters, followed by a small gold page number. Further down the left column are 4 editorial teaser blocks, each with a gold circular icon and gold uppercase heading, white descriptive text, and a gold page number. The 4 headings are “ESCAPE THE DEFAULT”, “WORK WITH PURPOSE”, “A NEW STORY”, and a boxed teaser “DESIGN SPECIAL”. At the bottom right is a realistic barcode block with small pricing text above it and a small issue number beside it. The overall layout should feel like a real luxury magazine cover mockup: crisp typography, elegant serif fonts, black, white, cream, and gold palette, glossy reflections on the marble, cinematic shadows, subtle product reflection beneath the book, and high-end editorial photography styling.

items.promptZh: 一张高品质的镜子自拍照捕捉到了一位{argument name="subject" default="年轻女子，留着长长的红棕色波浪发和大胆的酒红色嘴唇"}站在时尚现代的卫生间里。她胸前穿着一件{argument name="outfit" default="充满活力的钴蓝色短袖网眼 T 恤，上面饰有大型华丽的“LV”字母图案，大理石纹理的白色和灰色饰面”}，层叠在深色底座上。她的造型搭配深色合身紧身裤，饰有复古风格的花卉印花，由柔和的米色和柔和的粉红色玫瑰组成。背景展示了{argument name="setting" default="高档内饰，配有抛光黑色大理石墙壁、一排简约的白色矩形容器水槽和抛光镀铬装置"}。镜子后面混合着温暖的垂直灯带和梳妆台底部的醒目的霓虹蓝色 LED 灯照亮了整个场景，在木炭瓷砖地板上投射出现代、高对比度的光线，而她则拿着一部黑色智能手机进行拍摄。
items.prompt: A high-quality mirror selfie captures a {argument name="subject" default="young woman with long, wavy reddish-brown hair and a bold burgundy lip"} standing in a sleek, contemporary restroom. She is wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="vibrant cobalt blue short-sleeved mesh t-shirt featuring a large, ornate "LV" monogram logo in a marble-textured white and grey finish"} across the chest, which is layered over a dark base. Her look is paired with dark, form-fitting leggings decorated with a vintage-inspired floral print consisting of muted beige and soft pink roses. The background showcases an {argument name="setting" default="upscale interior with polished black marble walls, a row of minimalist white rectangular vessel sinks, and polished chrome fixtures"}. The scene is illuminated by a mix of warm vertical light strips behind the mirrors and a striking neon blue LED glow tracing the base of the vanity, casting a modern, high-contrast light across the charcoal-tiled floor while she holds a black smartphone to frame the shot.

items.title: 米色背景女性肖像
items.promptZh: 这是一张高度逼真的工作室肖像，拍摄的是一位 20 多岁的{argument name="subject sex" default="female"}，她的身材自然健康，取景从胸部向上，与眼睛齐平，以光滑温暖的米色工作室背景为中心，没有任何干扰。她有一头又长又密的深色{argument name="hair color" default="black"}头发，呈松散、略显凌乱的自然波浪，发量强劲，中心部分柔软，垂落在双肩上。她的姿势轻松而自信，直面镜头，表情平静、中立、自信。她穿着两层可见的衣服：一件纯白色圆领 T 恤，里面穿着一件敞开的轻质灰灰色休闲拉链夹克，呈现出柔和中性色调的简约现代街头服饰外观。包括一只耳朵上可见的精致小耳环。使用专业工作室照明，具有柔和的正面主光、柔和的填充、柔和的自然阴影、准确的肤色以及与背景的非常明亮的分离。使用 85mm 人像镜头 f/2.8 拍摄，浅景深拍摄对象清晰，时尚人像风格，自然平衡的调色，最少的修饰，超细致，无滤镜，无噪点，无运动模糊，无卡通特征。
items.prompt: A highly realistic studio portrait of a {argument name="subject gender" default="female"} in her mid-20s with a naturally fit build, framed from the chest up at eye level, centered against a smooth warm beige studio backdrop with no distractions. She has long, thick, dark {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair styled in loose, slightly messy natural waves with strong volume and a soft center part, falling over both shoulders. Her pose is relaxed and confident, facing the camera straight on with a calm, neutral, self-assured expression. She wears 2 visible clothing layers: a plain white crew-neck T-shirt underneath a lightweight taupe-gray casual zip jacket worn open, with a minimal modern streetwear look in muted neutral tones. Include a small subtle earring visible on one ear. Use professional studio lighting with a soft frontal key light, gentle fill, soft natural shadows, accurate skin tones, and very light separation from the background. Shoot with an 85mm portrait lens look at f/2.8, tack-sharp on the subject with shallow depth of field, editorial fashion portrait style, natural balanced color grading, minimal retouching, ultra-detailed, no filters, no noise, no motion blur, no cartoonish features.

items.title: 卷发女性时尚肖像
items.promptZh: 这是一幅高度写实的工作室肖像，描绘的是一位 20 多岁女性，身材自然健美，从躯干中部到眼睛水平，站立姿势轻松而自信，方肩，表情平静、中性、自信。她有一头浓密的长发，深棕色到近乎黑色的卷发，自然的卷度，松散的卷发，稍微偏离中心的部分，垂落在双肩上。她穿着两件显眼的衣服：一件橄榄绿合身圆领 T 恤和一件浅米色休闲夹克，敞开并从双肩滑落，打造轻松的编辑造型。使用带有泥土色调的柔和中性调色板。使用 f/2.8 的 85mm 人像镜头拍摄，拍摄对象对焦清晰，景深浅，背景模糊柔和自然。使用专业工作室设置照亮场景：柔和的前主光、微妙的填充以保留柔和的阴影细节，以及微弱的边缘光以进行分离。将她放在干净光滑的工作室背景上，背景采用柔和温暖的米色-灰色中性渐变，没有任何干扰。保持肤色准确和真实，色彩分级自然和平衡，后期处理最少，整体造型就像休闲街头服饰中的现代编辑时尚肖像，超详细、干净且逼真。
items.prompt: A highly realistic studio portrait of a woman in her mid-20s with a naturally fit build, framed from mid-torso up at eye level, standing in a relaxed yet confident pose with squared shoulders and a calm, neutral, self-assured expression. She has thick, long, dark brown to nearly black curly hair with natural volume, loose defined curls, and a slightly off-center part, falling over both shoulders. She wears 2 visible clothing pieces: an olive green fitted crew-neck t-shirt and a light beige casual jacket worn open and slipping off both shoulders for an effortless editorial look. Use a muted neutral palette with earthy tones. Shoot with an 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8, tack-sharp focus on the subject, shallow depth of field, and soft natural background blur. Light the scene with a professional studio setup: a soft front key light, subtle fill to preserve gentle shadow detail, and a faint rim light for separation. Place her against a clean smooth studio backdrop in a soft warm beige-gray neutral gradient with no distractions. Keep skin tones accurate and realistic, color grading natural and balanced, post-processing minimal, and overall styling like a modern editorial fashion portrait in casual streetwear, ultra-detailed, clean, and photorealistic.

items.title: 西语猫咪维修漫画
items.promptZh: 用西班牙竖版格式创建丰富多彩的幽默漫画风格海报，具有复古卡通外观、粗黑轮廓、温暖的橙色和黄色调色板、半色调纹理以及夸张的表现力人物。该布局有 4 个不同的面板：顶部有 1 个大标题面板，底部行有 3 个相等的垂直面板。在顶部面板中，展示了一只自鸣得意的橙色虎斑猫勤杂工，像舒适的客厅车间中的人一样笔直站立，一只爪子拿着一把螺丝刀，另一只爪子放在臀部，戴着一条带有可见工具的实用腰带。猫眯起自信的眼睛，露出狡猾的笑容。在此顶部面板的左侧，放置一个巨大的锯齿状漫画连环画，标题为西班牙粗体仿旧字体：“3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL”，其中“ARRUINAR”为红色，其余部分为黑色。在其下方添加一条胶带纸条，上面写着“edición casera”。在顶部面板的背景中，在墙上放置一个带框的标牌，上面写着“YO PUEDO SOLO”，上面有一个小爪子图案、一个小盆栽、架子和猫身后的动态放射线。在底行中，创建 3 个带标签的步骤面板，每个面板都有一个黄色标题框和粗体黑色文本。面板 1 标题：“PASO 1”。同样的橙色猫平静地坐在落地灯旁边的地板上，自信地闭着眼睛，随意地拿着一把螺丝刀。添加一个对话气泡，上面写着“Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos”。包括一个小型开放式工具箱和地板上的一些螺丝。面板 2 标题：“PASO 2”。展示正在修理中的猫，现在睁大了眼睛，笨拙地拧开了灯的错误部件，而碎片和螺丝在空中飞舞。添加一个对话气泡，上面写着“Ups...”，并在底部附近添加一个便签，上面写着“tocar lo que noera”。包括视觉运动线、散落的碎片和倒塌的花盆。面板 3 标题：“PASO 3”。展示后果：灯坏了，冒着烟，电线和火花裸露在外，房间里一片狼藉，碎片到处都是，猫拿着螺丝刀呆呆地坐着。一只棕色的狗站在右边，看上去很失望，在对话气泡中问道“¿Qué hiciste？”猫在另一个对话气泡中回复“No sé...se complicó alone”。在底部添加一个胶带标签，上面写着“最终结果”。通过精美的数字插图、富有表现力的面孔、漫画字体和 DIY 灾难色调，使整个图像变得有趣、混乱和模因。
items.prompt: Create a colorful humorous comic-style poster in Spanish, vertical format, with a retro cartoon look, thick black outlines, warm orange and yellow palette, halftone texture, and exaggerated expressive characters. The layout has 4 distinct panels: 1 large title panel across the top and 3 equal vertical panels along the bottom row. In the top panel, show a smug orange tabby cat handyman standing upright like a person in a cozy living room workshop, holding a screwdriver in one paw and the other paw on the hip, wearing a utility belt with visible tools. The cat has narrowed confident eyes and a sly grin. On the left side of this top panel, place a large jagged comic burst with the Spanish headline in bold distressed lettering: "3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL", with "ARRUINAR" in red and the rest in black. Below it, add a taped paper strip that says "edición casera". In the background of the top panel, include a framed sign on the wall that reads "YO PUEDO SOLO" with a small paw print, a small potted plant, shelves, and dynamic radial lines behind the cat. In the bottom row, create 3 labeled step panels, each with a yellow header box and bold black text. Panel 1 header: "PASO 1". Show the same orange cat sitting calmly on the floor beside a standing lamp, eyes closed with overconfidence, casually holding a screwdriver. Add a speech bubble that says "Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos." Include a small open toolbox and a few screws on the floor. Panel 2 header: "PASO 2". Show the cat mid-repair, now alarmed with wide eyes, awkwardly unscrewing the wrong part of the lamp while pieces and screws fly through the air. Add a speech bubble that says "Ups..." and a sticky note near the bottom that says "tocar lo que no era". Include visual motion lines, scattered debris, and a toppled plant pot. Panel 3 header: "PASO 3". Show the aftermath: the lamp is broken and smoking with exposed wires and sparks, the room is messy with shattered parts everywhere, and the cat sits stunned holding the screwdriver. A brown dog stands to the right, looking disappointed, asking in a speech bubble "¿Qué hiciste?" The cat replies in another speech bubble "No sé... se complicó solo." Add a taped label at the bottom that says "resultado final". Make the entire image playful, chaotic, and meme-like, with polished digital illustration, expressive faces, comic lettering, and a DIY disaster tone.

items.title: 月夜花园和风少女
items.promptZh: 梦幻般的柔和动画插图，描绘了月光下的春天花园中池塘边的宁静年轻女子，以精致的日本奇幻风格渲染，采用扁平的动画色彩，没有阴影，超干净的线条，没有颗粒感的纹理。她坐在水边的四分之三后视位置，脸微微转向观众，表情平静而忧郁。她有一头很长的直发{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"}，刘海柔软，花饰编织成花冠。她穿着淡蓝色和奶油色的优雅飘逸和服，上面有丰富的图案，带有风格化的波浪和白狐，分层的织物围绕着她。她身后右侧放着一把巨大的传统纸阳伞，半开着，上面悬挂着水晶般的装饰品。她的周围是头顶上茂密盛开的樱花树枝，前景是散落的花瓣。池塘里正好有 10 朵发光的莲花漂浮在反光的水面上，还有 4 条可见的锦鲤在水面附近游动。在远处的左侧背景中，包括一座横跨水面的小型多层宝塔剪影。从左上角，柔和的彩虹光束斜射到池塘上，产生彩虹色的反射。在树枝上挂上一些刻面水晶饰品，让它们在光线下闪闪发光。使用以薰衣草色、腮红、淡蓝色、象牙色和淡金色为主的调色板。错综复杂的装饰细节、发光的水面倒影和抛光的垂直构图，营造出空灵、浪漫、宁静和神奇的氛围。
items.prompt: A dreamy pastel anime illustration of a serene young woman in a moonlit spring garden beside a pond, rendered in delicate Japanese fantasy style with flat anime coloring, no shadows, ultra-clean linework, and no grainy texture. She is seated in three-quarter back view at the water’s edge, turning her face slightly toward the viewer with a calm, melancholic expression. She has very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair with soft bangs and floral ornaments woven into a blossom crown. She wears an elegant flowing kimono in pale blue and cream, richly patterned with stylized waves and white foxes, with layered fabric pooling around her. A large traditional paper parasol rests behind her on the right side, partly open, with dangling crystal-like ornaments. Surround her with dense blooming cherry blossom branches overhead and scattered petals in the foreground. The pond is filled with exactly 10 glowing lotus flowers floating on reflective water and exactly 4 visible koi fish swimming near the surface. In the distant left background, include a small multi-tier pagoda silhouette across the water. From the upper left, a soft rainbow beam of light descends diagonally onto the pond, creating iridescent reflections. Hang several faceted crystal ornaments from the branches so they sparkle in the light. Use a palette dominated by lavender, blush pink, pale blue, ivory, and soft gold. The atmosphere should feel ethereal, romantic, tranquil, and magical, with intricate decorative detail, luminous water reflections, and a polished vertical composition.

items.title: 中文万年历应用界面
items.prompt: A clean, elegant iPhone app UI mockup for a Chinese perpetual calendar and almanac app, shown as a full-screen mobile screenshot on a soft warm white background with subtle paper-like texture and refined East Asian editorial aesthetics. The interface uses a minimalist serif-and-sans mix, muted brown, gray, black, pale blue, green, and gold accents, with spacious layout and delicate dividers. Show the iOS status bar at the top with the time 8:45, cellular signal, Wi‑Fi icon, and a battery indicator reading 96. Below it, a header for {argument name="month" default="4月"} with secondary text “24日 | 每日万年历” and, on the right, a rounded rectangular date-picker button labeled “择日” with a calendar icon plus a separate plus symbol. The main section is a monthly calendar grid for {argument name="year" default="2026"}, with 7 weekday columns labeled Sunday through Saturday in Chinese: 周日, 周一, 周二, 周三, 周四, 周五, 周六. Render a 6-row month view with exactly 42 date cells including adjacent-month dates. The visible dates should be: first row 29, 30, 31, 1, 2, 3, 4; second row 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11; third row 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18; fourth row 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25; fifth row 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 1, 2; sixth row 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Each day cell includes a large Gregorian date and a smaller Chinese lunar date or note underneath. Include colored holiday and solar-term tags across specific cells, with exactly 10 highlighted labels visible: “休十七” on the 4th, “清明节” on the 5th, “休十九” on the 6th, “谷雨” on the 20th in green, “劳动节” on the next-month 1st, “休十六” on the next-month 2nd, “休十七” on the last-row 3rd, “青年节” on the last-row 4th, “休立夏” on the last-row 5th, and “天后诞” on the last-row 9th in orange. Add small lunar phase markers on a few days, including yellow crescent or dot icons around the 2nd, 10th, 17th, 24th, and next-month 2nd. Make the {argument name="selected date" default="24"} cell in the Friday column stand out with a rounded blue gradient tile and soft shadow, with smaller text “初八” inside. Beneath the calendar, show a detailed daily information panel separated by whitespace. The left side features a very large date title “4月24日”; the right side stacks “星期五 2026” and “农历三月初八”. Below that, include smaller gray metadata lines such as “第114天 · 第17周 金尊月” and a traditional sexagenary/date string like “丙午 · 马年 壬辰月 戊辰日”. At the far right of this metadata area, place a rounded outline pill button labeled “今日”. Underneath, present a large white rounded card with almanac guidance. The card contains two major sections with exactly 2 headings: a green “宜” section and a red “忌” section, separated by fine dotted dividers. In the “宜” section, include the directional fortune line “喜神 东南 福神 正北 财神 正北” and three activity items: “祭祀”, “修饰垣墙”, “余事勿取”. In the “忌” section, include the conflict line “冲煞 冲狗 煞南”. At the bottom, show a 5-item iOS-style tab bar with labels exactly “今日”, “MONTH”, “YEAR”, “EVENTS”, “MORE”; the first tab is active and includes the small sublabel “4月24日”. Overall style: premium app design concept, calm scholarly Chinese calendar aesthetic, high-fidelity mobile product shot, realistic yet idealized interface, perfectly aligned typography, subtle shadows, soft contrast, and polished startup-quality UI.

items.title: 复古宣传风动作海报
items.promptZh: 大胆的复古宣传风格海报插图，在轻微老化的纸张纹理上使用有限的红色、黑色和暖奶油色调色板。该构图的中心是一个动态的动漫风格的动作场景：一位身着白色道服、系着黑腰带的武术家，肩上扛着一位长发女子，摆出消防员的抬举或摔跤姿势。图中的斗士从膝盖向上，以一种强有力的宽站姿，面向左侧，女人水平地披在肩上，裸露的双腿抬起并弯曲，长长的黑发向下垂落，头上仍然戴着一顶黑色宽边牛仔帽。以高对比度墨水线条艺术渲染两个人物，具有厚重的黑色阴影和清晰的图形轮廓，将漫画角色设计与复古丝网印刷海报能量相结合。在它们后面，用激进的几何射线和楔形填充背景：6 个主要的红色和黑色角形在奶油色背景上向外辐射，营造出冲击感和运动感。在右上角添加 1 个圆形标志，其中包含带有红色点缀的凶猛大猩猩或猿头图标。在下三分之一处，将大型粗体压缩版式融入到构图中：较小的行写着“苏格兰食谱：”，巨大的主标题写着“MINCE AND TATTIES”。在分层对角横幅面板中，将文本设置为奶油色红色和黑色奶油色，单词总共占据 3 个文本组：“苏格兰食谱：”、“MINCE AND”和“TATTIES”。强调戏剧性的对角线布局、海报化的阴影、仿旧的印刷纹理，以及复古苏联建构主义或纸浆剥削食品海报与武术漫画美学融合的感觉。
items.prompt: A bold retro propaganda-style poster illustration with a limited palette of red, black, and warm cream on a lightly aged paper texture. The composition features a dynamic anime-inspired action scene in the center: a martial artist in a white gi with a black belt carries a long-haired woman over one shoulder in a fireman's carry or wrestling throw pose. The fighter is shown from the knees up in a powerful wide stance, facing left, with the woman draped horizontally across the shoulders, her bare legs lifted and bent, her long dark hair flowing downward, and a black wide-brim cowboy hat still on her head. Render both figures in high-contrast inked line art with thick black shadows and sharp graphic contours, mixing manga character design with vintage screen-printed poster energy. Behind them, fill the background with aggressive geometric rays and wedges: 6 major red and black angular shapes radiating outward across the cream backdrop, creating a sense of impact and motion. In the top right corner, add 1 circular emblem containing a fierce gorilla or ape head icon with red accents. Across the lower third, place large bold condensed block typography integrated into the composition: the smaller line reads “SCOTTISH RECIPE:” and the huge main title reads “MINCE AND TATTIES”. Make the text red on cream and cream on black in layered diagonal banner panels, with the words occupying 3 text groupings total: “SCOTTISH RECIPE:”, “MINCE AND”, and “TATTIES”. Emphasize dramatic diagonal layout, posterized shadows, distressed print texture, and the feeling of a vintage Soviet constructivist or pulp exploitation food poster fused with martial arts manga aesthetics.

items.title: 像素游戏资产图鉴
items.prompt:
请根据【游戏主题：{argument name="游戏主题" default="鬼灭之刃/炭治郎"}】创作一张高完成度、高信息密度、适合系列化发布的「像素世界资产图鉴 / Pixel World Asset Atlas」。

这不是普通像素插画，也不是单张游戏场景图，而是一张面向游戏开发、美术设定、关卡设计和视觉提案的“2D像素游戏资产总览图”。画面需要像一张完整的游戏素材说明板，把一个【游戏类型：{argument name="游戏类型" default="横版动作"}】所需的核心角色、敌人、道具、地形、场景、机关、Boss和装饰元素系统化整理在同一张图中，形成清晰、专业、可复用的游戏资产图鉴。

【基础设定】
主题世界观：【游戏主题】
游戏类型：【游戏类型】
时代背景：【时代背景】
主角身份：【主角身份】
敌人类型：【敌人类型】
主要场景：【主要场景环境】
整体风格：【风格方向，例如{argument name="风格" default="16-bit复古街机像素风"}】
主色调：【主色调】
辅助色：【辅助色】
点缀色：【点缀色】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，横版4:3】
如没有填写，自动按照游戏主题最优方案进行匹配。

【整体画面要求】
画面采用横版大画布，浅色或低干扰背景，整体像一张游戏开发资产表、像素设定集展开页、说明书式资源目录。所有元素都应为统一像素密度的2D pixel art sprite，具有清晰黑色或深色描边、有限色阶、复古游戏质感。不要生成真实摄影风、3D渲染风、厚涂插画风或电影海报风。重点是“系统完整、分类清晰、资源丰富、可开发感强”。

【版式结构】
整张图采用模块化网格排版，用细线分割不同资源区域。每个区域需要有编号标题和简短分类标签，整体阅读路径为从左到右、从上到下。版式应具有说明书、游戏开发文档、素材图鉴、设定板的秩序感。信息密度要高，但不能混乱；每个模块内部的元素应等距排列，保持清晰可读。

【必须包含的模块】
1. 玩家角色模块：展示完整动作帧，包括站立、行走/奔跑、跳跃等。动作帧应横向排列，像游戏sprite sheet。
2. 敌人单位模块：设计多种敌人，包括普通、远程、重装、精英单位等。
3. 武器与道具模块：展示近战、远程、投掷物、特效、拾取物等。
4. 基础地形砖块模块：展示地面、墙体、平台、转角、不同材质地块。
5. 自然/外部场景资源模块：展示树木、草丛、石头、障碍物。
6. 建筑/基地/营地资源模块：展示门、窗、墙、梯子、营地设施。
7. 特殊地形模块：展示桥梁、水体、悬崖、洞口。
8. 室内/地下/设施资源模块：展示管道、控制台、金属门、设备。
9. Boss / 遭遇战资源模块：展示大型Boss、特殊载具、巨型机关。
10. 通用装饰与交互元素模块：展示梯子、绳索、指示牌、开关、机关。

【视觉细节要求】
所有资源需要保持统一的像素尺寸逻辑和世界观一致性。比例关系明确。动作帧需体现连续性；地形砖块可拼接；道具和机关有功能识别度；Boss元素需有压迫感。

items.title: 水彩绘本儿童对话
items.promptZh: 柔和诗意的儿童书籍插图，带有水彩和水粉纹理。清澈柔和的日光。柔和的柔和色彩搭配柔和的蓝色和暖色调。可见的笔触和纸纹。具有大负空间的简约构图。手绘绘本风格，不是卡通，不是动漫，不是3D。 {argument name="subject" default="两个孩子平静地交谈，形成软联系"}。
items.prompt: Soft poetic children's book illustration with watercolor and gouache textures. Clear gentle daylight. Muted pastel colors with soft blue and warm tones. Visible brush strokes and paper grain. Minimalist composition with large negative space. Hand-painted picture book style, not cartoon, not anime, not 3D. {argument name="subject" default="Two children in calm conversation, soft connection forming"}.

items.title: 冲绳夏日旅游横幅
items.prompt:
Create a polished Japanese travel agency summer banner ad for Okinawa in a bright, inviting commercial style. Use a wide horizontal layout with a vivid tropical beach scene as the full background: crystal-clear turquoise ocean, white sand shoreline, small green island in the mid distance, deep blue sky with large fluffy white clouds, and palm leaves hanging in from the upper right corner. On the right foreground, place 1 traditional Okinawan shisa lion-dog statue sitting on a stone wall, surrounded by red hibiscus flowers and lush tropical greenery. Near the water, include 1 small glass-bottom sightseeing boat floating close to shore. Add 2 small simple fish doodle icons over the sea.

Make the typography the hero element. Across the left-center to center, place very large Japanese calligraphic headline text reading {argument name="headline text" default="夏の沖縄"}, with a blue gradient and white glow or soft outline, highly legible and elegant. Above it, add a handwritten-style Japanese catchphrase in blue reading {argument name="catchphrase" default="青い海、青い空、心ほどける島時間。"} with a loose underline flourish. Under the main headline, add a smaller Japanese subheading reading {argument name="subheading" default="感動の景色と、あたたかいおもてなしに出会う旅へ。"}.

In the upper left, add a circular summer badge with a sunburst feel, soft cream background, tiny wave lines, a small hibiscus accent, and Japanese text reading "この夏は 沖縄で 最高の思い出を!". Decorate the headline area with 1 pink hibiscus flower on the left and subtle ocean-wave graphic strokes.

Along the lower middle, place 3 rounded white feature cards in a row, partially overlapping the beach scene. Count and depict all 3 cards clearly: the first card shows a sea turtle swimming underwater in a circular photo, with Japanese heading "美しい自然を満喫" and smaller body text about transparent waters and scenic spots; the second card shows a bowl of Okinawa soba in a circular photo, with heading "沖縄グルメを堪能" and smaller body text mentioning 沖縄そば and ゴーヤチャンプルー; the third card shows Shuri Castle in a circular photo, with heading "観光スポットも充実" and smaller body text mentioning 美ら海水族館 and 首里城. Add small coral, shell, hibiscus, and starfish decorations around these cards.

On the right lower-middle, overlap the beach with 1 tilted circular promotional sticker in pale blue and cream, with a small yellow tab on top. The yellow tab says "早めの予約がおトク!" and the main circle says "夏の沖縄ツアー 好評受付中!". Add a white plumeria flower accent near the sticker.

Create a full-width dark blue footer bar across the bottom. On the left side of the footer, place a white travel company logo icon and company name text {argument name="company name" default="〇〇旅行株式会社"}, with a smaller Japanese tagline below. Across the center of the footer, place exactly 3 circular line-icons with short Japanese captions: 1 calendar icon for tour plans, 1 support staff icon for travel assistance, and 1 suitcase icon for comfortable travel help. On the right side of the footer, add a boxed CTA area with Japanese text "詳しくはこちらから" and a mock search field containing {argument name="search text" default="〇〇旅行　沖縄"} plus a search icon. Overall design should feel premium, cheerful, summery, and highly marketable, like a professional Japanese web banner or travel campaign visual.

items.title: 东京时尚杂志封面
items.prompt: A stylized Japanese fashion magazine cover titled MODE TOKYO, designed like a glossy contemporary women's style publication. The composition is a high-angle, dynamic street-fashion anime illustration of 2 girls looking up toward the viewer from beside a brick wall with colorful graffiti and dramatic sunlight. The girl on the right has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair in a lively messy ponytail with loose bangs, bright green eyes, a wide cheerful grin, and a sporty-feminine outfit: a light blue lace-trim camisole or slip-style top, short bottoms, chunky white sneakers, and a black choker. She is posed energetically, leaning forward with one knee bent, giving a confident summer-fashion editorial feel. The girl on the left has long vivid teal-green hair with straight heavy bangs, large blue eyes, and a calm, cool expression. She wears a casual layered street outfit in dark tones with a sleeveless top and sits lower in the frame, angled toward the right girl while gazing upward. Use bold cel-shaded anime rendering with crisp linework, glossy highlights in the hair and eyes, soft skin shading, and a polished commercial illustration finish. The background should combine sunlit urban texture, blurred mural colors in pink, purple, orange, and black, and deep shadows to create contrast. The overall palette mixes hot pink typography, summer sunlight, teal, blonde, and saturated street-art hues. Include dense magazine-cover typography in a premium editorial layout: a giant pink serif masthead reading {argument name="magazine title" default="MODE"} across the top with TOKYO vertically on the left; on the upper right a dark circular or rounded block containing {argument name="issue number" default="06"}, JUNE 2024, vol.218, and cover lines in Japanese; on the left side several smaller Japanese and English fashion blurbs including NEO BASIC STYLE and SPORTY × FEMININE; a pink circular badge on the right with Japanese text and Trend 7; a large hot-pink Japanese headline across the lower left and center reading 私らしく、もっと輝く季節。; elegant white handwritten script diagonally across the lower right reading Shine in my Style; small footer cover lines and hashtags in Japanese; and a small BEAUTY label at bottom right. Make it look exactly like a real high-end Japanese fashion magazine cover, vertical format, full bleed, vibrant, youthful, feminine, sporty, and trendy.

items.title: 板球运动员海报
items.promptZh: 一张戏剧性的体育海报，上面是一位身穿宝蓝色德里首都队球衣的男性板球运动员的腰部肖像，面朝左，摆出强有力的四分之三姿势。他的脸被以脸部为中心的大型软边垂直矩形模糊所遮挡，产生了匿名的暴露效果。他的头后面有一个明亮的白色圆形光环，中心像聚光灯或月亮。背景是深海军蓝和黑色，两侧有电蓝色火焰般的纹理，上面覆盖着粗糙的粉笔式涂鸦、箭头、圆圈和大号手绘字母，营造出坚韧的城市运动美感。球衣衣领和门襟饰有橙红色装饰，右胸和袖子上有白色 Puma 标志，左胸上有德里首都队队徽，袖子上有红色圆形 Jio 贴片，胸前有矩形 ALL SEASONS 赞助商贴片，躯干上有大型英雄品牌标志。添加逼真的织物纹理、汗水光泽、颗粒、灰尘、划痕和仿旧海报磨损。在底部，放置优雅的白色手写脚本“欢迎来到迪利”，上面有非常大的粗体裂纹白色大写字母“{argument name =“player name”default =“REHAN AHMED”}。使用高对比度照明、喜怒无常的阴影、居中构图和优质 IPL 团队公告海报风格。
items.prompt: A dramatic sports poster featuring a waist-up portrait of a male cricket player in a royal blue Delhi Capitals jersey, facing slightly left in a strong three-quarter pose. His face is obscured by a large soft-edged vertical rectangular blur centered over the face, creating an anonymized reveal effect. Behind his head is a bright glowing white circular halo, centered like a spotlight or moon. The background is dark navy and black with electric blue flame-like textures rising on both sides, overlaid with rough chalk-style scribbles, arrows, circles, and large hand-drawn letters for a gritty urban sports aesthetic. The jersey has red-orange collar and placket accents, a white Puma logo on the right chest and sleeve, a Delhi Capitals crest on the left chest, a red circular Jio patch on the sleeve, a rectangular ALL SEASONS sponsor patch on the chest, and large Hero branding across the torso. Add realistic fabric texture, sweat sheen, grain, dust, scratches, and distressed poster wear. At the bottom, place elegant white handwritten script reading Welcome to Dilli above very large bold cracked white block letters reading {argument name="player name" default="REHAN AHMED"}. Use high contrast lighting, moody shadows, centered composition, and a premium IPL team announcement poster style.

items.title: 涂鸦巷街头时尚写真
items.promptZh: 一张喜怒无常的全身时尚肖像，照片中一位{argument name="subject" default="young Woman"}站在一条狭窄的城市小巷或隧道里，上面布满了浓密的彩色涂鸦，拍摄于夜间，在戏剧性的低调灯光和闪光灯的现实主义照射下拍摄。她随意地靠在墙上，一只手抚摸着一对大的包耳式黑色耳机，另一只手塞进一件超大{argument name="hoodie color" default="mustard Yellow"}连帽衫的前袋中。这款连帽衫足够长，读起来几乎就像一件连帽衫连衣裙，胸部中央有一个简单的黑色笑脸图案，并配有白色抽绳。她背着一个带有 2 条可见肩带的黑色背包、白色圆袜和厚实的黑白低帮运动鞋。她的双腿裸露，姿势放松，一只膝盖稍微弯曲，一只脚向前迈进。她的头发齐肩，略显凌乱，{argument name="hair color" default="dark silver"}。从头部到鞋子垂直构图，拍摄对象位于画面稍偏左的中心位置。背景是一面砂砾墙，以绿松石蓝色、黄色、粉色和黑色喷漆为主，上面有滴水、标签和抽象的卡通涂鸦形状，营造出一种原始的街头艺术氛围。地板又黑又旧，还溅着油漆反光。使用高对比度、深阴影、逼真的皮肤和织物纹理、编辑街头服饰摄影风格、地下城市氛围、对服装和身体的敏锐关注、柔和的面部细节以及电影般的黑暗夜生活氛围。
items.prompt: A moody full-body fashion portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} standing in a narrow urban alley or tunnel covered in dense colorful graffiti, photographed at night with dramatic low-key lighting and flash-lit realism. She is leaning casually against the wall with 1 hand touching a large pair of over-ear black headphones and 1 hand tucked into the front pocket of an oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="mustard yellow"} hoodie. The hoodie is long enough to read almost like a hoodie dress and has a simple black smiley-face graphic centered on the chest with white drawstrings. She wears a black backpack with 2 visible shoulder straps, white crew socks, and chunky black-and-white low-top sneakers. Her legs are bare, and her pose is relaxed with one knee slightly bent and one foot set forward. Her hair is shoulder-length, slightly messy, and {argument name="hair color" default="dark blonde"}. Compose the shot vertically from head to shoes, with the subject centered slightly left of frame. The background is a gritty painted wall dominated by turquoise blue, yellow, pink, and black spray paint, with drips, tags, and abstract cartoon-like graffiti shapes creating a raw street-art atmosphere. The floor is dark, worn, and reflective with paint splatters. Use high contrast, deep shadows, realistic skin and fabric texture, editorial streetwear photography style, underground urban vibe, sharp focus on clothing and body, subdued facial detail, and a cinematic dark nightlife mood.

items.title: 街头涂鸦动漫插画
items.promptZh: 使用提供的参考图像，将照片转换为风格化的动漫街头艺术插图，同时保持相同的主题、姿势、服装、耳机、背包和涂鸦墙设置。将模糊的真脸换成干净的原创动漫女孩脸，金色短波波头和侧分刘海，让表情显得平静而略显冷漠。保留超大号的黄色连帽衫和黑白运动鞋，但将服装简化为带有粗黑色墨水轮廓的大胆的卡通阴影形状。将举起的手上的物体从触摸耳机改为拿着一个靠近脸部的蓝色小喷漆罐。将墙壁颜色强化为鲜艳的青色、粉红色和黄色涂鸦泼溅，并以高对比度、粗略线条和略低角度的全身构图，以动态漫画/波普艺术风格渲染整个图像。
items.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the photo into a stylized anime street-art illustration while keeping the same subject, pose, outfit, headphones, backpack, and graffiti-wall setting. Replace the obscured real face with a clean original anime girl face, with a short blonde bob and side-swept bangs, and make the expression calm and slightly aloof. Keep the oversized yellow hoodie and black-and-white sneakers, but simplify the clothing into bold cel-shaded shapes with thick black ink outlines. Change the object in the raised hand from touching the headphones to holding a small blue spray-paint can near the face. items.prompt:
Create a refined vintage-modern type specimen poster for a fictional typeface named {argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"}, designed as an elegant fusion of Roman and Japanese typography. Use a tall portrait layout on warm ivory textured paper with thin gray divider lines, black letterforms, and muted vermilion accent text and seals. Center the composition around a large serif Latin wordmark "{argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"}" above 2 oversized Japanese kanji, "華世", set in a matching high-contrast classical style. Above the title, place the small heading "INTRODUCING" with a tiny ornamental diamond. To the right of the title area, add a vertical Japanese tagline reading "古典の美、未来の書体。". Under the main kanji, add the subtitle "A ROMAN × JAPANESE TYPEFACE" and below it a Japanese line in vermilion: "ローマの精神、日本の美。". On the far left, create a narrow sidebar with the stacked English text "A TYPEFACE HARMONIZING ROME AND JAPAN", a small circular crest, the Japanese text "製作 — MMXXIV", and "CREATED IN KYOTO, JAPAN".

Build the lower two-thirds as a meticulous type specimen sheet with exact labeled sections. In a left column, include 2 sections: "WEIGHTS" with 5 items — Light, Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold — and "POINT SIZES" with 9 items — 8pt, 10pt, 12pt, 14pt, 18pt, 24pt, 36pt, 48pt, 72pt. In the main area, include a section titled "ROMAN CHARACTERS" showing 4 specimen lines: uppercase alphabet A through Z, lowercase alphabet a through z, numerals 0 through 9, and a punctuation/symbol line with slashes, commas, semicolons, exclamation mark, question marks, apostrophes, quotation marks, em dash, parentheses, brackets, braces, ampersand, at sign, dollar sign, asterisk, dagger, and double dagger. Below that, include a section titled "JAPANESE CHARACTERS" with 4 lines: 19 kanji "日 月 山 川 花 鳥 風 林 火 水 土 金 木 道 心 時 空 光 夢 永", 23 hiragana "あ い う え お か き く け こ さ し す せ そ た ち つ て と な に ぬ ね の", 21 katakana "ア イ ウ エ オ カ キ ク ケ コ サ シ ス セ ソ ン タ チ ツ テ ト ナ ニ ヌ ネ ノ", and a symbols line including Japanese punctuation, corner brackets, wave dash, middle dot, parentheses, angle brackets, double angle brackets, black lenticular brackets, postal mark, reference marks, and iteration mark.

Along the next row, add 4 compact specimen panels: "LIGATURES" with 10 items — Æ, AE, AJ, Œ, KA, KE, KI, KO, KU, and "st ct fi fl ft fb"; "STYLISTIC ALTERNATES" with 12 items — A, A, A, R, R, K, K, a, a, g, g, y, y, J, J, Q, Q, t, t — arranged as a neat sampling grid; "SPACING STUDY" showing the word "KASEI" with wide tracking above the kanji string "華世永美"; and "NUMERAL STYLES" with 4 lines — lining figures 0123456789, oldstyle figures 0123456789, and small caps combinations "H 0123" and "H 0123". Add tiny red Japanese captions beneath some of these sample boxes.

At the bottom, create 3 feature panels. Left panel titled "WORDS" with 3 entries: "HARMONIA" with the red Japanese and English gloss "調和  HARMONY", "VERITAS" with "真実  TRUTH", and "FORTITUDO" with "勇気  COURAGE". Center panel with a large Japanese quote "時を越え、美は残る。" above the English statement "BEAUTY ENDURES\nBEYOND TIME." and a small signature line "— KASEI" in red. Right panel titled "DETAILS" with a large kanji "永" over faint construction circles and guide lines, plus 4 right-aligned Japanese annotation callouts connected by fine dotted leader lines.

Finish with a footer containing 4 blocks: a small crest and "KASEI TYPE FOUNDRY" with "WWW.KASEIFOUNDRY.JP"; a centered language support note "SUPPORTING 200+ LANGUAGES" and "LATIN / GREEK / CYRILLIC / JAPANESE / SYMBOLS"; a right-side statement "DESIGNED WITH RESPECT\nCRAFTED FOR THE FUTURE"; and a square vermilion seal bearing "華世". Overall style should feel like a premium Japanese foundry specimen sheet, balancing editorial Swiss-grid precision, classical book typography, subtle Japanese branding, generous margins, restrained luxury, and museum-poster elegance.

items.title: 未来教室全息课堂
items.promptZh: 明亮的未来教室或科学博物馆学习实验室，里面挤满了学龄儿童，与大型混合现实全息图、电影般的超详细照片写实互动。场景是温暖的午后阳光下的广角室内，有落地玻璃窗、现代化的桌子、书架、数字显示器，以及干净的高科技教育氛围。大约 9 名儿童和 1 名成人老师分布在房间里，通过手势和触摸互动积极探索科学展品。在中心，一颗发光的半透明全息人体心脏漂浮在胸部高度，3 个孩子聚集在它周围，好奇地伸向它。头顶上悬挂着一个巨大的全息太阳系，正好有 9 颗行星围绕着明亮的太阳运行，具有发光的轨道轨迹和神奇的科学可视化风格。在左侧，一名儿童正在与一个高大的垂直全息 DNA 双螺旋相互作用。左前方的桌子上有一个圆形桌面全息图，显示了一个微型山河生态系统，其中恰好包含 4 种可见动物：大象、鹿、美洲驼或羊驼和熊。左后方的桌子上有一个圆形的全息建筑城市模型，具有宏伟的古典圆顶建筑和周围的结构。右前桌上有一个由发光球体和棒材制成的大型球棒分子模型。在右中和右上空间中，包括额外的浮动科学全息图：正好 2 个几何多面体、正好 2 个分子图、正好 2 个球形能量或数据地球仪以及 1 个沙漏状抽象全息图。孩子们应该是多元化的种族，穿着休闲，投入，惊讶，合作，并观看不同的全息主题。使用柔和的体积阳光、玻璃和桌面上的真实反射、全息图发出的微妙蓝色和金色光芒、浅层大气薄雾以及优质的鼓舞人心的 STEM 教育广告美学。
items.prompt: A bright futuristic classroom or science museum learning lab filled with school-age children interacting with large mixed-reality holograms, cinematic ultra-detailed photorealism. The scene is a wide-angle interior during warm late-afternoon sunlight, with floor-to-ceiling glass windows, modern tables, bookshelves, digital displays, and a clean high-tech educational atmosphere. About 9 children and 1 adult teacher are spread across the room, actively exploring science exhibits with gestures and touch interactions. In the center, a glowing semi-transparent holographic human heart floats at chest height while 3 children gather around it, reaching toward it in curiosity. Suspended overhead is a large holographic solar system mobile with exactly 9 planets orbiting a bright sun, with luminous orbit trails and a magical scientific visualization style. On the left side, one child interacts with a tall vertical holographic DNA double helix. On the front-left table, there is a circular tabletop hologram of a miniature mountain-and-river ecosystem containing exactly 4 visible animals: an elephant, a deer, a llama or alpaca, and a bear. On the back-left table, there is a circular holographic architectural city model featuring a grand classical domed building and surrounding structures. On the right-front table, there is a large ball-and-stick molecular model made of glowing spheres and rods. In the mid-right and upper-right space, include additional floating science holograms: exactly 2 geometric polyhedra, exactly 2 molecule diagrams, exactly 2 spherical energy or data globes, and 1 hourglass-like abstract hologram. The children should be ethnically diverse, dressed casually, engaged, amazed, collaborative, and looking at different holographic subjects. Use soft volumetric sunlight, realistic reflections on glass and tabletops, subtle blue and gold glow from the holograms, shallow atmospheric haze, and a premium inspirational STEM-education advertisement aesthetic.

items.promptZh: 为 {argument name="location name" default="BEACON HOLLOW"} 创建一张复古奇幻旅行明信片海报，其设计类似于 20 世纪 50 年代至 1960 年代的大字纪念明信片。该构图是一个细节丰富的水平场景，具有严重风化的纸张纹理、圆形明信片角、褪色的墨水、折痕、划痕、狐臭和磨损的边缘。在顶部和中心，巨大的立体大写字母以经典复古明信片风格拼写“BEACON HOLLOW”，具有温暖的奶油色轮廓和红棕色挤压阴影；每封信都包含目的地的微型彩绘风景小插图，包括高山山峰、瀑布、松树林、神奇的庄园、发光的塔楼和山谷景观。左上角，手绘文字以深红色写着“GREETINGS FROM”。右上角有一枚圆形黑色邮政盖销邮票，上面写着“BEACON HOLLOW / MAY 18 / 1967 / CREATIVE RETREAT”，与贴有“BEACON HOLLOW”和“CREATIVE RETREAT”和“7c”的复古邮票重叠，描绘了一座月光下的山峰和一座灯塔般的灯塔塔。在标题下方，放置一个小的弧形丝带横幅，上面写着{argument name="tagline" default="a magejosh目的地"}，上面有微小的指南针星星装饰。主要背景应该展示雄伟的黄金时段山谷，蜿蜒的河流，遥远的雪峰，茂密的常绿森林，右侧是一座栖息在悬崖上的大型木材和石头奇幻小屋，内部光线温暖，楼梯沿着斜坡下降。在小屋和前景周围散布微妙的魔法蓝色灯光和微弱的神秘圆形符号，营造出世界建筑与魔法相遇的氛围。在左下角，放置 3 个前景桌面物体：一个带有指南针标志的深色陶瓷杯、一本打开的素描本以及斜放在书页上的一支钢笔。速写本的左页标题为“竞选创意”，列出了 3 个项目符号：“被遗忘的山谷”、“发条朝圣者”和“第一道曙光的回声”，下面画了一座小城堡；右页显示树插图和手写文字“Beery world Hollow”。在较低的中心，添加一张摊在桌子上的旧插图地图，显示山脉图标和手绘地图细节。在右下角，放置另外 5 个前景元素：一本压花有星星罗盘和“创意成为传奇”短语的闭合皮革日记本，一组 4 个多面体骰子，一个质朴的木制路标，上面有 4 个方向板条，上面写着“故事”、“游戏设计”、“世界建筑”和“人工智能创造者”，一个发光的玻璃灯或管装置，以及附近的一个漂浮的奥术类似目标的印记。在旧纸上的中间左侧添加一条固定的手写便条，上面写着“希望你在这里 - 建设世界，追逐奇迹，将想法变成冒险。 - {argument name =“signature name”default =“magejosh”}”蓝色草书。使用具有高细节的绘画插图、怀旧的美国明信片设计、幻想概念艺术感性、温暖的日落灯光、柔和的青色天空、棕褐色老化以及诱人的创意静修心情。
items.prompt: Create a vintage fantasy travel postcard poster for {argument name="location name" default="BEACON HOLLOW"}, designed like a large-letter souvenir postcard from the 1950s–1960s. The composition is a single richly detailed horizontal scene with heavily weathered paper texture, rounded postcard corners, faded inks, creases, scratches, foxing, and worn edges. Across the top and center, huge dimensional block letters spell “BEACON HOLLOW” in classic retro postcard style, with warm cream outlines and red-brown extruded shadows; each letter contains miniature painted scenic vignettes of the destination, including alpine peaks, waterfalls, pine forests, a magical manor, glowing towers, and valley landscapes. In the upper left, hand-painted script text reads “GREETINGS FROM” in dark red. In the upper right, include a circular black postal cancellation stamp reading “BEACON HOLLOW / MAY 18 / 1967 / CREATIVE RETREAT,” overlapping a vintage postage stamp labeled “BEACON HOLLOW” and “CREATIVE RETREAT” with “7c,” depicting a moonlit mountain and a lighthouse-like beacon tower. Beneath the title, place a small curved ribbon banner reading {argument name="tagline" default="a magejosh destination"} with tiny compass-star ornaments. The main background should show a majestic golden-hour mountain valley with a winding river, distant snowy peaks, dense evergreen forests, and on the right a large timber-and-stone fantasy lodge perched on a cliff, warmly lit from within, with stairs descending the slope. Scatter subtle magical blue lights and faint arcane circular glyphs around the lodge and foreground for a worldbuilding-meets-magic atmosphere. In the lower left, place exactly 3 foreground desk objects: a dark ceramic mug with a compass emblem, an open sketchbook spread, and a fountain pen resting diagonally across the pages. The left page of the sketchbook is titled “Campaign Ideas” and lists 3 bullets: “The Forgotten Vale,” “Clockwork Pilgrims,” and “Echoes of the First Light,” with a small castle drawing below; the right page shows a tree illustration and the handwritten text “Beery world Hollow.” Across the lower center, add an old illustrated map spread out on the table, showing mountain icons and hand-drawn cartographic details. In the lower right, place exactly 5 more foreground elements: a closed leather journal embossed with a star compass and the phrase “Ideas Become Legends,” a cluster of 4 polyhedral dice, a rustic wooden signpost with 4 directional slats reading “STORY,” “GAME DESIGN,” “WORLD BUILDING,” and “AI FOR CREATORS,” a glowing glass lamp or tube device, and a nearby floating arcane target-like sigil. Add a pinned handwritten note left of center on aged paper reading, “Wish you were here — building worlds, chasing wonder, and turning ideas into adventures. — {argument name="signature name" default="magejosh"}” in blue cursive. Use painterly illustration with high detail, nostalgic Americana postcard design, fantasy concept art sensibility, warm sunset lighting, muted teal sky, sepia aging, and an inviting creative-retreat mood.

items.title: 注意力税信息海报
items.promptZh:
一张粗野主义瑞士现代信息图风格的醒目编辑海报，背景为浅暖灰色，竖版构图，采用分割式布局：超大字体主导左半部分，一张模糊的单色人脸主导右半部分。主标题以巨大紧缩无衬线大写字母堆叠排列，文字内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="SHORT-FORM ATTENTION TAX"}，其中“SHORT-FORM”为黑色，“ATTENTION TAX”为鲜艳红橙色。最左侧边缘放置一个小型竖排年份标记“-2024”。左上角添加极小大写文字“YOUR ATTENTION. THEIR ECONOMY.”，右上角添加极小大写文字“TIME IS LIMITED. ATTENTION ISN’T.”，并在角落附近加入小加号套准标记。在左侧主标题下方，添加副标题“A hidden cost extracted every time you scroll.”

在左下侧向下堆叠创建 3 个编号信息块，每块由一条竖排红橙色条和大型黑色数字标记：第 01 节标题为“WHAT IS IT?”，第 02 节标题为“WHY DOES IT EXIST?”，第 03 节标题为“HOW IT AFFECTS BEHAVIOR”。在第 01 节下加入正文，解释“短内容注意力税”是消费无尽短内容所支付的无形代价，并以秒、分钟和被旨在让你持续滚动平台所榨取的心理能量来衡量。在第 02 节下加入正文，解释平台争夺注意力，因为注意力、数据和利润相互关联，而短内容被优化为即时奖赏、无限滚动且难以停止。在第 03 节下加入恰好 6 个红橙色破折号样式项目符号：“Shortens attention span”“Reduces deep focus”“Increases impulsive behavior”“Disrupts memory & learning”“Drives comparison & anxiety”和“Creates compulsive usage loops”，随后是一句关于重塑你思考、感受和行动方式的简短结论。

在中左部和下中部区域，添加混合尺寸的辅助编辑排版：“Attention is the most valuable currency of the 21st century.”，其中“currency”为红橙色；一个小型数据块写着“THE AVERAGE PERSON SPENDS 90+ MINUTES DAILY ON SHORT-FORM VIDEO APPS.”，其中“90+ MINUTES”为红橙色；一条巨大的堆叠数字陈述写着“16 DAYS”，为黑色，周围文字上方为“THAT’S OVER”，下方为“A YEAR.”；以及一行小型收尾文字“TAX AVOIDANCE STARTS WITH AWARENESS.”。

在右半部分，展示一张黑白人脸特写肖像，部分裁切，正视前方，表情严肃中性。在人脸上施加强烈水平运动模糊、数字涂抹、类似扫描线的条纹和横穿面部的故障条，尤其是在额头、鼻子和嘴部。在面部中右侧附近叠加恰好 5 个竖排社交媒体风格界面图标：一个白色圆形/个人资料点、一个红橙色爱心、一个白色对话气泡、一个白色书签丝带和一个白色分享箭头。添加一个大型半透明红橙色圆形覆盖面部右下部分。加入微妙的 HUD 风格图形元素：右上方附近一个带小红橙色三角楔形的淡淡圆形准星、最右边缘附近一条细竖测量刻度、几个白色方形标记、黑白小横条，以及散布的细小加号作为版式纹理。

底部左侧放置一个条形码，其上方有微小坐标式文字，然后沿宽度间隔放置 3 个页脚标注：“PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION. PROTECT YOUR LIFE.”、“BE MINDFUL. BE INTENTIONAL. BE FREE.”和“RECLAIM FOCUS. RECLAIM TIME. RECLAIM YOU.”。仅使用黑、米白和红橙色的克制调色板。整体观感应像一张高端社会批判海报，混合字体激进主义、数据编辑设计和反乌托邦科技噪点肖像，并具有清晰版式、强烈负空间和印刷海报真实感。
items.prompt:
A bold editorial poster in a brutalist Swiss-modern infographic style on a light warm-gray background, portrait orientation, with a split composition: oversized typography dominating the left half and a blurred monochrome human face dominating the right half. The main headline is stacked in huge condensed sans-serif uppercase text reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHORT-FORM ATTENTION TAX"}, with “SHORT-FORM” in black and “ATTENTION TAX” in vivid red-orange. Along the far left margin place a small vertical year mark reading “-2024”. At the top left add tiny uppercase text “YOUR ATTENTION. THEIR ECONOMY.” and at the top right add tiny uppercase text “TIME IS LIMITED. ATTENTION ISN’T.” with small plus-sign registration marks near the corners. Beneath the headline on the left, add the subheading “A hidden cost extracted every time you scroll.”

Create 3 numbered information blocks stacked down the lower left side, each marked by a vertical red-orange bar and large black numerals: section 01 titled “WHAT IS IT?”, section 02 titled “WHY DOES IT EXIST?”, and section 03 titled “HOW IT AFFECTS BEHAVIOR”. Under section 01, include body text explaining that the Short-Form Attention Tax is the invisible price paid for consuming endless short-form content and that it is measured in seconds, minutes, and mental energy extracted by platforms designed to keep you scrolling. Under section 02, include body text explaining that platforms compete for attention because attention, data, and profit are linked, and that short-form content is optimized to be instantly rewarding, infinitely scrollable, and hard to stop. Under section 03, include exactly 6 bullet points in red-orange dash style: “Shortens attention span”, “Reduces deep focus”, “Increases impulsive behavior”, “Disrupts memory & learning”, “Drives comparison & anxiety”, and “Creates compulsive usage loops”, followed by a short concluding sentence about reshaping how you think, feel, and act.

In the center-left and lower-middle areas, add supporting editorial typography in mixed sizes: “Attention is the most valuable currency of the 21st century.” with the word “currency” in red-orange; a small stat block saying “THE AVERAGE PERSON SPENDS 90+ MINUTES DAILY ON SHORT-FORM VIDEO APPS.” with “90+ MINUTES” in red-orange; a giant stacked numeric statement reading “16 DAYS” in black with the surrounding text “THAT’S OVER” above and “A YEAR.” below; and a small closing line “TAX AVOIDANCE STARTS WITH AWARENESS.”

On the right half, show a close-up portrait of a human face in black and white, partially cropped, looking forward, with a serious neutral expression. Apply heavy horizontal motion blur, digital smear, scanline-like streaks, and glitch bars crossing the face, especially across the forehead, nose, and mouth. Overlay exactly 5 vertical social-media style interface icons near the center-right of the face: a white circle/profile dot, a red-orange heart, a white speech bubble, a white bookmark ribbon, and a white share arrow. Add a large translucent red-orange circle covering the lower-right part of the face. Include subtle HUD-like graphic elements: a faint circular reticle with a small red-orange triangular wedge near the upper right, a thin vertical measurement scale near the far right edge, a few white square markers, small black and white horizontal bars, and scattered tiny plus signs for layout texture.

At the bottom, place a barcode on the left with tiny coordinate-like text above it, then 3 footer callouts spaced across the width: “PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION. PROTECT YOUR LIFE.”, “BE MINDFUL. BE INTENTIONAL. BE FREE.”, and “RECLAIM FOCUS. RECLAIM TIME. RECLAIM YOU.” Use a restrained palette of black, off-white, and red-orange only. The overall look should feel like a high-end social critique poster, mixing typographic activism, data editorial design, and dystopian tech-noise portraiture, with crisp layout, strong negative space, and print-poster realism.

items.promptZh: 灰白色背景的鲜明黑白社论反科技海报，设计得像一本关于数字成瘾的现代野兽派杂志封面。该构图是垂直的，高度印刷，有一个中心超现实图像和多个小文本块。在顶部中心，巨大的粗体压缩无衬线文本在一行上写着“DOOM”，下面是“SCROLLING”，“SCROLLING”一词在整个页面上延伸，部分运动模糊或水平涂抹。左上角有一个小文本块，上面写着“滚动。滑动。没有任何变化。”其上方有一条短水平线。在右上角，小文字写着“24 / 7 / 365”，上面写着“THE FEED NEVER ENDS”，下面有一条水平分隔线。在标题下方的左侧，用小的编辑文字添加定义段落：“花费过多时间在网上滚动浏览负面或令人痛苦的内容的行为，通常会导致焦虑、无助和疲劳的感觉。”在其下方，包括两条短水平分隔线，然后是一个大的统计数据“67%”，后面是较小的文本：“18-24 岁的人们说他们滚动的内容比他们想要的要多。——皮尤研究中心，2023 年”。下面是另一条声明：“更多滚动。更少生活。”下面有一条分隔线。海报的中心是一部光滑的黑色智能手机，垂直放置在底部中心，从正面看，底部扬声器孔和充电端口可见。从电话屏幕中出现的是一条长长的、不可能的楼梯，向上退入一条由重复的半透明垂直面板组成的狭窄隧道，形成了一条幽闭恐怖的走廊。在隧道内，一只巨大的灰度人眼出现在上半部分，部分被雾霾、垂直切片和幻影重复遮挡，就好像被困在饲料中一样。中心图像应该感觉怪异、梦幻、压抑和电影化，具有柔和的雾气、高对比度、复印颗粒、微妙的运动涂抹和分层透明度。沿着中心图像的右侧，添加一个狭窄的垂直编号索引，其中包含 24 个可见条目：001、002、003、004、005、007、008、009、010、011、012、013、014、015、017、018、019、020、 021、022、024、025、026 和省略号，以及下方的细向下箭头。在右栏中，添加一个标题为“旨在让您着迷”的文本块。接下来是 4 句简短的台词：“无限的反馈。不可预测的奖励。无休止的比较。这不是一个小故障，而是商业模式。”在其下方放置一个简单的眼睛/地球图标，然后是一个黑色矩形框，其中包含以下消息：“意识是第一步：放下手机。向上看。收回你的时间。”在左下角，在底部边缘附近放置一个巨大的黑色文字片段，上面写着“END”，旁边还有另一个堆叠的语句：“你滚动得越多，你活得越少。”在左边距附近添加微小的垂直缩微文本，以增加编辑风格。在底部页脚上，放置 4 个图标/文本组：一个地球图标、一个眼睛图标、一个小警告文本块，上面写着“警告：过多的屏幕时间会影响您的心理健康、睡眠和生产力。”、一个展开角图标、一个条形码，以及最右侧的最终声明，上面写着“保持在场。活在现实生活中。”使用极简的瑞士网格对齐、宽大的负空间、锐利的黑色排版、微妙的仿旧印刷纹理和高级时尚海报美学。
items.prompt: A stark black-and-white editorial anti-tech poster on an off-white background, designed like a modern brutalist magazine cover about digital addiction. The composition is vertical and highly typographic, with one central surreal image and multiple blocks of small text. At the top center, huge bold condensed sans-serif text reads DOOM on one line and SCROLLING below it, with the word SCROLLING stretched across the page and partially motion-blurred or smeared horizontally. In the upper left corner, a tiny text block reads “SCROLL. SWIPE. NOTHING CHANGES.” with a short horizontal line above it. In the upper right corner, small text reads “24 / 7 / 365” above “THE FEED NEVER ENDS” with a horizontal divider line below. On the left side under the title, add a definition paragraph in small editorial text: “the act of spending an excessive amount of time scrolling through negative or distressing content online, often leading to feelings of anxiety, helplessness, and fatigue.” Beneath that, include 2 short horizontal divider lines, then a large statistic reading “67%” followed by smaller text: “OF PEOPLE AGED 18–24 SAY THEY SCROLL MORE THAN THEY INTEND TO. — PEW RESEARCH, 2023”. Below that, another statement reads “MORE SCROLLING. LESS LIVING.” with a divider line beneath. The center of the poster features a glossy black smartphone standing vertically at the bottom center, seen front-on, with the bottom speaker holes and charging port visible. Emerging from the phone screen is a long impossible staircase receding upward into a narrow tunnel made of repeated translucent vertical panels, creating a claustrophobic corridor. Within the tunnel, a giant grayscale human eye appears in the upper half, partially obscured by haze, vertical slicing, and ghosted repetitions, as if trapped inside the feed. The central image should feel eerie, dreamlike, oppressive, and cinematic, with soft fog, high contrast, photocopy grain, subtle motion smear, and layered transparency. Along the right side of the central image, add a narrow vertical numbered index with exactly 24 visible entries: 001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 007, 008, 009, 010, 011, 012, 013, 014, 015, 017, 018, 019, 020, 021, 022, 024, 025, 026, and an ellipsis, plus a thin downward arrow underneath. In the right column, add a text block titled “DESIGNED TO KEEP YOU HOOKED.” followed by 4 short lines: “Infinite feeds. Unpredicted rewards. Endless comparison. It’s not a glitch— it’s the business model.” Below that place a simple eye/globe icon, then a black rectangular box containing the message: “AWARENESS IS THE FIRST STEP: PUT THE PHONE DOWN. LOOK UP. RECLAIM YOUR TIME.” On the lower left, place a massive cropped black word fragment reading END near the bottom edge, with another stacked statement beside it: “THE MORE YOU SCROLL, THE LESS YOU LIVE.” Add tiny vertical microtext near the left margin for editorial flavor. Across the bottom footer, place 4 icon/text groups: a globe icon, an eye icon, a small warning text block reading “WARNING: EXCESSIVE SCREEN TIME CAN IMPACT YOUR MENTAL HEALTH, SLEEP, AND PRODUCTIVITY.”, an expand-corners icon, a barcode, and a final statement on the far right reading “STAY PRESENT. LIVE IN REAL LIFE.” Use minimalist Swiss-grid alignment, generous negative space, sharp black typography, subtle distressed print texture, and a high-fashion poster aesthetic.

items.promptZh: 使用提供的参考图像作为品牌风格指南，为 {argument name="brand name" default="Netflix"} 生成一个深色创意生成应用界面，在 2x2 网格中显示 4 个广告牌广告概念。应用参考中准确的品牌调色板和整体视觉标识：深黑色背景、红色口音、白色排版、木炭覆盖层和干净的现代无衬线样式。将参考从静态品牌设置页面转换为图像生成结果屏幕，其中左侧边栏模型选择器包含 2 个模型卡，主画布显示 4 个生成的概念缩略图。每个缩略图都应该是一个电影般的夜间户外广告牌模型，具有戏剧性的灯光、光泽的反射和一个戴着 VR 耳机的人。使用粗体广告牌文案阅读 {argument name="headline text" default="NETFLIX VR"}、{argument name="subheadline text" default="COMING SOON"} 和 {argument name="date text" default="28TH MAY"}。在右侧添加小型 UI 芯片和标签来总结提示，并在 4 个图像中的每一个图像上方添加生成时间徽章。让结果看起来像品牌广告创意的高级创意工具屏幕截图。
items.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the brand style guide, generate a dark creative-generation app interface showing 4 billboard ad concepts in a 2x2 grid for {argument name="brand name" default="Netflix"}. Apply the exact brand palette and overall visual identity from the reference: deep black background, red accent, white typography, charcoal overlays, and clean modern sans-serif styling. items.title: 男士夏季穿搭图鉴
items.promptZh:
使用提供的参考图像作为同一个人和身体基础，将其转变为在朴素温暖的米色工作室背景上干净的男士夏季时尚造型手册。保持主题可识别性，在每种造型中刻意模糊脸部，并生成 8 种全身服装变体，排列在 4×2 编辑网格中。添加手写的造型师注释，并用箭头标记每套服装的关键服装项目。

顶排造型1：奶油色针织Polo衫，海军蓝剪裁短裤，白色皮革运动鞋。 
顶排造型2：鼠尾草绿色亚麻衬衫，白色亚麻短裤，棕色皮凉鞋，衬衫上挂着太阳镜。 
顶排造型三：米白色罗纹背心，棕色百褶长裤，白色帆布运动鞋，单肩奶油色帆布手提包。 
顶排造型四：浅色营领碎花衬衫、浅蓝色牛仔短裤、棕褐色麂皮乐福鞋。 
底排造型5：带有绿色“WELLNESS CLUB”文字的白色图案T恤，深绿色运动短裤，白色跑步运动鞋，白色圆领袜，浅色棒球帽，帆布手提包。 
底排造型 6：海军蓝短袖外套敞开穿，搭配白色背心，米色休闲斜纹棉布裤，深棕色船鞋。 
底排造型7：奶油色纹理针织短袖衬衫、浅色水洗牛仔裤、棕褐色袋鼠、浅色帽子。 
底排造型8：黑色合身T恤、白色亚麻抽绳长裤、黑色凉鞋、黑色斜挎包。

让它看起来像一本精美的时尚造型指南，具有逼真的比例、柔和均匀的灯光、最小的阴影以及每个人旁边优雅的手写注释。

items.title: 董事会议室数据大屏
items.promptZh: 明亮的现代玻璃墙办公室内有宽阔的电影公司董事会场景，办公室配有落地窗，外面隐约可见城市全景天际线。大约 {argument name="number of attendees" default="22"} 不同性别和种族的商业专业人士坐在一个大型 U 形轻木会议桌旁，每个人都穿着正式的商务服装，许多人在打开的笔记本电脑上工作。在房间的前面，一个巨大的壁挂式数字仪表板占据了整个构图，显示了深蓝色和青色的未来金融分析界面，并带有 12 个可见数据面板：1 个左上角的大面板，带有标题文本 {argument name="dashboard header" default="SELECTING THE TRACKING TOOL"} 以及折线图和条形图，1 个顶部中心的小面板，带有抽象的圆形数据纹理，1 个右上角的面板，带有大的数字指标读数92.231 和图表栏、1 个右上角面板，带有折线图和齿轮状界面图标、1 个中左圆形仪表和技术控制条、1 个中左高面板，带有垂直数据条和圆形覆盖层、1 个中心面板，带有三个圆形仪器式读数、1 个中右面板，带有紧凑的技术图表和小型 UI 元素、1 个中右水平面板，带有圆形刻度盘和中央数字指示器、1 个中下部面板，带有发光环形图和波形样式图形，1 个右下宽面板，带有密集的表格仪表板数据，以及 1 个小的底部中心辅助面板。从居中的后视角观看房间，强调对称性和面向屏幕的就座与会者的半圆形，一名站立的演示者的轮廓靠近显示屏。温暖的阳光从左侧进入，在木地板上形成柔和的镜头光晕和长长的阴影，而整体图像风格是抛光的高端编辑插图，倾向于写实的企业概念艺术，采用凉爽的蓝色和温暖的琥珀色调色板，超详细、干净、未来主义、专业和雄心勃勃。
items.prompt: A wide cinematic corporate boardroom scene in a bright modern glass-walled office with floor-to-ceiling windows and a panoramic city skyline faintly visible outside. Around {argument name="number of attendees" default="22"} business professionals of mixed genders and ethnicities sit in a large U-shaped arrangement of light wood conference tables, each person dressed in formal business attire and many working on open laptops. At the front of the room, a huge wall-mounted digital dashboard dominates the composition, showing a futuristic financial analytics interface in dark blue and cyan with exactly 12 visible data panels: 1 large top-left panel with the headline text {argument name="dashboard headline" default="SELECTING THE TRACKING TOOL"} and line and bar charts, 1 small top-center panel with abstract circular data textures, 1 top-center-right panel with a large numeric metric reading 92.231 and chart bars, 1 top-right panel with line graphs and gear-like interface icons, 1 mid-left strip of circular gauges and technical controls, 1 center-left tall panel with vertical data bars and circular overlays, 1 center panel with three round instrument-style readouts, 1 center-right panel with compact technical diagrams and tiny UI elements, 1 mid-right horizontal panel with circular dials and a central numeric indicator, 1 lower-center panel with glowing ring charts and waveform-style graphics, 1 lower-right wide panel with dense tabular dashboard data, and 1 small bottom-center auxiliary panel. The room is viewed from a centered rear perspective, emphasizing symmetry and the semicircle of seated attendees facing the screen, with one standing presenter silhouetted near the display. Warm sunlight enters from the left, creating soft lens flare and long shadows across the wooden floor, while the overall image style is a polished high-end editorial illustration leaning toward photorealistic corporate concept art, in a cool blue and warm amber color palette, ultra-detailed, clean, futuristic, professional, and ambitious.

items.promptZh: 从房间后角观看高级商务会议期间的广角逼真公司董事会场景。大约 {argument name="number of attendees" default="18"} 身着商务装的专业人士围坐在一张大型 U 形轻木会议桌旁，大多数人面前都放着打开的笔记本电脑、笔记本电脑、咖啡杯、水杯和智能手机。该团体包括不同种族的男性和女性，所有人都专注于温暖的木镶板墙上巨大的壁挂式数字演示屏幕。屏幕显示一个深蓝色的分析仪表板，其中包含多个图表和数据面板，包括条形图、折线图、KPI 图块、世界地图、百分比圆圈和趋势视觉效果，建议财务、运营或执行报告。一位演示者坐在靠近中右侧面向屏幕的位置，而团队的其他成员则在正式的战略会议中聚精会神地观看。办公室是一间现代化的行政会议室，整个左侧都有落地窗，白天可以看到高层建筑朦胧的城市天际线。包括带有镀铬框架的时尚黑色皮革办公椅、抛光木地板、嵌入式线性天花板灯以及靠近显示墙的高大绿色盆栽植物。自然光充满房间，与干净的建筑内部照明相平衡。强调真实感、专业氛围、锐利的细节、微妙的反射、可信的肤色和优质的企业室内设计。以电影建筑摄影风格拍摄，超详细、高分辨率、宽构图。
items.prompt: A wide-angle photorealistic corporate boardroom scene during a high-level business meeting, viewed from the back corner of the room. Around {argument name="number of attendees" default="18"} professionals in business attire sit around a large U-shaped light wood conference table, most with open laptops, notebooks, coffee cups, glasses of water, and smartphones in front of them. The group includes men and women of varied ethnicities, all focused toward a huge wall-mounted digital presentation screen on a warm wood-paneled wall. The screen shows a dark blue analytics dashboard with multiple charts and data panels, including bar charts, line graphs, KPI tiles, a world map, percentage circles, and trend visuals, suggesting finance, operations, or executive reporting. A presenter sits near the center-right side facing the screen, while the rest of the team watches attentively in a formal strategy session. The office is a modern executive meeting room with floor-to-ceiling windows along the entire left side, revealing a hazy urban skyline of high-rise buildings in daylight. Include sleek black leather office chairs with chrome frames, a polished wood floor, recessed linear ceiling lights, and a tall green potted plant near the display wall. Natural daylight fills the room, balanced with clean architectural interior lighting. Emphasize realism, professional atmosphere, sharp detail, subtle reflections, believable skin tones, and premium corporate interior design. Shot in a cinematic architectural photography style, ultra-detailed, high resolution, wide composition.

items.title: 日系校服少女插画
items.promptZh: 一个简单可爱的平面矢量图，描绘了一个开朗的日本女学生，以纯浅灰色背景为中心，从大腿中部向上以正面姿势显示。她有一头长直发，刘海斜斜，皮肤白皙，脸蛋圆润，双颊泛着粉色腮红，一只眼睛睁着，另一只眼睛眨着，鼻子很小，嘴巴张着微笑。她穿着经典的日本高中制服，深海军蓝西装外套，白色衬衫领，脖子上有大红色丝带蝴蝶结，灰色百褶裙，有 2 个可见的金色西装纽扣。双臂水平伸直，向观看者的两侧延伸，双手做出和平手势，手指向下倾斜。使用大胆干净的黑色轮廓、柔和柔和的平面色彩、最小的阴影、卡哇伊贴纸风格的比例、对称的构图和友好俏皮的表情。
items.prompt: A simple cute flat vector illustration of a cheerful Japanese schoolgirl centered on a plain light gray background, shown from about mid-thigh up in a front-facing pose. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair with side-swept bangs, fair skin, a rounded face, pink blush on both cheeks, one eye open and the other eye winking, a small nose, and an open smiling mouth. She is wearing a classic Japanese high school uniform with a dark navy blazer, white shirt collar, large red ribbon bow at the neck, and a gray pleated skirt, with 2 visible gold blazer buttons. Both arms are stretched straight out horizontally to the sides toward the viewer, and both hands are making peace signs with the fingers angled downward. Use bold clean black outlines, soft pastel-like flat colors, minimal shading, kawaii sticker-style proportions, symmetrical composition, and a friendly playful expression.

items.promptZh:
微型爪足浴缸中的{argument name="subject" default="Chicken"}的经典沐浴肖像

一只动漫风格的小鸡，它的翅膀上有一个微小的{argument name="weapon" default="katana"}，正在跳跃，划破飘流的樱花花瓣。背景是盛开的樱花的模糊柔和的森林。小鸡身上戴着一条{argument name="clothing" default="mint-green ninja围巾"}，在身后飘扬，灯光闪烁着柔和的粉色和金色。

The background is a blurred pastel forest of blooming cherry blossoms. items.title: 巧克力历史立体书
items.promptZh: 在干净的白色背景上创建一本打开的古董历史书的方形 1:1 微距摄影图像，其样式就像一本可食用的历史弹出书。这本书很厚，复古，皮革装订，180 度平放。它的页面是老化的羊皮纸，纸张泛黄，边缘磨损，纸张纹理清晰可见。在左页上，展示了丰富但略显凌乱的可可收获物，部分覆盖了印刷文字：正好 5 个深红橙色和棕色色调的完整或分裂的可可豆荚，1 个装满可可粒的木碗，一大片松散的可可豆，破碎的可可壳，小堆可可粒，以及夹在配料中的几片光滑的绿叶。一切都应该感觉有机、丰富、有触觉。在右侧页面上，创建一个完全由巧克力和糖果材料制成的各种瑞士巧克力的大型 3D 弹出式雕塑：正好 8 个可见的黑巧克力、牛奶巧克力和白巧克力混合的巧克力条或条块，排列成花束状的直立结构，后面有 5 个大叶形可可或巧克力叶，底部卷曲的淡巧克力刨花，散落的可可面包屑，以及带有复古标签的包装纸基，上面写着“CHOCOLAT” SUISSE”和较小的文字“Maison de Qualité”。在它旁边，放置了一位 1:35 比例的维多利亚时代巧克力绅士，围着围裙，积极地用双手展示和调整巧克力展示。在右侧页面上以粗体黑色衬线文本打印：“Vevey，1875”。下面是一段关于可可和瑞士巧克力文化的简短褪色草书传说段落。该段落应为：“从可可豆荚简陋的外壳中，诞生了一种优雅的甜点。在瑞士巧克力屋中，可可被提炼成一种珍贵的美味佳肴，在沙龙和家庭中共享，因其舒适、庆祝和甜蜜发明工艺而受到珍视。”灯光柔和、温暖，博物馆灯光集中在打开的书的中心。情绪具有教育意义、异想天开且结构丰富。强调真实感、浅景深、微型世界美学、优质的编辑风格和极高的材质纹理保真度。
items.prompt: Create a square 1:1 macro photography image of an open antique history book on a clean white background, styled like an edible history pop-up book. The book is thick, vintage, leather-bound, and lying open flat at 180 degrees. Its pages are aged parchment with yellowed paper, worn edges, and visible paper texture. On the left page, show an abundant, slightly messy cocoa harvest spread partially covering the printed text: exactly 5 whole or split cacao pods in deep red-orange and brown tones, 1 wooden bowl filled with cacao nibs, a large scatter of loose cacao beans, broken cacao shells, small piles of nibs, and several glossy green leaves tucked among the ingredients. Everything should feel organic, overflowing, and tactile. On the right page, create a large 3D pop-up sculpture of assorted Swiss chocolate built entirely from chocolate and confectionery materials: exactly 8 visible chocolate bars or bar segments in mixed dark, milk, and white chocolate, arranged in a bouquet-like upright structure with 5 large leaf-shaped cacao or chocolate leaves behind them, curled pale chocolate shavings at the base, scattered cacao crumbs, and a wrapped paper base with a vintage label reading “CHOCOLAT SUISSE” and smaller text “Maison de Qualité”. Beside it, place a tiny 1:35 scale Victorian-era chocolatier gentleman in an apron, actively presenting and adjusting the chocolate display with both hands. Print on the right page in bold black serif text: “Vevey, 1875”. Below that, include a short faded cursive lore paragraph about cacao and Swiss chocolate culture. The paragraph should read: “From the cacao pod’s humble shell emerges a confection of elegance. In Swiss chocolate houses, cacao is refined into a treasured delicacy, shared in salons and homes alike, prized for comfort, celebration, and the craft of sweet invention.” Lighting is soft, warm museum lighting focused at the center of the open book. Mood is educational, whimsical, and richly textural. Emphasize photorealism, shallow depth of field, miniature world aesthetic, premium editorial styling, and extremely high material texture fidelity.

items.title: 末世废墟黄昏景象
items.promptZh: 黄昏时的喜怒无常的后世界末日电影景观，以深棕褐色和琥珀色调色板绘制，展示了充满浓密发光云的动荡天空下的工业或城市结构废墟。在左侧前景中，一根巨大的对角倒塌金属梁或起重机臂从左下角向左上侧升起，上面覆盖着撕裂的织物或碎片和缠结的电缆。一根长电缆沿对角线向下穿过框架向中心延伸。在朦胧的中景，中心稍偏右的地方，矗立着一座受损的圆顶塔或天文台般的建筑，部分被灰尘、烟雾和漂浮的碎片遮盖。地面上布满了锯齿状的瓦砾、破碎的建筑和轮廓分明的残骸。使用来自地平线附近的云朵的戏剧性背光、柔和的体积雾霾、大气透视、绘画纹理和毁灭世界的史诗色调。构图应该给人一种垂直、庄严、荒凉、电影般的感觉，看不到任何人。
items.prompt: A moody post-apocalyptic cinematic landscape at dusk, painted in a dark sepia and amber palette, showing the ruins of an industrial or urban structure beneath a turbulent sky filled with dense, glowing clouds. In the left foreground, a large diagonal collapsed metal beam or crane arm rises from the bottom left toward the upper left, draped with torn fabric or shredded sheeting and tangled cables. A single long cable stretches diagonally downward across the frame toward the center. In the hazy midground, slightly right of center, stands a damaged domed tower or observatory-like building, partially obscured by dust, smoke, and drifting debris. The ground is filled with jagged rubble, broken structures, and silhouetted wreckage. Use dramatic backlighting from the cloud breaks near the horizon, soft volumetric haze, atmospheric perspective, painterly textures, and a ruined-world epic tone. The composition should feel vertical, solemn, desolate, and cinematic, with no people visible.
items.author: 炎鎮🔥 - ₿onochin -

items.title: 末世城市废墟夜景
items.promptZh: 夜晚，一条黑暗的、世界末日般的城市街道，从地面向上望去，透过两边都是废墟高楼的狭窄峡谷。该建筑遭到严重损坏，部分倒塌，锯齿状的轮廓、破碎的外墙和黑色的哥特式工业细节逐渐消失在阴影中。浓密的烟柱和暴风云充满了天空的中心，在地平线附近的冷淡光芒的背光下，形成了一个引人注目的高对比度焦点。整体调色板几乎是单色的深海军蓝、木炭色、黑色和柔和的钢蓝色，散布着微小的橙色余烬状斑点在整个场景的空气中飘荡。气氛是凄凉的、不祥的、电影般的，就像灾后的荒地或被轰炸的城市废墟。绘画般的数字概念艺术，柔和的大气雾霾，厚重的纹理，微妙的胶片颗粒感，没有人，没有车辆，没有可读的标志，宽阔的构图，毁坏结构的高细节，建筑物的强烈垂直框架，以及占据上半部分的不祥的烟雾天空。
items.prompt: A dark, apocalyptic city street at night, viewed from ground level looking upward through a narrow canyon of ruined tall buildings on both sides. The architecture is heavily damaged and partially collapsed, with jagged silhouettes, broken facades, and blackened gothic-industrial details fading into shadow. A dense column of smoke and stormy cloud fills the center of the sky, backlit by a cold pale glow near the horizon, creating a dramatic high-contrast focal point. The overall palette is nearly monochrome deep navy, charcoal, black, and muted steel blue, with scattered tiny orange ember-like specks drifting through the air across the whole scene. The mood is bleak, ominous, and cinematic, like a post-disaster wasteland or bombed urban ruin. Painterly digital concept art, soft atmospheric haze, heavy texture, subtle film-grain feel, no people, no vehicles, no readable signs, wide composition, high detail in the ruined structures, strong vertical framing from the buildings, and a foreboding smoky sky dominating the upper half.
items.author: 炎鎮🔥 - ₿onochin -

items.title: 汉密尔顿传奇海报
items.promptZh: 为{argument name="athlete name" default="Lewis Hamilton"}创建一个引人注目的垂直海报风格的体育致敬，设计类似于电影传统蒙太奇，具有黑暗、高对比度、金黑颜色等级、砂砾烟雾、火花、体育场烟雾和庆祝灯光。在顶部放置一个巨大的金属仿旧标题，上面写着 {argument name="headline text" default="LEWIS HAMILTON"}，其下方有一个粗体的金色副标题，上面写着“BEYOND SPEED. BEYOND LIMITS”。下面有一条较小的白线，上面写着“A LEGEND IN MOTION”。构图以这位身穿现代黑色赛车服的运动员的大型特写英雄肖像为中心，从胸部向上展示，略微面向侧面，表情强烈，皮肤纹理细致，头发编成辫子，边缘灯光引人注目，整个套装上可见赞助商风格的标志。使用 8 个支撑元素围绕中央肖像构建拼贴画：左上角是童年卡丁车场景，标记为“1995”，标题为“梦想开始”；下面是一个单座青少年方程式赛车场景，标有“2003”，标题为“F1 IS CALLING”；下面是胜利庆祝场景，标有“2008”，标题为“一颗明星诞生”，第二行为“FIRST WIN CANADIAN GP”；左下角，一幅赛车肖像，标有“2013”​​，标题为“WORLD CHAMPION”，第二行为“A NEW ERA”；中心躯干文本块标记为“2014 – 2020”，标题为“DOMINANCE”和三个统计行“7 WORLD TITLES”、“6 CONSTRUCTORS’ TITLES”和“82 RACE WINS”；底部中央，一辆正面黑色一级方程式赛车，编号为 44，从阴影中显现出来；右上方，一个胜利的全身人物在五彩纸屑中高举奖杯；中右，垂直成就栏标题为“成就”，正好有 5 个桂冠统计数据，分别为“7× F1 世界冠军”、“103 场比赛获胜”、“104 杆位置”、“197 次登上领奖台”和“7 次英国大奖赛获胜”，后面是最后的文字标注“SIR”和“KNIGHTED FOR SERVICES TO”行赛车运动”；右下角是这位运动员的现代肖像，手放在胸前，旁边写着“2021 年及以后”标题和堆叠文字“仍在推动。仍在鼓舞人心。仍在获胜。”在底部边缘添加 2 辆额外的汽车：一辆红色一级方程式赛车在左下角以运动模糊对角线疾驰，一辆较小的黑色一级方程式赛车在右下角。在底部附近放置一个白色斜体大写居中的引号：{argument name="quote" default="I DON’T RACE TO BE SECOND. I RACE TO BE ONE OF A KIND."}，后面是金色手写签名式脚本，内容为 {argument name="signature name" default="Lewis Hamilton"}。最后以白色大写字母间隔的页脚口号结尾：“才华、纪律、激情、目的。”其下方还有最后一行：“刘易斯·汉密尔顿——不仅仅是一名车手。一场运动。”使用分层的深度、清晰的版式、优质的杂志海报布局、微妙的英国国旗口音、逼真的汽车、照片般真实的面孔以及鼓舞人心的冠军纪录片美学。
items.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical poster-style sports tribute for {argument name="athlete name" default="Lewis Hamilton"}, designed like a cinematic legacy montage with a dark, high-contrast, gold-and-black color grade, gritty smoke, sparks, stadium haze, and celebratory lighting. At the top, place a huge metallic distressed headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LEWIS HAMILTON"}, with a bold gold subheadline beneath it reading “BEYOND SPEED. BEYOND LIMITS.” and a smaller white line below saying “A LEGEND IN MOTION.” The composition centers on a large, close-up hero portrait of the athlete in a modern black racing suit, shown from the chest up, facing slightly to the side with intense expression, detailed skin texture, braided hair, dramatic rim lighting, and visible sponsor-style logos across the suit. Build a collage around the central portrait using exactly 8 supporting elements: on the upper left, a childhood go-kart scene labeled “1995” with the caption “THE DREAM BEGINS”; below it, a single-seater junior formula car scene labeled “2003” with the caption “F1 IS CALLING”; below that, a victory celebration scene labeled “2008” with the caption “A STAR IS BORN” and a second line “FIRST WIN CANADIAN GP”; lower left, a racing portrait labeled “2013” with the caption “WORLD CHAMPION” and a second line “A NEW ERA”; center torso text block labeled “2014 – 2020” with the title “DOMINANCE” and three stat lines “7 WORLD TITLES”, “6 CONSTRUCTORS’ TITLES”, and “82 RACE WINS”; bottom center, a front-facing black Formula 1 car with number 44 emerging from shadows; upper right, a triumphant full-body figure raising a trophy overhead amid confetti; mid-right, a vertical achievements column titled “ACHIEVEMENTS” with exactly 5 laurel-wreathed stats reading “7× F1 WORLD CHAMPION”, “103 RACE WINS”, “104 POLE POSITIONS”, “197 PODIUM FINISHES”, and “7 BRITISH GP WINS”, followed by a final text callout “SIR” and the line “KNIGHTED FOR SERVICES TO MOTORSPORT”; lower right, a modern portrait of the athlete with hand over chest beside the caption “2021 & BEYOND” and the stacked text “STILL PUSHING. STILL INSPIRING. STILL WINNING.” Add 2 additional cars at the bottom edge: a red Formula 1 car on the lower left streaking diagonally with motion blur, and a smaller black Formula 1 car on the lower right. Place a centered quote near the bottom in white italic caps: {argument name="quote" default="I DON’T RACE TO BE SECOND. I RACE TO BE ONE OF A KIND."}, followed by a gold handwritten signature-style script reading {argument name="signature name" default="Lewis Hamilton"}. Finish with a footer slogan in spaced-out white capitals: “TALENT. DISCIPLINE. PASSION. PURPOSE.” and a final line beneath it: “LEWIS HAMILTON – MORE THAN A DRIVER. A MOVEMENT.” Use layered depth, sharp typography, premium magazine-poster layout, subtle British flag accents, realistic cars, photoreal faces, and an inspirational champion-documentary aesthetic.

items.title: 山野花海蕾丝时尚写真
items.titleZh: 山野花海蕾丝时尚写真
items.promptZh: 一张柔和的社论风格户外时尚照片，照片中一位女士在白天站在山上的野花草地上，从后面拍摄，她的身体稍微转向一侧四分之三，头向后仰向镜头。她有一头齐肩到中背的凌乱的{argument name="hair color" default="dark silver"}头发，被风吹得有点凌乱。她的脸被温暖的米棕色色调的扁平矩形模糊块完全遮挡。她穿着精致、透明的白色蕾丝套装，由两件可见的部分组成：长袖半透明花卉蕾丝上衣，带荷叶边袖口和高腰白色蕾丝下装。这个姿势放松而性感，一只手臂垂下，另一只手臂放在臀部附近。她周围是茂密的天然草和盛开的野花，包括前景和中景可见的白色雏菊和黄色小花。将她放置在连绵起伏的绿色和金色山丘前面，背景是戏剧性的白垩白色悬崖面和侵蚀线。使用开阔的风景、部分多云的蓝天、温暖的自然阳光、泥土色调、浅景深、电影构图、写实摄影、高细节、柔和的对比度和梦幻般的波西米亚乡村氛围。
items.prompt: A soft, editorial-style outdoor fashion photograph of a woman standing in a wildflower meadow in the mountains during daylight, shown from behind with her body turned slightly three-quarters to the side and her head angled back toward the camera. To the right of center, a glamorous woman with a short black bob and earrings leans over the desk in a fitted red floral cheongsam-style dress, looking toward the papers and laptops. On the far right, a fifth woman with messy light-brown hair in a loose bun wears an oversized open shirt over a cropped white T-shirt with the OpenAI knot logo and casual pants, leaning over the table with one hand braced on the surface and the other near a drawing tablet. The room should contain 2 laptops visible on the desk, 1 central monitor, 3 mugs, 2 sticky notes, 1 paper sign, 1 notebook page titled "Plans", and many scattered creative objects like pens, cables, books, papers, and cans. The first laptop is covered with stickers including a large X logo; the second laptop has an OpenAI logo. The desk includes a black mug with a moon-and-text design, a white mug that says "Good answer takes time.", a white cup with an orange sunburst logo, an energy-drink can, a clear plastic drink cup, a closed notebook, loose handwritten notes, and a tablet on the far right. One sticky note says "You got this" with a heart, and another says "One step at a time" with a tiny flower. The notebook page on the desk reads "Plans" and lists 3 items: "1. World peace", "2. More coffee", "3. Nap", with a small cat doodle. Add a huge hand-lettered Japanese title in layered pink, white, and purple lettering with glow and sticker-like outlines reading: 「冷凍したブルーベリー使ってパウンドケーキ焼いたら中身溢れて失敗した件。」 Below it, add a smaller subtitle line: 「〜甘くて、ちょっぴり切ない青春のレシピ〜」. On the right side, place 1 vertical white quote box with Japanese text: 「うまくいかない日だって、人生のスパイスになるんだ。」 In the lower left, add 1 pinned pink note card that says “Sweet but clumsy.” and 1 torn recipe memo sheet with handwritten Japanese checklist items. Add a small speech bubble near the cake that says “Oops!”. Include a circular stamp-style seal near the lower right that reads “Blueberry disaster”. At the bottom, add film-credit style text in white, including “A FILM BY YUMEIRO PASTEL”, and a large release line in pink and white: “{argument name="release date" default="2024.6.30(SUN)"} ROADSHOW”. Under that, add the Japanese tagline: 「失敗は、最高の思い出になる。だから、また挑戦しよう。」 Frame the whole poster with lace, stickers, scraps of paper, and scrapbook-style decorations. Make it ultra-detailed, glossy, sentimental, kawaii, cinematic, and intentionally over-the-top like a fake coming-of-age movie poster about a baking failure.
