items.title: 国米蓝黑哈兰德海报
items.promptZh: {argument name="player name" default="Erling Haaland"} 加入{argument name="club name" default="Inter Milan"} 的引人注目的垂直足球转会公告海报，采用深色、高对比度的黑色和电蓝色色调设计，具有坚韧的电影运动图形风格。该构图以同一球员的两幅分层肖像为特色：上中左上方有一个超大的特写半身像，侧面翻转并向上看，显示光滑的金发扎成一个短发髻，两侧剃光；中下部有一张半身动作肖像，身穿俱乐部蓝黑条纹主场球衣，向上举起一根食指，做出胜利的手势。使用肌肉发达的运动体型、强烈的英雄气概、边缘照明、深阴影、纹理皮肤细节和光泽的头发亮点。球衣胸前应有白色赞助商字标、白色小旋风标志、圆形俱乐部徽章和三色盾牌贴片。在球员身后，放置一个巨大的发光圆形国米风格徽章图形作为背景。总共添加 3 个可见的俱乐部徽标：右上角有 1 个小徽标，左下角有 1 个大型织物旗帜徽标，球衣上有 1 个徽章。底部中心是现代足球场的夜景，明亮的泛光灯与绘画般的蓝色烟雾和笔触效果融为一体。在中间，用巨大的粗糙手绘字体写下球员的姓氏，部分被数字遮盖，在右侧加上一个大的手写数字 9。在设计周围添加 8 个文字元素：顶部中心小文字“INTER MILAN”；左上角堆叠的名称文本，包含玩家姓名和蓝色“9”；中左口号“NATO PER SEGNARE”；右侧竖排文字“I M INTER”；中右口号“FORZA INTER PER SEMPRE”；右下城市文字“SAN SIRO”；右下方小文字“MILANO ITALIA”；底部中心小文字“1908”和“LA BENEAMATA”。还要在左上角肖像附近添加 1 个白色签名涂鸦。背景应该是黑色垃圾纹理、蓝色墨水飞溅、划痕、烟雾和放射光的分层拼贴，具有优质的社交媒体体育海报效果，超详细、锐利、充满活力，适合足球模因或粉丝转会展示的海报。
items.prompt: A dramatic vertical football transfer announcement poster for {argument name="player name" default="Erling Haaland"} joining {argument name="club name" default="Inter Milan"}, designed in a dark, high-contrast black and electric-blue palette with a gritty cinematic sports-graphic style. The composition features 2 layered portraits of the same player: one oversized close-up bust in the upper center-left, turned in profile and looking upward, showing slick blond hair tied into a short bun with shaved sides; and 1 mid-body action portrait in the lower center, wearing the club’s blue-and-black striped home jersey and raising one index finger upward in a victory gesture. Use a muscular athletic build, intense heroic presence, rim lighting, deep shadows, textured skin detail, and glossy hair highlights. The jersey should include a white sponsor wordmark across the chest, a small white swoosh-style logo, the round club crest, and a tricolor shield patch. Behind the player, place a huge glowing circular Inter-style emblem graphic as a backdrop. Add 3 visible club logos total: 1 small logo at the top right, 1 large fabric flag logo at the bottom left, and 1 crest on the shirt. At the bottom center, include a night view of a modern football stadium with bright floodlights, blending into painterly blue smoke and brush-stroke effects. Across the center, place the player surname in huge rough hand-painted lettering, partially obscured by the figure, plus a large handwritten-style number 9 on the right. Add 8 text elements around the design: top center small text “INTER MILAN”; upper left stacked name text with the player name and a blue “9”; left-middle slogan “NATO PER SEGNARE”; right side vertical text “I M INTER”; right-middle slogan “FORZA INTER PER SEMPRE”; lower right city text “SAN SIRO”; lower right small text “MILANO ITALIA”; bottom center small text “1908” and “LA BENEAMATA”. Also add 1 white signature scribble near the upper-left portrait. The background should be a layered collage of black grunge textures, blue ink splashes, scratches, smoke, and radial light, with a premium social-media sports poster finish, hyper-detailed, sharp, energetic, and poster-ready for a football meme or fan transfer reveal.

items.title: 高级品鉴菜单俯拍图
items.prompt: A photorealistic top-down product-style photograph of a single luxury tasting menu printed on bright white textured paper and placed on a dark walnut wooden tabletop, with soft warm ambient lighting and gentle natural shadows. The sheet is portrait orientation, slightly rotated clockwise, occupying most of the frame with clean margins around it. The design is an ultra-minimal fine-dining menu with elegant editorial typography, lots of negative space, precise alignment, and a refined black-and-dark-gray ink palette. At the upper left, the restaurant identity appears in 3 stacked lines: a large serif word {argument name="restaurant name" default="Silence"}, below it 2 Chinese characters "沈默", and below that a large serif French line "Le Silence". Under the title is a small location line reading "Ginza, Tokyo B3F". At the upper right is a small date line in French followed by Japanese date text: {argument name="date text" default="22 Avril 2026 • 令和八年四月二十二日"}. The main body is organized into 3 vertical content zones: a left numbered course list, a middle translated course list, and a far-right icon column. The left list contains exactly 9 numbered courses labeled 1 through 9, each with French title and Japanese subtitle and an English ingredient line beneath; the 9 visible course titles are: "Huître de Bretagne, eau de mer", "Daurade de Kyoto, pétale de sakura", "Oursin d’Hokkaidō, consommé d’algue", "Asperge de Nemuro, sauce mousseline", "Homard de Miyako, bisque légère", "Canard de Challans, figue et balsamique", "Boeuf de Kagoshima, truffe noire", "Fromage de chèvre, miel du Japon", and "Agrume, thé vert et gin". The middle list repeats the 9 dishes in a second compact column with French titles and Japanese descriptions. The far-right column contains exactly 9 horizontal icon rows aligned to the courses, each row showing small monochrome hand-drawn ingredient or allergen pictograms; some rows have 2 icons and some 3, for a total of 19 icons overall. Near the lower left is a section titled "Le mot du chef" followed by a short French paragraph in small serif text. Below that is a section titled "Origine des ingrédients / 食材の産地" with a dense 2-row ingredient-origin grid listing exactly 15 numbered origin entries in tiny text. In the lower right quadrant, include a small label "Chef" above a large sweeping handwritten signature reading {argument name="chef name" default="Keiichiro Aoyama"}. Along the very bottom edge is a thin horizontal rule and a centered allergen legend line with exactly 7 small outline icons and labels: shellfish, crustaceans, egg, fish, milk, gluten, sulfites, each labeled in French with Japanese beneath. The overall impression should be high-end Michelin-style menu design, editorial restraint, immaculate spacing, subtle paper grain, sharply legible text hierarchy, and realistic photography rather than a flat scan.

items.title: 未来奥迪概念跑车
items.promptZh: 一款基于{argument name="carbrand" default="Audi"}的未来派概念轿跑车，以面向右侧的低后四分之三侧视图显示，隔离在一个巨大的黑色工作室中，地板是深色哑光的，几乎没有背景细节。该车拥有时尚的白色车身、长溜背式车顶线、遮光车窗、超低车身姿态、宽大的车身比例以及光滑简约的表面。侧面在车门和后侧面板上有 1 个大型浅灰色旋风图案，类似于运动贴花。后部部分透明或被切开，以暴露高性能动力传动系统：1 个可见的电池组安装在驾驶室后面的低处，1 个暴露的金属电机或变速箱组件，以及 3 个厚厚的银色排气或进气管，弯曲穿过后部机械舱。尾部包括一条横跨整个宽度的连续细 LED 灯条，奥迪环在中心发光，下方发光的“tron”字样。车轮为深黑色多辐高性能轮圈，配有低断面轮胎；两个可见轮胎都有发光的白色侧壁刻字，带有风格化的日语字符和赛车文字。在侧裙和前轮拱附近添加微妙的发光品牌。灯光具有电影感和喜怒无常的效果，有冷酷的蓝色边缘光、光泽的反射、柔和的光晕，以及照明元素周围微弱的赛博朋克光环。超详细的汽车渲染、高级概念车设计可视化、逼真的材料、戏剧性的对比度、干净的构图、没有人。
items.prompt: A futuristic concept coupe based on an {argument name="car brand" default="Audi"}, shown in a low rear three-quarter side view facing right, isolated in a vast black studio with a dark matte floor and almost no background detail. The car has a sleek white body with a long fastback roofline, blacked-out windows, an ultra-low stance, wide body proportions, and smooth minimalist surfacing. The side features 1 large pale gray swoosh graphic across the door and rear quarter panel, resembling a sporty decal. The rear is partially transparent or cut away to expose the performance drivetrain: 1 visible battery pack mounted low behind the cabin, 1 exposed metallic motor or transmission assembly, and 3 thick silver exhaust or intake pipes curving through the rear mechanical bay. The tail includes a continuous thin LED light bar spanning the width, the Audi rings glowing at center, and the word “tron” illuminated beneath. The wheels are deep black multi-spoke performance rims with low-profile tires; both visible tires have glowing white sidewall lettering, with stylized Japanese characters and racing text. Add subtle illuminated branding near the side skirt and front wheel arch. Lighting is cinematic and moody with cool blue rim light, glossy reflections, soft bloom, and a faint cyberpunk halo around the illuminated elements. Hyper-detailed automotive render, premium concept-car design visualization, photorealistic materials, dramatic contrast, clean composition, no people.
items.author: Allar Haltsonen

items.title: 白色电动跑车雨夜漂移
items.titleZh: 白色电动跑车雨夜漂移
items.promptZh: 一张电影般的夜间汽车动作照片，展示了一辆未来派白色电动运动轿车，其灵感来自奥迪 e-tron GT，是在它在潮湿的城市街道上猛烈漂流时拍摄的快速侧向镜头。该车的左侧轮廓简洁，车头指向右侧，姿态低沉而咄咄逼人，黑色车顶、深色车窗、黑色车轮以及发红光的连续细 LED 尾灯条。后车身经过彻底修改并部分拆除，露出后轮区域后面的金属涡轮式管道和机械部件。浓浓的白色轮胎烟雾从车后部滚滚而出，充满了整个车架左侧。路面因雨水而变得光滑，反射着蓝色、白色和琥珀色的城市灯光。背景非常暗，远处的建筑物和路灯发出柔和的散景，加上微弱的垂直杆和障碍物，所有这些都经过严重的运动模糊以强调速度。使用黑色、钢蓝色、冷白色和暖橙色高光的喜怒无常的城市调色板、逼真的摄影、高细节、低角度跟踪透视、长镜头平移拍摄、戏剧性的反射、浅景深和强烈的赛车能量。
items.prompt: A cinematic night automotive action photo of a futuristic white electric sports sedan inspired by an Audi e-tron GT, captured in a fast side-tracking shot while it drifts hard across a wet city street. The car is shown in clean left-side profile with the front pointing to the right, low and aggressive stance, black roof, dark tinted windows, black wheels, and a continuous thin LED rear light bar glowing red. The rear bodywork is radically modified and partially removed, exposing metallic turbo-like piping and mechanical components behind the rear wheel area. Thick white tire smoke billows from the back of the car and fills the entire left side of the frame. The pavement is glossy from rain and reflects blue, white, and amber city lights. The background is very dark with soft bokeh from distant buildings and streetlights, plus faint vertical poles and barriers, all heavily motion-blurred to emphasize speed. Use a moody urban color palette of black, steel blue, cool white, and warm orange highlights, realistic photography, high detail, low-angle tracking perspective, long-lens panning shot, dramatic reflections, shallow depth of field, and intense motorsport energy.

items.title: 霓虹夜奥迪超跑追拍
items.promptZh: 电影般的后四分之三跟踪镜头，展示了一辆未来派白色奥迪超级跑车在夜间潮湿的街道上穿过密集霓虹灯城市的场景，从靠近后轮的非常低的角度观看。该车拥有时尚的宽体轿跑车轮廓、光泽的珍珠白色车身面板、黑色后饰板以及连续细长的 LED 尾灯带，分段式红白灯元件延伸至尾部。发光的奥迪四环标志在后部中央以白色点亮，其下方有一个风格化的发光车型徽章，上面用未来派字体写着“tron”。后部车身被部分拆除或透明打开，露出裸露的高性能机械部件：1个大型矩形金属电池或动力装置安装在后部低处，3个可见的厚排气或冷却管横跨后部，1个可见的变速箱或电机组件靠近中右，以及一个带有2个大翅片的深黑色后扩散器。该车配备超大深盘黑色车轮和超宽后轮胎，轮胎侧壁周围饰有明亮的白色日式字母。在背景和沿路面使用强烈的运动模糊来暗示高速，并重点关注车身和裸露的机械。场景周围环绕着抽象的城市散景、条纹霓虹灯标牌、红色、蓝色和白色城市灯光在潮湿的人行道和光滑车身上的反射。高对比度、赛博朋克氛围、逼真的汽车摄影、戏剧性的夜间灯光、超细致的金属纹理、电影镜头、动态构图、速度、力量、未来工程。
items.prompt: A cinematic rear three-quarter tracking shot of a futuristic white Audi supercar racing through a dense neon-lit city at night on a wet street, viewed from a very low angle close to the rear wheel. The car has a sleek widebody coupe silhouette, glossy pearl white body panels, a black rear fascia, and a continuous thin LED taillight strip with segmented red and white light elements stretching across the tail. The glowing Audi four-ring logo is illuminated in white at the center rear, with a stylized glowing model badge beneath it that reads "tron" in a futuristic font. The rear bodywork is partially removed or transparently open to reveal exposed high-performance mechanical components: 1 large rectangular metallic battery or power unit mounted low at the back, 3 visible thick exhaust or cooling pipes spanning across the rear, 1 visible gearbox or motor assembly near the center-right, and a deep black rear diffuser with 2 large fins. The car rides on oversized deep-dish black wheels with ultra-wide rear tires, and the tire sidewalls feature bright white Japanese-style lettering around the circumference. Use strong motion blur in the background and along the road surface to imply high speed, with sharp focus on the car body and exposed machinery. Surround the scene with abstract urban bokeh, streaking neon signage, reflections of red, blue, and white city lights across the wet pavement and glossy bodywork. High contrast, cyberpunk atmosphere, realistic automotive photography, dramatic nighttime lighting, ultra-detailed metal textures, cinematic lens, dynamic composition, speed, power, futuristic engineering.

items.title: 电动奥迪都市夜驰
items.promptZh: 电影般的夜间汽车动作镜头，展示了一辆未来派电动跑车在现代市中心中赛车的场景，从低后四分之三跟踪角度观看。该车是一款时尚的{argument name="carbrand" default="Audi"}概念车，拥有光滑的{argument name="body color" default="white"}车身、黑色车顶线、深色车窗、极宽的后轮胎、发光的后灯条以及位于背面中心的发光的{argument name="rear徽章文字" default="tron"}品牌标识。后下部部分透明或开放，展示先进的电动传动系统和电池硬件，具有金属细节和冷蓝色照明。在车门和后侧板上添加流动的浅灰色和蓝色侧面图形，打造概念车外观。车辆在潮湿的多车道城市快速路上快速行驶，沥青、车道标线和周围建筑物出现强烈的运动模糊。背景布满了夜晚高大的玻璃办公楼、数百盏明亮的窗户灯、屋顶上分散的红色飞机警示灯，以及远处闪烁的红绿灯。包括沿最左侧边缘的障碍物或墙壁的反射，以强调速度和相机运动。灯光凉爽、高对比度、喜怒无常，具有蓝白色高光、道路上的光泽反射和高级科幻奢华美感。超细致、逼真、长时间曝光的感觉、动态跟踪拍摄、清晰地聚焦在汽车上，而城市环境因速度而变得模糊。
items.prompt: A cinematic nighttime automotive action shot of a futuristic electric sports coupe racing through a modern downtown city, viewed from a low rear three-quarter tracking angle. The car is a sleek {argument name="car brand" default="Audi"} concept vehicle with a glossy {argument name="body color" default="white"} body, black roofline, dark tinted windows, extremely wide rear tires, illuminated rear light bar, and glowing {argument name="rear badge text" default="tron"} branding centered on the back. The rear lower section is partially transparent or open, revealing advanced electric drivetrain and battery hardware with metallic detail and cool blue illumination. Add flowing pale gray and blue side graphics on the doors and rear quarter panels for a concept-car look. The vehicle is driving fast on a wet multi-lane urban expressway, with strong motion blur in the asphalt, lane markings, and surrounding buildings. The background is filled with tall glass office towers at night, hundreds of bright window lights, scattered red aircraft warning lights on rooftops, and streaking traffic lights in the distance. Include reflections along a barrier or wall on the far left edge to emphasize speed and camera motion. Lighting is cool, high-contrast, and moody, with blue-white highlights, glossy reflections on the road, and a premium sci-fi luxury aesthetic. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, long-exposure feel, dynamic tracking shot, sharp focus on the car while the city environment blurs from speed.

items.title: 高露洁传统现代双联海报
items.titleZh: 高露洁传统现代双联海报
items.promptZh: {argument name="brand name" default="Colgate Sensation White"} 的豪华广告海报，被一面狭窄的华丽镜子垂直分成镜面的两半，中心发出明亮的蓝色光芒。左侧，一位四分之三侧面像的非洲老妇人抱臂而立，身穿图案丰富的靛蓝和金色传统蜡印连衣裙，搭配配套的包裹头巾，层叠的金珠项链、耳坠、叠放的手镯，一手直立一根传统的咀嚼棒。右侧，一位年轻的非洲女性穿着相配的靛蓝和金色连衣裙，佩戴黄金珠宝，模仿了这个姿势，一只手直立着一支现代的白色和蓝色牙刷。两个人物都优雅、端庄，从腰部以上拍摄，背景是温暖质感的棕色工作室背景，具有电影般的金色灯光、高对比度、抛光的肤色和优质的美容广告美学。在左上角添加 1 个红色圆形高露洁徽标。在中下部区域覆盖奶油色的大型精致衬线字体：左侧文本 {argument name="left slogan" default="Depuis toujours."} 和右侧文本 {argument name="right slogan" default="Pour toujours."}，在镜子分隔线上的两个短语之间居中放置一个发光的蓝色牙齿图标。在底部附近添加一个较小的居中衬线标语，颜色为奶油色：{argument name="tagline text" default="Le meilleur de la Tradition, la Force de la science"}。将 1 个高露洁 Sensation 白色牙膏盒放在右下角，稍微向相机倾斜，有光泽且逼真。整体构图应传达祖先传统与现代牙科科学的融合、优质的非洲时尚肖像、对称平衡、编辑活动设计以及精致的国际化妆品广告。
items.prompt: Luxury advertising poster for {argument name="brand name" default="Colgate Sensation White"}, split vertically into two mirrored halves by a narrow ornate mirror with a bright blue glow at the center. On the left side, an elderly African woman in three-quarter profile stands with arms folded, wearing a richly patterned indigo-and-gold traditional wax-print dress, a matching wrapped headscarf, layered gold bead necklaces, drop earrings, stacked bracelets, and holding 1 traditional chewing stick upright in one hand. On the right side, a younger African woman in matching indigo-and-gold dress and gold jewelry mirrors the pose and holds 1 modern white-and-blue toothbrush upright in one hand. Both figures are elegant, dignified, and photographed from the waist up against a warm textured brown studio backdrop with cinematic golden lighting, high contrast, polished skin tones, and premium beauty-ad aesthetics. Add 1 red circular Colgate logo in the top left corner. Overlay large refined serif typography in cream across the middle-lower area: left text {argument name="left slogan" default="Depuis toujours."} and right text {argument name="right slogan" default="Pour toujours."}, with a glowing blue tooth icon centered between the two phrases on the mirror divide. Add a smaller centered serif tagline near the bottom in cream: {argument name="tagline text" default="Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science"}. Place 1 Colgate Sensation White toothpaste box in the bottom right corner, angled slightly toward camera, glossy and realistic. The overall composition should communicate the fusion of ancestral tradition and modern dental science, premium African fashion portraiture, symmetrical balance, editorial campaign design, and a sophisticated international cosmetics advertisement.

items.title: 高露洁传统现代广告
items.promptZh: 为高露洁 Sensation White 制作一个抛光的方形广告图像，垂直分成相等的两半，中间有一条发光的分隔线，展示传统与现代科学之间的并排对比。在左半部分，一位年长的非洲妇女坐在浅色大理石桌面后面，室内环境温暖朴实，背景是雕刻的木墙板和陶罐。她穿着一件图案丰富的传统铁锈橙色和金色裹身裙，戴着分层的珠项链和手镯，留着自然的灰色短发。她把一根天然的咀嚼棒放在嘴边，摆出平静而庄严的姿势。在她头顶上用温暖的金黄色大字弯曲法文标题文字：“Depuis toujours”。在右半部分，将一名年轻的非洲儿童坐在同一个桌面后面，桌面采用时尚现代的蓝色内饰，配有柔和的灯光和垂直的金色装饰。孩子穿着生动的传统现代服装：铜棕色束腰外衣，前面有亮蓝色图案，镶有金色饰边，头发编成整齐的辫子，嘴边拿着一把高露洁牙刷。将法语标题文字以大而亮的蓝色字母弯曲在孩子上方：“Pour toujours”。在底部中心，跨越两半并放置在大理石桌子上的显着位置，恰好展示了 2 个高露洁 Sensation White 牙膏盒，它们稍微偏移地堆叠在一起，顶部放置着一支配套的牙刷。包装必须高度清晰和逼真，具有红色高露洁标志和蓝白色的 Sensation White 品牌。在底部边缘居中添加醒目的白色法式标语：“Le meilleur de la Tradition, la Force de la science”。使用电影级商业照明、优质产品摄影真实感、丰富的肤色、平衡的对称性以及传统与创新相遇的视觉故事。
items.prompt: Create a polished square advertising image for Colgate Sensation White, split vertically into two equal halves with a glowing divider line in the center, showing a side-by-side contrast between tradition and modern science. On the left half, place an elderly African woman seated behind a pale marble tabletop in a warm, earthy interior with carved wooden wall panels and a clay pot in the background. She wears a richly patterned traditional rust-orange and gold wrap dress with layered bead necklaces and bracelets, and has short gray natural hair. She holds a natural chewing stick near her mouth in a calm, dignified pose. Curve the French headline text above her head in large warm golden-yellow letters: "Depuis toujours." On the right half, place a young African child seated behind the same tabletop in a sleek modern blue interior with soft glowing lights and vertical gold accents. The child wears a vivid traditional-modern outfit: a copper-brown tunic with bright blue patterned front panel and gold trim, with neat braided hair, and holds a Colgate toothbrush near the mouth. Curve the French headline text above the child in large bright blue letters: "Pour toujours." At the bottom center, spanning both halves and placed prominently on the marble table, show exactly 2 Colgate Sensation White toothpaste boxes stacked slightly offset, with one matching toothbrush resting on top. The packaging must be highly legible and realistic, featuring the red Colgate logo and blue-white Sensation White branding. Add a bold white French tagline centered along the bottom edge: "Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science". Use cinematic commercial lighting, premium product-photography realism, rich skin tones, balanced symmetry, and a visual story of heritage meeting innovation.

items.title: 夏威夷独行少女拼贴
items.prompt:
A 12-frame collage of candid, emotional snapshots of a {argument name="subject" default="young Japanese woman"} traveling alone in {argument name="location" default="Hawaii"}, casually captured on a smartphone.
Each frame feels like a fleeting personal memory — imperfect, sun-drenched, intimate, and unposed.

The woman has a naturally curvy figure with a soft, feminine silhouette, subtly emphasizing her bust without exaggeration. Her presence feels real and unstyled, like a private photo album.

Scenes include: walking barefoot on the beach, ძლიერი日差しの中での海辺、palm trees swaying, overexposed ocean reflections, small local cafés, a modest motel room, sunset الساحل, night markets, views from inside a moving car.

Shot with a smartphone aesthetic: slight motion blur, soft focus, blown-out highlights from tropical sunlight, lens flare, sun glare, high ISO noise at night, uneven framing, accidental cropping.

Composition feels random and spontaneous — subject sometimes off-center, partially cut off, mid-motion, or obscured by light leaks.

Lighting varies: harsh midday sun, warm golden hour glow, deep sunset tones, humid night street lighting.

Color grading: faded cinematic tones, slightly desaturated with warm highlights, nostalgic film-like look, subtle grain, lifted blacks.

Emotion: solitude, fleeting youth, bittersweet nostalgia, quiet introspection, like memories from a trip taken alone.

Layout: 12 images arranged in a loose, imperfect collage grid, slightly tilted and misaligned like a scrapbook.

No text, no watermark.

items.title: 黑白西装男子坐像
items.promptZh: 在上传的图片中为{argument name="subject" default="handsome man"}创建一张 4:5 高对比度、黑白影棚肖像。他以一种颓然、沉思的姿势坐在一张{argument name="furniture" default="minimalist dark wood chair"}上。他的右肘放在膝盖上，头重重地靠在手掌上，左手松松地握着一个带有黑色塑料盖的白色一次性咖啡杯。他戴着经典的黑色 Wayfarer 风格太阳镜，遮住了眼睛，增添了坚忍、喜怒无常的氛围。 西装：超大、挺括的黑色西装外套和配套的阔腿裤。面料是厚重的哑光羊毛。袖口上可见四个黑色小纽扣。鞋类：清爽、明亮的白色罗纹棉袜在深色裤子和鞋子之间形成鲜明的视觉效果。鞋子：高度抛光的黑色皮革牛津鞋，配有细鞋带，鞋头略带光泽。背景：简约、无菌的工作室环境，带有{argument name="background" default="浅灰色或灰白色纹理石膏墙"}。最左边可以看到柔和的垂直阴影或窗帘边缘。灯光：柔和、漫射的侧光在男士脸上营造出柔和的渐变效果，并在超大西装上营造出深邃、戏剧性的褶皱。灯光强调高对比度的“白底黑字”美感。地板：明亮、无缝的工作室地板，可以捕捉到椅子腿和男人鞋子投下的柔和阴影。颜色等级：纯单色（黑色和白色），具有宽动态范围 - 深黑色和明亮、干净的白色。胶片质量：以非常微妙的胶片颗粒清晰地聚焦于主题，模仿专业的编辑时尚摄影（让人想起 20 世纪 90 年代的极简主义广告）。
items.prompt: Create a 4:5 high-contrast, black-and-white studio portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="handsome man"} in the uploaded image. He is seated in a slumped, pensive posture on a {argument name="furniture" default="minimalist dark wooden chair"}. His right elbow rests on his knee, with his head leaning heavily into his palm, while his left hand loosely grips a white disposable coffee cup with a black plastic lid. He is wearing classic black Wayfarer-style sunglasses, hiding his eyes and adding to the stoic, moody atmosphere.Suit: An oversized, structured black blazer and matching wide-leg trousers. The fabric is a heavy, matte wool. Four small black buttons are visible on the sleeve cuff. Footwear: Crisp, bright white ribbed cotton socks creating a sharp visual break between the dark trousers and shoes. Shoes: Highly polished black leather Oxford shoes with thin laces and a slight sheen on the toe box. Background: A minimalist, sterile studio setting with a {argument name="background" default="light grey or off-white textured plaster wall"}. A soft, vertical shadow or curtain edge is visible on the far left. Lighting: Soft, diffused side-lighting that creates gentle gradients on the man's face and deep, dramatic folds in the oversized suit. The lighting emphasizes the high-contrast "black on white" aesthetic. Floor: A light, seamless studio floor that catches the soft shadows cast by the chair legs and the man's shoes. Color Grade: Pure monochrome (black and white) with a wide dynamic range—deep blacks and bright, clean whites. Film Quality: Sharp focus on the subject with a very subtle film grain, mimicking professional editorial fashion photography (reminiscent of 1990s minimalist campaigns).

items.title: 冰美式面包手绘标注
items.prompt: 请观察照片中的元素，并为每个元素添加有意义的手绘注释。【画面里的东西】{argument name="画面内容" default="冰美式、面包、窗边、阳光"}【画法要求】・用白色细线，像手绘笔一样・一笔画风格，线条随意一点，不要太工整・沿着物体边缘轻轻描一圈轮廓・适当加箭头 / 虚线，引导视线【文字风格】・中文手写感，偏口语一点・句子要短，像随手写的・语气像日常碎碎念 / 小情绪【小装饰】・可以加一点点：热气、小星星、爱心、简单表情

items.title: 品牌包装系统陈列图
items.prompt:
请为品牌【{argument name="品牌名称" default="品牌名称"}】、类目为【{argument name="品牌类目" default="品牌类目"}】创作一张高审美、高完成度的「品牌包装系统展示图」。这不是普通电商白底图，也不是单一产品图，而是一张具有品牌提案感、视觉识别系统感和商业摄影质感的包装家族陈列效果图。画面需要体现“同一品牌在多个包装载体上的统一落地”，呈现一个成熟消费品牌的完整包装系统。

【画幅要求】整体必须为固定 4:5 的竖版海报构图，画面方向明确为纵向，禁止生成横版构图、宽幅桌面陈列或过于分散的横向展示。整体构图需符合海报阅读逻辑：上方保留呼吸感，中部为品牌包装系统的主要视觉焦点，下方安排辅助包装、标签和产品本体，整体重心集中，适合直接作为品牌展示海报发布。

【核心要求】根据【类目】自动匹配最合理、最自然的包装组合与产品形态，并围绕【品牌名字】建立统一的品牌视觉系统。画面中应选择少量但有代表性的包装形式，组成一组完整而精炼的品牌包装系统，不追求堆砌数量，而强调主次层级、品牌统一性与陈列美感。可根据类目合理选择以下包装类型中的一部分：手提袋 / 购物袋、纸盒 / 礼盒 / 外包装盒、长条盒 / 单品盒 / 套装盒、包装袋 / 封套 / 小样袋 / 软袋、杯子 / 瓶子 / 罐子 / 管状容器 / 喷雾瓶 / 泵头瓶、标签 / 贴纸 / 封签 / 吊牌 / 小卡片，以及与类目对应的真实产品本体。

【类目适配逻辑】包装形式与产品形态需要根据【类目】自动匹配，但不局限于单一方向。可参考以下适配逻辑自由发散：若类目为食品 / 烘焙 / 零食 / 饮品，则以纸袋、纸盒、包装袋、杯子、食品容器、贴纸、封签及真实产品本体为主；若类目为茶饮 / 咖啡 / 饮料，则以杯子、瓶子、罐装包装、提袋、杯套、封口贴、礼盒等为主；若类目为美妆 / 护肤 / 彩妆 / 香水，则以瓶、罐、管、盒、礼盒、手提袋、小样包装等为主；若类目为香氛 / 家居 / 生活方式，则以香薰瓶、蜡烛杯、包装盒、礼盒、提袋、吊卡、标签卡等为主；若类目为服饰 / 饰品 / 潮玩 / 文创，则以包装盒、抽屉盒、防尘袋、手提袋、贴纸、吊牌、配件包装等为主；若类目为数码配件 / 工具 / 小型消费品，则以硬盒、外包装盒、收纳袋、说明卡、贴纸、封套、标签等为主。整体必须体现“类目合理、品牌统一、包装成体系”的效果。

【数量与密度控制】请控制画面中的物件数量，不要过多堆砌，也不要把所有可能包装形式全部展示出来。整体应呈现“少而精、完整但不拥挤”的品牌包装系统效果。建议选择最具代表性的包装载体进行展示：大件包装 1～2 个，中型包装 2～3 个，小型包装或辅助物件 2～4 个，真实产品本体 1～3 个，总可见元素建议控制在 6～10 个之间。包装种类应体现层次变化与系统感，但不宜重复过多同类物件。画面需要有足够留白与呼吸感，确保每个包装都清晰可见、主次明确、摆放舒展，宁可少而精，也不要为了“完整”而过度塞满。

【品牌视觉系统要求】所有包装必须属于同一个品牌系统，统一使用【品牌名字】作为核心品牌识别元素。整体应具备一致的 logo / 标志呈现、字体风格、图形语言、插画语言或纹样系统、排版逻辑、配色体系、材质与印刷质感。品牌调性、色彩方向、图案元素、辅助图形和视觉氛围，请根据【类目】自动匹配并合理发散，不局限于任何固定风格。整体风格应统一、协调、具有品牌识别度，可以是简约高级、自然有机、时尚现代、轻奢精致、年轻清新、艺术感、潮流个性或经典优雅，但必须符合【类目】特征，并呈现成熟品牌的设计完成度。

【配色机制要求】整体配色不要固化为某一种固定组合，也不要连续多次出现高度相似的主色系统。每次生成时应根据【类目】与品牌气质，主动形成不同的主色方案与配色关系，采用“受控发散”的方式进行色彩演绎。色彩可以是低饱和自然色、现代中性色、轻复古色、明快清新色、轻奢深色系或艺术感综合色系，但必须保持高级、统一、克制、有品牌感。允许每次生成时呈现不同的视觉气质，例如奶油白与焦糖棕、雾灰蓝与暖白、橄榄绿与亚麻米、酒红与奶霜白、可可棕与象牙白、炭灰与麦秆金、雾粉灰与米白、海军蓝与暖灰等，仅作为参考方向而非固定模板。不要荧光色，不要廉价高饱和，不要杂乱失控的多色拼贴。

【画面构图与陈列要求】画面采用品牌包装家族陈列逻辑，而不是杂乱堆放。整体为商业摄影棚场景，使用 3/4 轻俯视角或略带透视的正面陈列角度，形成有层次、有秩序、有主次的包装展示画面。构图参考以下逻辑：后景摆放 1～2 个较大的包装作为视觉支撑，如手提袋、大礼盒、大外盒；中景安排品牌核心包装或主力单品包装，作为主要视觉焦点；前景摆放较小包装、辅助包装、标签、贴纸及真实产品本体；至少有一个真实产品与包装产生自然互动，如产品半露出、摆放在包装前方、与包装组合展示；整体形成平衡而有设计感的三角式或错落式构图。画面干净、有留白、不拥挤，内容丰富但克制，以有限而精准的包装组合体现完整的品牌包装生态。

【视觉风格要求】整体呈现高端商业摄影质感与品牌提案感，背景为干净的摄影棚环境，可为白色、暖白色、浅灰色，或根据品牌调性自动匹配的极简背景。画面应强调真实的包装材质表现、清晰的纸张折痕、盒型结构、瓶罐轮廓、标签细节、印刷质感、压纹 / 烫金 / 哑光 / 棉纸纹理 / 牛皮纸纹理等材质细节，以及统一而高级的配色搭配、精致现代干净的品牌视觉语言和强烈的“这是一整套品牌包装系统”的完整感。

【光影要求】采用真实商业摄影级光影，可为柔和棚拍光，也可带有轻微方向性的自然侧光。需要有清晰但克制的阴影，以增强立体感、空间感与高级感。整体光线通透、明亮、干净，不要阴暗，不要廉价感，不要杂乱背景。

【最终效果要求】最终画面应像一个成熟品牌的包装系统展示海报、包装家族提案图或品牌视觉落地效果图，而不是零散商品拼图。重点突出：固定 4:5 竖版海报感、品牌统一性、包装家族完整性、商业摄影感、设计提案感、类目适配性，以及高级审美与视觉完成度。

items.title: 映像公司四服务海报
items.prompt: Create a clean, premium Japanese corporate poster for a {argument name="company name" default="Arks"} video production company, in a minimalist editorial layout on an off-white background with lots of negative space. Portrait orientation, A4-like poster proportions. At the very top left, place an oversized bold black sans-serif logotype reading {argument name="company name" default="Arks"}, spanning nearly the full width of the page. In the upper right, add a small stacked brand mark in thin uppercase letters: "VIDEO" on one line, "PRODUCTION" on the next, "COMPANY" on the third, with a small burnt-orange geometric accent nearby. Below the logo, add a vertical burnt-orange bar on the left and a large elegant Japanese headline in black Mincho-style serif: {argument name="headline text" default="4つの領域で、映像を磨く。"}. Directly underneath, add a smaller service line in Japanese with slash separators: "SNS運用 / ショートドラマ / MV制作 / AI映像". The main body is a 2 by 2 grid of exactly 4 service panels with thin light-gray divider lines. Each panel has a large black editorial number and a Japanese label. Panel 1 label: "SNS運用" with the number "01"; image shows a close-up hand holding a smartphone displaying social media analytics, on a desk with charts, a calendar sheet, a pen, and a coffee mug, in warm natural office lighting; caption below in Japanese: "企画・分析・運用を一つの流れで。" Panel 2 label: "ショートドラマ" with the number "02"; image shows exactly 2 Japanese high-school-age students in white shirts standing outdoors on a rooftop or balcony, one female and one male, side-profile composition, muted overcast daylight, cinematic shallow depth of field; caption below: "共感が残る、短編の物語設計。" Panel 3 label: "MV制作" with the number "03"; image shows a moody musician playing electric guitar in a dim studio, backlit by soft haze, with a camera monitor in the foreground showing the same performer; caption below: "アーティストの世界観を、映像で可視化。" Panel 4 label: "AI映像" with the number "04"; image shows a dark professional AI video-generation or image-editing software interface on a monitor, with a cinematic scene of a lone figure standing on rocks under dramatic clouds, plus thumbnail timeline images and side control panels; caption below: "技術を表現へ変える、次世代の映像制作。" At the bottom left, place a small three-line English slogan in uppercase: {argument name="tagline text" default="CREATE.\nCONNECT.\nLEAVE A MARK."} with a small burnt-orange line accent above it. At the bottom right, place the website {argument name="website" default="arks-vp.com"} in small serif text with a short black horizontal line beside it. Use a refined mix of bold modern sans-serif for the large logo and numbers, and elegant Japanese serif for headlines and labels. Color palette: black, charcoal, warm off-white, light gray rules, and restrained burnt-orange accents. The overall feel should be realistic, polished, contemporary, Japanese editorial advertising design, with accurate Japanese typography and natural image tones.

items.title: 餐厅美食手绘涂鸦照
items.prompt: A moody, dark restaurant table photo styled like a trendy handwritten doodle edit, shot from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. The scene shows a wooden table with 4 main food-and-drink items: in the center-left, a large white pasta bowl with black rim text reading "OLIO E PIU," filled with creamy spaghetti or truffle pasta and topped with a glossy raw egg yolk, with a spoon resting inside the bowl and soft steam rising; at the lower right, a large white dinner plate cropped by the frame, holding roasted vegetables and a piece of browned meat with light green seasoning dust; at the lower left, a stemmed glass of white wine, partly cropped; at the upper right, a goblet-style glass of dark sparkling drink. The background is very dim and warm, almost black, making the food and glassware stand out under low ambient light. Add white hand-drawn overlay doodles and Japanese handwritten notes directly on top of the photo: one large curved headline at the upper left that says "おいしい時間、しあわせだな〜♡" with a sweeping underline and 2 small hearts; one note above the pasta that says "しっとり、たまごとろり" with a dotted arrow pointing to the egg yolk; one note near the upper-right drink that says "さっぱり、リフレッシュ！" with a dotted arrow pointing to the glass; one note at the lower left near the wine glass that says "sparkling. ちょっとした ごほうび。♡" with a curved dotted arrow; and one note near the lower center-right that says "あまくて、やわらかい :) ♡" with a dotted arrow pointing to the plated food. Include exactly 10 doodle embellishments besides the text: 2 steam squiggles above the pasta, 2 small sparkle stars near the wine glass, 2 small sparkle marks near the lower plate, 2 tiny droplet marks beside the upper-right drink, and 2 hearts near the headline. Use thin white chalk-like lines, casual imperfect handwriting, and a cozy editorial social-media aesthetic, keeping the composition realistic and photographic while the doodles look playful and hand-sketched.

items.promptZh: 在阳光明媚的日子，在室外网球场从超广角、低场边视角拍摄的超现实体育广告海报。在最远的前景中，一名男子网球运动员戏剧性地冲向镜头，同时将一个大的哑光钴蓝色绝缘水瓶推向观众，使瓶子成为画面中的主要物体。瓶子上覆盖着可见的冷凝水滴，并配有拉丝金属金色瓶盖，底部附近印有白色徽标文字{argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"}。运动员穿着干净的白色运动 T 恤、亮蓝色网球短裤、白色腕带、白色袜子和白色网球鞋。他的另一只手臂向后伸展，拿着一个黑色网球拍，在图像右侧的球拍附近可以看到一个明亮的黄绿色网球。这个姿势应该给人一种充满活力和运动感的感觉，一条腿深深弯曲，另一条腿在蓝色硬地球场上呈弓步伸展。使用强烈的正午阳光、清晰的阴影、生动饱和的蓝色和清澈无云的天空，远处的背景中有绿色的树木和深色的栅栏线。将其设计为优质水袋品牌广告活动，重点关注瓶子和运动员、戏剧性的透视、商业润色和充满活力的动作。在下半部分的球场表面上添加干净的白色广告排版：一条较小的行显示为{argument name="headline intro" default="Play Hard"}，一条非常大的粗行显示为{argument name="headline main" default="Hydrate Smart"}，还有一个较小的副标题显示为{argument name="tagline" default="Hydration that keep up with every move."}。再次将白色的 {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} 徽标放在右上角，并在右下角放置一个白色的小网站网址，内容为 {argument name="website" default="www.aqua.com"}。
items.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic sports advertising poster shot from an extreme wide-angle, low courtside perspective on a bright sunny day at an outdoor tennis court. In the extreme foreground, a male tennis player lunges dramatically toward the camera while thrusting a large matte cobalt-blue insulated water bottle toward the viewer, making the bottle the dominant object in the frame. The bottle is covered with visible condensation droplets and has a brushed metallic gold cap, with the white logo text {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} printed near the bottom. The athlete wears a clean white athletic t-shirt, bright blue tennis shorts, white wristbands, white socks, and white tennis shoes. His other arm stretches back holding a black tennis racket, with 1 bright yellow-green tennis ball visible near the racket on the right side of the image. The pose should feel dynamic and athletic, with one leg bent deeply and the other extended in a wide lunge across the blue hard court. Use strong midday sunlight, crisp shadows, vivid saturated blues, and a clear cloudless sky, with green trees and a dark fence line in the distant background. Compose it like a premium hydration brand campaign, with sharp focus on the bottle and athlete, dramatic foreshortening, commercial polish, and energetic motion. Add clean white ad typography integrated onto the court surface in the lower half: a smaller line reading {argument name="headline intro" default="Play Hard"}, a very large bold line reading {argument name="headline main" default="Hydrate Smart"}, and a smaller subheading reading {argument name="tagline" default="Hydration that keeps up with every move."}. Place the {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} logo again in white at the top right, and a small website URL in white at the bottom right reading {argument name="website" default="www.aqua.com"}.

items.title: 湿婆舞王神话绘画
items.promptZh: 这是一幅巨大的神话奇幻画作，画中湿婆神在炽热的神圣竞技场中央表演坦达瓦舞，全身充满活力的舞蹈姿势，一条腿抬起，另一只脚踩在他身下倒下的人身上。湿婆拥有灰蓝色的皮肤，肌肉发达的体格，长长的狂野飘逸的黑发向四面八方爆炸，高高的髻发髻，白色的新月塞在头发里。他的表情强烈而神圣。一条眼镜蛇盘绕在他的脖子上，他戴着多条金刚菩提珠项链、手镯和臂环、大圆形耳环和神圣的装饰品。他的衣服是虎皮缠腰布，橙色的布腰带在空中飘扬。一只举起的手拿着一个小达玛鲁鼓，一只前手举起祝福手势，手掌上可见嗡符号，另一只手在张开的手掌上方召唤出明亮的火焰。他的头后面有一个巨大的发光圆形光环，上面反复刻有梵文咒文，创造出光芒四射的曼陀罗效果。场景是一个世界末日般的喜马拉雅寺庙景观，左右两侧有乌云、烟雾、余烬、岩石山脉、瀑布以及古老的石头神龛和寺庙塔。场景左侧竖立着一根用红布包裹的三叉戟。湿婆周围有一圈恰好由 10 名崇拜者和苦行者组成的圆圈，分成两侧，虔诚地唱诵、跪下、举起双臂、举起火把、敲鼓。湿婆下面正好有一个倒在石头地上的黑皮肤男性雕像。地面龟裂并融化，一圈炽热的熔岩和火焰环绕着舞台。使用戏剧性的电影灯光、深木炭阴影下的橙色火光、高度详细的解剖结构、复杂的珠宝和纹理、旋转的头发和织物运动、虔诚的史诗幻想现实主义、绘画笔触、对称的中心构图、超详细、高对比度、垂直海报格式。
items.prompt: A monumental mythological fantasy painting of Lord Shiva performing the Tandava in the center of a fiery sacred arena, full-body, dynamic dancing pose with one leg raised and the other foot pressing down on a fallen figure beneath him. Shiva has ash-blue skin, a powerfully muscular physique, long wild flowing dark hair exploding outward in all directions, a high matted topknot, and a white crescent moon tucked into the hair. His expression is intense and divine. A cobra is coiled around his neck, and he wears multiple rudraksha bead necklaces, bracelets, and armlets, large circular earrings, and sacred ornaments. His clothing is a tiger-skin loincloth with dramatic red-orange cloth sashes whipping through the air. One raised hand holds a small damaru drum, one front hand is lifted in a blessing gesture with the Om symbol visible on the palm, and another hand conjures a bright flame above the open palm. Behind his head is a large glowing circular halo inscribed repeatedly with Sanskrit mantra text, creating a radiant mandala effect. The setting is an apocalyptic Himalayan temple landscape with dark storm clouds, smoke, embers, rocky mountains, waterfalls, and ancient stone shrines and temple towers on both the left and right sides. A trident wrapped with red cloth stands upright on the left side of the scene. Around Shiva is a circle of exactly 10 worshippers and ascetics, split across both sides, shown chanting, kneeling, raising arms, carrying torches, and playing drums in devotion. Beneath Shiva is exactly 1 fallen dark-skinned male figure lying on the stone ground. The ground is cracked and molten, with a blazing ring of lava and fire encircling the dance platform. Use dramatic cinematic lighting, glowing orange firelight against deep charcoal shadows, highly detailed anatomy, intricate jewelry and textures, swirling hair and fabric motion, devotional epic fantasy realism, painterly brushwork, symmetrical central composition, ultra-detailed, high contrast, vertical poster format.

items.promptZh: 高度详细的历史海上场景，展示了两艘大型木制帆船在明亮的蓝天和柔软的分散云彩下停泊在平静的反光水面上。在左边，一艘巨大华丽的欧洲大帆船占据了构图的主导地位，从左后船尾部分看去，有华丽雕刻的巴洛克式船尾装饰，有金色、红色、蓝色和奶油色、纹章标志、多个船尾窗户，以及带有暖红棕色木板的深色船体。它有 4 根可见的桅杆，包括船首斜桅、密集的黑色索具、鸦巢和许多部分展开并松散悬挂的乳白色方帆。右侧，一艘传统的中国帆船面朝左，有一面非常大的锈棕色板条帆，棕色、黑色和白色的弯曲木质船体，雕刻着船尾细节，还有较小的桅杆和索具。在前景中心，包括一艘小木划艇和一名穿着轻便衣服、戴着檐帽的站立船夫，增加了两艘船之间的比例。在远处的背景中，在最左边的地平线附近显示出额外帆船的微弱轮廓。灯光是明亮的日光，木材上有温暖的亮点，波纹水中的微妙反射，以及绘画般但逼真的完成，超详细的纹理，电影构图，宽高比，没有现代元素。
items.prompt: A highly detailed historical maritime scene at water level, showing two large wooden sailing ships anchored close together on calm reflective water under a bright blue sky with soft scattered clouds. On the left, a massive ornate European galleon dominates the composition, viewed from the rear-left stern quarter, with richly carved baroque stern decorations in gold, red, blue, and cream, heraldic emblems, multiple stern windows, and a dark hull with warm reddish-brown planking. It has 4 visible masts including a bowsprit, dense black rigging, crow's nests, and many cream-white square sails partially unfurled and hanging loosely. On the right, a traditional Chinese junk faces slightly left, with 1 very large rust-brown battened sail raised, a curved wooden hull in brown, black, and white, carved stern details, and smaller masts and rigging. In the foreground center, include 1 small wooden rowboat with 1 standing boatman wearing light clothing and a brimmed hat, adding scale between the two ships. In the distant background, show faint silhouettes of additional sailing vessels near the horizon on the far left. Lighting is crisp daylight with warm highlights on the wood, subtle reflections in the rippling water, and a painterly yet photorealistic finish, ultra-detailed textures, cinematic composition, wide aspect ratio, no modern elements.

items.prompt: A poetic, cinematic macro illustration of the cover of {argument name="book title" default="Wind, Sand and Stars"} by {argument name="author name" default="Antoine de Saint-Exupéry"}, rendered as a surreal desert world emerging directly from the textured paper page. A large human hand holds a glossy black and gold fountain pen near the top right, the engraved gold nib touching the paper and releasing a dark stream of ink that becomes a winding path across a miniature Sahara landscape. On the upper left, the printed title text appears in elegant serif typography, with the author name below it and a short italic quote in smaller script beneath. The page transforms into a detailed map-like desert tableau with exactly 16 tiny human figures scattered across the scene: 1 lone standing figure balanced beside the pen nib, 3 figures near a small campfire, 2 central robed men in conversation, 3 figures gathered beside the biplane, 1 solitary figure walking near the lower middle, 2 riders on camels at the lower left, 3 standing figures near the truck at the lower right, and 1 tiny seated figure near the wreckage at the lower left. Include exactly 1 vintage biplane parked on the right with visible markings, exactly 1 old expedition truck at the bottom right, exactly 1 windsock near the center-right, exactly 1 desert oasis town with palm trees on the right, exactly 1 ruined sandcastle-like mound on the left, exactly 1 dark tent encampment on the left-center, exactly 1 wrecked engine or fuselage fragment in the lower left corner, and exactly 1 compass rose printed at the bottom left. The ink trail should branch through dunes and cracked earth like a route on an old map, connecting landmarks labeled with place names including {argument name="map label one" default="Tamanrasset"}, {argument name="map label two" default="Agadir"}, and {argument name="map label three" default="Dakar"}. The base sits in the lower left and center foreground, enclosed by pale concrete walls with defensive corner towers and several cylindrical turret emplacements. Inside the compound are 5 major structures: a large central metallic command or factory building with a curved roof and landing-pad markings, 1 long segmented industrial generator on the left, 1 smaller smokestack power structure near the bottom center, and 2 green cylindrical reactor or storage buildings on the right. Show dirt tracks, scattered crates, utility details, and a paved gray yard inside the walls. A large orange fireball explosion is erupting inside the base near the right-center interior, with smoke and debris. Another smaller explosion is happening outside the walls at the upper left on a dirt road near 2 red ground vehicles or launchers, with black smoke rising. The shoreline curves around shallow blue-green water with sandy banks, rocky cliffs, and many palm trees, creating a tropical desert cove. In the water on the right side, depict 5 gray modern warships in formation, angled diagonally, each leaving white wakes as they move. Count 8 missiles total with bright flaming trails arcing from the ships toward the land and base defenses; one missile is striking the nearest ship-side target area with a bright blue-white impact flash over the waterline, while others arc toward the compound and shore. Include tiny infantry figures near the beach and walls, some fallen, to suggest an active assault. The style should look like a polished high-detail strategy game screenshot, with realistic military sci-fi architecture, cinematic lighting, sharp textures, dynamic explosions, and readable spatial depth.

items.title: 飞艇动画分镜稿
items.prompt: 一份专业的动漫院线分镜头（16：9），标题为《{argument name="标题" default="天空之击"}》，副标题为“{argument name="副标题" default="战士与圣石"}”。干净的浅米色背景，圆角矩形面板排列成三列网格，共 9 个场景。每个场景面板显示：橙色“场景 XX”标签、时间码、场景标题，然后是两个并排的画面，分别标有“开始帧”→“结束帧”，通过白色箭头连接，下面有注释（镜头/对白/特效/动作）。艺术风格：清晰的卡通渲染 {argument name="画风" default="新海诚的×工作室机智，×进击的巨人"}——柔和的画风光线、立体云朵、温暖的金色阳光、电影般的广角镜头、动态动作姿势、浓郁的天蓝和翡翠绿调，搭配黄铜和铜色点缀。需要描绘的场景：1. 广角景——一艘雄伟的蒸汽朋克飞艇，黄铜螺旋桨和飘扬的帆，在高空穿透积云海洋（慢速无人机推入）2.低角度特写一名女战士的靴子和交叉的双腿悬挂在飞艇木制栏杆上，风中头发飘动（静电→微微向上倾斜） 3.鸟瞰视角俯瞰栏杆下方：广阔的翡翠山谷，蜿蜒的河流和远处一个茅草屋顶的小中世纪村庄（眩晕变焦）4.飞艇桥内部——海盗船长戴着三角帽和长大衣，举着一块比蛋稍大、发着蓝光的圣石，脸上有耀眼的青色光（中→石头放大）5.甲板上的船员发现入侵者——一名满脸胡渣的海盗举起一把黄铜中世纪左轮手枪对准她，其他人震惊地转身（两枪→跟着瞄准）6.子弹飞行中极近距离，旋转穿过空中，伴随着运动模糊和烟雾轨迹，朝栏杆方向飞去（子弹时间追踪镜头）7.栏杆——空的。 她被放置的地方什么都没有，子弹穿过空气（快速剪辑，杂音）8。女战士在空中优雅地做月面翻身，背景是明亮的天空，头发和斗篷在动作中拖曳（慢动作，宽→近）9。着陆镜头——她悄无声息地在射手身后降落，低蹲着，手放在剑柄上，海盗转身半空震惊僵住（低角度→对峙） 底部部分包括：“关键角色”一行，有 4 个角色肖像（女战士、海盗船长、射手海盗、一名船员）;一个“音调与方向”盒子（动态动作、风和云粒子，吉卜力风格的奇观与武士的强烈情感）;“音乐与特效计划”时间线（环境风→紧张弦乐→子弹→→沉默）;以及“技术规格”盒装（30 秒，16：9 1920×1080,24 帧，全彩，mp4 H.264）。布局：简洁的信息图，细边框，粉彩色格，每帧内高度细致的动漫关键视觉，专业制作文档美学。

items.title: 九宫飞星风水图
items.prompt: Create a clean, symmetrical Chinese feng shui infographic poster in a traditional almanac style on a warm light beige background. The main title at the top is large dark red Chinese calligraphy text reading {argument name="headline text" default="2026年九宫飞星图"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath in black reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="（丙午年）"}. Add a decorative compass rose in the upper left corner labeled with the four cardinal directions in Chinese: 南 at top, 北 at bottom, 东 at left, 西 at right. Center the composition around a 3x3 grid of 9 bordered square panels with thin ornamental Chinese-style corners, evenly spaced and perfectly aligned. Each square contains a large colored number, a Chinese star name, one line beginning with 吉星 or 凶星, and an illustrative symbolic object. Top row has 3 panels: top-left labeled 东南 with a purple-framed panel for number 9 and text 九紫右弼星, plus 吉星: 喜庆、姻缘、贵人, illustrated with purple balloons, a gift box, and a small firework burst; top-center labeled 正南 with an orange-framed panel for number 5 and text 五黄廉贞星, plus 凶星: 灾祸、意外、疾病, illustrated with a gold gourd and ancient Chinese coins tied with a red tassel; top-right labeled 西南 with a gold-framed panel for number 7 and text 七赤破军星, plus 凶星: 破财、口舌、盗贼, illustrated with a brass bell and a silver sword. Middle row has 3 panels: middle-left aligned with 正东 in large vertical side text, a green-framed panel for number 8 and text 八白左辅星, plus 吉星: 财运、置业、积蓄, illustrated with a bonsai-like money tree and gold ingots; middle-center labeled 中宫 in a blue capsule tag overlapping the top edge of the center square, a blue-framed panel for number 1 and text 一白贪狼星, plus 吉星: 人缘、感情、智慧, illustrated with a crystal ball on a wooden stand; middle-right aligned with 正西 in large vertical side text, a green-framed panel for number 3 and text 三碧禄存星, plus 凶星: 是非、口舌、争执, illustrated with bamboo and a small stacked rock fountain. Bottom row has 3 panels: bottom-left labeled 东北 with a green-framed panel for number 4 and text 四绿文曲星, plus 吉星: 学业、文昌、考试, illustrated with an open book, brush pen, and ink stone with bamboo leaves behind; bottom-center labeled 正北 with a gold-framed panel for number 6 and text 六白武曲星, plus 吉星: 权力、贵人、偏财, illustrated with a golden guardian lion statue on a pedestal holding a ball; bottom-right labeled 西北 with a gray-framed panel for number 2 and text 二黑巨门星, plus 凶星: 病痛、伤害、阻滞, illustrated with a stone pagoda and a small incense burner. Use exactly 6 outer direction labels around the grid: 东南, 正南, 西南 above the top row, and 东北, 正北, 西北 below the bottom row, each inside rounded capsules matching the panel colors. Add exactly 2 large vertical side direction labels outside the grid: 正东 on the left side and 正西 on the right side. At the bottom center, add a pill-shaped legend with 2 segments: a red segment reading 吉星: 1、4、6、8、9 and a dark gray segment reading 凶星: 2、3、5、7. Include faint pale cloud motifs behind some objects for traditional atmosphere. Style is crisp vector-infographic with soft watercolor-like object rendering, high readability, balanced spacing, and an elegant Chinese metaphysical chart aesthetic.

items.title: 日式品牌杂志跨页
items.promptZh: 为出版和品牌服务创建豪华的日本杂志风格的公关编辑跨页，设计为两页小册子布局。左半部分是一个在精致的办公室休息室里的黑暗的电影肖像场景：一位坐着的日本商人穿着海军定制西装、白衬衫、深色领带、白色口袋巾和手表，坐在皮椅上，一只手靠近下巴，在一张光滑的木桌旁边若有所思地摆着姿势。他的脸被故意用柔和的矩形模糊遮挡。灯光柔和而温暖，高大的窗户反射着光线，营造出高级的行政氛围。在这个深色的左侧页面上，放置大型优雅的衬线英文标题文本：{argument name="headline text" default="PUBLISHING BRANDING"}，在左上方附近以柔和的金色堆叠成两行。在其下方，添加多行白色日文文案，包括一个较大的副标题和几个垂直排列的短正文段落。在左下角附近，有一个带边框的黑框，其中正好包含 4 个清单项目，每个项目前面都有一个复选标记，并带有日语文本。在左下角放置一个小页码“02”。右半部分是一个干净的白色编辑信息页面，具有精致的简约排版和宽敞的间距。在顶部，放置一个黑色的日文大标题，右上方对齐，下面有两个简短的日文正文文本块；最右上方有一张小照片，上面有四本堆放的精装书和一个玻璃花瓶，靠近一扇绿树成荫的明亮窗户。在中间，添加一个居中的日语部分标题，以表示五个好处，然后是 5 个编号的列，标记为 1 到 5，每个列都有一个简短的日语标题和几行较小的解释性日语文本。在其下方，为工作流程添加另一个居中的日语部分标题，然后是水平布局的 4 个步骤块：带有语音气泡图标的步骤 01、带有铅笔图标的步骤 02、带有打开的书本图标的步骤 03、带有扩音器图标的步骤 04。每个步骤都包含英文单词 STEP 加上一个两位数的数字、一个简短的日语字幕和几行较小的日语描述，步骤之间有小 V 形符号。沿着右页底部，并排放置 3 张长方形照片：城市景观办公室会议桌场景、用笔写字的手部特写以及一本打开的书旁边的一摞书。在这些图像下，在左下角添加一个突出的日语衬线风格结束语，并在右下角添加一个较小的日语段落。将页码“03”放在右下角。使用深海军蓝、黑色、暖棕色、象牙色和柔和的金色等高级调色板，在编辑奢华、企业信任和高端出版美学之间取得平衡。整体构图应该感觉像真正的杂志广告或咨询手册，精美、逼真、优雅且可信。
items.prompt: Create a luxurious Japanese magazine-style PR editorial spread for a publishing and branding service, designed as a two-page brochure layout. The left half is a dark, cinematic portrait scene in a sophisticated office lounge: a seated Japanese businessman in a navy bespoke suit, white shirt, dark tie, white pocket square, and wristwatch sits in a leather chair with one hand near his chin, posed thoughtfully beside a glossy wooden table. His face is intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur. The lighting is moody and warm, with reflections from tall windows and a premium executive atmosphere. On this dark left page, place large elegant serif headline text in English reading {argument name="headline text" default="PUBLISHING BRANDING"}, stacked in two lines near the upper left in muted gold. Below it, add multiple lines of Japanese copy in white, including a larger subheadline and several short body paragraphs arranged vertically. Near the lower left, include a bordered dark box containing exactly 4 checklist items, each preceded by a check mark, with Japanese text. Put a small page number "02" in the bottom-left corner. The right half is a clean white editorial information page with refined minimalist typography and generous spacing. At the top, place a large Japanese headline in black, aligned upper center-right, with two short Japanese body text blocks beneath it; on the upper far right include a small photo of exactly 4 stacked hardcover books and a glass vase near a bright window with greenery. Across the middle, add a centered section title in Japanese for five benefits, followed by exactly 5 numbered columns labeled 1 through 5, each with a short Japanese heading and several lines of smaller explanatory Japanese text. Beneath that, add another centered Japanese section title for workflow, followed by exactly 4 step blocks laid out horizontally: STEP 01 with a speech bubble icon, STEP 02 with a pencil icon, STEP 03 with an open book icon, STEP 04 with a megaphone icon. Each step includes the English word STEP plus a two-digit number, a short Japanese subtitle, and a few lines of smaller Japanese description, with small chevrons between steps. Along the bottom of the right page, place exactly 3 rectangular photos side by side: a city-view office meeting table scene, a close-up of a hand writing with a pen, and a stack of books near an open book. Under these images, add a prominent Japanese closing statement in a serif style on the lower left, and a smaller Japanese paragraph on the lower right. Put page number "03" in the bottom-right corner. Use a premium palette of deep navy, black, warm brown, ivory, and muted gold, with a balance of editorial luxury, corporate trust, and high-end publishing aesthetics. The overall composition should feel like a real magazine advertisement or consulting brochure, polished, photorealistic, elegant, and credible.

items.title: 吹风机美发广告
items.promptZh: 在干净的浅灰色工作室背景上创建优质简约美容广告。左侧展示一位从胸部以上的迷人女模特，{argument name="hair color" default="deep brunette"} 头发戏剧性地向左吹，形成光滑、有光泽的波浪，强调光泽和动感。她穿着一件优雅的白色扭领露背连衣裙。她的脸被弱化了，不是焦点。在右侧，放置一个时尚现代的圆柱形吹风机，采用金属银色饰面，在黑色空心中心周围有玫瑰金圆形边缘，直立显示，带有可见的手柄按钮、下部通风孔和连接线。使用豪华商业产品——摄影灯光、柔和阴影、超净修饰、高端化妆品广告造型。在右上角添加粗体现代无衬线标题文本：在第一行添加 {argument name="headline text" default="Effortless Shine."}，在其下方添加较轻的 {argument name="subheadline text" default="Everyday Perfect."}。在左下角，包含 4 个垂直堆叠的功能标注，带有细轮廓圆形图标和小无衬线文本：1) 标题为“快速干燥”的闪光图标。和机身“强大的数字电机可实现快速、高效的结果。” 2) 温度计图标，标题为“智能加热”。和身体“每秒测量空气温度 40 次。” 3) 波浪热线图标，标题为“专为头发健康而设计”。和身体“有助于保护自然光泽和光滑度。” 4) 静音扬声器图标，标题为“专为平衡而设计”。和机身“轻便、安静、使用舒适。”在右下角添加奢侈品牌徽标文本 {argument name="brand name" default="LUXÉO"}，其下方带有小写大写字母“PROFESSIONAL”。垂直海报布局、精美的移动广告美学、理想的美容科技品牌、逼真的头发纹理、逼真的皮肤、清晰的版式和优质的社论构图。
items.prompt: Create a premium minimalist beauty advertisement on a clean light gray studio background. Show a glamorous female model from chest up on the left side, with {argument name="hair color" default="deep brunette"} hair blown dramatically to the left in a smooth, glossy wave, emphasizing shine and movement. She wears an elegant white halter dress with a twisted neckline. Her face is de-emphasized and not the focal point. On the right side, place a sleek modern cylindrical hair dryer in a metallic silver finish with a rose-gold circular rim around a black hollow center, shown upright with visible handle buttons, lower air vent perforations, and attached cord. Use luxury commercial product-photography lighting, soft shadows, ultra-clean retouching, and high-end cosmetic ad styling. Add bold modern sans-serif headline text in the upper right: {argument name="headline text" default="Effortless shine."} on the first line and {argument name="subheadline text" default="Everyday perfection."} below it in a lighter weight. In the lower left, include exactly 4 vertically stacked feature callouts with thin outlined circular icons and small sans-serif text: 1) sparkle icon with title "Fast drying." and body "Powerful digital motor for quick, efficient results." 2) thermometer icon with title "Heat intelligent." and body "Measures air temperature 40 times per second." 3) wavy heat lines icon with title "Designed for hair health." and body "Helps protect natural shine and smoothness." 4) muted speaker icon with title "Engineered for balance." and body "Lightweight, quiet, and comfortable to use." In the bottom right corner, add the luxury brand logo text {argument name="brand name" default="LUXÉO"} with small uppercase "PROFESSIONAL" beneath it. Vertical poster layout, polished mobile ad aesthetic, aspirational beauty-tech branding, realistic hair texture, realistic skin, crisp typography, and premium editorial composition.
items.author: Choya

items.title: 奢华香水广告
items.promptZh: 以适合智能手机的垂直编辑布局创建高端奢华香水广告。从左后侧拍摄一位优雅女性的特写剪裁肖像，仅能看到她的下半张脸和肩膀区域，她的头稍微偏向一边，因此她的耳朵、下巴、脖子和肩膀很突出，而上脸大部分都在画面之外。她的头发呈柔软、丰盈的深色盘发造型，发丝松散、抛光。她穿着一件丝质象牙色细肩带吊带裙。她的皮肤散发着温暖、漫射的光泽，焕发光彩。她一手精致地握住靠近脖子和锁骨的长方形玻璃香水瓶，手指优雅而精致。瓶子里装有浅金色液体，有一个刻面透明瓶盖，还有一个奶油色方形标签，上面写着{argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE"}，下面较小的文字写着“EAU DE PARFUM”。使用极简主义美术美容活动美学，采用柔和的米色、香槟色、象牙色和腮红色调、明亮的自然工作室灯光、柔和的阴影、浅景深、清晰的玻璃反射和干净的灰白色背景。在右侧留出足够的负空间用于广告文案。在右侧添加优雅的衬线标题文本，采用柔和的灰褐色，分为 3 行，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="A香味，在沉默中徘徊。"}。包括微妙的高级时尚杂志感觉、超现实的皮肤纹理、奢侈品摄影和精美的商业美容修饰。
items.prompt: Create a high-end luxury perfume advertisement in a vertical smartphone-friendly editorial layout. Show a close-up, cropped portrait of an elegant woman from the back-left side, with only the lower half of her face and shoulder area visible, her head turned slightly away so her ear, jawline, neck, and shoulder are prominent while the upper face is mostly out of frame. Her hair is styled in a soft, voluminous brunette updo with loose, polished strands. She wears a silky ivory spaghetti-strap slip dress. Her skin is luminous with warm, diffused highlights. In one hand she delicately holds a rectangular glass perfume bottle near her neck and collarbone, fingers graceful and refined. The bottle contains pale golden liquid, has a faceted transparent cap, and a cream square label that reads {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE"} with smaller text below reading "EAU DE PARFUM". Use a minimalist fine-art beauty campaign aesthetic with soft beige, champagne, ivory, and blush tones, bright natural studio lighting, gentle shadows, shallow depth of field, crisp glass reflections, and a clean off-white background. Leave generous negative space on the right side for ad copy. Add elegant serif headline text on the right in a muted taupe color, split across 3 lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="A scent that lingers in silence."}. Include a subtle premium fashion-magazine feel, ultra-realistic skin texture, luxury product photography, and polished commercial beauty retouching.

items.title: 森林护肤广告海报
items.promptZh: 奢华天然护肤品广告活动在阳光斑驳的森林空地上拍摄，风格类似于{argument name="brand name" default="WILLOW & ROOT"}的高级社论美容海报。一位美丽的年轻女子居中，她的皮肤被阳光亲吻过，松散的金发编成粗辫子，穿着柔软的米色细肩带吊带连衣裙，坐在一张质朴的长满青苔的原木桌后面，脸旁捧着精致的白色野花。她的脸被温暖的棕褐色色调的干净矩形块遮挡，营造出匿名模特效果。在原木的前景中，从左到右以精美的电子商务阵容排列了 5 种美容产品：绿色玻璃滴管瓶，标有有机面油，带竹盖；圆形腮红粉饼，带尘土玫瑰色盖子；有色润唇膏，采用柔和的陶土包装；磨砂浅绿色泵瓶，标有水润精华液，带竹泵；以及封闭式竹粉盒，刻有品牌名称。在产品周围和框架边缘添加柔软的白色野花和郁郁葱葱的绿色树叶。使用温暖的黄金时段背光、奶油色散景、浅景深、柔和的镜头发光、自然的绿色和米色调色板、高端植物健康美学、逼真的皮肤和包装、居中构图、垂直 4:5 布局。在顶部叠加优雅的深色衬线字体，并在两行中​​添加标题 {argument name="headline text" default="Rooted in Radiance"}，在下面写一个较小的无衬线标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Nature-Powered. Skin-Loving."}，用小叶子图标和细水平分隔线分隔。添加 2 个圆形促销徽章：左上角是一个橄榄绿徽章，带有叶子图标和文字 {argument name="left badged text" default="PLANT-BASED + CRUELTY FREE"}；右上角有一个米色徽章，上面写着 {argument name="discount text" default="15% OFF FIRST ORDER"}。在右上角放置一个小的白色 Pollo.ai 水印。优质美容广告、干净奢华的构图、现代移动优先的电子商务活动。

items.prompt: A vintage American comic-book page in a faded 1950s romance-adventure style, printed on slightly yellowed paper with visible halftone texture, inked panel borders, and soft weathered colors. In the second panel, an interior car view from behind the couple as they drive down Ocean Drive, showing colorful pastel buildings and palms ahead; the man has dark hair and a blue shirt, the woman wears sunglasses, a pink dress, and a lavender headscarf. In the third panel, show the couple approaching the entrance of a modern museum with the visible wall text “MIAMI ART MUSEUM”, glass doors, and people inside; add a caption box reading “THE EXHIBIT WAS AT A MODERN MUSEUM…” and a speech balloon saying “LET’S GO!”. In the fifth panel, show the couple outside again by the water with the skyline, palm trees, and a sailboat in the background, standing close together in the sun; add a caption box reading “WE STEPPED OUT INTO THE SUN…” and a small closing narration box at the bottom right saying “A BEAUTIFUL DAY.” Include speech balloons saying “THAT WAS PERFECT.” and “ART, SUN, AND MIAMI… CAN’T BEAT IT!”. Three ancient Chinese men stand side by side behind a ceremonial altar table in a blooming orchard of pink peach blossoms, each holding a respectful fist-and-palm salute at chest height. The man on the left is broad and heavily built, wearing dark lamellar armor with a deep red robe panel and rugged warrior styling; the man in the center is shorter and slimmer, wearing layered brown scholar-official robes and a simple topknot; the man on the right is tall and imposing, wearing flowing dark green robes with armor details, a long black beard, and a noble commanding presence. Pink petals drift through the air and scatter on the ground. The orchard forms a tunnel of flowering branches overhead, with rustic wooden fencing and traditional buildings softly visible in the background through light spring haze. Include exactly 2 horses flanking the group: a dark horse on the far left and a white horse on the far right, both saddled and calm. Composition is symmetrical, eye-level, centered on the oath ritual, with rich period textures, realistic faces and fabrics, soft natural morning light, shallow atmospheric depth, and an epic, reverent, painterly-cinematic realism in the style of a prestige historical drama.

items.prompt: A cinematic historical war scene from Romance of the Three Kingdoms depicting the straw boat borrowing arrows on a wide gray river during a violent rainstorm, viewed from a slightly elevated front angle. In the foreground, a convoy of 6 narrow wooden boats is lashed together in a line, each boat wrapped thickly with dense bundles of straw along the sides and bow, creating rough protective walls. Hundreds of black-feathered arrows are embedded all over the straw armor, sticking out in every direction, with more arrows flying diagonally through the air in heavy wind and rain. The lead boat dominates the frame; its cabin is covered with dark blue fabric curtains and blue roof panels. Standing calmly inside the front cabin are 2 robed ancient Chinese strategists, one in a pale white robe holding a feather fan and one darker-robed companion beside him, both composed and unhurried amid the chaos. Along the left side of the boats are clustered oarsmen and soldiers in dark period clothing, with several large war drums visible on the decks. In the background across the river, a massive enemy river fleet fills the misty distance: dozens of tall wooden warships, watchtowers, and platforms crowded with troops and archers. Multiple military banners bearing the single large Chinese character "曹" rise above the fleet, indicating Cao Cao's forces. The atmosphere is cold, desaturated, and epic, with fog, smoke, rain streaks, rough water, low contrast blue-gray lighting, and highly detailed realistic textures in wet wood, straw, fabric, and river spray. items.promptZh:
创建电影商业故事板表。

布局：
- 固定 6 面板网格 (2x3)，间隔均匀
- 干净的白色或中性背景
- 每个面板清晰分离，无 UI，无杂乱

全球风格：
- 电影现实主义，高端商业外观
- 柔和控制的灯光，所有面板一致
- 无角色或环境漂移

故事弧（严格顺序）：
1.设置
2.紧张
3.产品展示
4.产品交互
5.转型（影响）
6.干净的结束镜头

场景概念：
{参数名称=“故事概念”默认=“一个女人住在一个安静的公寓里，旁边有一只紧张、不可预测的老虎。老虎的行为就像一只家猫，但始终面临危险。当她提供产品（猫粮）时，老虎明显放松并变成一只平静的家猫。”}

面板要求（每个面板包括）：
- 电影框架（清晰的构图、主题）可读）
- 镜头/动作（适用时重点关注角色 + 产品）
- 摄像机（镜头类型、角度、运动）

产品规则：
- 产品必须清晰、可读且在面板 3、4、6 中光线充足
- 无变形，无需重新设计
- 包装必须保持一致

视觉优先级：
- 紧张（老虎）和浮雕（猫）之间的强烈对比
- 每个区域都具有清晰的可读性框架
- 没有抽象或超现实的扭曲，接地气的现实主义

文本：
- 仅最小、小、专业的标签（面板编号+短镜头注释）
- 没有额外的图形
items.prompt:
Create a cinematic commercial storyboard sheet.

LAYOUT:
- Fixed 6-panel grid (2x3), evenly spaced
- Clean white or neutral background
- Each panel clearly separated, no UI, no clutter

GLOBAL STYLE:
- Cinematic realism, high-end commercial look
- Soft controlled lighting, consistent across all panels
- No character or environment drift

STORY ARC (strict order):
1. Setup
2. Tension
3. Product reveal
4. Product interaction
5. Transformation (impact)
6. Clean closing shot

SCENE CONCEPT:
{argument name="story concept" default="A woman lives in a quiet apartment with a tense, unpredictable tiger. The tiger behaves like a domestic cat but carries constant danger. When she serves the product (cat food), the tiger visibly relaxes and transforms into a calm domestic house cat."}

PANEL REQUIREMENTS (for EACH panel include):
- Cinematic frame (clear composition, subject readable)
- Shot / Action (focused on character + product when applicable)
- Camera (shot type, angle, movement)

PRODUCT RULES:
- Product must be sharp, readable, and well-lit in panels 3, 4, 6
- No distortion, no redesign
- Packaging must remain consistent

VISUAL PRIORITIES:
- Strong contrast between tension (tiger) and relief (cat)
- Clear readability in every frame
- No abstract or surreal distortion, grounded realism

TEXT:
- Minimal, small, professional labels only (panel number + short shot note)
- No extra graphics

items.promptZh: 一幅细节丰富的垂直壁画，采用古老的东亚宗教壁画风格，在风化的丝绸或石膏上绘制，有明显的裂缝、擦伤、褪色的颜料和仿旧的金箔。在中心，一位天上菩萨般的女神优雅地漂浮在一个巨大的粉红色莲花基座上，周围是一个巨大的圆形金色光环，填充在构图的中上部。她戴着精致的珠宝头饰、层叠的项链、臂章和柔和的朱砂红色、奶油色、青色和柔和绿色的飘逸长袍，丝带般的长围巾以优雅的弧线绕在她的身上。她的右臂高举，精致地捧着一朵粉红色的莲花，左手向外伸出，做出温柔的供奉姿势。她的周围正好有三位较小的侍女：左下一位站在云上弹奏琵琶，中下一位跪着或漂浮，捧着一盘莲花，右下一位轻立云上，双手举起。背景是深邃的青金石蓝色的天空，布满了风格化的奶油色和玉色的云朵，隐约飞翔的鸟儿，莲花盛开，左上角和右上角有两个华丽的寺庙亭阁。在中左和中右边缘附近添加悬挂装饰图案，并将整个图像包围在装饰性花卉边框中。整体气氛神圣、优雅、古色古香，有着复杂的线条、精致的纺织图案、柔和的泥土色调以及占主导地位的蓝色和金色调色板，类似于珍贵的博物馆壁画或虔诚的挂轴。
items.prompt: A richly detailed vertical mural in the style of an aged East Asian religious wall painting on weathered silk or plaster, with visible cracks, abrasions, faded pigment, and distressed gold leaf. At the center, a celestial bodhisattva-like goddess floats gracefully above a large pink lotus pedestal, framed by a huge circular golden halo filling the upper middle of the composition. She wears an elaborate jeweled headdress, layered necklaces, armlets, and flowing robes in muted cinnabar red, cream, teal, and soft green, with long ribbon-like scarves swirling around her body in elegant arcs. Her right arm is raised, delicately holding a pink lotus flower, while her left hand extends outward in a gentle offering gesture. Surrounding her are exactly 3 smaller attendant maidens: one at lower left standing on clouds and playing a pipa, one at lower center kneeling or floating while presenting a tray of lotus blossoms, and one at lower right standing lightly on clouds with both hands raised in reverence. The background is a deep lapis-blue celestial sky filled with stylized cream and jade clouds, faint flying birds, lotus blooms, and 2 ornate temple pavilions in the upper left and upper right corners. Add hanging ornamental motifs near the mid-left and mid-right edges, and enclose the whole image in a decorative floral border. The overall mood is sacred, elegant, and antique, with intricate linework, delicate textile patterns, muted earthy tones, and a dominant blue-and-gold palette, resembling a treasured museum fresco or devotional hanging scroll.

items.promptZh: 这是一张高度真实的编辑工作室肖像，描绘的是一名 30 多岁的{argument name="subject sex" default="woman"}，身材自然健美，以与眼睛齐平的半身构图呈现。拍摄对象以一种轻松、自信的姿势面对镜头，双手随意地插在口袋里，身穿深炭色定制西装外套，内搭柔和的橄榄灰色圆领 T 恤和深色裤子。头发是{argument name="hair style" default="齐肩深棕色波浪发，自然侧分"}，略微凌乱，柔和地勾勒出肩膀。保持表情平静、中立、自信。使用 f/2.8 的 85 毫米人像镜头，拍摄对象清晰对焦，背景柔和模糊。照明是干净的专业工作室照明，带有 1 个来自前方的柔光箱主光，微妙的填充以减少刺眼的阴影，以及 1 个围绕头发和肩膀的柔和的边缘光。背景是一个无缝的工作室背景，具有柔和温暖的米色到浅灰褐色渐变，最小的纹理，没有干扰。色彩分级应该自然且平衡，具有真实的肤色、柔和的对比度，并且没有大量的修饰或滤镜。整体氛围低调、现代、精致、优质，就像时尚或企业社论肖像。超详细、逼真、8k、无噪音、无运动模糊、无扭曲、无道具、无珠宝、无文字。
items.prompt: A highly realistic editorial studio portrait of a {argument name="subject gender" default="woman"} in their late 30s with a naturally fit build, shown in a half-body composition at eye level. The subject stands facing the camera in a relaxed, confident posture with both hands tucked casually into pockets, wearing a dark charcoal tailored blazer over a muted olive-gray crew-neck t-shirt and dark trousers. The hair is {argument name="hair style" default="shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair with a natural side part"}, slightly tousled and softly framing the shoulders. Keep the expression calm, neutral, and self-assured. Use an 85mm portrait lens look at f/2.8 with the subject sharply in focus and the background softly blurred. Lighting is clean professional studio lighting with 1 softbox key light from the front, subtle fill to reduce harsh shadows, and 1 gentle rim light around the hair and shoulders. The background is a seamless studio backdrop with a soft warm beige-to-light taupe gradient, minimal texture, and no distractions. Color grading should be natural and balanced, with realistic skin tones, soft contrast, and no heavy retouching or filters. The overall mood is understated, modern, polished, and premium, like a fashion or corporate editorial portrait. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, 8k, no noise, no motion blur, no distortions, no props, no jewelry, no text.

items.promptZh: 高端工作室社论肖像，半身取景，主角是 30 多岁到 40 岁出头的{argument name="subject sex" default="woman"}，身材自然健美。她以轻松、自信的姿势面对镜头站立，双手插在裤兜里，肩膀柔软，姿势挺直，表情平静中性自信。她有一头齐肩至稍长的深棕色波浪发，侧分自然，蓬松。她穿着 3 件可见的衣服：橄榄绿轻质休闲夹克，棉质质地略有磨损，正面有拉链，胸前有一个带盖口袋；里面是一件普通的深木炭色或黑色圆领T恤；深色合身长裤，配有黑色腰带和简单的方扣。使用 85 毫米人像镜头在眼睛水平位置拍摄，浅景深约为 f/2.8，使拍摄对象保持清晰细腻，而背景则柔和地失焦。使用具有 3 个清晰灯光组件的专业工作室照明：1 个来自前方的柔光箱主光、1 个用于柔化阴影的微妙补光、以及 1 个来自后面的柔和边缘光，用于将头发和肩膀与背景分开。背景是一个无缝干净的工作室背景，具有温暖的米色到灰褐色中性渐变，平滑且无干扰。整体形象应该给人高度真实、精致和现代的感觉，就像低调的时尚活动或生活方式杂志的肖像一样。自然平衡的调色，逼真的肤色，超详细的织物纹理和发丝，无噪音，无运动模糊，无风格化，无卡通元素，无解剖扭曲，8K 画质。
items.prompt: A high-end studio editorial portrait, half-body framing, featuring a {argument name="subject gender" default="woman"} in her mid-30s to early 40s with a naturally fit build. She stands facing the camera in a relaxed, confident pose with both hands tucked into her pants pockets, shoulders soft, posture upright, and a calm neutral self-assured expression. She has shoulder-length to slightly longer dark brown wavy hair with a natural side part and loose volume. She wears 3 visible clothing pieces: an olive green lightweight casual jacket with a slightly worn cotton texture, zip front and a single chest flap pocket; a plain dark charcoal or black crew-neck t-shirt underneath; and dark fitted pants with a black belt and simple square buckle. Shot at eye level with an 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field around f/2.8, keeping the subject crisp and detailed while the background falls softly out of focus. Use professional studio lighting with 3 clear light components: 1 softbox key light from the front, 1 subtle fill light to soften shadows, and 1 gentle rim light from behind to separate the hair and shoulders from the backdrop. Background is a seamless clean studio backdrop with a warm beige-to-taupe neutral gradient, smooth and distraction-free. The overall image should feel highly realistic, polished, and modern, like an understated fashion campaign or lifestyle magazine portrait. Natural balanced color grading, realistic skin tones, ultra-detailed fabric texture and hair strands, no noise, no motion blur, no stylization, no cartoon elements, no anatomical distortions, 8K quality.

Write. Bloom."}。将一本带有钢笔的打开的笔记本放在她腿附近的前景中，显示玫瑰草图和笔记，并在右下角另外放置一本打开的植物插图书。在上部区域，正好包括 4 本漂浮的打开的书和几张漂浮在空中的松散的书页。在她身后，创建一个明亮的拱形窗户，展现出一座柔和的童话城市，在清澈的天蓝色背景下有大教堂般的尖顶。整个图像充满了分散的红色和粉色玫瑰花瓣、闪光、柔和的绘画光线、装饰性花卉细节以及海军蓝、粉色和奶油色的色彩丰富的书籍封面。 {argument name="occasion" default="Sant Jordi Day"} 使用精美的动漫插图造型、高度细致的线条、明亮的柔和亮点、浪漫的奇幻氛围、平衡的对称框架以及具有纪念意义的春季图书和玫瑰主题视觉效果。

汽车必须是精致的 2017 福特野马 GT 敞篷车，金属电蓝色油漆，引擎盖上有光泽的反射，可见的野马小马格栅标志，激进的车头灯，肌肉发达的引擎盖雕刻，空气动力学前保险杠，黑色合金轮毂，优质红色敞篷织物车顶，逼真的挡风玻璃反射，精致的后视镜，正宗的轮胎胎面，陈列室干净的饰面

场景设置在高档别墅车道上，浅米色六角形石路面，左侧有新鲜绿草的弧形边界，热带棕榈叶从顶角进入框架，微妙的奢华户外氛围。柔和的自然日光、漫射的午后照明、汽车和车身下的真实阴影、油漆上的柔和反射、电影级高级色彩分级、自然对比度、浅深度分离，同时保持环境清晰度。 35mm镜头拍摄，垂直构图，全身取景，细节清晰，超写实单反画质，零AI外观，自然肤色渲染，真实发丝，织物质感，石材表面纹理，奢华生活意境。左下角时尚文字“AmanZaid”，签名风格

变脸、身份不同、美化脸、编辑过的脸、光滑的塑料皮肤、假皮发光、错误的发型、短发、褪色发型、嗡嗡声、凌乱的变形头发、女性特征、肌肉发达的身体、肥胖的身体、宽阔的肩膀、不良的解剖结构、长脖子、短腿、多余的手指、缺失的手指、变异的手、扭曲手臂，破碎的姿势，斗鸡眼，懒惰的眼睛，坏太阳镜，模糊的脸，低分辨率，像素化，嘈杂的图像，曝光过度，曝光不足，刺眼的阴影，不切实际的反射，假车形状，错误的车型，损坏的汽车，额外的轮子，扭曲的野马标志，公司

items.title: 海边咖啡店活动海报
items.prompt:
Create a lively Chinese event poster with a warm, trendy coffee-shop aesthetic, photographed from inside a seaside cafe looking out through large floor-to-ceiling windows at palm trees, a bright blue sky, outdoor seating, and a Ferris wheel in the distance. The composition should feel like a candid lifestyle scene combined with energetic graphic design. In the foreground, place a dark wooden table with 1 open laptop centered near the bottom, 1 takeaway coffee cup with a black lid on the right side of the table, 1 black bag on the left, and 1 short stack of books near the left edge. Use a sunlit, slightly golden afternoon atmosphere with reflections on the glass and a relaxed vacation vibe.

Overlay bold poster graphics in a collage style using torn paper, brushstroke paint, stickers, and taped note-paper elements. The main headline on the upper left should be huge, hand-painted Chinese calligraphy in dark brown and orange, reading “疯狂星期四”, with a small yellow tag near it that reads “第11期”, and an even smaller top-left badge reading “活动预告” with a tiny megaphone icon. Beneath the main headline, add a green brushstroke banner with the text “下周四，不见不散！”, and below that a smaller line in parentheses: “（五一长假前最后一期）”.

Add 2 torn notebook-paper cards: 1 in the upper right and 1 in the lower left. The upper-right note should contain a short invitation paragraph in Chinese, neatly typeset in black and orange text, reading: “让我们海边小聚，远眺摩天轮，吹吹海风，和 App & AI Builder 们一起聊聊产品、远程生活与创作。” and include a small orange heart doodle in the bottom-right corner of that note. The lower-left note should list 3 info blocks with icons and orange section headers: “时间”, “地点”, and “说明”. Under “时间”, write “2026年04月23日 (星期四)” and “12:00 ~ 18:00”. Under “地点”, write “南山区·前海石公园·福叁咖啡”. Under “说明”, write “无需报名，随时来吧！”.

Across the middle-right area, place a large playful white script-style slogan with a dark outline, angled slightly upward, reading “喝咖啡、随意交流 海边散步，主打一个 Chill~”. Add 1 illustrated coffee cup sticker next to this slogan on the right. Use energetic orange paint splashes and sketch doodles around the headline and notes to make the poster feel youthful and spontaneous.

At the bottom, place a wide off-white torn-paper footer strip containing 3 feature blocks laid out horizontally. Block 1: a snowflake-like icon with the text “舒适环境” and smaller text “空调 + 宽敞桌椅”. Block 2: a Wi‑Fi icon with the text “电网无忧” and smaller text “WiFi + 插座”. Block 3: larger orange handwritten text “期待与你 海边相遇！” with a blue underline flourish and a tiny heart doodle. The overall design should mix real photography and graphic poster elements, with strong contrast, brush lettering, scrapbook textures, cafe lifestyle realism, and a fashionable AI-generated social-media event-poster look.

items.title: 琥珀色发明家肖像
items.promptZh: 在黑暗、喜怒无常的工作室中拍摄的{argument name="subject" default="一位才华横溢的年轻女发明家"}的风格化半身肖像，渲染为一幅温暖的琥珀色和古铜色数字绘画，具有半写实的细节和微妙的素描般的线条。她面朝前方，摆出一种放松的直立姿势，从躯干中部向上剪短，长长的深棕色头发松散地披在肩上，几缕飘逸的发丝在橙色背光的边缘照亮，薄框透明眼镜若隐若现。为她穿上亮泽的芥末黄色飞行员夹克，搭配深酒红色高领毛衣。灯光充满戏剧性和电影感：一盏发光的球形格子灯位于她身后的左侧，在她的头发和夹克周围投射出金色的光环和温暖的边缘光，而背景的其余部分则淡入炭棕色阴影。在她身后，融入了视觉记忆图或发明家思维宫殿的感觉：淡淡的技术草图、几何构造线以及像发光粉笔一样直接绘制在背景上的手写科学笔记。右侧正好包括 2 个大型线框形式：1 个位于右上方附近的倾斜篮状格子椭圆体和 1 个位于右下方附近带有轴状引导线的微弱矩形图。在左下角正好包括 1 个发光的晶格球体灯。在右上角添加小手写文字，上面写着“TPMS”，下面有三条子弹状的线条：“gyroid”、“diamond”和“primitive”，并在右中心附近添加一个小公式注释，写着“E = hv”。整体氛围应该给人一种聪明、优雅、讨人喜欢、略带未来感的感觉，就像一幅肖像与概念记忆界面的融合。使用丰富的焦橙色、金色、赤褐色、棕黑色和酒红色调色板，具有高对比度、明亮的高光和抛光的编辑艺术效果。
items.prompt: A stylized half-body portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a brilliant young woman inventor"} in a dark, moody studio, rendered as a warm amber-and-copper digital painting with semi-realistic detail and subtle sketch-like linework. She faces forward in a relaxed upright pose, cropped from about mid-torso upward, with long dark brown hair swept loosely over one shoulder, a few flyaway strands rim-lit by orange backlight, and thin clear-framed eyeglasses partly visible. Dress her in a glossy mustard-yellow bomber jacket over a deep burgundy turtleneck sweater. The lighting is dramatic and cinematic: a glowing spherical lattice lamp sits behind her on the left, casting a golden halo and warm edge light around her hair and jacket, while the rest of the background fades into charcoal brown shadow. Behind her, integrate the feeling of a visual memory map or inventor's mind palace: faint technical sketches, geometric construction lines, and handwritten scientific notes drawn directly onto the background like illuminated chalk. Include exactly 2 large wireframe forms on the right side: 1 tilted basket-like lattice ellipsoid near the upper right and 1 faint rectangular diagram with axis-like guide lines near the lower right. Include exactly 1 glowing lattice sphere lamp on the lower left. Add small handwritten text in the upper right that reads “TPMS” with three bullet-like lines underneath: “gyroid”, “diamond”, and “primitive”, and a small formula note reading “E = hv” near the right-center. The overall mood should feel intelligent, elegant, flattering, and slightly futuristic, like a portrait merged with a conceptual memory interface. Use a rich palette of burnt orange, gold, auburn, brown-black, and wine red, with high contrast, luminous highlights, and a polished editorial-art finish.

items.title: 机甲驾驶员动漫海报
items.promptZh: 创作一张戏剧性的动漫科幻海报 {argument name="character name" default="Puru Two"}，灵感来自于机甲战争场景中的网络新型飞行员。该构图是一个垂直方向的角色关键视觉，其中一个中央全身女性人物穿着时尚的红黑飞行员连体衣，以略低角度的姿势自信地站立。她有一头橙色的分层短发，侧边的刘海很长，皮肤苍白，表情严肃，情感上疏远。她的套装是有光泽的深红色，侧幅为黑色，高领，合身接缝，前拉链，深色手套，实用腰带，肩膀和胸部有军事徽章。背景是一个黑暗的、类似太空的抽象场，有黑色、深红色、洋红色和分散的星状纹理，飞溅的能量效果，以及坚韧的未来派宣传海报情绪。中心人物周围有 3 个镶嵌面板：右上特写是她的眼睛和上脸，通过透明驾驶舱或 HUD 玻璃反射，带有红色界面灯和小型技术读数；中右是一个幽灵般的年轻女孩的柔和苍白肖像，穿着宽松的白色长袍，背景是发光的雾蒙蒙的白灰色背景；右下特写是一只戴着手套的手握着机械控制杆，驾驶舱仪表带有发光装置。在左右边缘添加密集的图形设计元素和版式，结合优雅的衬线英文文本、日文垂直标题文本、紧凑的技术标签和机甲规格块。包括可见文本，例如大标题“PURU TWO”、“NEO ZEON”、“CYBER-NEWTYPE”、“MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM ZZ”、“PSYCHO GUNDAM MK-II”、百分比/状态读数（例如“99.8%”）以及其他小型控制面板注释。使用高细节的动画插画风格、电影般的红色灯光、光泽的织物亮点、清晰的线条、微妙的屏幕反射、分层的 UI 覆盖以及让人想起豪华科幻人物档案的高级海报布局。
items.prompt: Create a dramatic anime sci-fi poster of {argument name="character name" default="Puru Two"}, inspired by a cyber-newtype pilot from a mecha war setting. The composition is a vertically oriented character key visual with one central full-body female figure in a sleek red and black pilot bodysuit, shown standing confidently in a slightly low-angle pose. She has short layered orange hair with long side bangs, pale skin, and a serious, emotionally distant expression. Her suit is glossy crimson with black side panels, a high collar, fitted seams, a front zipper line, dark gloves, a utility belt, and military insignia on the shoulders and chest. The background is a dark, space-like abstract field with black, crimson, magenta, and scattered star-like textures, splattered energy effects, and a gritty futuristic propaganda-poster mood. Surround the central figure with 3 inset panels: a top-right close-up of her eyes and upper face reflected through a transparent cockpit or HUD glass with red interface lights and small technical readouts, a mid-right soft pale portrait of a ghostly young girl in a loose white gown against a luminous misty white-gray background, and a bottom-right close-up of 1 gloved hand gripping a mechanical control lever with illuminated cockpit instrumentation. Add dense graphic design elements and typography throughout the left and right edges, combining elegant serif English text, Japanese vertical title text, compact technical labels, and mecha specification blocks. Include visible text such as the large title "PURU TWO", "NEO ZEON", "CYBER-NEWTYPE", "MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM ZZ", "PSYCHO GUNDAM MK-II", percentage/status readouts like "99.8%", and other small control-panel annotations. Use a high-detail painted anime illustration style, cinematic red lighting, glossy fabric highlights, sharp linework, subtle screen reflections, layered UI overlays, and a premium poster layout reminiscent of a luxury sci-fi character dossier.

items.title: 摩洛哥餐厅品牌视觉板
items.titleZh: 摩洛哥餐厅品牌视觉板
items.promptZh: 使用提供的蒸粗麦粉菜肴的参考图像作为英雄美食照片，将其转换为名为 {argument name="restaurant name" default="La Casbah"} 的摩洛哥餐厅的精美单页品牌标识板。保持菜肴本身的可识别性，但将其作为右上角英雄区域的主要视觉效果，并在温暖的米色编辑布局和精致的摩洛哥风格风格上围绕它构建完整的优质品牌展示。添加左上角的品牌块，其中餐厅名称为大衬线标识，其上方有一个小几何标志，以及法语标语“SAVEURS D’AILLEURS，SOURIRES D’ICI”。包括一个简短的法国品牌段落和下面一个大胆的结束语。然后创建一个包含 9 个部分的结构化网格品牌指南：1) “LOGO PRINCIPAL”在浅色背景上显示主徽标，2) “VARIATIONS”，包含 3 种徽标变体 — 一种红色方形版本、一种绿色方形版本和一种圆形印章版本，3) “TYPOGRAPHIES”显示 3 种文本样式 — 标题、副标题和正文，4) “PALETTE DE COULEURS”，带有 6 个标记为 Casbah 的色样红色、撒哈拉沙色、橄榄绿、香料橙、薄荷绿和木炭，每个都有十六进制代码，5）“灵感”有 3 个图像图块 - 摩洛哥拱门瓷砖、多彩香料和新鲜薄荷叶，6）“包装”有 3 个模型 - 纸质外卖袋、带袖子的食物碗和外卖咖啡杯，7）“商品”有 3 个模型 - 围裙、手提袋和帽子， 8) “RÉSEAUX SOCIAUX”，包含 3 个社交帖子设计，使用食品和成分图像以及简短的法语营销文案；9) “VOIX DE LA MARQUE”，包含 4 个品牌声音特征和简短的法语描述。在右侧添加一个极简主义的引用块，阅读“BIEN MANGER.SOURIRE.RECOMMENCER”。最后采用全宽深红色页脚带，其中包含以徽标为中心的徽标和微妙的摩洛哥几何图案。整体外观：豪华餐厅品牌板、干净的机构展示、有凝聚力的摩洛哥视觉形象、优雅的版式、逼真的模型、柔和的自然纹理、编辑间距。
items.prompt: Using the provided reference image of the couscous dish as the hero food photo, transform it into a polished one-page brand identity board for a Moroccan restaurant named {argument name="restaurant name" default="La Casbah"}. Keep the dish itself recognizable, but integrate it as the main visual in the top-right hero area and build a complete premium branding presentation around it on a warm beige editorial layout with refined Moroccan-inspired styling. Add a top-left brand block with the restaurant name as a large serif logotype, a small geometric emblem above it, and the French tagline “SAVEURS D’AILLEURS, SOURIRES D’ICI.” Include a short French brand paragraph and a bold closing sentence beneath. Then create a structured grid brand guide with exactly 9 sections: 1) “LOGO PRINCIPAL” showing the main logo on a light background, 2) “VARIATIONS” with 3 logo variations — one red square version, one green square version, and one circular seal version, 3) “TYPOGRAPHIES” showing 3 text styles — titles, subtitles, and body copy, 4) “PALETTE DE COULEURS” with 6 color swatches labeled Casbah Red, Sahara Sand, Olive Green, Spice Orange, Mint Green, and Charcoal, each with hex codes, 5) “INSPIRATION” with 3 image tiles — Moroccan arch tilework, colorful spices, and fresh mint leaves, 6) “PACKAGING” with 3 mockups — paper takeout bag, food bowl with sleeve, and takeaway coffee cup, 7) “MERCHANDISE” with 3 mockups — apron, tote bag, and cap, 8) “RÉSEAUX SOCIAUX” with 3 social post designs using the food and ingredient imagery plus short French marketing copy, and 9) “VOIX DE LA MARQUE” with 4 brand voice traits and short French descriptions. Add a minimalist quote block on the right reading “BIEN MANGER. SOURIRE. RECOMMENCER.” Finish with a full-width deep red footer band containing the logo centered and subtle Moroccan geometric patterns. Overall look: luxury restaurant branding board, clean agency presentation, cohesive Moroccan visual identity, elegant typography, realistic mockups, soft natural textures, editorial spacing.
