items.title: 礼帽男融墨红日海报
items.promptZh:
主题和构图：

中心人物：{参数名称=“主题简介”默认=一个穿着 1940 年代经典软呢帽和正式西装的男人的清晰侧面视图”}。

融化效果：男人躯干的下半部分应该溶解或“滴”成长而垂直的黑色墨水条纹和飞溅，在背景下产生超现实的液体渗色效果。

图形元素：一个大的{argument name="background shape" default="solid fresh red Circle"}直接位于男人的头部和肩膀后面，创建一个锚定构图的“光环”或“冉冉升起的太阳”图案。

风格和调色板：

配色方案：严格的{argument name="配色方案"default="纯红色、深黑色和灰白色/奶油色的极简调色板"}。

摄影风格：以高对比度、黑白电影为主题的黑色摄影。纹理应看起来像景深较浅的高分辨率时尚社论。

背景：干净、略带纹理的灰白色纸或画布背景，给人一种优质的物理海报感觉。

技术细节：

灯光：强烈的“伦勃朗”灯光定义面部轮廓，强调鼻梁和下巴轮廓，并带有深色阴影。

气氛：忧郁、知性、高风险。设计应该给人现代感，但又符合 20 世纪中叶的时代风格。

框架：垂直海报方向（A 形框架），左侧和右侧有明显的负空间，以强调中心垂直轴。

宽高比为 9:16
items.prompt:
Subject & Composition:

Central Figure: A {argument name="subject profile" default="sharp profile view of a man wearing a classic 1940s fedora and a formal suit"}.

Melting Effect: The lower half of the man's torso should dissolve or "drip" into long, vertical black ink streaks and splatters, creating a surreal, liquid-bleed effect against the background.

Graphic Element: A large, {argument name="background shape" default="solid vibrant red circle"} is positioned directly behind the man's head and shoulders, creating a "halo" or "rising sun" motif that anchors the composition.

Style & Color Palette:

Color Scheme: A strict {argument name="color scheme" default="minimalist palette of True Red, Deep Black, and Off-White/Cream"}.

Photography Style: High-contrast, black and white film noir photography for the subject. The texture should look like a high-resolution fashion editorial with a shallow depth of field.

Background: A clean, slightly textured off-white paper or canvas background to give it a premium, physical poster feel.

Technical Details:

Lighting: Strong "Rembrandt" lighting to define the facial contours, emphasizing the bridge of the nose and the jawline with deep shadows.

Atmosphere: Somber, intellectual, and high-stakes. The design should feel modern yet period-accurate to the mid-20th century.

Framing: Vertical poster orientation (A-frame), with significant negative space on the left and right to emphasize the central vertical axis.

Aspect ratio is 9:16

items.promptZh: 居中的工作室肖像，是一只毛茸茸的{argument name="catbreed"default="ragdollkitten"}，在无缝的纯白色背景上直立坐着，直接面向镜头。这只小猫有着长而柔软、奢华的皮毛，毛色大部分为白色，身体两侧有微妙的冷灰色阴影，深灰色的耳朵，眼睛和上脸周围有灰色的面具，左前侧有一条卷曲的深灰色毛茸茸的尾巴。它的眼睛又大又圆，生动{argument name="eye color" default="blue"}，粉红色的小鼻子，精致的胡须，表情平静天真。展示从耳朵到爪子的全身，完美居中且对称，两只前爪靠拢且清晰可见。灯光高调、柔和、均匀，阴影极小，毛皮细节清晰，深度柔和，具有干净的高级宠物摄影外观。超写实，脸部锐利对焦，光滑的白色负空间，没有道具，没有文字，没有衣领，没有背景元素。
items.prompt: A centered studio portrait of a fluffy {argument name="cat breed" default="ragdoll kitten"} sitting upright and facing directly toward the camera on a seamless pure white background. The kitten has long, soft, luxurious fur with a mostly white coat, subtle cool gray shading on the sides of the body, darker gray ears, a gray mask around the eyes and upper face, and a dark gray fluffy tail curled around the front-left side. Its eyes are large, round, and vivid {argument name="eye color" default="blue"}, with a small pink nose, delicate whiskers, and a calm, innocent expression. Show the full body from ears to paws, perfectly centered and symmetrical, with both front paws close together and visible. Lighting is high-key, soft, and even, with minimal shadows, crisp fur detail, gentle depth, and a clean premium pet-photography look. Ultra-realistic, sharp focus on the face, smooth white negative space, no props, no text, no collar, no background elements.

items.prompt: Create a bold Japanese YouTube thumbnail for the theme {argument name="headline text" default="初心者でもできる AI×動画編集"}, in a futuristic neon-blue cyberpunk style. Use a wide 16:9 composition with a dark electric-blue background filled with glowing circuit lines, digital streaks, lens flares, and high-energy motion. Place a slanted glowing banner in the upper left containing the Japanese text {argument name="top banner text" default="初心者でもできる"}, with the first part in bright yellow and the rest in white. Make the main headline dominate the left and center: gigantic white glowing text “AI×” above even larger white glowing text “動画編集”, with thick blue neon outer glow, slight italic forward motion, beveled 3D shading, and dramatic perspective. In the upper right, add a circular holographic interface with the letters {argument name="ai badge text" default="AI"} in the center, surrounded by concentric rings and tiny HUD marks. Near it, include exactly 3 floating app-style icons: a play button icon, a square “Pr” icon, and an audio waveform icon, all glowing blue. Across the lower right, show a sleek angled video editing monitor displaying a neon city night road scene with a play symbol overlay; beneath the preview, include a timeline with exactly 4 visible tracks: 2 rows of video thumbnails and 2 colored audio bars, one magenta and one cyan-green. Along the bottom, add exactly 3 glowing rounded feature badges with icons and Japanese text: a book icon with “知識ゼロOK”, a clock icon with “時短でカンタン”, and a sparkle icon with “プロ級の仕上がり”. items.title: 青年共绘日本旅行图
items.promptZh: 浅灰白色背景上干净的编辑风格插图，正好显示 11 个年轻人聚集在地板上的一张巨大的纸周围，共同绘制了详细的日本旅行场景。构图是从稍上方观看的，以艺术品为中心，人们在其周围形成一个松散的圆圈。使用简单的手绘卡通风格，具有细长的黑色轮廓、柔和的柔和色彩、最小的阴影以及友好的现代杂志美学。纸上的中心图包括8个不同的风景元素：中间背景是白雪皑皑的富士山，山的右上方是红色的太阳，几朵白云，左上方深色树枝上的粉红色樱花，右边是一座红色的多层宝塔，中右附近有一座塔的高大城市天际线，一个有小船的蓝色湖泊，以及右下方蜿蜒的白色子弹头列车。在整个区域添加树木和灌木丛，并在中下部附近添加一座小拱桥。这11个人穿着随意，穿着各异的服装，都拿着记号笔或蜡笔，或倚着、跪着、或趴在纸上。顶部边缘有 6 个人，左侧有 3 个人，右下边缘有 2 个人。他们的服装应该有所不同：连帽衫、夹克、针织帽、格子衬衫、图案毛衣、蓝色 T 恤、黑色 T 恤，以及一个人在深色衣服外穿红色开衫。右边的一个人应该戴着眼镜，穿着红色羊毛衫，右下角的另一个人应该有深色卷发，戴着圆眼镜，穿着黑色T恤，并在画画时趴着。在纸张底部边缘附近撒一些蓝色和深色的松散蜡笔。以大型插图海报作为清晰的焦点，保持协作、创意和有趣的氛围。
items.prompt: A clean editorial-style illustration on a light gray-white background showing exactly 11 young people gathered around a huge sheet of paper on the floor, collaboratively drawing a detailed Japan travel scene. The composition is viewed from slightly above, centered on the artwork, with the people forming a loose ring around it. Use a simple hand-drawn cartoon style with thin black outlines, soft muted colors, minimal shading, and a friendly modern magazine aesthetic. The central drawing on the paper includes 8 distinct scenic elements: snow-capped Mount Fuji in the middle background, a red sun to the upper right of the mountain, a few white clouds, pink cherry blossoms on a dark branch at upper left, a red multi-tier pagoda on the right, a tall city skyline with a tower near the center-right, a blue lake with a small boat, and a sleek white bullet train curving across the lower right. Add trees and bushes throughout, plus a small arched bridge near the lower middle. The 11 people are casually dressed in varied outfits and are all holding markers or crayons while leaning, kneeling, or lying around the paper. Include 6 people across the top edge, 3 along the left side, and 2 along the lower-right side. Their clothing should vary: hoodies, jackets, a knit beanie, a plaid shirt, a patterned sweater, a blue T-shirt, a black T-shirt, and one person in a red cardigan over dark clothes. One person on the right should wear glasses and a red cardigan, another at the bottom right should have curly dark hair, round glasses, a black T-shirt, and be lying on his stomach while drawing. Scatter a few loose crayons in blue and dark colors near the bottom edge of the paper. Keep the mood collaborative, creative, and playful, with the large illustrated poster as the clear focal point.

items.prompt: A hyper-detailed, ultra-colorful anime festival illustration of 2 kemonomimi girls jumping midair in a joyful pose, filling the center of a tall vertical composition. The girl on the right is a cheerful catgirl with white-blonde hair, large fluffy cat ears, bright blue eyes, one eye winking, and a big open smile, wearing a vivid blue floral kimono-inspired short dress with oversized sleeves, layered frilly white petticoat trim, a large multicolored obi bow, floral hair ornaments, white ankle socks, and geta sandals, with a fluffy pale tail visible behind her; her right arm is raised making a peace sign and her left hand is near her chest. The girl on the left is a doggirl with medium brown hair, fluffy brown-and-white dog ears, and a curled fluffy tail, wearing a vivid pink and magenta floral kimono-inspired short dress with layered frills, a large decorative obi bow, floral hair ornaments, white socks, and sandals; she is also leaping with one arm raised in a peace sign. Render the left girl's face as intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur block. Surround them with an explosive fantasy-Japanese backdrop packed with decorative detail: Mount Fuji centered in the upper background with radiant sunrise rays, a large rainbow arc swirling on the right, stylized Great Wave-like curling waves on both sides, dense pink cherry blossoms overhead, 2 glowing paper lanterns near the upper left and upper right edges, and 2 more paper lanterns near the lower left and lower right corners, plus a red arched bridge at the bottom left. Use a saturated candy-bright palette of pink, cyan, blue, gold, orange, violet, and white, with confetti-like petals, sparkling particles, paint splashes, and intricate floral patterns covering nearly every surface. The mood is festive, cute, ecstatic, and celebratory, with dynamic foreshortening, crisp linework, glossy highlights, layered textures, and a highly polished gacha-card style illustration.

items.title: 兔女郎恋爱喜剧海报
items.prompt: A flashy Japanese romantic comedy movie poster in a cute-but-dramatic pop anime mascot style, designed like a theatrical film teaser. Center the composition on a full-body cartoon bunny girl mascot named {argument name="character name" default="パン子"}, with a large white face, black body and one black ear, one bright red ear, thick black outline, half-lidded glamorous eyes with long lashes, pink blush circles on her cheeks, a tiny red nose, a small tongue peeking out, and a pink bow with white polka dots on top of her head. She wears a sleeveless pink dress with white polka dots and a black scarf-like neck detail, posing with one hand near her cheek in a confident, slightly flirty stance. The background is a dreamy sunset waterfront city skyline with golden reflections on the water, pastel pink-orange-blue sky, sparkles, soft bokeh, and a ferris wheel on the left. Place 2 male silhouette figures in the midground, one on the left standing casually and one on the right in a suit-like pose, suggesting potential love interests. Add lush tropical flowers and leaves around the borders, especially pink hibiscus blossoms in the corners, plus floating hearts and glitter effects throughout. Use a bold, layered Japanese poster layout packed with decorative typography and stickers. At the top, handwritten-style Japanese text reads: 「笑って、泣いて、恋をして。アラサーの私、まだまだ諦めない！」 with pink emphasis and doodled heart lines. On the upper left, include a bright pink scalloped badge that says 「2026年 夏公開」. Along the right side, place vertical Japanese text: 「私の幸せ、探しにいきます。」. Near the lower left, add a pink ribbon label reading 「劇場版！」. Across the bottom center, create the large main title in bold decorative Japanese lettering: 「アラサー パン子の 婚活奮闘記」 with pink and dark navy text, white outlines, and a cute heart accent. Beneath it, add a pink slogan banner with yellow-highlighted text: 「恋に迷って、人生はもっとキラキラする♥」. Include small faux credits at the bottom in Japanese film-poster style. Around the lower area, place 4 small polaroid-style inset snapshots of the bunny character: 2 on the lower left and 2 on the lower right, each showing different cute situations such as a close-up pose, sitting at a cafe table, wearing sunglasses, or posing outdoors. Add a small notebook page labeled "Today's Mission" with checklist hearts in the lower left, and a plastic iced drink cup with straw plus sunglasses in the lower right. Overall feeling: feminine, comedic, inspirational, sparkly, over-the-top, and nostalgic, like a parody of a live-action romance film poster starring a mascot heroine. Use vivid pinks, peach sunset tones, sky blue, white, and navy, with glossy highlights and a polished promotional-poster finish.

items.prompt: A lavish dark fantasy anime illustration of 11 elegant young women gathered in a grand gothic library at night, composed like an elite magical academy coven portrait. The room is filled wall-to-wall with towering wooden bookshelves, rolling ladders, crimson velvet banners with occult gold sigils, carved paneling, candlelight, a warm table lamp on the far left, red upholstered armchairs and sofas, stacked antique books, potion bottles, crystal orbs, brass instruments, and a tall arched window showing a deep violet night sky. The overall palette is black, crimson, gold, and purple, with dramatic low-key lighting, rich shadows, glossy highlights, and a luxurious, sinister atmosphere. All 11 characters wear coordinated occult-school uniforms: black tailored jackets with gold embroidery and crest details, white shirts, red ties or ribbons, layered belts and chains, short skirts or fitted bottoms, black thigh-high stockings, and black capes lined in dark red. Place 3 seated prominently in the middle on ornate red chairs and sofa, 3 in the back row standing among the shelves, 3 in the front row on the floor or leaning close to the table, and 2 reclining at the far left and far right edges. Vary their hair colors and styles across the group, including {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"}, silver, black, red, blue, brown, and purple; use long wavy hair, twin tails, straight long hair, side ponytail, and loose layered cuts. Give each woman a calm, confident, slightly dangerous expression, as if they are genius witches or aristocratic students. Count and include 6 clearly visible magical effects or props being actively handled: 1 red flame floating above a raised hand in the back center, 1 glowing purple orb held by a standing girl near the upper right center, 1 swirling purple magic circle over an open book at the lower left, 1 faint purple arcane flame near the lap of the seated silver-haired girl on the right-center, 1 dark violet smoky aura around the far-right reclined girl, and 1 glowing purple crystal lamp or alchemical vessel on the central coffee table. Also include 4 additional glass vessels in the foreground and side tables: 1 crystal ball at the bottom left, 1 tall red potion bottle at the bottom right, and 2 smaller laboratory bottles beside it. Add multiple open and closed grimoires across laps, tables, and the floor, with at least 8 visible books in total. The central focal character is a poised blonde girl seated in the largest armchair, legs crossed, hand near her face, framed as the leader. Render in highly detailed polished anime style, ultra-detailed fabrics, intricate gold trim, subtle facial shading, luminous eyes, cinematic composition, wide group shot, fantasy key art quality, moody gothic academia, magical sisterhood, sharp focus, ornate environment, no modern objects.

The pond fills most of the scene, with exactly 10 blooming lotus flowers in pink, peach, and pale yellow, broad green lily pads, and exactly 9 visible koi fish in orange, white, black, and gold swimming in luminous swirling water. Tiny glowing fireflies and magical light specks float throughout the air and reflect on the pond surface. In the midground, an arched wooden bridge crosses the water. In the background, a serene Japanese garden extends with lush greenery, moss, shrubs, a stone lantern on the left, another warm garden lantern on the right, a small traditional pavilion with a dark tiled roof, and trees with red-orange autumn leaves mixed with deep green foliage. items.promptZh: 为 {argument name="country name" default="Switzerland"} 创建一张非常详细的复古风格插图旅行海报和信息图，显示为以干净的浅灰色背景为中心的雕刻 3D 地形图。在顶部放置一个巨大的粗体黑色无衬线标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="SWITZERLAND"}，下面有较小的大写文本，内容为 TRAVEL GUIDE，两侧是细水平分隔线和带有白色十字的微小红色盾牌标志。中心装饰是瑞士的凸起地形图，渲染得像一个微型立体模型，有岩石边界、绿色山谷、白雪皑皑的阿尔卑斯山峰、蓝色湖泊、蜿蜒的白色道路和几条铁路线。使用黑点标记和带有白色大写文本的粗体黑色胶囊标签在地图上准确标记 12 个目的地：巴塞尔、苏黎世、圣保罗。圣加仑、卢塞恩、伯尔尼、因特拉肯、库尔、圣加仑莫里茨、卢加诺、采尔马特、日内瓦和洛桑。将微型地标建筑和风景直接整合到地图上，包括教堂、老城塔楼、海滨建筑、城堡和山村，以及两列穿过景观的红色小火车。在地图周围添加周围的旅行蜉蝣：1 个破旧的棕色复古手提箱，左上角有旅行贴纸和红色瑞士十字徽章，左侧有 1 个古董黄铜罗盘，右上角有 1 张邮票，上面写着《前往瑞士旅行》，上面有山地艺术和邮政盖销标记，右上角的杆子上有 1 个逼真的瑞士国旗，左下角有 1 张倾斜的拍立得照片，上面有雪山和标题 {argument name="photo title" default=“瑞士阿尔卑斯山”}，总共 4 个刻面心形水晶吊饰，其中 2 个透明/银心和 2 个红心放置在构图周围。在右侧，添加带有图标插图和细分隔线的垂直观光列表，其中包含 12 个带有标题和简短景点线的城市条目：苏黎世 — 班霍夫大街；老城（Altstadt）；苏黎世湖。卢塞恩 — 卡佩尔桥；狮子纪念碑；卢塞恩湖。因特拉肯 — 少女峰；哈德库尔姆；布里恩茨湖和图恩。采尔马特——马特宏峰；戈尔内格拉特铁路；滑雪和徒步旅行。日内瓦——大喷泉；联合国;日内瓦湖。洛桑 — 奥林匹克博物馆；洛桑大教堂；日内瓦湖。伯尔尼 — 联邦宫； Zytglogge 钟楼；熊公园。英石。莫里茨 — 圣莫里茨湖；滑雪;奢侈品购物。卢加诺 — 卢加诺湖；布雷山；瑞士-意大利文化。英石。圣加仑 — 修道院图书馆；圣加仑大教堂；纺织博物馆。库尔——旧城区；主教宫；莱茵河谷。巴塞尔——艺术博物馆；巴塞尔大教堂；莱茵河。使用优质的编辑旅游品牌美学，结合逼真的微型地图渲染、清晰的排版、柔和的工作室阴影、物体下微妙的阴影以及精美的旅游活动外观。
items.prompt: Create a highly detailed vintage-inspired illustrated travel poster and infographic for {argument name="country name" default="Switzerland"}, shown as a sculpted 3D relief map centered on a clean light gray background. At the top, place a huge bold black sans-serif title reading {argument name="headline text" default="SWITZERLAND"}, with smaller uppercase text below reading TRAVEL GUIDE, flanked by thin horizontal divider lines and a tiny red shield emblem with a white cross. The centerpiece is a raised topographic map of Switzerland rendered like a miniature diorama, with rocky borders, green valleys, snowy alpine peaks, blue lakes, winding white roads, and a few rail lines. Mark exactly 12 destinations on the map with black dot markers and bold black capsule labels with white uppercase text: BASEL, ZÜRICH, ST. GALLEN, LUCERNE, BERN, INTERLAKEN, CHUR, ST. MORITZ, LUGANO, ZERMATT, GENEVA, and LAUSANNE. Integrate miniature landmark buildings and scenery directly onto the map, including churches, old town towers, waterfront structures, castles, and mountain villages, plus two small red trains moving through the landscape. Add surrounding travel ephemera arranged around the map: 1 worn brown vintage suitcase with travel stickers and a red Swiss-cross badge in the upper left, 1 antique brass compass rose on the left, 1 postage stamp in the upper right reading TRAVEL TO SWITZERLAND with mountain art and postal cancellation marks, 1 realistic Swiss flag on a pole in the top right corner, 1 tilted polaroid photo in the lower left with snowy mountains and the caption {argument name="photo caption" default="Swiss Alps"}, and 4 faceted heart-shaped crystal charms total, with 2 clear/silver hearts and 2 red hearts placed around the composition. On the right side, add a vertical sightseeing list with icon illustrations and thin separators, containing exactly 12 city entries with headings and short attraction lines: ZÜRICH — Bahnhofstrasse; Old Town (Altstadt); Lake Zurich. LUCERNE — Chapel Bridge; Lion Monument; Lake Lucerne. INTERLAKEN — Jungfraujoch; Harder Kulm; Lake Brienz & Thun. ZERMATT — Matterhorn; Gornergrat Railway; Skiing & Hiking. GENEVA — Jet d'Eau; United Nations; Lake Geneva. LAUSANNE — Olympic Museum; Lausanne Cathedral; Lake Geneva. BERN — Federal Palace; Zytglogge Clock Tower; Bear Park. ST. MORITZ — St. Moritz Lake; Skiing; Luxury Shopping. LUGANO — Lake Lugano; Monte Brè; Swiss-Italian Culture. ST. GALLEN — Abbey Library; St. Gallen Cathedral; Textile Museum. CHUR — Old Town; Bishop's Palace; Rhine Valley. BASEL — Kunstmuseum; Basel Minster; Rhine River. Use a premium editorial travel-brand aesthetic, combining realistic miniature map rendering, crisp typography, soft studio shadows, subtle drop shadows under objects, and a polished tourism campaign look.

items.title: Cinematic Beyblade Rooftop Launch
items.titleZh: 电影般的陀螺屋顶发射
items.promptZh: 一张超写实的电影动作照片，拍摄的是一名年轻人在黄金时段的日落时分在屋顶上跳跃，这张照片是从一个戏剧性的低角度拍摄的，背景是橙色的天空，天空中散布着零散的云彩。他位于画面中央，双膝弯曲，头戴编织草帽，敞开的{argument name="jacket color" default="bright red"}外套衬衫在风中飘扬，身穿白色背心，深色宽松工装裤，粗犷的深色靴子，分层项链，无指手套，腰间夹着一条带有发射器皮套的腰带。他的右臂伸向镜头，在可见的开伞绳上发射一个旋转的陀螺玩具，右侧最前景的玩具被渲染得很大，并且在深度和速度上都呈现运动模糊。在底部前景放置一个透明的塑料陀螺战斗体育场，捕捉日落的温暖反射，并带有清晰可见的印刷徽标文本{argument name =“brand text”default =“BEYBLADE X”}。城市天际线延伸到较低的背景，几座高层建筑在地平线附近的夕阳映衬下形成剪影。灯光非常温暖和背光，具有强烈的边缘光、电影对比度、微妙的镜头眩光和动态的织物运动。构图应该感觉像是{argument name="toy league" default="Beyblade X"}的真人宣传海报，以垂直海报格式强调活力、青春、速度和城市屋顶竞争。
items.prompt: A hyper-realistic cinematic action photo of a young man mid-jump above a rooftop at golden-hour sunset, captured from a dramatic low angle against a glowing orange sky filled with scattered clouds. He is centered in the frame, airborne with both knees bent, wearing a woven straw hat, an open {argument name="jacket color" default="bright red"} overshirt flaring in the wind, a white tank top, dark loose cargo-style pants, rugged dark boots, layered necklaces, fingerless gloves, and a belt with a launcher holster clipped at his waist. His right arm is thrust toward the camera, launching a spinning top toy on a visible ripcord, with the toy in the extreme foreground on the right side rendered large and motion-blurred for depth and speed. Place a transparent plastic Beyblade battle stadium at the bottom foreground, catching warm reflections from the sunset, with the clearly visible printed logo text {argument name="brand text" default="BEYBLADE X"}. The city skyline stretches across the lower background with several high-rise buildings silhouetted by the setting sun near the horizon. Lighting is intensely warm and backlit, with strong rim light, cinematic contrast, subtle lens flare, and dynamic fabric movement. The composition should feel like a live-action promotional poster for {argument name="toy franchise" default="Beyblade X"}, emphasizing energy, youth, speed, and urban rooftop competition, in vertical poster format.

items.promptZh: 黄金时段日落时分，在一条狭窄的古老欧洲石头街道上拍摄了电影般的真人动作场景，使用戏剧性的广角镜头从极低的特写视角拍摄。在中左前景中，一位充满活力的男性战士以{argument name="character name" default="Luffy"}为灵感，在运动中向前猛冲，他戴着草帽，穿着敞开的{argument name="jacket color" default="red"}衬衫、浅色背心和深色裤子。当他用手持发射器发起旋转陀螺战斗攻击时，他的身体剧烈扭曲。在右边的前景中，一名穿着深色西装和白衬衫、衣着得体、酷似黑帮的男子向前倾身，同时发射发射器，身后还有两名西装革履的男子，街上挤满了围观者。在眼前的前景中，正好有两个旋转陀螺在光滑的黑色表面上碰撞，产生明亮的橙色火花和围绕陀螺的多个圆形光迹，强调了速度和冲击力。环境密集而大气：两侧风化的石头建筑拔地而起，街道上挤满了观众，宏伟的巴洛克大教堂圆顶和塔楼矗立在阳光照射的背景中。使用强烈温暖的琥珀色和铜色灯光、深阴影、高对比度、灰尘和火花颗粒、坚韧纹理、戏剧性的运动模糊、浅景深和史诗般的大片色调。构图应该感觉像是地下战斗、街头决斗和动漫风格的真人改编的混合体，具有动能、张力和超细节的现实主义。
items.prompt: A cinematic live-action action scene in a narrow old European stone street at golden-hour sunset, shot from an extremely low, close-up perspective with a dramatic wide-angle lens. In the center-left foreground, a dynamic male fighter inspired by {argument name="character name" default="Luffy"} lunges forward in mid-motion, wearing a straw hat, an open {argument name="jacket color" default="red"} shirt, a light tank top, and dark pants. His body is twisted aggressively as he launches a spinning-top battle attack with a handheld launcher. In the right foreground, a sharply dressed gangster-like man in a dark suit and white shirt leans in, also firing a launcher, with two more suited men behind him and a crowd of onlookers filling the street. In the immediate foreground, exactly 2 spinning tops collide on a glossy dark surface, producing showers of bright orange sparks and multiple circular light trails that arc around them, emphasizing speed and impact. The environment is dense and atmospheric: weathered stone buildings rise on both sides, the street is packed with spectators, and a grand baroque cathedral dome and towers stand in the sunlit background. Use intense warm amber and copper lighting, deep shadows, high contrast, dust and spark particles, gritty texture, dramatic motion blur, shallow depth of field, and an epic blockbuster tone. The composition should feel like a hybrid of underground battle, street duel, and anime-inspired live-action adaptation, with kinetic energy, tension, and hyper-detailed realism.

items.title: 分词原理手绘科普图
items.prompt: A cute hand-drawn scrapbook-style horizontal educational infographic in Chinese on a warm beige paper background with rounded borders, pastel doodles, tape stickers, tiny stars, and a classroom-notebook aesthetic. The top center has a large headline in playful handwritten Chinese: "什么是分词？" with the second half in coral pink and the rest in dark brown. On the upper left, a chibi Shiba Inu teacher character stands facing forward, wearing a pale yellow shirt and blue necktie, holding a pointer stick upward, with a speech bubble that says "今天来学习分词(Tokenization)!". On the upper right, a cute blue square token mascot labeled "TOKEN" sits smiling, with blush cheeks, tiny legs and arms, and a magnifying glass; next to it is a speech bubble saying "我是 Token！被切得越合理，模型越聪明！". Near the right edge, add a small hanging notepad card reading "知识点 收藏夹" with a heart icon. Beneath the headline, place a rounded dashed text box containing the definition: "分词是将人类可读的文本切分成 Token 的过程。" with the word "Token" highlighted in blue. Below that, add a line of explanatory text: "下面以 “程序员Left” 和 “人工智能” 为例，看看不同的分词方式：" with "程序员Left" highlighted in light blue and "人工智能" highlighted in pink. The lower half contains exactly 4 rounded pastel panels arranged left to right, each with a numbered badge and title. Panel 1 is mint green and titled "1 词级分词". It includes the subtitle "按完整语义划分文本" and exactly 3 token bubbles: "程序员", "Left", "人工智能". At the bottom of this panel, show the Shiba Inu teacher giving a thumbs up with a speech bubble saying "语义完整，容易理解！". Panel 2 is pale yellow and titled "2 字符级分词". It includes the subtitle "逐字切分文本" and exactly 9 circular token bubbles arranged in rows: "程", "序", "员", "L", "e", "f", "t", "人", "工", "智", "能"—visually presented as individual characters from the example text, in a compact grid. At the bottom, show the blue token mascot holding a pencil, with a speech bubble saying "粒度最细，但序列会很长~". Panel 3 is pale pink and titled "3 子词分词". It includes the subtitle "按词根以及前后缀划分" and exactly 5 token bubbles: "程序", "员", "Left", "人工", "智能". At the bottom, show the Shiba Inu teacher thinking with one paw at its mouth and a question mark above the head, with a speech bubble saying "折中方案，效果 often 很好！". Panel 4 is pale blue and titled "4 字节级分词". It includes the subtitle "将字词转为字节编码，根据转换后的内容进行组合和划分" and displays exactly 14 small circular code bubbles: "E7", "A8", "8B", "...", "66", "74", "E4", "BA", "BA", "E8", "83", "BD", "..." arranged in multiple rows like encoded bytes. At the bottom, show the blue token mascot again, smiling, with a speech bubble saying "适合处理任意文本！" and a tiny light bulb doodle nearby. Across the very bottom, place a rounded banner note that reads: "不同分词方式各有优势，实际应用中会根据任务和数据选择合适的方案哦！". Use soft pastel green, yellow, pink, and blue for the four panels, dark brown handwritten text, subtle shadows, rounded shapes, and adorable kawaii expressions throughout. Keep the composition balanced, clean, and friendly, like a polished social-media science explainer poster.

items.prompt: A cute horizontal educational infographic in a hand-drawn scrapbook style on a pastel desk-and-paper collage background, explaining Chinese word segmentation with byte-level BPE. The scene is divided into 3 clearly separated instructional sections arranged from left to right across a wide banner. On the far left stands a chibi Shiba Inu mascot, {argument name="character name" default="柴小七"}, with warm tan and cream fur, round face, small triangular ears, rosy cheeks, and a curious expression, holding a cup and standing beside a small desk with drawers, pencils, and a chair. Above the dog is a bold rounded white title box with black Chinese text: {argument name="headline text" default="中文分词：Byte-level BPE（BBPE）流程科普"}. In the first teaching section near the upper middle, show 4 small translucent blue token-shaped tiles lined up on a wooden shelf, each labeled “Token”, with a curved arrow and small handwritten Chinese note “词频语料统计” pointing toward the next step. In the second section, place a large magnifying glass highlighting 3 small frequency tiles labeled exactly “E7”, “94”, and “B5”, with the section label in a yellow note reading “2. 频率统计与合并”; beneath and inside the magnified area include a large black Chinese character “电”, and nearby a handwritten note “频繁字节对”. In the third section at lower middle-left, add a wooden sign and a larger merged translucent blue token tile labeled “Token”, with a small yellow note reading “3. 跨字合并”, large black Chinese text “我们→”, and a caption strip below that says “高频词组合并为 Token”. On the far right, show the final explanatory result with 3 small byte boxes labeled “E7”, “94”, and “B5” above a large black Chinese character “电”, then a note card reading “1. 字节级编码（UTF-8）”, and below that the large black Chinese word “我们”. Connect the sections with curved arrows in pink, blue, and green to show process flow. Include 1 animated blue token mascot with tiny arms and legs near the center-bottom, smiling and waving. Use soft cream, pink, beige, and light blue colors, thick clean outlines, sticker-like cutout shapes, taped paper corners, notebook textures, pencils around the edges, and a friendly hand-account illustration style suitable for a science explainer graphic.

items.title: 千禧年家庭客厅快照
items.promptZh: 这是一张在中国 2000 年代初期的简陋客厅里拍摄的真实纪实风格的室内家庭快照，拍摄得就像一张真实的消费者相机照片，环境日光柔和，纹理轻微，色彩自然，右下角有一个黄色日期戳，内容为 {argument name="date stamp" default="2003.02.02"}。场景中正好出现了 3 个人：前景中的一个小女孩盘腿坐在有图案的地毯上，玩着一辆彩色玩具车；一名穿着浅灰色毛衣和蓝色裤子的成年人跪在电视柜附近的地板上；一名穿着深蓝色长袖衬衫的成年人靠在沙发旁的电子设备上。让图像感觉不拘一格、怀旧且具有令人信服的摄影效果，就好像在家里的一个普通下午拍摄的一样。左侧有一台巨大的 CRT 电视，显示黑白静态雪花，位于深色媒体架上，下面堆放着电子设备和架子。在中央背景中，放置一个显示 {argument name="calendaryear" default="2003"} 的挂历，以及一个木制搁架单元，用于放置镶框的家庭照片、书籍、磁带和小家居用品。右侧有一张沙发，上面覆盖着浅色花卉蕾丝套，扶手上放着一个蓝色文件夹或笔记本。添加家居杂乱和生活细节：电视旁边的地板上正好有两盆盆栽，一块有图案的地毯覆盖了大部分地板，以及略显昏暗、温暖的日常公寓氛围。孩子应该穿一件粉红色的毛衣和深色的裤子，扎着小辫子，注意力集中在玩具上。整体风格应该高度真实，就像真正的家庭档案照片而不是插图，具有可信的视角、柔和的阴影和微妙的镜头缺陷。
items.prompt: A candid documentary-style indoor family snapshot in a modest early-2000s living room in China, photographed like a real consumer camera photo with soft ambient daylight, slight grain, natural color, and a yellow date stamp in the bottom right reading {argument name="date stamp" default="2003.02.02"}. The scene shows exactly 3 people: a little girl in the foreground sitting cross-legged on a patterned carpet and playing with a colorful toy car, one adult kneeling on the floor near the TV stand in a light gray sweater and blue pants, and one adult leaning over electronics equipment in a dark blue long-sleeve shirt near a sofa. Preserve the same East Asian celestial imperial design language, floating architecture above clouds, gilded ornamentation, warm sunset lighting, and ultra-detailed realistic concept-art look, then turn it into a polished multi-panel lore board on a dark background with elegant editorial typography. Include 8 labeled sections: 1 large hero overview panel for the civilization, 1 architecture section with 9 images, 1 characters section with 7 full-body character designs, 1 clothing and armor section with 6 outfit variations, 1 vehicles and transport section with 4 vehicle designs, 1 world map section with 1 illustrated map, 1 environments section with 6 environment images, and 1 culture and details section with 6 close-up detail images. items.prompt: A vintage hand-drawn Chinese infographic on textured off-white paper with torn deckled edges, printed in a limited two-ink palette of deep purple and bright cyan accents, with halftone shading and poster-like comic line art. The composition compares intuitive manual cooking versus tool-assisted cooking and externalized cognition. On the left, a large adult cook in an apron is dramatically stir-frying in a wok with flames, flying ingredients, smoke swirls, and energetic motion lines; the cook’s face is obscured by a rectangular blur block. Above the head is a glowing brain-like thought bubble containing 3 small icons: a seasoning bottle, a flame, and a timer/clock, with rays radiating outward. At the lower left, a broken chain hangs beside large bold Chinese text reading “全凭手感”. Below the cook, a smaller confused person mixing in a bowl looks worried, surrounded by exactly 4 question marks. In the center, multiple thick arrows point from the cook’s intuition toward a structured cooking workflow. At upper center is large Chinese text “照着做”. Beneath it, a hand holds a smartphone recipe screen showing visible Chinese text including “5克盐” and “中火3分钟”, with a finger tapping the screen. Around the phone are measured cooking tools and ingredients: 2 measuring spoons, 1 measuring cup, 1 digital scale, and 6 small bowls arranged neatly, plus a pot on a stove with steam rising and a finished plated dish nearby. Near the plated dish is Chinese text “七八分” and a 5-star rating row with exactly 4 filled stars and 1 empty star. On the right, show a concept map of externalized cognition around a simple smiling stick-figure cook standing behind a table of food. items.prompt: A dense surreal collage poster blending retro Japanese street culture, dystopian futurism, environmental collapse, and cosmic dream imagery in one vertically stacked composition. The image should feel like layered mixed-media street art made from torn posters, ink illustration, manga textures, watercolor washes, newspaper print, spray paint, and graphic design fragments. The overall palette combines deep midnight blues, black, cream paper tones, neon magenta, crimson red, cherry blossom pink, and industrial gray. In the upper left, show a large red sun behind Mount Fuji with cherry blossom branches crossing the corner, and a small airplane in the sky. Along the left side and lower left, depict a crowded Tokyo-like city street packed with pedestrians, glowing signs, dense buildings, and a tall cylindrical building with a smiley face near the top and a vertical sign reading AI IS WATCHING YOU. Include stylized Japanese-style signage on nearby buildings. Add a giant wave motif and a pagoda integrated into the urban scene. In the upper center, place a dark industrial skyline with multiple smokestacks releasing massive black clouds, transitioning into a giant astronaut floating forward with one hand reaching out. In the upper right, transform the sky into outer space with stars, a swirling purple-and-blue nebula, and a black hole. Beneath that, create a futuristic eco-city of sleek skyscrapers mixed with lush trees, cliffs, and cascading waterfalls. Add a glowing neon sign on the far right that reads DREAMING IS FREE. Near the astronaut, place a torn poster with the text THE FUTURE IS UNWRITTEN in large type and below it But we are the authors in smaller type. Across the center, layer floral elements including cherry blossoms and large roses around a partially obscured central human portrait to give the sense of fragmented identity. In the lower center, show a person from behind wearing a dark hooded jacket with graffiti-style text reading QUESTION EVERYTHING. Around them, include additional cutout portrait fragments, a Mondrian-inspired geometric block of red, blue, yellow, white, and black rectangles, a classical marble bust fragment, a white dove in flight, a small protest sign that reads EQUALITY ≠ EQUITY, and a seated figure looking toward the futuristic landscape. In the lower left corner, include part of a noir-style person in a dark hat and coat, and in the lower right, part of a manga-style female face in profile. Scatter graffiti, torn edges, ink splatters, layered paper textures, and poster remnants throughout. The composition should be extremely busy, cinematic, and thought-provoking, balancing hope and anxiety, tradition and technology, nature and urban overload, in the style of a high-detail contemporary collage mural.

Create a premium Japanese figure advertisement poster on a clean off-white background with subtle pale gray brushstroke textures and tiny scattered gold flecks. The layout should look like a luxury hobby product introduction page for an original anime/mecha statue. The main centerpiece is a highly detailed 1/7 scale-style figure of {argument name="character name" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}, a slim teenage anime girl in a dramatic crouching attack pose, turned three-quarters to the viewer, with one knee bent under her body and the other mechanical leg planted forward. She raises a katana overhead with both hands as if about to strike. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur block. She has long brown hair with loose strands flying outward, a white headband with a small mechanical side ornament, and a navy Japanese sailor school uniform with a cropped long-sleeve top, red neckerchief, short pleated skirt, and exposed midriff. Her arms and legs are mostly robotic: metallic silver-gray mechanical arms with articulated fingers and visible joints, bulky armored mech thighs and calves with realistic pistons, seams, weathering, and small orange caution markings. The sword is a polished katana with a white-and-black wrapped handle and a metallic guard. Render the statue as a realistic painted collectible figure with studio lighting, glossy and matte material contrast, precise shadows, and showroom-grade product photography.

Design the page like a commercial figure brochure with exactly 5 numbered detail callout sections. On the left side, stack 4 rectangular close-up panels vertically, each with a number and Japanese label plus short descriptive body text in Japanese: panel 1 shows a close-up of the face and hair, labeled "01 表情"; panel 2 shows the upper torso and uniform, labeled "02 上半身"; panel 3 shows the raised mechanical arms and sword grip, labeled "03 メカアーム&ソード"; panel 4 shows the mechanical legs, labeled "04 メカレッグ". At the bottom right, add a wider rectangular panel labeled "05 武装・ディテール" showing exactly 2 katana close-up views arranged horizontally, one above the other. Keep all panel images bordered lightly and integrated into the poster layout.

At the upper left, place a large expressive brush-calligraphy title reading {argument name="main title" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}, with an ink-brush circle motif behind the first word. At the upper right, add a gold minimalist logo and the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}, with small Japanese tagline text beneath it. Along the right side, place a vertical Japanese promotional slogan in elegant dark text. In the lower left area, include small product specification text in Japanese with exactly these lines of product info styling: scale, product name, sculptor credit, paint credit, brand, and a release date line. Use {argument name="release date" default="2025年12月"} in the schedule area. Along the bottom, add a dark horizontal footer bar with the gold brand logo on the left, the brand name repeated, a short Japanese brand statement in small text across the center, and tiny legal/disclaimer text at the far right. Overall style: high-end Japanese figure marketing sheet, refined editorial composition, realistic collectible statue photography, elegant white-and-gold packaging aesthetic, anime girl fused with hard-surface mecha design, polished and premium.

items.title: 日式未来都市夜景
items.promptZh: 一幅超详细的超高分辨率垂直插图，展示了一座超现实的日本未来主义大城市的夜晚，从一个非常高、陡峭的向下角度穿过狭窄的建筑物峡谷观看，仿佛站在黑暗的山坡小巷或屋顶俯瞰上。保持构图 9 分 16 秒的戏剧性，以深入的视角观察巨大的发光城市盆地，那里挤满了层层叠叠的低矮屋顶、狭窄的街道、高架人行道和逐渐消失在远方的高耸的摩天大楼。两侧都是密集的前景建筑，构成了场景：左上角，一个巨大的发光红色纸灯笼标志，上面悬挂着一个古老的木屋檐，上面挂着粗体的黑色日文字符；在左上方，一个巨大的红色纸灯笼标志，上面悬挂着一个古老的木屋檐；右边是一座高大的建筑立面，有许多明亮的窗户和几个垂直的霓虹灯标志；在整个图像中，纠结的头顶公用电线和电线杆穿过视野。下面的城市应该会让人感到拥挤而又迷人，将复古昭和时代的小巷美学与赛博朋克未来主义融为一体。使用丰富的图形绘画风格，具有强烈的黑色墨色线条、大胆的卡通阴影形状和发光的霓虹灯口音，保留中途之旅般的电影美感，同时添加更精细的环境细节。主要颜色是炽热的橙色和琥珀色的窗光、饱和的深红色和猩红色的标牌、深紫色的夜空、热洋红色的亮点和电青色的色调。通过剪影和亮着的窗户暗示着无数微小的可读的微观场景，充斥着下城：街道上的节日游行、夜生活人群、疲惫不堪的工薪阶层、小巷中隐藏的帮派人物、娱乐巷中的舞者、公寓窗户里学习的学生、争吵的情侣、发光屏幕前的游戏玩家，以及嵌入整个建筑的许多其他人类小故事。强调都市的辉煌与情感的孤立、拥挤的无聊与颓废的美丽之间的对比，带有对毫无意义的现代生活的讽刺意味。尽管密度很大，但图像必须在美学上保持和谐，清晰的小细节随处可见，日语中发光的标牌，分层的深度，大气的薄雾，以及超现实的、略显压抑但美丽的情绪。
items.prompt: A hyper-detailed ultra-high-resolution vertical illustration of a surreal Japanese futuristic megacity at night, viewed from a very high, steep downward angle through a cramped canyon of buildings, as if standing on a dark hillside alley or rooftop overlook. Keep the composition 9:16 and dramatic, with a deep plunging perspective into an immense glowing urban basin packed with tightly layered low rooftops, narrow streets, elevated walkways, and towering skyscrapers fading into the distance. Frame the scene with dense foreground architecture on both sides: on the upper left, a large glowing red paper lantern sign with bold black Japanese characters hanging from an old wooden eave; on the right, a tall building facade with many lit windows and several vertical neon signs; across the image, tangled overhead utility wires and poles cut through the view. The city below should feel overcrowded yet mesmerizing, blending retro Showa-era alleyway aesthetics with cyberpunk futurism. Use a rich, graphic painterly style with strong black inky linework, bold cel-shaded shapes, and luminous neon accents, preserving a Midjourney-like cinematic beauty while adding much finer environmental detail. Dominant colors are blazing orange and amber window light, saturated crimson and scarlet signage, deep violet night sky, hot magenta highlights, and electric cyan accents. Populate the lower city with countless tiny readable micro-scenes implied through silhouettes and lit windows: festival processions in the streets, nightlife crowds, exhausted salary workers, hidden gang figures in side alleys, dancers in entertainment lanes, students studying in apartment windows, arguing couples, gamers at glowing screens, and many other small human stories embedded throughout the architecture. Emphasize the contrast between urban splendor and emotional isolation, overcrowded boredom and decadent beauty, with a satirical undertone about meaningless modern life. The image must remain aesthetically harmonious despite the density, with crisp small details visible everywhere, glowing signage in Japanese, layered depth, atmospheric haze, and a surreal, slightly oppressive but beautiful mood.

items.promptZh: 坚韧的复古宣传风格海报插图，采用有限的黑色、深红色和旧米色纸张纹理调色板，设计就像大胆的复古丝网印刷动作海报。以戏剧性的对角线构图展示 2 位风格化的女性，她们在战斗中僵住了。左边，一名穿着白色短制服、戴着棱角分明的护士帽、打扮得像护士的女人向前猛冲，单膝抬起，单臂弯曲，身体急剧缩短。右边，一名穿着合身黑色连衣裙、戴着宽边黑色帽子的女人向后倾斜，摆出防御姿势，一只手臂举过头顶，另一只手臂靠近躯干，长长的黑发在她身后飘逸。用棱角分明的几何形状、夸张的四肢、锐利的阴影和高对比度的黑色面部平面渲染两个人物。使用强烈的红色对角光线扫过背景，并用黑色建筑条和抽象的建构主义形状构成场景。添加仿旧纸纹、墨水磨损和轻微套准不良，以获得磨损的打印效果。在右上角放置一个模糊的小猴头标志。在左下角包含大块的海报文字，共 3 行，分别为“苏格兰食谱：”、“肉末和”、“纹身”，前 2 行为米色，最后 2 行为浓红色，使用粗方形无衬线显示字体。在右下角添加一个类似红色十字的图形元素。整体情绪是暴力的、讽刺的、电影般的和引人注目的图形，就像苏联建构主义低俗电影海报广告{argument name="dish name" default="苏格兰食谱：肉馅和馍馍"}。
items.prompt: A gritty retro propaganda-style poster illustration with a limited palette of black, deep red, and aged beige paper texture, designed like a bold vintage screen-printed action poster. Show 2 stylized women in a dramatic diagonal composition, frozen mid-fight. On the left, a woman dressed like a nurse in a short white uniform and angular nurse cap lunges forward with one knee raised and one arm bent, her body sharply foreshortened. On the right, a woman in a fitted black dress and wide-brim black hat leans backward in a defensive pose, one arm raised above her head and the other near her torso, long dark hair flowing behind her. Render both figures with hard-edged geometric shapes, exaggerated limbs, sharp shadows, and high-contrast noir facial planes. Use aggressive red diagonal rays sweeping across the background, with black architectural bars and abstract constructivist shapes framing the scene. Add distressed paper grain, ink wear, and slight misregistration for a worn print effect. Place a small blurred monkey head emblem in the upper-right corner. Include large blocky poster text in the lower left across 3 lines reading “SCOTTISH RECIPE:” then “MINCE AND” then “TATTIES”, with the first 2 lines in beige and the final 2 lines in strong red, using a heavy squared sans-serif display font. Add a red cross-like graphic element in the lower-right corner. The overall mood is violent, satirical, cinematic, and strikingly graphic, like a Soviet constructivist pulp film poster advertising {argument name="dish name" default="Scottish Recipe: Mince and Tatties"}.

items.titleZh: 日式轻小说人物关系图
items.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the cast reference, transform the simple lineup into an ornate Japanese light-novel character relationship chart poster. Keep the same 10 named characters and reuse their existing portrait art as the base visuals, but redesign the layout into a polished infographic on a soft cream and pale-blue fantasy background with decorative borders, sparkles, roses, and a small European-style hotel building vignette in the upper left. Add a large Japanese title at the top, 「支配人はかりそめの顔」, with the subtitle 「キャラクター紹介＆相関図」, and place a dark badge in the upper right that says 「ネタバレ配慮版」. Put the heroine 一条 紬希 in the center as the main focus in a framed character card labeled 「主人公」, and place 秦野 啓司 in a large framed card on the right as the key counterpart. Arrange the remaining 8 characters around them in individual profile cards: 加賀坂 その葉, 川原 澪, 樫村, 紬希の母, ハルカ, 杏子, 美果, 桜子. Connect the characters with multiple colored arrows and relationship labels to visualize the network; include exactly 14 visible relationship labels: 「親友」, 「理解者」, 「本音を見抜く」, 「憧れ」, 「相談」, 「画策」, 「仲直り中」, 「直感的理解」, 「メンター」, 「実務支援」, 「保護者的存在」, 「後輩　ムードメーカー」, 「後輩　グループを支える」, 「後輩　明るさ・希望」. Also add the 8 central horizontal relationship callouts between 一条 紬希 and 秦野 啓司: 「偽溶み→公認」, 「ライバル」, 「秘密を共有」, 「対等な相棒」, 「気になる存在」, plus a pink central badge reading 「反発から信頼へ」, and 3 lower callouts: 「信頼」, 「協力を後押し」, 「二人の空気に気づく」. Include a gold-ribbon group label above the three lower girls that says 「ASTRALの仲間たち」. Add a bottom section with exactly 10 smaller summary cards, one for each character again, lined up across the width. On the far right, add 2 boxed sidebar sections titled 「作品のキーワード」 and 「関係の見どころ」; the first should contain 4 bullet items with icons, and the second should contain 4 bullet items with icons. Fill every card with dense Japanese profile text and role tags in a clean editorial style, as if for a promotional relationship guide included with a novel. Make the overall design elegant, readable, romantic-mystery themed, and magazine-quality.

items.promptZh: 一张逼真的生活方式时尚照片，照片中一位女士站在温暖、阳光明媚的现代阁楼客厅里，从大腿中部向上取景，面对镜头，双手插在一件超大黑色缎面大学风格飞行员夹克的口袋里。这件夹克是明显的焦点：光滑的黑色面料，罗纹衣​​领和下摆，按扣前襟，略微蓬松的袖子，胸前有大号大学字母，上面写着{argument name="front text" default="NEW YORK"}，用粗体橙色字母和白色轮廓。在上袖上添加较小的橙白色运动贴片，并在另一袖上添加白色块文字，营造真正的团队夹克感觉。为模特设计一头长长的、宽松的、柔软的波浪状平衡发，头发颜色为{argument name="hair color" default="dark Brown with caramelhighlight"}，佩戴简约的珠宝，包括分层的金项链，以及在框架底部可见的浅灰色运动裤。为了保护隐私，用居中的矩形模糊块故意遮挡脸部。环境是简约的米色内饰，左边高大的工业窗户投射出强烈的早晨阳光和几何阴影，一张带枕头的奶油色沙发，一张低矮的咖啡桌，上面放着三本书和一个深色的碗，苍白的墙壁，背景是一张简单的木制边桌。以高端编辑电子商务风格拍摄，具有自然的金色光线、柔和的阴影、锐利的夹克细节、浅景深、中性暖色调和干净的高级街头服饰美学。
items.prompt: A realistic lifestyle fashion photo of a woman standing indoors in a warm, sunlit modern loft living room, framed from mid-thigh up, facing the camera with her hands tucked into the pockets of an oversized black satin varsity-style bomber jacket. The jacket is the clear focus: glossy black fabric, ribbed collar and hem, snap-button front, slightly puffed sleeves, and large collegiate lettering across the chest that reads {argument name="front text" default="NEW YORK"} in bold orange letters with white outlines. Add a smaller orange-and-white sports patch on the upper sleeve and white block text on the opposite sleeve for an authentic team-jacket feel. Style the model with long, loose, softly wavy balayage hair in {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown with caramel highlights"}, minimal jewelry including layered gold necklaces, and light gray sweatpants visible at the bottom of frame. Keep the face intentionally obscured with a centered rectangular blur block for privacy. The setting is a minimalist beige interior with tall industrial windows on the left casting strong morning sunlight and geometric shadows, a cream sofa with a pillow, a low coffee table with 3 stacked books and a dark bowl, pale walls, and a simple wooden side table in the background. items.promptZh: 一幅黑暗的赛博朋克动画插图，一个孤独的年轻女子，带着巨大的机械爪臂，站在夜晚雨天霓虹灯笼罩的小巷里，从一个戏剧性的低角度观看，让她看起来雄伟而危险。她脸色苍白，黑色的长发遮住了眼睛，一双红眸隐隐泛着红光，表情冰冷，没有任何感情。她穿着一件超大连帽冬季科技外套，配有大毛皮镶边兜帽和毛皮袖口，分层黑色战术街头服饰，配有肩带、腰带，宽松的深色裤子塞进厚重的靴子里。她的左臂被一个巨大的工业机械假肢所取代，该假肢占据了前景，里面装有密集的齿轮、活塞、管道、电缆、裸露的机械装置和发光的红色指示灯，末端是 3 个长而弯曲的爪子，爪子锋利的尖端从内部被深红色的能量照亮。在外套和机器上添加小贴花、警告标签和垂直东亚标牌。将她置于一条狭窄的未来城市街道上，街道上遍布高耸的建筑物、悬挂的电缆、薄雾和许多垂直的霓虹灯标志，上面写着红色和青绿色的汉字。路面湿漉漉的，像镜子一样，反射着爪子和周围标牌发出的红光。使用炭黑色、青铜色、深红色和病态青色等坚韧、超细节、高对比度的调色板。情绪冷漠、喜怒无常、令人生畏、聪明、略带忧郁。高度细致的线条、复杂的机械渲染、电影灯光、雨雾、城市密度、动漫遇上硬表面概念艺术、杰作品质。
items.prompt: A dark cyberpunk anime illustration of a lone young woman with a massive mechanical claw arm standing in a rainy neon-drenched alley at night, viewed from a dramatic low angle that makes her look imposing and dangerous. She wears an oversized hooded winter-tech coat with a large fur-trimmed hood and fur cuffs, layered black tactical streetwear, straps, belts, and baggy dark pants tucked into heavy boots. Her left arm is replaced by an enormous industrial mech prosthetic that dominates the foreground, packed with dense gears, pistons, tubing, cables, exposed mechanisms, and glowing red indicator lights, ending in 3 long curved talons with razor-sharp tips lit from within by crimson energy. Add small decals, warning labels, and vertical East Asian signage on the coat and machinery. Set her in a narrow futuristic city street filled with towering buildings, hanging cables, mist, and many vertical neon signs with Chinese characters in red and cyan-green. The pavement is wet and mirror-like, reflecting the red lights from the claw and the surrounding signage. Use a gritty, ultra-detailed, high-contrast palette of charcoal black, gunmetal, deep crimson, and sickly teal. The mood is cold, moody, intimidating, intelligent, and slightly melancholic. Highly detailed linework, complex mechanical rendering, cinematic lighting, rain haze, urban density, anime-meets-hard-surface concept art, masterpiece quality.

items.title: 雨巷机械巨臂少女
items.promptZh: 一幅黑暗的赛博朋克动画插图，描绘了一个怪异的小女孩在夜间站在一条被雨水浸湿的狭窄小巷中，从戏剧性的低角度观看，使她的超大机械臂占据了前景。她穿着一件宽大的白色连帽外套，上面印有补丁状的符号、图表和工业标记，连帽在她的脸上投下深深的阴影。她的脸很小，像娃娃一样，黑色的短直发，苍白的皮肤，两只发光的白色眼睛没有可见的瞳孔，表情安静而没有感情。她的一只手臂被一根比她的身体大得多的巨大重型机械肢体所取代，并向观众延伸。该手臂由分层的白色装甲板、裸露的接头、电缆、螺栓、活塞和分段机械制成，上面有划痕和污垢，呈现出磨损的战斗工业外观。这只手正好有 4 个巨大的爪状手指接触潮湿的地面，每个手指末端都有长长的黑红色爪子，红色的内部灯光通过指关节、手腕和前臂上的通风口和间隙发出光芒。在上臂下方添加悬挂的黑色电缆，并在肘部和肩部机构周围添加微妙的红光泄漏。她的另一只袖子通常挂在身边。她在外套下面穿着深色短裤或裙子，小腿周围有超大的蓬松白色暖腿套，光脚在反光的人行道上清晰可见。巷子里密布着管道、导管、电缆、通风口和旧标牌，包括背景中的青绿色垂直霓虹灯标志，营造出喜怒无常的青色背光。雨水穿过场景，水坑反射出青色和红色的光芒，爪尖附近散布着微小的橙红色火花。使用肮脏的白色、木炭色、青色和深红色的柔和调色板，具有电影对比度、高度细致的线条、坚韧的纹理、大气雾气和令人难以忘怀的未来反乌托邦情绪。制作角色{argument name="character name" default="a hooded mech-arm girls"}，穿上{argument name="coat color" default="dirty White"}外套、{argument name="glow color" default="crimson red"}机械灯和{argument name="neon color" default="teal green"}小巷标牌。
items.prompt: A dark cyberpunk anime illustration of a small eerie girl standing in a narrow rain-soaked alley at night, viewed from a dramatic low angle that makes her oversized mechanical arm dominate the foreground. One of her arms is replaced by an enormous heavy mech limb that is far larger than her body, extending toward the viewer. The hand has exactly 4 massive clawed fingers touching the wet ground, each ending in long black-red talons, with red internal lights glowing through vents and gaps across the knuckles, wrist, and forearm. Add dangling black cables beneath the upper arm and subtle red light leaks around the elbow and shoulder mechanisms. Her other sleeve hangs normally at her side. She wears dark shorts or a skirt beneath the coat and oversized fluffy white leg warmers around her lower legs, with bare feet visible on the reflective pavement. The alley is dense with pipes, conduits, cables, vents, and old signage, including teal-green vertical neon signs in the background, creating a moody cyan backlight. Rain falls through the scene, puddles reflect teal and red light, and tiny orange-red sparks scatter near the claw tips on the ground. Use a muted palette of dirty white, charcoal, teal, and crimson, with cinematic contrast, highly detailed linework, gritty textures, atmospheric fog, and a haunting futuristic dystopian mood. Make the character {argument name="character name" default="a hooded mech-arm girl"}, with {argument name="coat color" default="dirty white"} outerwear, {argument name="glow color" default="crimson red"} mechanical lights, and {argument name="neon color" default="teal green"} alley signage.

items.promptZh: 逼真的特写桌面场景显示一大堆未煮过的长粒白米倒在温暖的棕色木质表面上，几乎填满了整个画面。相机稍微抬高并与稻堆成一定角度，因此稻米在图像中央形成一个宽阔的圆顶，数千颗单独的稻谷清晰可见，并在温暖的室内灯光下柔和地照亮。在米中隐藏一个小复活节彩蛋：左下区域附近正好有一颗不寻常的米粒水平旋转，并在其表面以清晰的小字母整齐地刻有文字“{argument name=”engraved text”default=”GPT Image 2”}”。在左下角添加一个带有亮红色轮廓的圆形放大标注，放大周围米粒中的单个雕刻颗粒，以便文本变得可读。另外，在右下角添加 1 个小画中画插图，显示休闲的室内直播或采访环境，4 个人围坐在圆木桌和一台打开的笔记本电脑周围，环境光线温暖，面孔略显模糊；插图应该感觉像是辅助上下文缩略图，比主稻米图像小得多。优先考虑逼真的纹理、令人信服的宏观细节、自然的阴影、大米中微妙的象牙色变化，以及突出显示的谷物上清晰但可信的雕刻文字。

items.promptZh: 使用单色宝蓝色调色板为{argument name="club name" default="Cruzeiro"}制作一张引人注目的垂直足球致敬海报。前景中展示了两名男足球运动员，两人都穿着不同时代的蓝色克鲁塞罗主场球衣。前面的球员身材较大，居中稍偏右，腰部以上，右手食指举起，呈现出动态的奔跑姿势，肌肉发达，表情严肃，胜利的表情，现代的蓝色球衣，带有白色肩部条纹，白色赞助商标志，胸前有俱乐部的白色星星徽章。后卫球员身材略小，位于左侧和后方，同样在运动，穿着复古的蓝色球衣，带有复古的白领和经典的汽水赞助商标志，让人想起俱乐部的早期时代。他们的面孔应该是通用的并且不可识别。在背景中，在他们身后中央放置一个巨大的圆形克鲁塞罗徽章，挤满了蓝色灯光的体育场人群，以及恰好两面飘扬的旗帜：一面在左上角，带有俱乐部徽章，一面在右上角，带有大号支持者文字。添加大气烟雾、晕影阴影和分层灯光效果，打造英雄般、喜庆的运动设计外观。恰好包含 4 个融入构图的葡萄牙语文本元素：左侧，风格化的白色字体“O INÍCIO DE UM FENÔMENO”；右侧是“O MAIOR DE TODOS”，带有小皇冠图标；横跨下部中心，用非常大的白色画笔脚本，{argument name="main header" default="FENÔMENO"}；在最底部的间隔大写文本中，{argument name="bottom tagline" default="ONTEM UM SONHO.HOJE UMA LENDA."} 最后一个单词以亮蓝色突出显示。在主标题下添加手写签名，签名编号为 {argument name="jersey number" default="9"}。使用高对比度的体育海报合成、坚韧的纹理、锐利的球衣织物细节、戏剧性的边缘照明以及适合俱乐部传奇庆祝活动的史诗般的球迷文化氛围。
items.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical football tribute poster in a monochrome royal-blue palette for {argument name="club name" default="Cruzeiro"}. Show 2 male footballers layered in the foreground, both wearing blue Cruzeiro home jerseys from different eras. The front player is larger, centered slightly right, shown from the waist up in a dynamic running pose with his right index finger raised, muscular build, serious triumphant expression, modern blue jersey with white shoulder stripes, white sponsor logos, and the club's white stars crest on the chest. The back player is slightly smaller, positioned left and behind, also in motion, wearing a vintage blue jersey with a retro white collar and a classic soda sponsor logo, evoking an earlier era of the club. Their faces should be generic and not identifiable. In the background, place a huge circular Cruzeiro crest centered behind them, a packed stadium crowd with blue lighting, and exactly 2 waving flags: one in the upper left with the club badge, and one in the upper right with large supporter text. Add atmospheric smoke, vignette shadows, and layered light effects for a heroic, celebratory sports-design look. Include exactly 4 Portuguese text elements integrated into the composition: on the left, "O INÍCIO DE UM FENÔMENO" in stylized white lettering; on the right, "O MAIOR DE TODOS" with a small crown icon; across the lower center in very large white brush-script, {argument name="main headline" default="FENÔMENO"}; and at the very bottom in spaced uppercase text, {argument name="bottom tagline" default="ONTEM UM SONHO. HOJE UMA LENDA."} with the last word highlighted in brighter blue. Add a handwritten signature under the main headline with the number {argument name="jersey number" default="9"}. Use high-contrast sports poster compositing, gritty texture, sharp jersey fabric detail, dramatic rim lighting, and an epic fan-culture mood suitable for a club legend celebration.
items.author: Lucas Couto

items.title: 美式餐厅菜单板墙面
items.promptZh: 使用提供的参考图像，将火车内部场景替换为经典美国餐厅柜台墙的直接纪实风格照片。完全移走人、窗户反射、热水瓶和书。顶部和木板墙壁上采用温暖的钨丝灯泡，保持图像逼真且自然光照。添加一个大的黑色信板菜单，以白色大写字母作为主要主题，在开放式厨房通行证上方用金属框起来。包括 6 个菜单部分，其中包含这些确切的标题和项目：早餐有 5 个项目（两个鸡蛋吐司 4.95、培根和鸡蛋 6.50、火腿和鸡蛋 6.75、煎蛋卷 7.25、饼干和肉汁 5.50）；煎锅，包含 4 种商品（短叠 4.25、煎饼 5.25、法式吐司 5.75、华夫饼 5.95）；三明治 5 种（生菜三明治 5.50、金枪鱼融化 6.25、烤奶酪 4.50、俱乐部三明治 7.50、汉堡 6.00）；配菜 5 种（薯饼 2.50、培根 2.95、香肠 2.95、吐司 1.50、馅饼 3.25）；饮料 5 种（咖啡 1.25、茶 1.25、牛奶 1.50、橙汁 1.75、苏打水 1.50）；还有一条每日特别线路，上面写着“炸鸡排 8.25”。菜单下方有一个不锈钢服务口和台面，前台有 2 个调味品瓶、1 个餐巾分配器和 1 个摇酒器等用餐细节。宽阔的水平构图，居中，真实的纹理，略带怀旧的路边小餐馆的气氛。

items.prompt: A surreal fashion portrait of a mysterious cowboy figure centered in the frame, shot from the chest up against a vivid cobalt-blue daytime sky with a few soft white clouds. The person’s face is completely obscured by a tall vertical rectangular blur block running from the forehead past the nose and mouth, creating an anonymous censored identity effect. They wear a glittery red cowboy hat with a pale white crown, a black scarf or bandana wrapped around the neck and lower face, and a bold red western-style jacket or shirt covered in white horse illustrations and floral-patterned motifs. Layer the neck and chest with heavy maximalist jewelry: 1 oversized long pearl strand hanging low, at least 4 shorter pearl necklaces stacked at the collar, and 1 ornate gold statement necklace with coin-like dangling elements. Place 2 pale pink horse heads behind the figure’s shoulders, one on the left and one on the right, facing slightly outward like surreal companions or sculptural props. In the lower background, include 2 red sports cars partially visible, one on each side, blending into a red desert-like horizon. Use a dreamy retro-futurist western aesthetic with glossy textures, soft focus, slight chromatic aberration, and a lo-fi editorial look. Symmetrical composition, centered subject, saturated colors, strange luxurious mood, high-fashion surrealism, cinematic portrait photography.

items.promptZh: 一张在喜怒无常的高档卫生间里用智能手机对着镜子自拍的照片，卫生间里有深{argument name="wall color" default="crimson red"}纹理的墙壁，还有一面带有细黑框的大圆形镜子，占据了构图的主导地位。一名{argument name="subject" default="young Woman"}留着一头{argument name="hair color" default="dark Brown"}长卷发，略微偏离中心，躯干向前并向一侧倾斜，摆出轻松自信的姿势，一只手将手机举在脸前，另一只手支撑在深色石头或大理石台面上。她穿着一件合身的黑色露肩鸡心领长袖上衣和高腰木炭色或黑色牛仔裤，一只手臂下夹着一个黑色单肩包。手机闪光灯非常明亮，完全遮住脸部，并在图像上形成锐利的星爆加上 1 条强烈的水平蓝白色镜头耀斑条纹，具有微妙的光晕和逼真的智能手机曝光剪裁。她身后是一扇深色木镶板门，位于倒影的中心。房间里有 2 个高大的圆柱形壁灯，带有温暖的发光灯泡，靠近镜子边缘的每一侧都有一个，左墙上有 1 个金色的小灯开关板，底部中心可见 1 个弧形拉丝金属水龙头，右下边缘有 2 个小烛台或许愿灯。风格是正宗的手机相机摄影，略有颗粒感，温暖的低光氛围，真实的反射，轻微的传感器噪音，自然阴影，亲密的夜生活卫生间美学，垂直肖像框架。

items.titleZh: 马德里广场隐藏物品谜题
items.promptZh: 这是一张细节丰富、色彩丰富的插图隐藏物品海报，背景是阳光明媚的马德里太阳门广场，渲染得像一幅生动的手绘旅行拼图，具有清晰的墨水轮廓、纹理水彩水粉阴影和略带异想天开的漫画风格。从稍微抬高的视线高度观看，广场上挤满了巨大的人群，右侧背景是皇家邮政钟楼，左侧背景是 Tío Pepe 屋顶标志，左侧是红色菱形 Sol 地铁标志，中心附近有熊和草莓树雕像，历史悠久的外墙、蓝天和柔软的云彩。在左上角，在场景上钉上一个撕破的笔记本纸标牌，上面写着大号西班牙语文本：{argument name="headline text" default="¿Dónde está \"El Hombre del Puro\"?"} 和第二行 {argument name="subheadline text" default="Encuéntralo en Madrid"}。在它旁边，添加目标男子的固定小肖像照片：一名身穿深色软呢帽和深色外套的中年男子，嘴边叼着一支雪茄，风格就像参考快照。在广场上放置 1 个地铁入口标志、1 个标有“Loterías y Apuestas del Estado”的彩票亭、1 个带有明信片展示和写着“¡HOLA！DESDE MADRID”标牌的圆顶纪念品亭、1 个带有黑板写着“CHURROS CON CHOCOLATE”的西班牙油条摊位、右下角 1 个帽子展示摊位、1 名吉他手、2 名身着红色连衣裙的弗拉门戈舞者、1 条街道穿着亮橙绿色制服的清洁工，背面写着“MADRID LIMPIO ENTRE TODOS”，1 个骑自行车的人，2 条狗，1 个拿着红色泰迪熊气球的孩子，许多鸽子分散在前景中，孩子们玩肥皂泡，背着背包和地图的游客，家庭，街头旁观者和表演者。人群应该感觉密集而熙熙攘攘，数十个不同的人物穿着不同的夏季服装，摆出自然的姿势，创造了一个具有挑战性的搜索场景。强调西班牙当地色彩、有趣的观察细节、温暖的橙色和阳光照射下的石灰色，以及经典的《威利在哪里？》的感觉。风格城市搜索插图的重点是在 {argument name="city" default="Madrid"} 人群中寻找 {argument name="target character" default="El Hombre del Puro"}。
items.prompt: A highly detailed, colorful illustrated hidden-object poster set in Madrid’s Puerta del Sol on a bright sunny day, rendered like a lively hand-drawn travel puzzle with crisp ink outlines, textured watercolor-gouache shading, and a slightly whimsical caricature style. The composition is packed edge to edge with a huge crowd in the plaza, viewed from a slightly elevated eye level, with the Real Casa de Correos clock building dominating the right background, the Tío Pepe rooftop sign in the left background, the red diamond Sol metro sign on the left, the bear and strawberry tree statue near the center, historic facades, blue sky, and soft clouds. At the top left, include a torn notebook-paper sign pinned over the scene with large Spanish text: {argument name="headline text" default="¿Dónde está \"El Hombre del Puro\"?"} and a second line {argument name="subheadline text" default="Encuéntralo en Madrid"}. Next to it, add a pinned small portrait photo of the target man: a middle-aged man in a dark fedora and dark coat holding a cigar near his mouth, styled like a reference snapshot. Fill the square with exactly 1 metro entrance sign, 1 lottery kiosk labeled “Loterías y Apuestas del Estado,” 1 domed souvenir kiosk with postcard display and a sign reading “¡HOLA! DESDE MADRID,” 1 churros stand with a chalkboard reading “CHURROS CON CHOCOLATE,” 1 hat display stall on the lower right, 1 guitarist, 2 flamenco dancers in red dresses, 1 street cleaner in a bright orange-and-green uniform with text on the back reading “MADRID LIMPIO ENTRE TODOS,” 1 bicyclist, 2 dogs, 1 child holding a red teddy-bear balloon, many pigeons scattered across the foreground, children playing with soap bubbles, tourists with backpacks and maps, families, street onlookers, and performers. The crowd should feel dense and bustling, with dozens of distinct figures in varied summer clothing and natural poses, creating a challenging search scene. Emphasize Spanish local color, playful observational details, warm oranges and sunlit stone grays, and the feeling of a classic “Where’s Waldo?” style city-search illustration centered on finding {argument name="target character" default="El Hombre del Puro"} somewhere among the crowd in {argument name="city" default="Madrid"}.

items.title: 霓虹花园少女与兔
items.promptZh: 夜间郁郁葱葱的花园中呈现梦幻般的卡哇伊 3D 渲染，充满了发光的粉红色霓虹灯图形和柔和的闪光。中间是一个像洋娃娃一样的小女孩，她有着长长的丝质金发和白色的蝴蝶结发带，穿着淡蓝色的围裙，外面是带有白色镶边的粉色泡泡袖衬衫。她轻轻地伸手触碰站在她面前的一只大白兔角色的嘴。兔子有着超大的直立耳朵、乌黑亮泽的眼睛、红润的脸颊和可爱的毛绒般的脸，白色的身体上穿着一件浅蓝色的制服式夹克，上面有一个小小的金色徽章。在前景和背景中用茂密的绿色植物、雏菊和丰富的粉红色花朵包围它们。在顶部，放置大型发光的韩语霓虹灯文字：{argument name="headline text" default="і특하구나~"}，采用亮粉色气泡字体，带有柔和的光晕。包含 7 个额外的霓虹灯或 UI 风格的装饰元素：左上角有 1 个心形标志，上面写着 {argument name="top sign text" default="CUTE"}，右上角的白色柜子上有 1 个霓虹灯星形标志，右侧兔子附近有 1 个发光的心形轮廓，左侧有 1 个复古粉色计算机风格的浮动窗口，带有微小的工具栏细节，中央心形图形包含文本 {argument name="window text" default="you're so珍贵"}，左下角有 1 个大的发光心形轮廓，右下角有 1 个粉色手持式虚拟宠物设备，显示一个小兔子精灵，设备附近有 1 个发光的小水晶心。添加柔和的绽放、光泽高光、神奇的闪光颗粒、粉色边缘照明、浅景深、玩具摄影造型以及以柔和的粉色和蓝色为主色调的怀旧可爱的互联网美学。
items.prompt: A dreamy kawaii 3D render in a lush flower garden at night, filled with glowing pink neon graphics and soft sparkles. In the center, a small doll-like girl is shown from behind, with long silky blonde hair and a white bow headband, wearing a pastel blue pinafore dress over a pink puff-sleeve blouse with white trim. She gently reaches up to touch the mouth of a large white rabbit character standing in front of her. The rabbit has oversized upright ears, glossy black eyes, rosy cheeks, and a cute plush-like face, and wears a light blue uniform-style jacket with a tiny gold badge over a white body. Surround them with dense greenery, daisies, and abundant pink blossoms in the foreground and background. Across the top, place large glowing Korean neon text reading {argument name="headline text" default="가특하구나~"} in bright pink bubble lettering with a soft halo. Include exactly 7 additional neon or UI-style decorative elements: 1 heart-shaped sign at the upper left with the word {argument name="top sign text" default="CUTE"}, 1 neon star sign on a white cabinet at the upper right, 1 glowing heart outline near the rabbit on the right, 1 retro pink computer-style floating window on the left with tiny toolbar details and a central heart graphic containing the text {argument name="window text" default="you're so precious"}, 1 large glowing heart outline at the bottom left, 1 pink handheld virtual pet device at the bottom right showing a tiny bunny sprite, and 1 small glowing crystal heart near the device. Add soft bloom, glossy highlights, magical glitter particles, pink rim lighting, shallow depth of field, toy-photography styling, and a nostalgic cute internet aesthetic with pastel pink and blue as the dominant palette.

items.title: 韩系错位透视人像
items.promptZh: 9:16 垂直——创意强制透视肖像，{argument name="style" default="韩国偶像风格"}，单一主体。模拟35mm胶片美感，柔和的自然纹理，轻微褪色，温和的过度曝光，柔和的色调，低对比度，柔和的高光绽放，轻盈梦幻的氛围。靠近窗户的最小室内环境，干净的浅色调背景，简单的日常环境。年轻{argument name="subject" default="韩国女偶像"}，非常有吸引力，自然的简约妆容，水润逼真的肌肤纹理，微妙的瑕疵。服装：{argument name="outfit" default="宽松垂坠的大号白衬衫+短裤"}，柔软的面料，宽松的版型，朴素但微妙的塑身效果，没有暴露的元素。头发：深色长发，略显凌乱，自然卷。构图（关键）：强制透视错觉——相对于附近的物体，主体显得异常小（例如在杯子内、站在桌子边缘或与前景中的手互动），但仍然逼真；由相机距离和对齐造成的比例模糊性。相机：稍微低或与眼睛水平的角度，故意透视失真，前景物体靠近镜头，主体放置得更远以产生尺寸错觉。姿势：自然放松的姿势，轻微的身体曲线，随意的站姿或轻坐的姿势。表情：目光柔和平静，微笑或微微张开的嘴唇，自然而不做作。照明：漫射的自然窗户光、柔和的阴影、柔和的光线包裹着拍摄对象。心情：俏皮，略显超现实，但扎根于现实，亲密的日常时刻，带有视觉上的扭曲。质量：超写实，胶片颗粒细腻，轻微柔软，框架不完美，自然瑕疵。
items.prompt: 9:16 vertical — creative forced perspective portrait, {argument name="style" default="Korean idol style"}, single subject. analog 35mm film aesthetic, soft natural grain, slightly faded colors, gentle overexposure, pastel tones, low contrast, soft highlight bloom, airy and dreamy atmosphere. minimal indoor setting near a window, clean light-toned background, simple everyday environment. young {argument name="subject" default="Korean female idol"}, very attractive, natural minimal makeup, dewy realistic skin texture, subtle imperfections. outfit: {argument name="outfit" default="oversized white shirt loosely draped + short bottoms"}, soft fabric, relaxed fit, modest but subtly body-shaping, no revealing elements. hair: long dark hair, slightly messy, natural volume. composition (key): forced perspective illusion — the subject appears unusually small relative to nearby objects (such as being inside a cup, standing on a table edge, or interacting with a hand in the foreground), but still realistic; scale ambiguity created by camera distance and alignment. camera: slightly low or eye-level angle, intentional perspective distortion, foreground object close to lens, subject placed farther away to create size illusion. pose: natural relaxed posture, slight body curve, casual stance or light sitting pose. expression: soft calm gaze, slight smile or slightly parted lips, natural and unposed. lighting: diffused natural window light, soft shadows, gentle light wrapping around subject. mood: playful, slightly surreal but grounded in reality, intimate everyday moment with a visual twist. quality: ultra-realistic, fine film grain, slight softness, imperfect framing, natural imperfections.

items.title: 巫师重金属播客海报
items.promptZh: 一张戏剧性的黑暗奇幻工作室海报，两个巫师般的人物摆出一副模仿重金属专辑封面的姿势。在前景中，一位身材矮胖的年长巫师坐在或靠向镜头，穿着一件光滑的黑色连帽长袍，戴着大罩耳式录音室耳机，长而浓密的白胡子垂在胸前。他左手握着一根高大的黑色手杖；权杖有一个细长的矛头形华丽顶部，带有开放式格子细节。一个巨大的黑色播客麦克风安装在吊杆或支架上，直接放置在他面前，与嘴巴齐平，麦克风主体上有一个可见的贴纸，上面写着“CARAJO”。在他身后站着第二位年长的巫师，身穿带有金色镶边和绳带的发光白色长袍，也留着长长的白发和长长的白胡子。他右手握着一根高高的白色法杖，上面有与之相配的华丽矛尖，左手张开，以一种威严的施法姿势向观众伸出。站立的巫师头后面有一个由符文组成的明亮的电蓝色发光圆形光环，产生神奇的召唤环效果。背景是纯黑色，具有高对比度的电影灯光：后面有冷蓝色边缘光，手、长袍和法杖上有温暖的亮点。构图是垂直的，框架严密，黑袍巫师占据下部中央，白袍巫师高耸在他身后。在底部中心，添加标题 {argument name="title text" default="GORDALF"}，采用巨大的金属石纹理哥特式大写字母，就像一个幻想金属徽标，并在该单词下方居中放置 1 个小型神秘风格徽章。逼真的角色扮演肖像，超细致的面料，戏剧性的奇幻现实主义，海报设计，锐利的焦点，喜怒无常的史诗氛围。
items.prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy studio poster of two wizard-like figures posed like a parody heavy-metal album cover. In the foreground, a stocky older wizard sits or leans toward the camera, wearing a glossy black hooded robe, large over-ear studio headphones, and a long thick white beard spilling over his chest. He grips a tall black staff in his left hand; the staff has an elongated spearhead-shaped ornate top with open lattice details. A large black podcast microphone on a boom or stand is positioned directly in front of him at mouth level, with a visible sticker that reads "CARAJO" on the microphone body. Behind him stands a second older wizard in a luminous white robe with gold trim and a rope belt, also with long white hair and a long white beard. He holds a tall white staff with a matching ornate spearhead top in his right hand and extends his left hand toward the viewer in a commanding spell-casting gesture, fingers spread. Behind the standing wizard’s head is a bright electric-blue glowing circular halo made of runes, creating a magical summoning-ring effect. The background is pure black, with high-contrast cinematic lighting: cool blue rim light from behind and warm highlights on the hands, robes, and staffs. The composition is vertical, tightly framed, with the black-robed wizard occupying the lower center and the white-robed wizard towering behind him. At the bottom center, add the title {argument name="title text" default="GORDALF"} in huge metallic stone-textured gothic block letters, like a fantasy metal logo, and place 1 small occult-style emblem centered underneath the word. Photorealistic cosplay portrait, ultra-detailed fabrics, theatrical fantasy realism, poster design, sharp focus, moody epic atmosphere.

items.title: Vintage Moda Pier in Istanbul
items.titleZh: 伊斯坦布尔的复古摩达码头
items.promptZh: 伊斯坦布尔历史悠久的莫达码头的梦幻复古旅行照片，以石头海滨码头的尽头为中心，从平静的黑暗水面上以垂直构图拍摄。这座两层的滨水建筑拥有浅米色的石墙、温暖的赤陶瓦四坡屋顶、底层高大的拱形窗户、带有许多细长柱子的开放式上层阳台，以及上层立面上的可见标志，上面写着“{argument name=”piersign text”default=”MODA ïSKELESі”}”。码头后面最左边的白色渡轮部分可见，散布着的小行人沿着码头和建筑物周围站立，在不成为肖像主题的情况下提供了比例。前景是反光的港口水面，泛着柔和的波纹和柔和的建筑物倒影；码头边缘排列着白色栏杆和底部粗糙的深色岩石。上方，广阔的阴天和厚厚的层云占据了图像的近一半。使用怀旧的 Instagram 滤镜美感，包括褪色、温暖的棕褐色调、阴影中的轻微绿色投射、柔和的胶片颗粒、低对比度、柔和的雾度、微妙的晕影和轻微风化的模拟照片感觉。以建筑为中心，宁静，电影般，现实，略带忧郁，就像一张阴天的{argument name="city" default="Istanbul"}旅行明信片。
items.prompt: A dreamy vintage travel photograph of the historic Moda pier terminal in Istanbul, centered at the end of a stone waterfront jetty, shot in a vertical composition from across calm dark water. The two-story waterfront building has pale beige stone walls, a warm terracotta tiled hip roof, tall arched windows on the ground floor, an open upper veranda with many slim columns, and a visible sign reading "{argument name="pier sign text" default="MODA İSKELESİ"}" on the upper facade. A white ferry is partially visible on the far left behind the pier, and small scattered pedestrians stand along the dock and around the building, giving scale without becoming portrait subjects. The foreground is reflective harbor water with soft ripples and a muted reflection of the building; the pier edge is lined with white railings and rough dark rocks at the base. Above, a wide overcast sky with heavy layered clouds fills nearly half the image. Use a nostalgic Instagram-filter aesthetic with faded colors, warm sepia-beige tones, slight green cast in the shadows, gentle film grain, low contrast, soft haze, subtle vignette, and a lightly weathered analog-photo feel. Architecture-focused, serene, cinematic, realistic, slightly melancholy, like a viral travel postcard of {argument name="city" default="Istanbul"} on a cloudy day.

items.promptZh: 黄昏时分，{argument name="city" default="Istanbul"} 博斯普鲁斯海峡的梦幻复古风格照片，以垂直构图从水面拍摄。巨大的吊桥从左上到右上横跨整个框架，最左边有一座高高的桥塔，缆绳上垂下一串精致的温暖灯光，再加上一排微小的橙色灯光追踪着道路。桥下，平静的黑暗水面充满了前景。总共放置 3 艘可见的船只：1 艘中型白色客运渡轮位于面向观察者的中间距离中心，1 艘长而低的白色渡船位于桥下右侧较远的后方，1 艘小船位于最右侧边缘。在左边的海岸线上，展示了一个明亮的海滨，有温暖的黄色灯光、几棵棕榈树，以及最左边边缘一座老建筑的一部分。在桥下方的中左背景附近，有一座苍白的水边清真寺，有 1 个圆顶和 2 个细长的尖塔。在一切的背后，是一片朦胧的山坡，密集的建筑物逐渐消失在远处。使用怀旧的病毒 Instagram 滤镜外观：浓重的温暖棕褐色和柔和的橄榄色调、褪色的对比度、柔焦、可见的胶片颗粒、微妙的晕影、轻微的漏光、低清晰度和老化的模拟打印纹理。气氛应该是喜怒无常、浪漫、电影般的、柔和模糊的，就像一个古老的旅行记忆。
items.prompt: A dreamy vintage-style photograph of the Bosphorus in {argument name="city" default="Istanbul"} at dusk, shot from water level in a vertical composition. The enormous suspension bridge spans the frame from upper left to upper right, with a tall bridge tower on the far left and delicate strings of warm lights hanging down from the cables, plus a line of tiny orange lights tracing the roadway. Below the bridge, calm dark water fills the foreground. Place 3 visible boats total: 1 medium white passenger ferry centered in the middle distance facing the viewer, 1 long low white ferry farther back near the right side under the bridge, and 1 small boat at the far right edge. On the left shoreline, show an illuminated waterfront with warm yellow lights, a few palm trees, and part of an old building at the extreme left edge. Near the center-left background beneath the bridge, include a pale waterside mosque with 1 dome and 2 slender minarets. Behind everything, add a hazy hillside dense with buildings fading into the distance. Use a nostalgic viral Instagram-filter look: heavy warm sepia and muted olive tones, faded contrast, soft focus, visible film grain, subtle vignette, slight light leaks, low clarity, and an aged analog print texture. The atmosphere should feel moody, romantic, cinematic, and softly blurred, like an old travel memory.

items.promptZh: 一张正面照片，一艘巨大的白色游轮位于伊斯坦布尔水面上的画面中央，从远处穿过狭窄的港口航道看到，游轮缓慢地驶向镜头。蝴蝶结上有一个大胆的风格化嘴唇图案，涂有红色和黑色，营造出俏皮的病毒式Instagram滤镜感。船的后方和周围是密集的海滨城市景观，其中有低矮的建筑、码头，以及矗立在天际线右侧的两座细长的清真寺尖塔。构图对称且具有电影感，船在垂直中心占据主导地位，前景是深色的海水，上方是巨大的、戏剧性的天空。天空的上三分之一处布满了厚重的暴风雨云，但下半部分的天空却泛着淡黄绿色的薄雾，给图像带来了一种复古、梦幻、略带怪异的气氛。正好包括分散在天空中的 4 只小鸟。应用怀旧的模拟胶片外观，其中包括褪色、颗粒、灰尘斑点、柔和模糊、浅晕影、柔和的对比度以及略显风化的 90 年代旅游快照美感。在左下角添加橙色摄像机样式的日期戳，内容为 {argument name="date stamp" default="02 25 '94"}。垂直 3:4 取景，居中构图，逼真的摄影，喜怒无常的旅行明信片色调，城市和船舶的细节因雾霾而略微柔和。
items.prompt: A front-facing photograph of a massive white cruise ship centered in the frame on the water in Istanbul, seen from a low distance across a narrow harbor channel, with the ship moving slowly toward the camera. The bow has a bold stylized lips graphic painted in red and black, creating a playful viral Instagram-filter feel. Behind and around the ship is a dense waterfront cityscape with low buildings, docks, and exactly 2 slender mosque minarets rising on the right side of the skyline. The composition is symmetrical and cinematic, with the ship dominating the vertical center, dark water in the foreground, and a huge dramatic sky above. The sky is filled with heavy storm clouds across the upper third, but the lower sky glows in pale yellow-green haze, giving the image a vintage, dreamy, slightly eerie atmosphere. Include exactly 4 small birds scattered in the sky. Apply a nostalgic analog film look with faded colors, grain, dust specks, soft blur, light vignette, muted contrast, and a slightly weathered 1990s tourist snapshot aesthetic. Add an orange camcorder-style date stamp in the lower left corner reading {argument name="date stamp" default="02 25 '94"}. Vertical 3:4 framing, centered composition, realistic photography, moody travel postcard tone, city and ship details slightly softened by haze.

items.title: 日系时尚杂志封面
items.prompt: A polished Japanese fashion magazine cover illustration in elegant contemporary editorial style, vertical full-page composition. The cover title is a huge teal serif masthead reading "AURA" across the top. In the upper right, include 4 stacked issue details: "6", "June 2025", "No.126", and a small boxed label "アウラ", followed by the price line "特別定価 ¥980". The background is a bright pale blue sky with soft white clouds. Center the portrait of an androgynous, ethereal young model, shown from chest up, wearing a crisp white tailored jacket with subtle gold piping, a white shirt, a vivid aqua-teal vest or tie layer, and a gemstone-like star brooch at the collar. The character has very long, layered, windswept hair in {argument name="hair color" default="icy white with pale aqua tint"}, with glossy strands flowing across the shoulders, and fair luminous skin. The face is largely obscured by a centered rectangular censor block in muted gray-blue to pale pink gradient, covering the eyes, nose, and upper cheeks; the visible lower face shows a soft mouth and refined chin. One hand is raised near the lips in a thoughtful fashion-portrait pose. Use delicate anime-inspired linework, airy lighting, translucent highlights, and luxury beauty-editorial rendering. Add 3 left-column cover blurbs in Japanese with teal headlines and smaller black body text: first, "透明感をまとう 初夏のスキンケア" with 2 smaller lines beneath; second, "好印象をつくる 爽やかカラー術" with 2 smaller lines beneath; third, "プロが教える 美しい髪の条件" with 2 smaller lines beneath. Add a teal circular badge on the right with 4 lines of white text: "Special Interview", "風と光と、", "自分らしさと。", and "ソラが語る 日常と美学". Near the lower center, place a small italic English line "Cover & Special Feature" above the large Japanese main headline "ソラ、という名の透明感。" with the first word in teal and the rest in black. Under that, add 2 lines of smaller Japanese subheadline text. Along the bottom edge, create 3 feature teasers with pale italic English category labels and Japanese copy beneath: left label "Fashion", center label "Beauty", right label "Trend", each with 2 short Japanese lines. Overall mood: serene, luxurious, airy, refreshing early-summer beauty fashion cover with cohesive aqua-and-white color design.

items.title: 日式暗黑奇幻舞台海报
items.titleZh: 日式暗黑奇幻舞台海报
items.prompt: A dramatic vertical Japanese stage-play poster in luxurious dark fantasy anime style, featuring a single androgynous young actor in a half-body portrait against a nighttime city skyline with glowing high-rise windows and soft bokeh lights. The character has long straight hair in deep black with vivid teal-turquoise inner glow and streaks, glossy highlights, and strands flowing across the shoulders. They wear an elegant black high-collared costume with subtle brocade texture, a fitted dark coat, black leather gloves, and a jewel-like diamond-shaped turquoise pendant at the throat set in ornate gold. One gloved hand is raised near the collar in a poised theatrical gesture. The mood is mysterious, romantic, and slightly gothic, with cinematic rim lighting from behind, strong contrast, gold sparkles, and luminous accents in the hair and costume. Use a refined magazine-quality key visual composition with decorative gold filigree corners and a premium theatrical poster layout. Leave space for Japanese typography integrated into the design: at upper right, small text "夜空に輝く、唯一の星。", then "主演俳優" and the actor name "{argument name="character name" default="夜乃 宙"}" with small romanization "SORA YORUNO" beneath; along the left side, a vertical quote reading "この役に、すべてを捧げる。闇さえ、愛に変えてみせよう。"; near center-lower, small text "幻想ロマン・ステージ" above the large glowing gold title "{argument name="title text" default="夜の檻に囚われた光"}" with a small subtitle beneath "—それでも、君を愛した。"; include a dark teal rose motif and thorny circular ornament near the title. At the bottom left, add the date block "2025 6.20 FRI - 6.29 SUN" and venue "天穹シアター". At the bottom right, add a bordered ticket box with "チケット一般発売 5.10 SAT 10:00~". Center bottom credits in Japanese: "原作・脚本 霧月 澪", "演出 七海 翼", "音楽 深月 奏". Along the very bottom, add the tagline "—光か、闇か——。愛が、運命を選ぶ。—". Color palette: midnight blue, black, teal, cyan glow, and antique gold. Emphasize polished poster typography, layered depth, elegant fantasy drama branding, and a consistent face and atmosphere suitable for a theatrical promotional campaign.
