items.title: 巴西足球签约官宣海报
items.titleZh: 巴西足球签约官宣海报
items.promptZh: 以 2:3 垂直布局制作引人注目的巴西足球俱乐部签约公告海报，并采用黄色、深绿色、黑色和金色呈现坚韧的高对比度体育营销美感。主要拍摄对象是一名肌肉发达、纹身的男足球运动员，身穿亮黄色米拉索尔足球俱乐部主场球衣，以胸部以上居中的大型半身肖像呈现，面朝前方，表情严肃而令人生畏。他剃着光头，颈部和手臂上有明显的纹身，身材魁梧，体格健壮。球衣衣领和袖子上有深绿色镶边，胸前有两颗星星的米拉索尔队徽，对面胸前有 ATHLETA 标志，躯干上有一个大的绿色赞助商字标，上面写着“Poty”，肩部品牌标记和圆形袖子赞助商贴片。在他身后，右上角放置了一面引人注目的深绿色和黄色的米拉索尔旗帜，上面有一个巨大的俱乐部徽章和两颗星星，发光的体育场灯光，烟熏金色颗粒，以及夜间体育场人群背景。在左侧，用葡萄牙语堆叠大的粗体压缩文字：“BEM-VINDO AO”在超大的黄色“MIRASOL”上方，然后球员姓名分成两行，用巨大的白色字母表示“ALEX”和“POATAN”，下面是手写的黄色签名式“Poatan”。在其下方，添加一个 4 行大写白色文本激励块，最后一行以黄色突出显示：“DE CAMPEñO / NO OCTÓGONO / PARA GUERREIRO / EM CAMPO。/ A LUTA CONTINUA。”在右侧，添加一个垂直信息面板，其中包含 3 个图标和文字特征，每个特征都是黄色的，并带有匹配的符号：目标图标为“FOCO”，拳头图标为“DISCIPLINA”，头盔图标为“GARRA”，然后在它们下方有一个粗体的黄色标注：“AGORA É PELO LEãO！”。底部包括 2 个较小的次要球员图像：1 个在左下角，裁剪前的四分之三姿势亲吻球衣上的俱乐部徽章； 1 位于中右下方，是双臂举起、食指朝上的后视图。球衣后背上印有赞助商文字“DS TECNOLOGIA AUTOMOTIVA”、名字“POATAN”以及绿色大数字“10”。添加黑色和金色底部条，包含 4 个值，并用图标均匀分隔：狮子头和“MENTALIDADE DE CAMPEãO”、盾牌和“FORÇA E HONRA”、星星和“HUMILDADE E TRABALHO”、足球和“PAIXãO PELO JOGO”。在其下方，放置一面黄色横幅，上面写着“NOVO DESAFIO。MESMA MISSIO”。最底部有一个手写的白色短语“FÉ，FOCO E FAMÍLIA！”接下来是主题标签“#POATANÉLEËO”。使用电影边缘照明、强烈的对比度、金属金色光芒、纹理烟雾和高级俱乐部公告海报设计。
items.prompt: Create a dramatic Brazilian football club signing announcement poster in a vertical 2:3 layout, with a gritty high-contrast sports-marketing aesthetic in yellow, dark green, black, and gold. The main subject is a muscular tattooed male footballer wearing a bright yellow Mirassol FC home jersey, shown as a large centered half-body portrait from chest up, facing forward with a serious intimidating expression. He has a shaved head, visible neck and arm tattoos, and a broad athletic build. The jersey has dark green trim on the collar and sleeves, the Mirassol crest with two stars on the chest, the ATHLETA logo on the opposite chest, a large green sponsor wordmark reading “Poty” across the torso, shoulder brand marks, and a circular sleeve sponsor patch. Behind him, place a dramatic waving Mirassol flag in dark green and yellow on the upper right with a large club crest and two stars, glowing stadium lights, smoky golden particles, and a night stadium crowd background. On the left side, stack large bold condensed text in Portuguese: “BEM-VINDO AO” above an oversized yellow “MIRASOL”, then the player name split across 2 lines as “ALEX” and “POATAN” in huge white letters, with a handwritten yellow signature-style “Poatan” beneath. Below that, add a 4-line motivational block in uppercase white text with the final line highlighted in yellow: “DE CAMPEÃO / NO OCTÓGONO / PARA GUERREIRO / EM CAMPO. / A LUTA CONTINUA.” On the right side, add a vertical info panel with 3 icon-and-word traits, each in yellow with matching symbols: target icon with “FOCO”, fist icon with “DISCIPLINA”, and helmet icon with “GARRA”, then below them a bold yellow callout: “AGORA É PELO LEÃO!”. Include 2 smaller secondary player images at the bottom: 1 on the lower left, a cropped front three-quarter pose kissing the club badge on the jersey; and 1 on the lower center-right, a back view with both arms raised and index fingers pointing upward. On the back-view jersey, show the sponsor text “DS TECNOLOGIA AUTOMOTIVA” across the upper back, the name “POATAN”, and the number “10” in large green numerals. Add a black-and-gold bottom strip containing 4 values separated evenly with icons: lion head and “MENTALIDADE DE CAMPEÃO”, shield and “FORÇA E HONRA”, star and “HUMILDADE E TRABALHO”, soccer ball and “PAIXÃO PELO JOGO”. Beneath that, place a yellow banner with the slogan “NOVO DESAFIO. MESMA MISSÃO.” and at the very bottom a handwritten white phrase “FÉ, FOCO E FAMÍLIA!” followed by the hashtag “#POATANÉLEÃO”. Use cinematic rim lighting, intense contrast, metallic golden glow, textured smoke, and premium club-announcement poster design.

items.promptZh: 以黑暗电影混合媒体风格创作引人注目的垂直足球致敬海报，结合美术肖像、体育品牌、纹理垃圾绘画和高级编辑排版。中心主题是一幅{argument name="historicalfigure"default="Rabindranath Tagore"}的腰部肖像，被重新想象为巴塞罗那足球俱乐部的标志，脸稍稍偏右，银灰色长发，飘逸的长胡子，苍老的面容，以及平静的传奇气质。为他穿上经典的巴塞罗那足球俱乐部主场球衣，球衣带有深红色和海军蓝垂直条纹，左侧可见耐克标志，胸前有 FCB 徽章。在头发和肩膀周围使用喜怒无常的边缘照明和绘画高光，让人物感觉不朽，几乎神圣。将背景设置为巴塞罗那颜色、深靛蓝、深红色、酒红色和柔和金色的抽象画笔纹理构图，肖像后面有 3 个主要图形元素：靠近顶部中心的大型褪色巴塞罗那足球俱乐部徽章，左侧垂直的手写孟加拉手写文本块，以及右侧垂直运行的大型金色手写签名风格脚本。在左上角，放置 5 行优雅的衬线文本：第一行写着“RABINDRANATH”，第二行写着“TAGORE”，第三行写着“1861-1941”，第四行是引言“心无恐惧，昂首挺胸……”，第五行是草书签名，写着“Rabindranath Tagore”。在中下区域，在精致的海报布局中添加 5 条居中文本行：“MORE THAN A POET.”，然后是一条金色手写大行，上面写着“A timelessspirit.”，然后是“A {argument name="clubnickname"default="CULER"}FOREVER.”，然后是一条细的水平红蓝强调线，然后是下方居中的小 FCB 徽章。在底部，展示了黄昏时诺坎普的广阔视野，体育场灯光闪烁，日落地平线令人惊叹，看台上挤满了人，巨大的人群马赛克上写着{argument name="stadium slogan" default="MES QUE UN CLUB"}。在前景中，1 个足球以潮湿的反光球场为中心，球上可见巴塞罗那队徽。整个图像应该感觉像一张由粉丝制作的豪华传统海报，超详细、绘画性、情感、虔诚、高对比度、纹理、史诗，并且适合优质社交媒体足球图形或墙壁海报。使用高 2:3 的海报构图，具有分层深度、微妙的火花、油漆条纹和金色点缀。您可以选择将可见的俱乐部标识替换为 {argument name="footballclub"default="FCBarcelona"}，同时保留相同的精英致敬海报美感。
items.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical football tribute poster in a dark cinematic mixed-media style, combining fine-art portraiture, sports branding, textured grunge painting, and premium editorial typography. The central subject is a waist-up portrait of {argument name="historical figure" default="Rabindranath Tagore"} reimagined as an FC Barcelona icon, facing slightly to the right, with long wavy silver-gray hair, a long flowing beard, aged features, and a calm legendary presence. Dress him in a classic FC Barcelona home jersey with deep red and navy vertical stripes, visible Nike swoosh on the left side, and the FCB crest on the chest. Use moody rim lighting and painterly highlights around the hair and shoulders so the figure feels monumental and almost divine. Set the background as an abstract brush-texture composition in Barcelona colors, dark indigo, crimson, burgundy, and muted gold, with 3 major graphic elements behind the portrait: a large faded FC Barcelona crest near the top center, a vertical block of handwritten Bengali manuscript text on the left side, and a large gold handwritten signature-style script running vertically on the right. At the top left, place 5 lines of elegant serif text: the first line reads "RABINDRANATH", the second much larger line reads "TAGORE", the third line reads "1861-1941", the fourth line is the quote "Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high...", and the fifth line is a cursive signature reading "Rabindranath Tagore". In the middle-lower area, add 5 centered text lines in a refined poster layout: "MORE THAN A POET.", then a large gold handwritten line reading "A timeless spirit.", then "A {argument name="club nickname" default="CULER"} FOREVER.", then a thin horizontal red-and-blue accent line, and then a small centered FCB crest beneath it. At the bottom, show a wide view of Camp Nou at dusk with glowing stadium lights and a dramatic sunset horizon, packed stands, and a giant crowd mosaic reading exactly {argument name="stadium slogan" default="MES QUE UN CLUB"}. In the foreground place 1 football centered on the wet reflective pitch with the Barcelona crest visible on the ball. The entire image should feel like a luxury fan-made heritage poster, ultra-detailed, painterly, emotional, reverential, high contrast, textured, epic, and suitable for a premium social media football graphic or wall poster. Use a tall 2:3 poster composition with layered depth, subtle sparks, paint streaks, and gold accents. Optionally replace the visible club identity with {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} while preserving the same elite tribute-poster aesthetic.

items.title: 高价补剂讽刺漫画
items.promptZh: 干净、方形的社论卡通，采用平面矢量风格，具有柔和的阴影和粗体轮廓，浅灰色背景。场景是讽刺医疗办公室咨询价格过高的补充剂不起作用。左上角是一个巨大的三行西班牙文粗体无衬线标题：深青色的“Suplementos”，橙色的“costosos”，深青色的“que no funcionan”，标题下方带有橙色的小亮点和橙色的下划线旋风。在右上角，添加深青色的社交账号和网站：“@elnutridice”和“elnutridice.com”。沿着最左边缘，放置一条垂直的橙色信用线，上面写着“Imagen creada en: ia.elnutridice.com”。在前景中，一张木桌上摆满了大堆绿色现金，许多松散的钞票在人物周围的空中飞舞。右边，一位穿着白色实验室外套、青色手术服、穿着白色实验服、穿着青色手术服、得意洋洋的男医生坐在桌子后面，一手拿着厚厚一叠钱，另一只手随意地比划着。他的脸被故意模糊或用矩形模糊块进行审查。他的外套上有一个徽章或补丁，上面写着“SALUD Y COMISIONES”。他面前的桌子上有一个深青色的铭牌，上面有美元符号和西班牙语文字“TU SALUD，MI NEGOCIO”。在他身后的墙上，有一张镶框证书，上面写着“CERTIFICADO DE COMISIONES”，还有一个小架子，上面有 3 个可见物品：2 个青色活页夹和 1 个小盆栽植物。左边，一位留着深棕色长发、身穿青色长袖衬衫的女患者面对医生坐着，沮丧地举起一只手。她的脸也被模糊或用矩形模糊块审查。在她上方添加一个对话气泡：“Doc, ese suplemento carísimo que me mandó no me Sirvió para nada。”在医生上方添加一个对话气泡说：“A mí sí me Sirvió。”在桌子的左下角，放置一个标有“SUPLMENTO PREMIUM”的补充瓶，上面有橙色价格标记“$$$$”。在它旁边，放置一个剪贴板，上面有一张处方表，上面有一个大的“Rx”和文字“SUPLMENTO PREMIUM”。图中还包括 2 种小盆栽植物：1 种在地板上或桌子旁边的左下角，1 种在后架子上。使用幽默、批判、社交媒体信息图表语气、平衡的构图、清晰的排版、高可读性和精美的现代矢量插图美学。
items.prompt: A clean, square editorial cartoon in flat vector style with soft shading and bold outlines, on a light gray background. The scene is a satirical medical office consultation about overpriced supplements that do not work. At the top left, a huge three-line Spanish headline in bold sans-serif reads: “Suplementos” in dark teal, “costosos” in orange, and “que no funcionan” in dark teal, with a small orange sparkle accent and an orange underline swoosh beneath the headline. At the top right, add a social handle and website in dark teal: “@elnutridice” and “elnutridice.com”. Along the far left edge, place a vertical orange credit line that reads “Imagen creada en: ia.elnutridice.com”. In the foreground, show a wooden desk covered with large stacks of green cash, with many loose bills flying through the air around the characters. On the right, a smug male doctor in a white lab coat over teal scrubs sits behind the desk, holding a thick stack of money in one hand and gesturing casually with the other. His face is deliberately blurred or censored with a rectangular blur block. On his coat, a badge or patch reads “SALUD Y COMISIONES”. In front of him on the desk is a dark teal nameplate with a dollar symbol and the Spanish text “TU SALUD, MI NEGOCIO”. Behind him on the wall, include a framed certificate that reads “CERTIFICADO DE COMISIONES”, plus a small shelf with 3 visible items: 2 teal binders and 1 small potted plant. On the left, a female patient with long dark brown hair and a teal long-sleeve shirt sits facing the doctor, one hand raised in frustration. Her face is also blurred or censored with a rectangular blur block. Add a speech bubble above her saying: “Doc, ese suplemento carísimo que me mandó no me sirvió para nada.” Add a speech bubble above the doctor saying: “A mí sí me sirvió.” On the lower left corner of the desk, place a supplement bottle labeled “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM” with an orange price mark “$$$$”. Next to it, place a clipboard with a prescription sheet showing a large “Rx” and the text “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM”. Also include 2 small potted plants total in the image: 1 on the floor or lower left beside the desk and 1 on the rear shelf. Use a humorous, critical, social-media infographic tone, balanced composition, crisp typography, high readability, and polished modern vector illustration aesthetics.

items.title: 汉堡王餐厅街景外观
items.promptZh: 一家现代{argument name="restaurantbrand"default="BURGER KING"}快餐店的逼真的白天街角外观，从左前角度观看，在明亮的蓝天下，白云散布。该建筑采用米色灰泥立面，屋顶线沿线有醒目的红色装饰带，前墙左上方附近有一个大的圆形品牌标志，顶部有超大的红色槽形字母，拼写为{argument name="main sign text" default="BURGER KING"}。在立面的右侧，展示一个高大的垂直菜单广告牌，上面有 6 个可见的产品面板和价格：Whopper 6.99 美元、Impossible Whopper 7.49 美元、炸鸡薯条 3.49 美元、洋葱圈 2.49 美元、2 美元 6 美元的混合或搭配面板，以及包含薯条和饮料的 3 美元你的方式餐面板。在左侧添加一个黑色的得来速遮篷，并带有文字 {argument name="drive thru sign" default="DRIVE THRU"}，车道上有 2 辆车，其中一辆靠近相机的深色 SUV 和前面的一辆银色轿车。前角应该有落地玻璃窗，内部明亮，有一些顾客和菜单板依稀可见。在前窗放置 1 张招聘海报，上面写着 {argument name="window poster text" default="Now Hiring"}。添加维护整齐的景观，沿着建筑物边缘在深色覆盖床上种植 5 棵灌木，前景是混凝土人行道，草地带，电线杆，交通灯和延伸到左侧背景的郊区路边交叉路口。正午自然光、清晰的阴影、商业房地产摄影外观、超干净的标牌、高度清晰的文字、玻璃上的真实反射、清晰的建筑细节，以及右上角微妙的白色{argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"}水印。
items.prompt: A photorealistic daytime street-corner exterior of a modern {argument name="restaurant brand" default="BURGER KING"} fast-food restaurant, viewed from a front-left angle under a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. The building has a beige stucco facade with a bold red trim band along the roofline, a large round brand logo near the upper left of the front wall, and oversized red channel letters spelling {argument name="main sign text" default="BURGER KING"} across the top. On the right side of the facade, show one tall vertical menu billboard with 6 visible product panels and prices: Whopper $6.99, Impossible Whopper $7.49, Chicken Fries $3.49, Onion Rings $2.49, a 2 for $6 Mix or Match panel, and a $3 Your Way Meal panel with fries and drink. Include a black drive-thru canopy on the left side with the text {argument name="drive thru sign" default="DRIVE THRU"}, and 2 cars in the lane, one dark SUV closer to camera and one silver sedan ahead. The front corner should have floor-to-ceiling glass windows revealing a lit interior with a few customers and menu boards faintly visible. Place 1 hiring poster in the front window reading {argument name="window poster text" default="Now Hiring"}. Add neatly maintained landscaping with 5 shrubs in dark mulch beds along the building edge, a concrete sidewalk in the foreground, a grassy strip, utility poles, traffic lights, and a suburban roadside intersection extending into the left background. Natural midday lighting, crisp shadows, commercial real-estate photography look, ultra-clean signage, highly legible text, realistic reflections on glass, sharp architectural details, and a subtle white {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} watermark in the top-right corner.

items.title: 末日动作电影海报
items.promptZh: 在黄金时段的日落时创建超逼真的电影动作电影海报，展示一位粗犷的成年男性动作英雄站在一座未来派大城市上方摩天大楼屋顶破碎的玻璃边缘上。他位于画面左侧，全身姿势有力，身穿深色合身T恤、黑色牛仔裤和深色开衩夹克，留着随风飘扬的棕色短发。他的脸被故意用光滑的矩形模糊块遮挡，就像经过审查一样。他一只手拿着一个发光的蓝色全息设备，投射出一个透明的科幻界面，其中包含地图、目标图形和读数为 00:18:43 的数字倒计时器。背景是高耸的现代塔楼延伸至地平线的戏剧性天际线，中右低处的太阳在整个城市投射出温暖的橙色光芒。天空中充斥着爆炸性的重磅动作：右上角的一架大型直升机在半空中爆炸，产生火焰、烟雾、碎片和旋转的旋翼碎片；右下角有 1 架受损客机向下倾斜，尾随火焰并冒黑烟；两架快速军用喷气机在左上方的天空中疾驰而过，留下了明亮的导弹轨迹。添加飞扬的余烬、火花、漂浮的碎片和浓烈的体积烟雾云，营造出高风险的灾难氛围。将巨大的金属 3D 电影标题放在右上中上方，阅读 {argument name="title text" default="TIMEFALL"}，略微倾斜，带有粗体钢纹理和电影阴影。在其下方，添加干净的粗体大写标语：{argument name="tagline" default="ONE MAN. ONE CHANCE. NO LIMITS."}。在右上角添加一个小的白色品牌标记：{argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"}。使用超详细的照片写实主义、戏剧性的对比度、大片海报构图、变形光斑、锐利的角色细节、史诗般的规模和精美的好莱坞关键艺术造型。
items.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic action movie poster at golden-hour sunset, showing a rugged adult male action hero standing on the shattered glass edge of a skyscraper rooftop high above a futuristic megacity. He is positioned on the left side of the frame in a powerful full-body pose, wearing a dark fitted T-shirt, black jeans, and a dark open jacket, with windswept short brown hair. His face is intentionally obscured with a smooth rectangular blur block, as if censored. In one hand he holds a glowing blue holographic device projecting a transparent sci-fi interface with maps, targeting graphics, and a digital countdown timer reading 00:18:43. The background features a dramatic skyline of tall modern towers stretching to the horizon, with the sun low in the center-right casting warm orange light across the city. Fill the sky with explosive blockbuster action: 1 large helicopter in the upper right exploding midair with fire, smoke, debris, and spinning rotor fragments; 1 damaged passenger aircraft on the lower right banking downward trailing flames and black smoke; and 2 fast military jets streaking across the upper left sky leaving bright missile trails. Add flying embers, sparks, drifting debris, and intense volumetric smoke clouds for a high-stakes disaster atmosphere. Place a huge metallic 3D movie title across the upper-middle right reading {argument name="title text" default="TIMEFALL"}, angled slightly with bold steel texture and cinematic shadowing. Beneath it, add the tagline in clean bold capitals: {argument name="tagline" default="ONE MAN. ONE CHANCE. NO LIMITS."}. Add a small white brand mark in the top-right corner reading {argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"}. Use ultra-detailed photorealism, dramatic contrast, blockbuster poster composition, anamorphic flare, sharp character detail, epic scale, and polished Hollywood key art styling.

items.title: Dragon Queen at Burning Sunset
items.promptZh: 一幅电影般的黑暗奇幻肖像，{argument name="character name" default="a silver-haired Dragon queen"} 站在黑色火山碎石上的前景中，一条巨大的黑龙隐约出现在她身后，提供保护。这名女子穿着一件精致的及地黑色礼服，衣身和肩膀上有铠甲细节，长袖，高领结构，一件厚重的深色斗篷拖到右边。她的头发是{argument name="hair color" default="platinum silver"}，极长，松散，呈波浪形，在火光下闪烁着柔和的光芒。她的脸被刻意模糊、模糊，没有清晰的五官。龙占据了大部分背景，两只巨大的伸展翅膀构成了整个场景，密集的木炭鳞片，许多锋利的角和面部尖刺，发光的琥珀色眼睛，以及在女人上方呈弧形的巨大弯曲脖子。故事发生在一座中世纪城市废墟中，两边都是烧毁的石塔和摇摇欲坠的建筑，地面上熊熊燃烧，余烬飘荡，浓烟滚滚，橙色的夕阳天空上布满了暴风云。低角度的英雄构图，史诗般的人兽比例对比，超细致的纹理，逼真的奇幻写实，戏剧性的边缘照明，火热的橙黑调色板，喜怒无常的氛围，对女王和龙的敏锐关注，海报美学大片。在右上角附近添加干净的白色无衬线文本 {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"}。
items.prompt: A cinematic dark fantasy portrait of {argument name="character name" default="a silver-haired dragon queen"} standing in the foreground on blackened volcanic rubble, with an enormous black dragon looming protectively behind her. The woman wears an intricate floor-length black gown with armored detailing on the bodice and shoulders, long fitted sleeves, a high structured collar, and a heavy dark cape trailing to the right. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="platinum silver"}, extremely long, loose, and wavy, glowing softly in the firelight. Her face is intentionally obscured and indistinct, with no clear facial features. The dragon fills most of the background, with 2 large outstretched wings framing the scene, dense charcoal scales, many sharp horns and facial spikes, glowing amber eyes, and a massive curved neck arcing above the woman. Set in a ruined medieval city with burned stone towers and crumbling structures on both sides, active fires on the ground, drifting embers, smoke, and a blazing orange sunset sky with stormy clouds. Low-angle heroic composition, epic scale contrast between human and beast, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic fantasy realism, dramatic rim lighting, fiery orange and black color palette, moody atmosphere, sharp focus on the queen and dragon, blockbuster poster aesthetic. Add the text {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} in clean white sans-serif near the upper right.

items.title: 炸鸡汉堡广告大片
items.promptZh: 一个戏剧性的逼真快餐英雄在黑暗的餐厅桌子上拍摄了一个巨大的脆皮炸鸡三明治和一篮炸薯条。三明治居中稍偏左，堆得很高，有一个光滑的奶油蛋卷面包，顶部面包上有辛辣的橙汁，2个紫红色洋葱圈，3片泡菜片，2片番茄片，融化的切达干酪滴在超脆的炸鸡排上，卷曲的绿叶生菜，还有更多的奶油橙汁从底部的面包上滴下来。右边是一个黑色的铁丝篮，里面装满了厚切的薯条，上面放着脆脆的炸鸡块、白色的毛毛酱和小绿色香草装饰。冻结运动，橙色酱的多次飞溅和液滴向上和汉堡周围爆炸，加上空气中漂浮的面包屑和调味颗粒。在高档休闲餐厅环境中使用温暖的电影灯光、深阴影、高对比度、浅景深、丰富的金棕色纹理、面包和酱汁的光泽亮点以及喜怒无常的模糊散景背景。摄像机角度低且近，3/4 前视图，清晰聚焦于汉堡，薯条稍微次要但仍然详细。深色石板盘子，表面散落着面包屑和酱汁。在右上角添加一个干净的白色 {argument name="brand text" default="Pollo.ai"} 徽标。
items.prompt: A dramatic photorealistic fast-food hero shot of a giant crispy fried chicken sandwich and a side basket of loaded fries on a dark restaurant table. The sandwich is centered slightly left and stacked tall with a glossy brioche bun, spicy orange sauce on the top bun, 2 purple-red onion rings, 3 pickle slices, 2 tomato slices, melted cheddar cheese dripping over an extra-crunchy fried chicken fillet, curly green leaf lettuce, and more creamy orange sauce dripping from the bottom bun. To the right, show a black wire basket filled with thick-cut fries topped with crunchy fried chicken bites, white drizzle sauce, and small green herb garnish. Freeze motion with multiple splashes and droplets of orange sauce exploding upward and around the burger, plus floating crumbs and seasoning particles in the air. Use warm cinematic lighting, deep shadows, high contrast, shallow depth of field, rich golden-brown textures, glossy highlights on the bun and sauce, and a moody blurred bokeh background in an upscale casual restaurant setting. Camera angle is low and close, 3/4 front view, sharp focus on the burger, fries slightly secondary but still detailed. Dark slate serving plate, scattered crumbs and sauce drips on the surface. Add a clean white {argument name="brand text" default="Pollo.ai"} logo in the top-right corner.

items.promptZh: 在小型复古浴室中用闪光灯自拍，垂直拍摄，具有 2000 年代早期一次性相机的真实美感。一位年轻女子的脸被柔和的矩形模糊物遮住了，她站在一面略显肮脏的镜子前，她拿着一部带有明亮直射闪光灯的智能手机，在图像的右中位置产生了强烈的星爆耀斑。她有一头深棕色的头发，带有浅金色的亮点，造型凌乱的爪夹盘发，脸上有松散的发丝，戴着小圈形耳环和两条分层的银项链。她的服装是一件合身的白色婴儿 T 恤，上面印有褪色的粉色大学风格文字，从镜子里反面写着“NANTUCKET”，宽松的石南灰色运动裤和白色袜子；一只膝盖随意地抬起在水槽柜台上，给人一种轻松、亲密的快照感觉。手机壳上覆盖着可爱的贴纸和带有粉红色卡通熊或兔子图案的圆形手柄。浴室的下半部有淡粉色的墙砖，上半部是灰白色的，水槽柜台上堆满了总共 7 件可见的盥洗用品和美容用品：水槽左侧有 4 个瓶子，水槽边缘有 1 个黑色发刷，镜子底部边缘有 2 个香水或化妆品瓶。背景中挂着一条米色的毛巾，镜框是金属的，在闪光灯下有明显的污迹和灰尘斑点。包括拍摄对象在左侧墙壁和镜子上的​​戏剧性阴影投射、柔和的绿色室内环境光与刺眼的闪光、微妙的胶片颗粒、自然的皮肤纹理、轻微的镜头畸变以及真实的未经修饰的生活方式照片氛围。
items.prompt: A candid flash mirror selfie in a small retro bathroom, shot vertically with a realistic early-2000s disposable-camera aesthetic. A young woman with her face obscured by a soft rectangular blur stands in front of a slightly dirty mirror, holding a smartphone with a bright direct flash that creates a strong starburst flare at the center-right of the image. She has dark brown hair with lighter blonde highlights, styled in a messy claw-clip updo with loose strands around the face, and wears small hoop earrings plus 2 layered silver necklaces. Her outfit is a fitted white baby tee with faded pink collegiate-style text reading "NANTUCKET" in reverse from the mirror, and loose heather gray sweatpants with white socks; one knee is raised casually on the sink counter, giving the pose a relaxed, intimate snapshot feel. The phone case is covered with cute stickers and a round grip featuring a pink cartoon bear or bunny motif. The bathroom has pale pink wall tiles on the lower half, off-white upper walls, a sink counter cluttered with 7 visible toiletry and beauty items total: 4 bottles on the left side of the sink, 1 black hairbrush on the sink edge, and 2 perfume or cosmetic bottles along the bottom ledge of the mirror. A beige towel hangs in the background, and the mirror frame is metal with visible smudges and dust specks catching the flash. Include the subject’s shadow cast dramatically on the left wall and mirror, soft ambient greenish indoor light mixed with harsh flash, subtle film grain, natural skin texture, slight lens distortion, and an authentic unpolished lifestyle-photo mood.

items.promptZh: 创作一幅高度精细、色彩丰富的等距视角节日海报插画，描绘一个熙熙攘攘的拉丁美洲科技博览会，场景位于开放的城市广场中，挤满了数十位正在社交、编程、演讲、进食、录制媒体和参加讲座的人。整体风格应像一张高端社论式城市景观海报：充满活力、密集、乐观、俏皮，并布满清晰可读的标识，线条利落，带有绘画质感，阳光温暖，洋溢着庆祝性的创业社区氛围。左上方大舞台上的主标题写着 {argument name="headline text" default="LATAM TECH FEST"}，副标题为西班牙语“Aprender para transformar”。舞台上展示一场带蓝色灯光的现场会议，有演讲者和坐着的观众；舞台区域包括 4 块垂直图标面板，分别标有“Educación”“Tecnología”“Innovación”和“Futuro”，后墙还有 3 个发光的主题图标，分别标有“Código”“Comunidad”和“Impacto”。将广场构建成密集的多区域活动地图，场景中分布着正好 24 个清晰标注的标牌或展位：“Keep Coding Keep Growing”“YO APRENDÍ EN LÍNEA”“Remote Work Zone”“ENGLISH UPGRADE YOUR FUTURE”“STARTUPS BUILD THE FUTURE”“DESIGN THINKING”“HACKATHON 24 HORAS DE IDEAS”“Café con código”“AREPAS CON TODO”“Hechas con código y ♥”“Inspiración”“Networking”“Aprendizaje”“Café”“Baños”“SOMOS LATINOAMÉRICA”“AI LAB”“DATA PEOPLE”“DEVS QUE IMPACTAN”“MARKETING GROWTH & COMMUNITY”“PRODUCT BUILD WHAT MATTERS”“FINTECH EL FUTURO DEL DINERO”“FOUNDER MODE”和“DEMO DAY LAUNCH · SCALE”。在广场中央放置一个圆形喷泉，其中有一座大型绿色几何标志雕塑作为视觉锚点。周围环绕桌子、笔记本电脑、白板、人群、花盆和长椅。背景包括一个色彩缤纷的山坡街区，带有山脉、棕榈树、电线和正好 2 辆横跨天空的红色缆车；另外添加正好 1 架在头顶飞过的小型无人机。在右上方建筑上放置一个大型品牌标牌，写着 {argument name="brand name" default="Platzi"}，以及一块绿色广告牌，上面写着“NUNCA PARES DE APRENDER”。在下半部和中景前景中填充许多微型场景：一个标有“PODCAST ON AIR”的播客间、一个霓虹灯“LIVE STREAM”角落、一个有人使用笔记本电脑的创业工作区、一张黑客松评审桌、一个创始人路演区、一块带图表的金融科技板，以及一个带浓缩咖啡设备和菜单板的咖啡摊。在场景中添加 6 个动物或吉祥物细节：左侧工作桌附近趴着 1 只橘猫，左下方有 1 只水豚，中下偏左有 1 个多彩羊驼皮纳塔，中下偏下有 1 只黄色橡皮鸭，底部中右附近有 1 个小绿机器人，底部靠硬币旁有 1 只小乌龟。此外放置正好 4 个车辆元素：左下方有 2 辆绿色滑板车，右下方有 1 辆装饰过的塔可餐车，标牌写着“TACOS AL PASTOR”，还有 1 位坐轮椅的人穿行于人群中。加入强化科技文化的额外道具：贴有便利贴的白板、一块标题为“Traction”的板子，上面有上升图表和要点“Users”“Revenue”“Retention”“Love”、一块标题为“CAP TABLE”的板子带百分比行、地上有一枚比特币风格硬币、麦克风、相机、线缆、显示器、智能手机和品牌绿色周边商品。服装应为现代休闲创业风，包括连帽衫、夹克、背包、牛仔裤、运动鞋和会议胸牌，呈现不同年龄和拉丁美洲身份的多元混合。使用浓郁的绿色、青绿色、橙色、紫色和温暖中性色，并将茂盛植物和藤蔓融入建筑中。让每个角落都繁忙且值得探索，像一场《威利在哪里》风格的科技生态庆祝活动，同时保持构图清晰且富有吸引力。
items.prompt: Create a highly detailed, colorful isometric festival poster illustration of a bustling Latin American technology fair in an open urban plaza, packed with dozens of people networking, coding, presenting, eating, recording media, and attending talks. The overall style should feel like a premium editorial cityscape poster: vibrant, dense, optimistic, playful, and full of readable signage, with crisp linework, painterly textures, warm sunlight, and a celebratory startup-community atmosphere. The main headline on the large stage at upper left reads {argument name="headline text" default="LATAM TECH FEST"}, with a subheading in Spanish reading "Aprender para transformar". On the stage, show a live conference with blue lighting, a presenter, and a seated audience; include 4 vertical icon panels on the stage area labeled "Educación", "Tecnología", "Innovación", and "Futuro", plus 3 glowing topic icons on the back wall labeled "Código", "Comunidad", and "Impacto". Build the plaza as a dense multi-zone event map with exactly 24 clearly labeled signs or booths distributed across the scene: "Keep Coding Keep Growing", "YO APRENDÍ EN LÍNEA", "Remote Work Zone", "ENGLISH UPGRADE YOUR FUTURE", "STARTUPS BUILD THE FUTURE", "DESIGN THINKING", "HACKATHON 24 HORAS DE IDEAS", "Café con código", "AREPAS CON TODO", "Hechas con código y ♥", "Inspiración", "Networking", "Aprendizaje", "Café", "Baños", "SOMOS LATINOAMÉRICA", "AI LAB", "DATA PEOPLE", "DEVS QUE IMPACTAN", "MARKETING GROWTH & COMMUNITY", "PRODUCT BUILD WHAT MATTERS", "FINTECH EL FUTURO DEL DINERO", "FOUNDER MODE", and "DEMO DAY LAUNCH · SCALE". In the center of the plaza, place a circular fountain with a large green geometric logo sculpture as the visual anchor. Surround it with tables, laptops, whiteboards, crowds, planters, and benches. Include a colorful hillside neighborhood in the background with mountains, palm trees, power lines, and exactly 2 red cable cars crossing the sky; also add exactly 1 small drone flying overhead. On the upper right building, place a large brand sign reading {argument name="brand name" default="Platzi"} and a green billboard that says "NUNCA PARES DE APRENDER". Populate the lower and middle foreground with many micro-scenes: a podcast booth labeled "PODCAST ON AIR", a neon "LIVE STREAM" corner, a startup workspace with people using laptops, a hackathon judging table, a founder pitch area, a fintech board with charts, and a coffee stand with espresso equipment and menu boards. Add 6 animal or mascot details across the scene: 1 orange cat lounging near the left worktables, 1 capybara at the lower left, 1 multicolor llama piñata in the lower center-left, 1 yellow rubber duck near the center-bottom, 1 small green robot near the bottom center-right, and 1 tiny turtle near the bottom beside a coin. Also place exactly 4 vehicle elements: 2 green scooters at the lower left, 1 decorated taco truck at the lower right with the sign "TACOS AL PASTOR", and 1 wheelchair user moving through the crowd. Include extra props that reinforce tech culture: whiteboards with sticky notes, a board titled "Traction" with an upward graph and bullet points "Users", "Revenue", "Retention", "Love", a board titled "CAP TABLE" with percentage rows, a Bitcoin-style coin on the ground, microphones, cameras, cables, monitors, smartphones, and branded green merchandise. Clothing should be modern casual startup attire with hoodies, jackets, backpacks, jeans, sneakers, and conference badges, featuring a diverse mix of ages and Latin American identities. Use rich greens, teals, oranges, purples, and warm neutrals, with lush plants and vines integrated into architecture. Make every corner busy and discoverable, like a Where's-Waldo-style tech ecosystem celebration, but keep the composition readable and inviting.

items.title: 尤文球星金色海报
items.promptZh: 为尤文图斯足球明星 {argument name="player name" default="Bernardo Silva"} 创建一张引人注目的豪华体育海报，采用黑暗电影般的黑金编辑风格。垂直构图，高对比度，喜怒无常的体育场氛围，优质海报设计与分层蒙太奇。背景是一面巨大的飘扬的尤文图斯旗帜，占据了图像的上半部分，黑色织物上有宽阔的白色条纹，右侧有一个巨大的金属金色尤文图斯“J”徽章，顶部正好有 3 颗金色星星。在旗帜前面放置一幅超大的球员半身特写肖像，身穿经典的尤文图斯主场球衣，面朝左侧，头发湿漉漉的，有纹理，颈部纹身清晰可见，边缘灯光引人注目，脸部部分被阴影遮住，营造出神秘的英雄形象。在前景中，展示了同一名球员的全身动作姿势，他脚下有一个足球，在泛光灯照明的球场上向前奔跑，中心位置靠近底部，他穿着黑白条纹尤文图斯球衣，白色短裤、白色袜子、黑色靴子，短裤上有金色的数字 20，金色的阿迪达斯细节和吉普车赞助商标志清晰可见。体育场的下半部应该被明亮的白色泛光灯、黑暗的看台、浅雾和地面附近的微妙烟雾所包围。使用优雅的杂志海报排版融入构图：左上角小金色文字“JUVENTUS”和“FOUNDED 1897”，下面正好有 3 个金色星星；左上角有 4 个白色大写字母的垂直列表：“CLASS”、“VISION”、“INTELLIGENCE”、“WORK RATE”；下面有一个金色手写签名，年份分为两行：“20”和“26”；中左大衬线球员姓名文本，名字较小，姓氏较大，白色为“BERNARDO”和“SILVA”；下面是较小的金色文字“JUVENTUS”；右下角正好有 3 个金色星星，上面有 3 个堆叠的白色单词：“TRADITION”、“PASSION”、“GLORY”；底部中心正好有 3 颗金星，位于短语“THE OLD LADY”和较小的文字“SINCE 1897”上方。调色板仅限于黑色、白色、木炭色和金属金色。添加微妙的雨雾、织物纹理、小插图、徽章和文字上的发光亮点以及抛光的冠军联赛海报美感。
items.prompt: Create a dramatic luxury sports poster for {argument name="player name" default="Bernardo Silva"} as a Juventus football star, in a dark cinematic black-and-gold editorial style. Vertical composition, high contrast, moody stadium atmosphere, premium poster design with layered photomontage. The background is a massive waving Juventus flag filling the upper half of the image, black fabric with broad white stripes and a large metallic gold Juventus "J" crest on the right side, topped by exactly 3 gold stars. In front of the flag, place an oversized close-up half-body portrait of the player wearing a classic Juventus home kit, facing slightly left, with wet textured hair, visible neck tattoos, dramatic rim lighting, and the face partially obscured by shadow for a mysterious heroic look. In the foreground, place a full-body action pose of the same player running forward with a soccer ball at his feet on a floodlit pitch, centered near the bottom, wearing the black-and-white striped Juventus jersey with white shorts, white socks, black boots, gold number 20 on the shorts, gold Adidas details, and the Jeep sponsor logo clearly visible. The stadium should wrap across the lower half with bright white floodlights, dark packed stands, light fog, and subtle smoke near the ground. Use elegant magazine-poster typography integrated into the composition: top left small gold text "JUVENTUS" and "FOUNDED 1897", with exactly 3 gold stars beneath; along the upper left a vertical list of 4 words in white caps: "CLASS", "VISION", "INTELLIGENCE", "WORK RATE"; beneath that a gold handwritten signature and the year split across two lines as "20" and "26"; center-left large serif player name text with the first name smaller and the last name huge, reading "BERNARDO" and "SILVA" in white; below that smaller gold text "JUVENTUS"; lower right exactly 3 gold stars above 3 stacked white words: "TRADITION", "PASSION", "GLORY"; bottom center exactly 3 gold stars above the phrase "THE OLD LADY" and smaller text "SINCE 1897". Color palette limited to black, white, charcoal, and metallic gold. Add subtle rain haze, fabric texture, vignette, glowing highlights on the crest and text, and a polished Champions League poster aesthetic.

items.title: 水墨山水诗意画
items.prompt: A classical Chinese ink-wash painting on warm aged rice paper, combining landscape art and calligraphy in a clean two-part composition. On the left half, leave broad negative space filled with bold black brush-calligraphy showing the poem title {argument name="poem title" default="早发白帝城"}, the poet name {argument name="poet name" default="李白"}, and four large vertical lines of poem text in expressive handwritten script: {argument name="poem text" default="朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还。两岸猿声啼不住，轻舟已过万重山。"}. On the right half, paint a serene river gorge at sunrise in the style of a traditional shan shui scroll: a soft orange sun low above misty layered mountains, tall steep cliffs on both sides, faint haze in the distance, and calm reflective water glowing with pale gold light. In the foreground at lower right, place a small wooden river boat with a simple covered cabin and a vertical mast. A solitary ancient Chinese scholar in flowing white hanfu stands on the deck facing the landscape from behind, hair tied in a traditional topknot, long robe and sash slightly trailing in the breeze, creating a contemplative mood. Add a tiny temple pavilion perched high on the top of the right cliff. Use delicate ink outlines, subtle sepia and gray washes, textured paper grain, elegant empty space, and refined literati-painting aesthetics. The overall image should feel poetic, quiet, balanced, and museum-quality, with especially beautiful legible calligraphy integrated into the artwork.

items.title: 科幻沙漠双星球
items.promptZh: 黄昏或夜晚的超现实科幻沙漠景观，广阔的沙质平原覆盖着低沉的薄雾，周围环绕着黑色的锯齿状岩层。在前景中，左下角有一个崎岖的岩石壁架，左边是陡峭的悬崖墙，右边是一个较小的崎岖的露头，而远处的山脉坐落在地平线上。在地平线上方，以天空为中心，放置两个巨大的重叠天球：后球体是一个发光的蓝到青色渐变圆，前球体是一个稍低、部分遮盖青绿色发光球体，其下半部分有柔和的大气褪色。天空是深黑色的，星星非常微弱，营造出一种极简的宇宙氛围。使用电影灯光，沙漠中呈现温暖的琥珀棕色色调，行星中呈现凉爽的霓虹蓝色调，柔和的薄雾，高对比度，超干净的数字渲染，清晰的地形细节，以及平静、超凡脱俗的情绪。
items.prompt: A surreal sci-fi desert landscape at twilight or night, with a vast sandy plain covered in low drifting haze and surrounded by dark jagged rock formations. In the foreground, a rugged rocky ledge frames the lower left corner, with a steep cliff wall on the left and a smaller craggy outcrop on the right, while a distant mountain range sits low on the horizon. Above the horizon, centered in the sky, place 2 enormous overlapping celestial spheres: the rear sphere is a luminous blue-to-cyan gradient circle, and the front sphere is a slightly lower, partially eclipsing teal-green glowing sphere with a soft atmospheric fade on its lower half. The sky is deep black with very faint stars, creating a minimalist cosmic atmosphere. Use cinematic lighting with warm amber-brown tones across the desert and cool neon blues in the planets, soft mist, high contrast, ultra-clean digital rendering, sharp terrain detail, and a calm, otherworldly mood.

items.title: 博卡青年转会海报
items.promptZh: 引人注目的垂直足球转会公告海报，采用博卡青年队颜色，设计得像精美的社交媒体图形。展示{argument name="player name" default="Paulo Dybala"}的半身像，身穿现代博卡青年队主场球衣，深宝蓝色，配有金色宽胸带、金色肩部条纹，右胸有阿迪达斯标志，左胸有 CABJ 徽章，黄色带上有“betsson”赞助商。球员身体稍偏右，从上躯干到头顶剪短，留着深色短发，体格健壮，头稍微向左转，右手食指直接指向胸前的俱乐部徽章。面部细节不清晰；保持脸部模糊或失焦。使用深蓝色纹理体育场主题背景，带有发光亮点和微妙的垃圾覆盖。在左下背景中，包括 La Bombonera 体育场的正面，上面有明显的标牌，上面写着“LA BOMBONERA”和“CLUB ATLÉTICO BOCA JUNIORS”。在整个场景中添加漂浮的金色五彩纸屑小颗粒，以获得庆祝能量。在右上角放置一个大的 CABJ 盾牌徽标。排版必须是粗体且类似海报：左上角有金色小写大写文字“BIENVENIDO A LA BOMBONERA”；下面有一颗小金星；然后左侧是一个巨大的堆叠标题，其中“BIENVENIDO”为高大白色压缩大写字母，“DYBALA”为超大金色压缩大写字母。在名称下方添加较小的白色大写文字“PAULO DYBALA”，两侧是细金色线条和一颗小金色星星。在底部，在宽度上放置一条细金色水平线，并在中间放置金色大写文本“| JUGADOR DE BOCA |”其下方有一颗金星。使用高对比度、光泽的体育海报照明、丰富的海军蓝和金色分级、清晰的织物细节以及精英俱乐部公告美感。
items.prompt: A dramatic vertical football transfer announcement poster in Boca Juniors colors, designed like a polished social media graphic. Show a half-body portrait of {argument name="player name" default="Paulo Dybala"} wearing the modern Boca Juniors home jersey, dark royal blue with a wide gold chest band, gold shoulder stripes, Adidas logo on the right chest, CABJ crest on the left chest, and “betsson” sponsor across the yellow band. The player is centered slightly to the right, cropped from upper torso to top of head, with short dark hair and athletic build, turning his head slightly to his left while pointing with his right index finger directly at the club crest on his chest. Do not show facial details clearly; keep the face obscured or out of focus. Use a deep blue textured stadium-themed background with glowing highlights and subtle grunge overlays. In the lower left background, include La Bombonera stadium facade with visible signage reading “LA BOMBONERA” and “CLUB ATLÉTICO BOCA JUNIORS.” Add small floating gold confetti particles throughout the scene for celebratory energy. Place a large CABJ shield logo in the upper right. Typography must be bold and poster-like: at the top left in small gold uppercase text, “BIENVENIDO A LA BOMBONERA”; below it a small gold star; then a huge stacked headline on the left with “BIENVENIDO” in tall white condensed uppercase and “DYBALA” in oversized gold condensed uppercase. Below the name, add smaller white uppercase text reading “PAULO DYBALA,” flanked by thin gold lines and a small gold star. At the bottom, place a thin gold horizontal line across the width and centered gold uppercase text reading “| JUGADOR DE BOCA |” with a gold star beneath it. Use high contrast, glossy sports-poster lighting, rich navy and gold color grading, sharp fabric detail, and an elite club announcement aesthetic.

items.title: 大蒜一生切片科普图
items.prompt:
以“{argument name="食物名称" default="大蒜"}的一生”为主题的科普信息图。

画面中必须是“一个完整的单体食物”（如一个土豆 / 一把香蕉 / 一头大蒜），
通过横向切片的方式，表现同一个食物在不同时间阶段的变化，而不是多个不同食物拼接。

食物主体保持结构连续、形状一致，只是在不同切片区域呈现不同成熟度（像时间被切开）。

画面为竖版3:4比例，主体居中横向展开，被均匀分割为4-6段：

从左到右：未成熟 → 成熟 → 过熟 → 变质

每一段体现真实变化：

颜色变化（青→黄→黑等）
质地变化（饱满→软化→皱缩→腐坏）
特征变化（发芽、出水、霉变等）

每个阶段配文字说明：

阶段名称
外观特点
内部变化（糖分/淀粉/水分变化）
食用建议（推荐/适合烹饪/不可食用）

设计风格：

极简浅色背景（米色）
高真实感摄影风格
清晰分割线（时间切片感）
中文科普排版，小红书风格
适当使用⚠️✔️等标识

画面顶部标题：“{argument name="食物名称" default="大蒜"}的一生”

关键要求：必须表现为“同一个食物随时间变化的切片”，而不是多个独立个体拼接

items.promptZh: 大胆的极简主义品牌海报，采用哑光黑色背景，具有柔软的粒状印刷纹理，设计类似于初创企业登陆页面英雄图形。在左上角，放置一个简单的奶油色徽标图标，后跟精致衬线文字标记中的品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="Biscuit"}。在其下方，创建一个大的左对齐印刷块，大约占据构图的左半部分。主标题为：{argument name="headline text" default="Built for alonepreneurs."} 采用超大优雅的奶油色衬线字体，具有强烈的对比度和宽大的行距。在其正下方，添加第二条标题行，采用鲜艳的粉红色斜体衬线，内容为 {argument name="tagline text" default="Backed by simple."}。在其下方，添加一个较小的白色无衬线正文复制块，左对齐，读取 {argument name="body text" default="Everything you need to launch, run, and Growth — all in a place."}。在左下角附近，将网址 {argument name="website text" default="biscuit.so"} 以粗体粉红色无衬线字体放置。右半部分有一个可爱的抽象吉祥物：一个圆形的不规则云状粉红色斑点角色，带有扇形边缘，2个奶油色和黑色的大圆形眼睛，1个弯曲的微笑小嘴，以及2只圆形的小手，放在一个大的弯曲粉红色前景形状的顶部，该形状从底部边缘升起，像一座小山或产品表面。在右上象限添加浓密的粉红色喷雾状斑点和颗粒，并向中心褪色，产生有趣的宇宙墨水飞溅效果。使用有限的黑色、奶油色、白色和饱和粉色调色板；高对比度编辑排版；大量的负空间；干净、现代、平易近人、对创始人友好的 SaaS 品牌美学；字符位置居右；肖像海报构图。
items.prompt: A bold minimalist brand poster on a matte black background with a soft grainy print texture, designed like a startup landing-page hero graphic. In the top left, place a simple cream-colored logo icon followed by the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="Biscuit"} in a refined serif wordmark. Below it, create a large left-aligned typographic block occupying roughly the left half of the composition. The main headline reads: {argument name="headline text" default="Built for solopreneurs."} in oversized elegant cream serif type with strong contrast and generous line spacing. Directly beneath it, add a second headline line in vivid hot pink italic serif reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Backed by simplicity."}. Below that, add a smaller white sans-serif body copy block, left aligned, reading {argument name="body text" default="Everything you need to launch, run, and grow—all in one place."}. Near the bottom left, place the URL {argument name="website text" default="biscuit.so"} in bold hot pink sans-serif. On the right half, feature a cute abstract mascot: a rounded irregular cloud-like pink blob character with scalloped edges, 2 large cream-and-black circular eyes, 1 small curved smiling mouth, and 2 tiny rounded hands resting on top of a large curved pink foreground shape that rises from the bottom edge like a hill or product surface. Add a dense field of hot pink spray-like speckles and particles in the upper-right quadrant fading toward the center, giving a playful cosmic ink-splatter effect. Use a limited palette of black, cream, white, and saturated pink; high contrast editorial typography; lots of negative space; a clean, modern, approachable, founder-friendly SaaS branding aesthetic; centered-right character placement; portrait poster composition.

items.title: 卓别林代言止痒膏海报

items.prompt: A clean minimalist vertical product poster on a soft pale gray background with a subtle green tint, designed like a modern Chinese skincare or medicine advertisement. Show a {argument name="character type" default="Charlie Chaplin lookalike"} from the chest up on the left side, wearing a black bowler hat, black suit jacket, white shirt, dark tie, and gray vest, posed formally and holding a bright green plastic jar of {argument name="product name" default="anti-itch cream"} with a white lid in both hands at center-left. One hand supports the jar from below while the other points toward it, creating a clear product presentation pose. The face should have a gentle pleasant expression, but keep the composition focused more on wardrobe, hands, and product than facial detail. On the upper right, place a green brand logo and Chinese brand text. Below it, add large elegant green Chinese headline text reading “舒缓 止痒膏” and smaller English subtitle text “ANTI-ITCH CREAM”. To the right of the jar, include a circular botanical graphic with {argument name="herb" default="mint leaves"}, plus exactly 2 green checklist claims in Chinese beneath it. At the bottom, add a curved white panel spanning the width of the poster containing exactly 3 evenly spaced green line icons with Chinese captions: a leaf icon for cooling itch relief, a water droplet icon for moisturizing dry itch, and a shield icon for gentle protection. The product jar label should be yellow-green with Chinese text and small herb illustrations, matching the green branding. Overall style: sparse, neat, commercial poster, lots of negative space, premium pharmacy-ad aesthetic, soft studio lighting, realistic photography mixed with clean graphic layout, green-and-white color palette.

items.promptZh: 一张简约干净的海报，位于温暖的浅米色工作室背景上，具有微妙的墙壁到桌子的地平线、大量的负空间和柔和的漫射灯光。中右站着一个全身复古无声电影喜剧演员，酷似{argument name="character type" default="查理·卓别林"}，戴着黑色圆顶礼帽，穿着深色破旧西装、背心、白衬衫、领带、超大裤子和旧皮鞋，一手握着细弯手杖，轻轻微笑。他的另一只手臂以演示姿势伸向放在前景中央的一个大绿色罐子，里面装着{argument name="product name" default="anti-itch Cream"}。该罐子有一个白色的螺旋盖，半透明的绿色瓶身，明亮的黄绿色标签，上面有中药风格的包装细节，包括小汉字和英文文字{argument name="label text" default="ANTI-ITCH CREAM"}。一只逼真的人手从下面升起，从下面支撑罐子，使产品成为视觉焦点。在罐子底部和角色脚附近添加新鲜的绿色薄荷叶，以获得天然的草药暗示。构图应该感觉像一张现代广告海报：产品大且居中，人物稍微靠后和靠右，干净的剪纸外观，柔和的阴影，清晰的边缘，柔和的中性调色板，以绿色罐子为主色调。没有标题，没有额外的布局元素，没有混乱，没有边框。在右下角添加一个微小的四点闪光图标。纵横比垂直海报，精美的商业蒙太奇风格。
items.prompt: A minimalist clean poster on a warm light beige studio background with a subtle wall-to-table horizon line, lots of negative space, and soft diffused lighting. Center-right stands a full-body vintage silent-film comedian resembling {argument name="character type" default="Charlie Chaplin"}, wearing a black bowler hat, dark worn suit, vest, white shirt, tie, oversized trousers, and old leather shoes, holding a thin curved cane in one hand and smiling gently. No headline, no extra layout elements, no clutter, no border. Include a tiny four-point sparkle icon in the lower right corner. Aspect ratio vertical poster, polished commercial photomontage style.

items.title: 复古酒馆戴帽狗肖像
items.promptZh: 一张电影般的低角度照片，一只中型棕褐色狗自豪地坐在一家质朴的老酒吧内的图案瓷砖地板上，戴着一顶超大的棕色坎加塞罗风格皮革帽子，帽子上装饰着多个金属星星标志和缝制细节。狗位于画面中央，目光微微向上，表情平静、高贵、近乎英雄。狗的身后是右边一个长长的深色木制吧台，墙上密密麻麻地排列着许多玻璃酒瓶和挂着的酒杯，营造出一种杂乱的地道酒馆氛围。左侧有一张小木桌、两把木椅、黑暗的门口、破旧的墙壁、裸露的横梁和两个可见的裸露悬挂灯泡。采用温暖的琥珀色室内灯光，浓郁的棕色和金色色调，逼真的纹理，浅景深，纪录片式的现实主义，对狗的清晰聚焦，柔和的模糊背景，宽阔的电影构图，以及幽默而庄严的情绪。该图像应该感觉像巴西乡村酒吧的肖像，一只狗打扮得像当地的民间英雄。

On the left side, show a small wooden table, 2 wooden chairs, a dark doorway, worn walls, exposed beams, and 2 visible bare hanging light bulbs. Use warm amber indoor lighting, rich brown and golden tones, realistic textures, shallow depth of field, documentary-style realism, sharp focus on the dog, softly blurred background, wide cinematic composition, and a humorous but dignified mood. The image should feel like a Brazilian countryside bar portrait of a dog dressed like a regional folk hero.

items.prompt: 创作一张手绘风格的信息图卡片，比例为9:16竖版。卡片主题鲜明，背景为带有纸质肌理的米色或米白色，整体设计体现质朴、亲切的手绘美感。卡片上方以红黑相间、对比鲜明的大号毛笔草书字体突出标题，吸引视觉焦点。文字内容均采用中文草书，整体布局分为2至4个清晰的小节，每节以简短、精炼的中文短语表达核心要点。字体保持草书流畅的韵律感，既清晰可读又富有艺术气息。卡片中点缀简单、有趣的手绘插画或图标，例如人物或象征符号，以增强视觉吸引力，引发读者思考与共鸣。整体布局注意视觉平衡，预留足够的空白空间，确保画面简洁明了，易于阅读和理解。主题是："{argument name="主题" default="做IP是长期复利，坚持每日出摊，持续做，肯定会有结果，因为99%都坚持不住的。"}"

items.prompt: A luminous anime-style illustration of a young woman standing on a sunlit stone stairway in a Mediterranean seaside town, with the viewpoint at half-body to three-quarter-body height. The background shows 1 narrow stone stair street lined with old buildings and greenery, 1 bright blue sea bay, 1 distant coastline with mountains, 1 lighthouse-like tower, and several tiny white boats on the water under a clear sky with soft clouds. Warm midday sunlight, sparkling atmosphere, romantic vacation postcard feeling, highly detailed anime painting, soft painterly textures, vivid blue ocean, lush green foliage, elegant feminine character design. On the right side, place 1 large white paper letter card floating as a clean overlay, with neat handwritten-style Japanese text in dark ink, including friendly emojis and flowers, as if it is a heartfelt fan message or thank-you note. The note should read: 「いつも見守ってくださって ありがとうございます😊✨ 皆さんの優しい言葉や応援が、紬の心の支えになっています🌷 日々の小さな幸せを大切にしながら、これからも心を込めて歌や言葉を届けていきますね♪♪🌸 どうか、皆さんの心が 穏やかであたたかい毎日で ありますように…🍀💖 結葉紬より🌸」. Make the letter large, legible, and balanced against the character, with a clean white background and slight paper texture. items.promptZh: 制作一张电影体育广告海报，其中一只巨大的特写跑鞋在日落时在潮湿的城市街道上的浅水中飞溅。该构图是一个低角度、超动态的动作镜头，其中一只主要的鞋子占据了画面的右半部分，而一只次要的鞋子在其后面可见，暗示着跑步者正在迈步。这款英雄运动鞋是一款白色和灰色针织高性能鞋，带有黑色侧面旋风标志、灰色鞋带、红色小鞋带环装饰、厚实的半透明缓冲鞋底，底部边缘有明亮的橙红色外底发光。展示覆盖着逼真水滴和清晰纹理细节的鞋子，爆炸性飞溅颗粒冻结在鞋底周围。跑步者穿着深色运动紧身裤，只能从小腿以下看到。将戏剧性的城市天际线放置在右侧遥远的背景中，在暴风雨般的乌云下，在地平线附近爆发出温暖的金色阳光，柔和地模糊。使用凉爽的蓝灰色阴影和火热的橙色高光之间的强烈对比，并在被雨水浸湿的路面上产生光泽反射。在左侧，添加 3 个垂直排列的文本元素：一个巨大的粗体白色大写标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="JUST DO IT."}，其下方有 1 个白色旋风式品牌标记，下方是一条较小的大写橙色励志行，内容为 {argument name="tagline text" default="YOU CAN'T STOP WHAT'S ALREADY INSIDE YOU."}。在鞋舌标签上添加可见的品牌标识：{argument name="brand name" default="NIKE"}。使其看起来像{argument name="product type" default="running Shoes"}的优质高影响力商业海报，具有超真实的细节、戏剧性的灯光、浅景深、动感能量、清晰的版式、广告摄影润色和宽屏 16:9 布局。
items.prompt: Create a cinematic sports advertising poster featuring a giant close-up running shoe in motion splashing through shallow water on a wet city street at sunset. The composition is a low-angle, ultra-dynamic action shot with 1 primary shoe dominating the right half of the frame and 1 secondary blurred shoe visible behind it, implying a runner mid-stride. The hero sneaker is a white and gray knit performance shoe with a black side swoosh-style logo, gray laces, small red lace-loop accents, a thick translucent cushioned sole, and a bright orange-red outsole glow along the bottom edge. Show the shoe covered in realistic water droplets and sharp texture detail, with explosive splash particles frozen around the sole. The runner wears dark athletic leggings, visible only from the lower legs down. Place a dramatic urban skyline in the distant background on the right, softly blurred, under stormy dark clouds breaking into warm golden sunlight near the horizon. Use intense contrast between cool blue-gray shadows and fiery orange highlights, with glossy reflections on the rain-soaked pavement. On the left side, add 3 text elements arranged vertically: a huge bold distressed white uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="JUST DO IT."}, beneath it 1 white swoosh-style brand mark, and below that a smaller uppercase orange motivational line reading {argument name="tagline text" default="YOU CAN'T STOP WHAT'S ALREADY INSIDE YOU."}. Include visible branding on the tongue label with {argument name="brand name" default="NIKE"}. Make it look like a premium high-impact commercial poster for {argument name="product type" default="running shoes"}, with hyperreal detail, dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, motion energy, crisp typography, ad-photography polish, and a widescreen 16:9 layout.

items.title: 暗调香水奢华广告
items.promptZh: 为深色玻璃男士香水瓶制作一个奢华电影香水广告，标签为 {argument name="brand name" default="DIOR"} 和 {argument name="product name" default="SAUVAGE"}。该构图是一张宽屏优质产品镜头，瓶子位于中心稍偏右的位置，直立在光滑的湿黑色表面上，与观看者形成微妙的角度。瓶子采用深烟熏海军黑色透明玻璃制成，配有反光金属瓶盖，瓶盖上有圆形脊，正面有优雅的衬线字体，底部散发着温暖的琥珀色光芒。瓶子周围被一团戏剧性的飞溅的冻结在运动中的液体所包围，无数闪闪发光的金色液滴和条纹在瓶子的下半部分周围向上和向外爆炸。使用黑暗、喜怒无常、高对比度的背景，带有模糊的岩石或城市般的轮廓，以及远处发光的日落光线，以黑色、青铜色、琥珀色和金色色调为主。在左侧，在宽敞的布局中添加精致的奢华广告排版：大衬线标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="SAUVAGE"}，下方有一条较小的衬线品牌线，为 {argument name="subheadline text" default="DIOR"}，下方有一条细水平分隔线，以及一条小的大写无衬线标语为 {argument name="tagline" default="THE POWER OF INSTINCT"}。在左下角附近添加简约奢华的字母标记。强调光泽反射、锐利的瓶子边缘、逼真的液体物理、闪闪发光的高光、电影背光、浅景深和优质的高端美容广告造型。
items.prompt: Create a luxury cinematic fragrance advertisement for a dark glass men's perfume bottle labeled {argument name="brand name" default="DIOR"} and {argument name="product name" default="SAUVAGE"}. The composition is a widescreen premium product shot with the bottle placed slightly right of center, standing upright on a glossy wet black surface, angled subtly toward the viewer. items.promptZh:
{参数名称=“主题名称”默认=“[人名]”}。 
担任高端体育平面设计师，创作概念致敬海报。该风格是一种复杂的“双曝光照片网格合成”，具有混合媒体纹理。
中央结构（船舶）：
中心焦点是{argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}的大尺寸、高对比度黑白肖像剪影。这幅主肖像充当了容器的作用。
网格填充和纹理（混合媒体）：
剪影的内部充满了密集的“照片马赛克网格”，其中包含该人职业生涯中的动作镜头。
关键纹理说明：不要只粘贴平面照片。将艺术纹理应用于各种网格单元，以创造触觉、拼贴的感觉。使用如下效果：
半色调点：某些单元格上的漫画书风格的光栅图案。
面料/刺绣：微妙的线或帆布纹理暗示着球衣或补丁。
胶片颗粒：特定高对比度动作镜头上出现严重噪点。
色彩策略：
底座是单色黑白。仅在特定网格单元上使用选择性颜色叠加（与团队/旗帜相关）来创建节奏。
版式和品牌（严格的微观缩放）：
左上角（名称）：严格使用字体 {argument name="font family" default="Inter Semibold"} 书写“{argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}”。
字距调整：严格的负字距调整 (-4%)。
尺寸：小而谨慎。它必须最多占据画布宽度的 20%。不要让它太大或太大声。
右上角（符号）：放置主要徽标（团队/品牌/旗帜）。
尺寸：非常小。它必须最多占据画布宽度的 10%。
组成和背景：
背景：灰白色或浅灰色，具有可见的优质纸张或混凝土纹理。它不应该是纯数字白色。
对齐：将图形完美居中。在物体周围保持宽阔的负空间。

On the left side of the table, place 1 red-and-white striped fries carton filled with golden French fries, with a few extra fries scattered on the tabletop in front; the carton also has the KFC-style logo with its face area obscured. On the right side, place 1 tall transparent glass of dark cola packed with ice, condensation visible on the outside, branded with the KFC-style logo with the face area obscured. In front of the drink, place 1 small white dipping bowl filled with glossy red ketchup. At the bottom center, add the tagline in bold black sans-serif: “Crispy. Juicy. Irresistible.” and beneath it a small cursive signature-style line reading “Col. Harland Sanders.” with a small rectangular red accent below. items.promptZh: {argument name="landmark" default="格拉纳达的阿尔罕布拉宫"} 的高度详细、逼真的乐高立体模型，在黄金时段的日落时呈现出华丽的摩尔式庭院。该场景完全由乐高积木和小人仔部件构建而成，具有温暖的琥珀色灯光、电影般的深度和丰富的纹理。将构图集中在一条狭长的反光水道上，通向中间距离的一个小圆形喷泉和远处的一个宏伟的马蹄形拱门。庭院周围是错综复杂的棕褐色石头般的乐高墙壁、雕刻的几何浮雕图案、细长的柱子、瓷砖拱门和由密集分层的红棕色碎片制成的赤土屋顶线。背景中包括 2 座主塔和庭院后面矗立的几座额外的宫殿建筑，以及 6 棵高大的深绿色柏树，在橙色的天空映衬下形成剪影。在中央拱门和下墙周围添加蓝色、绿色和白色马赛克风格的瓷砖细节。庭院中正好有 9 名乐高游客和参观者：1 名戴着棕褐色帽子和浅色服装的游客，旁边有 1 名穿着蓝色夹克的游客，左侧前景有 1 名背着绿色背包的人，左侧前景有 1 名拿着相机的摄影师，1 名跪着的游客在水道右边缘检查花园，2 名站立的游客在右侧中景聊天，以及 2 名坐在右侧前景瓷砖长凳上的游客。用修剪整齐的低矮树篱和粉红色的小花围成水道。从倒影池开始使用低视平线视角，浅景深，中央庭院清晰的焦点，光滑的水面倒影，逼真的乐高螺柱纹理，以及一种庄严、有趣和博物馆品质的氛围。
items.prompt: A highly detailed photorealistic LEGO diorama of {argument name="landmark" default="the Alhambra in Granada"}, shown as an ornate Moorish courtyard at golden-hour sunset. The scene is built entirely from LEGO bricks and minifigure parts, with warm amber light, cinematic depth, and rich texture. Center the composition on a long narrow reflective water channel leading toward 1 small round fountain in the middle distance and a grand horseshoe arch beyond it. Surround the courtyard with intricate tan stone-like LEGO walls, carved-looking geometric relief patterns, slender columns, tiled archways, and terracotta rooflines made from densely layered reddish-brown pieces. In the background, include 2 main towers and several additional palace structures rising behind the courtyard, plus 6 tall dark green cypress trees silhouetted against a glowing orange sky. Add blue, green, and white mosaic-style tile details around the central arch and lower walls. Populate the courtyard with exactly 9 LEGO tourists and visitors: 1 traveler in a tan hat and light outfit, 1 visitor in a blue jacket beside them, 1 person with a green backpack at the left foreground, 1 photographer holding a camera in the left foreground, 1 kneeling visitor examining the garden at the right edge of the water channel, 2 standing visitors chatting in the right midground, and 2 seated visitors on a tiled bench in the right foreground. Frame the water channel with low manicured hedges and small pink flowers. Use a low eye-level perspective from the start of the reflecting pool, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the central courtyard, glossy water reflections, realistic LEGO stud texture, and a mood that feels majestic, playful, and museum-quality.

items.title: 豪车内慵懒女子写真
items.promptZh: 逼真的汽车内部偷拍照片，采用锁定的 4:5 垂直构图，使用 24 毫米智能手机风格的广角镜头从右前方与视线齐平的位置拍摄，照片中一位年轻的成年女性留着{argument name="hair color" default="dark Brown"}齐肩的头发，懒洋洋地躺在一辆现代豪华轿车的前排乘客座椅上，内饰采用亮白色皮革内饰。她的身体斜靠在座椅上，摆出一种紧凑舒适的姿势，双膝紧紧地向胸部靠拢，在腿部上形成强烈的广角透视；当她的脸转向镜头时，她的躯干稍微向左倾斜。一只手臂弯曲在脑后，另一只手轻轻触摸紧身胸衣的上边缘。她穿着 4 件可见的服装：{argument name="corset color" default="cream withdusty mauve embroidery"}合身花卉紧身胸衣、白色短裤、脚踝处皱缩的白色罗纹圆袜和细紧身胸衣肩带。她的表情轻松而亲密，妆容自然，肤质柔软。汽车内饰包括 5 个清晰可见的元素：白色乘客座椅、前景右侧的白色驾驶员座椅边缘、侧窗、全景玻璃车顶和深色门板装饰。洒满雨水的窗户外面是一个安静的郊区，有 4 个明显的环境线索：潮湿的街道、绿色的草坪、茂密的树木和阴天下模糊的房屋。照明是透过侧窗和玻璃屋顶的柔和的漫射灰色日光，具有柔和的环境阴影、微妙的 HDR 智能手机清晰度、温和的外部高光过度曝光、逼真的肤色、清晰的白色皮革反射以及屋顶玻璃上明显的雨滴。保持场景雅致、时尚编辑和高度逼真，就像在雨天用 iPhone 14 Pro 或索尼 Alpha 广角照片在停放的汽车内拍摄一样。

items.prompt: A realistic nighttime street photo shot as a mirror selfie through a large roadside convex traffic mirror, vertical 3:4 composition, with the entire circular mirror filling the frame and no black empty border outside the reflected scene. Use a strong fisheye lens and a slightly exaggerated dome-mirror effect so the road, scaffolding, poles, buildings, and lane markings bend heavily toward the edges. At the bottom center of the reflection, show a young person from about waist up taking the photo, wearing a {argument name="jacket style" default="black leather jacket"}, with short dark hair, small silver hoop earrings, and 2 visible silver rings, holding a {argument name="phone model" default="white iPhone 15 Pro Max"} up to cover most of the face. The subject stands casually with one hand in a pocket, centered in the mirror. The street is wet and glossy, reflecting intense red light. Include 1 moving dark car crossing the curved road from left to right with subtle motion blur and bright red taillight streaks. Surround the road with dense construction scaffolding and striped barriers; show exactly 2 red-and-yellow diagonal road barriers along the right and upper-right curve and additional striped safety panels around the left side. Include 3 clearly visible red traffic lights glowing in the background. Across the top arc, place a scaffold-wrapped building with large bright red Chinese neon signage. Lighting is dominated by red neon signs and street lamps, casting saturated red highlights across the asphalt and metal structures. The mood is cinematic, urban, candid, and realistic, with a gritty night-street atmosphere in an East Asian city.

Near the lower portion, add another Chinese line introducing a small caption at the bottom right, followed by the exact quoted English caption: “Typography • Photorealism • Layout • Consistency • Multilingual Text”. items.title: 等距蒸汽赛博城市
items.promptZh: 黄昏时分密集的等距蒸汽朋克赛博朋克城市插图，设计得像一个异想天开的独立科技区，名为{argument name="city name" default="INDIE MIND CITY"}。场景是一个庞大的城市广场，里面挤满了狭窄的砖砌建筑、屋顶天线、电缆、管道、霓虹灯、市场摊位、小小的行人和有趣的程序员幽默。在中心背景中，一个标有“PLAZA DEL PROMPT”的广场围绕着一个浅蓝色水的雕塑喷泉，周围有长凳和人们聚集。左边的背景是一座高大的建筑，上面有一个巨大的标牌，上面写着“BARRIO CÓDIGO ABIERTO”，上面布满了阳台、窗户、悬挂的衣物、空调、植物和街道活动。右边的背景上，另一个街区挂着一个大标牌“CALLEJÓN DE LOS AGENTES”，店面堆放着标牌，包括“Codex Barbería cortes excosos”、“Gemini Lavandería”、“Claude’s Coffee”和“Dr. Llama”。再往右，是一个重工业工厂区，里面有烟囱、起重机、管道、板条箱和过道，并展示了 3 个大型标志：“ZONA INDUSTRIAL”、“FÁBRICA DE TOKENS”和“LLM”。一团漂浮的字母和符号像生成的文本烟雾一样从烟囱上方升起。在前景中心，一座高大的钟楼式转角建筑有一个垂直的霓虹灯标志，上面写着“INDIE MIND”，正面有一个大圆形时钟，窗户温暖明亮，底部有一个小型石制动物雕塑。右侧前景中，热闹的市场区闪烁着灯串和明亮的霓虹灯标志“MERCADO NOCTURNO”，上面有 3 个明显的摊位标志：“Memoria usada barata”、“Embeddings fresco del día”和“Se cambian vectores”。附近还有另外 3 个笑话标语：“安全帽：快速注射区”、“黑客马拉松：entra y sal con un bug”以及一个标有“STACK OVERFLOW NOODLES”的食品摊。在左侧前景中，一座古老的混合用途建筑充满了标志和视觉笑话，包括一个巨大的屋顶广告牌，上面有两只猫和标题{argument name="main billboard text" default="INDIE MIND CITY"}，再加上一个小版本标签“v1.0.0”。在同一个块上，包括以下可见标志：“FORGE & CAFE”、“git Push Cafe +$2”、“Tienda de MERGE CONFLICTS abierto 24/7”、“Se reparan linters”、“NO rm -rf aquí”、“Ralph 在这里”、“npm install vv”、“sudo make me Sandwich”、“WORKTREE”、“SE VENDE GPU USADA”、“MUSEO” DEL MERGE CONFLICT”、“NOTARÍA DE COMMITS FIRMADOS”、“PSICÓLOGO PARA SENIOR DEVS 50m 80”、“GATO PERDIDO responde a localhost”，以及一个海报板，上面写着“HOY：charla sobre agenticcoding entrada libre”和“REUNIÓN DE AA^AI REUNIDOS DE LOS AGI”。在中左广场附近，添加一个三明治板式标志，标有“PROMPTS USADOS”，其下方有 3 条线，以及小广场标志，上面写着“HELLO WORLD”、“Tailscale”、“OpenRouter”和“Deepseek”。街道是鹅卵石铺成的，挤满了具体的小故事细节：一辆标有“LÍNEA MAIN”的黄色电车、一辆蓝色小车、一辆自行车车、一辆送货踏板车、户外咖啡桌、棋手、行人、板条箱、盆栽植物、条纹遮阳篷、晾衣绳、发光的窗户、屋顶上的猫，以及站在特工巷附近的白色骆驼。使用灰青色、铁锈色、琥珀色、棕褐色、褪色的霓虹粉色和青色等温暖柔和的调色板。将其渲染为超详细的社论插图，具有干净的等距视角、复杂的线条、柔和的氛围灯光、微小的可读标牌、舒适的城市混乱和幽默的手工世界建筑。
items.prompt: A dense isometric steampunk-cyberpunk city illustration at dusk, designed like a whimsical indie tech district called {argument name="city name" default="INDIE MIND CITY"}. The scene is a single sprawling urban plaza packed with narrow brick buildings, rooftop antennas, cables, pipes, neon signs, market stalls, tiny pedestrians, and playful programmer humor. In the center background, a plaza labeled “PLAZA DEL PROMPT” surrounds a sculptural fountain with pale blue water, with benches and people gathered around it. To the left background, a tall building with a giant sign reading “BARRIO CÓDIGO ABIERTO” is covered in balconies, windows, hanging laundry, air conditioners, plants, and street activity. To the right background, another block bears a large sign “CALLEJÓN DE LOS AGENTES,” with stacked storefront signs including “Codex Barbería cortes exactos,” “Gemini Lavandería,” “Claude’s Coffee,” and “Dr. Llama.” Further right, a heavy industrial factory zone with smokestacks, cranes, ducts, crates, and catwalks displays 3 large signs: “ZONA INDUSTRIAL,” “FÁBRICA DE TOKENS,” and “LLM.” A cloud of floating letters and symbols rises above the chimneys like generated text smoke. In the foreground center, a tall clocktower-like corner building has a vertical neon sign reading “INDIE MIND,” a large round clock on the facade, warm lit windows, and a small stone animal sculpture at its base. To the right foreground, a lively market district glows with string lights and a bright neon sign “MERCADO NOCTURNO,” with 3 visible stall signs: “Memoria usada barata,” “Embeddings frescos del día,” and “Se cambian vectores.” Nearby are 3 more joke signs: “HARD HAT: prompt injection zone,” “HACKATHON: entra y sal con un bug,” and a food stand labeled “STACK OVERFLOW NOODLES.” To the left foreground, an older mixed-use building is filled with signs and visual jokes, including a huge rooftop billboard with 2 cats on top and the title {argument name="main billboard text" default="INDIE MIND CITY"}, plus a small version label “v1.0.0.” On that same block, include these visible signs: “FORGE & CAFE,” “git push cafe +$2,” “Tienda de MERGE CONFLICTS abierto 24/7,” “Se reparan linters,” “NO rm -rf aquí,” “Ralph was here,” “npm install vv,” “sudo make me sandwich,” “WORKTREE,” “SE VENDE GPU USADA,” “MUSEO DEL MERGE CONFLICT,” “NOTARÍA DE COMMITS FIRMADOS,” “PSICÓLOGO PARA SENIOR DEVS 50m 80,” “GATO PERDIDO responde a localhost,” and a poster board reading “HOY: charla sobre agentic coding entrada libre” and “REUNIÓN DE AA^AI REUNIDOS DE LOS AGI.” Near the center-left plaza, add a sandwich-board style sign labeled “PROMPTS USADOS” with 3 lines beneath it, and small plaza signs that read “HELLO WORLD,” “Tailscale,” “OpenRouter,” and “Deepseek.” The streets are cobblestone and crowded with exact small story details: 1 yellow tram labeled “LÍNEA MAIN,” 1 small blue car, 1 bicycle cart, 1 delivery scooter, outdoor café tables, chess players, pedestrians, crates, potted plants, striped awnings, laundry lines, glowing windows, rooftop cats, and a white llama standing near the agent alley. Use a warm muted palette of dusty teal, rust, amber, tan, and faded neon pink and cyan. Render it as an ultra-detailed editorial illustration with clean isometric perspective, intricate linework, soft atmospheric lighting, tiny readable signage, cozy urban clutter, and humorous handcrafted worldbuilding.

items.title: 男士面部遮挡肖像
items.promptZh: 一张居中的工作室肖像照片，照片中一名成年男子从上胸部到头顶，在光滑的深海军蓝色背景下直面镜头。他留着剃得非常整齐的寸头，两侧耳朵清晰可见，皮肤呈中等棕褐色，面部短毛集中在下巴和下巴线上，还有淡淡的小胡子。给他穿上一件没有徽标的纯灰白色或奶油色圆领运动衫。使用柔和的专业工作室灯光，在头皮、耳朵、颈部和运动衫上提供柔和的高光、逼真的皮肤纹理、浅景深和干净的摄影外观。构图对称，头部靠近画面顶部，宽阔的肩膀填充下半部分，呈垂直纵向。覆盖 1 个大型不透明矩形检查块，以面部为中心，覆盖从前额到鼻子下方的区域，并跨越大部分面部宽度；将块设为平坦、柔和的棕色调，边缘稍软，以便完全隐藏面部特征。
items.prompt: A centered studio portrait photo of a single adult man from upper chest to top of head, facing straight toward the camera against a smooth deep navy-blue backdrop. He has a very closely shaved buzz cut, visible ears on both sides, medium tan skin, and short dark facial hair concentrated along the chin and jawline with a faint mustache. Dress him in a plain off-white or cream crewneck sweatshirt with no logo. Use soft professional studio lighting with gentle highlights on the scalp, ears, neck, and sweatshirt, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, and a clean photographic look. Compose it symmetrically with the head near the top of frame and broad shoulders filling the lower half, in a vertical portrait orientation. Overlay 1 large opaque rectangular censor block centered over the face, covering from forehead to below the nose area and spanning most of the facial width; make the block a flat muted brown tone with slightly soft edges so the facial features are completely hidden.

items.promptZh: 以现实的生活方式拍摄的舒适阳光下的家庭办公室场景。一只淡绿色眼睛的白色短毛猫笔直地坐在靠近中左的一张温暖的木桌上，面对镜头，表情平静专注，尾巴卷在前爪上。猫的左边是一个带叶的盆栽植物，放在一个有纹理的米色罐子里，还有一个陶瓷杯，里面装满了黑咖啡。猫的面前放着一本打开的螺旋笔记本，上面有手写的笔记和一支斜放在书页上的银笔。桌子的右侧是一台打开的笔记本电脑，稍微向观看者倾斜，显示出一幅生动的壁纸，上面是碧绿的湖泊和蓝天下白雪皑皑的山峰。桌子后面有一扇大窗户，上面挂着柔软的奶油色窗帘，明亮的金色早晨阳光从右侧射入，在桌子上投下自然的阴影。包括 2 张镶框墙画，在左墙上部分可见。氛围应该让人感到平静、富有成效和温馨的家庭氛围，具有柔和的电影灯光、清晰的细节、浅景深和高端编辑摄影现实主义。
items.prompt: A cozy sunlit home office scene photographed in a realistic lifestyle style. A white short-haired cat with pale green eyes sits upright on a warm wooden desk near the center-left, facing the camera with a calm attentive expression, its tail curled around its front paws. To the left of the cat is 1 leafy potted houseplant in a textured beige pot and 1 ceramic mug filled with dark coffee. In front of the cat lies 1 open spiral notebook with handwritten notes and 1 silver pen resting diagonally across the pages. On the right side of the desk is 1 open laptop angled slightly toward the viewer, showing a vivid wallpaper of a turquoise lake and dramatic snow-capped mountain peaks under a blue sky. Behind the desk is a large window with soft cream curtains, bright golden morning sunlight streaming in from the right and casting natural shadows across the desk. Include 2 framed wall pictures partially visible on the left wall. The atmosphere should feel peaceful, productive, and warmly domestic, with soft cinematic lighting, crisp details, shallow depth of field, and high-end editorial photography realism.

items.title: 动漫最后晚餐群像
items.promptZh:
一幅黑暗的、电影般的动漫群像，灵感来自《最后的晚餐》，背景设定在夜晚的长石宴会厅中。准确地展示了 11 个坐着或倾斜的女性角色，肩并肩地排列在铺着白色桌布的长桌后面，以宽大的对称构图直接观看。正中央是一位身穿华丽的蓝银盔甲和宝蓝色连衣裙的金发骑士女子，双臂铠甲沿着桌子延伸，成为视觉焦点。她面前放着一个发光的金色圣杯，将温暖的光芒向上照射到人们的脸上和手上。在他们身后，三扇高大的拱形窗户展现出暮色中的风景，一棵巨大的树在昏暗的天空下映出轮廓。天花板有深色木梁，侧壁上排列着大型阴影框画。

这 11 个角色应该感觉像是标志性动漫风格女性的跨界组合，具有不同的轮廓、发型和时尚。从左到右：1）一位身穿光亮红色紧身未来派套装的女士，身体前倾，一只手放在桌子上； 2）她身边有一位身穿柔和军装的黑发女子； 3）苍白的哥特式女孩，穿着长袖黑色连衣裙，纤细的手指举起双手； 4）金发短发女人，穿着宽松的白色T恤，休闲又摩登； 5) 一位身穿白衬衫、身材高大、红发的女士，稍稍落后于其他人； 6）中央的金发蓝色铠甲骑士； 7）一位身穿黑色连衣裙、戴着金色配饰和头饰的黑发女子，举起一根手指； 8）身着红色绣花长裙、留着黑色长发的迷人女子； 9) 一位身穿低胸黑色服装、身体向内倾斜的黑发女子； 10）一个穿着无袖服装的青色双马尾虚拟偶像女孩； 11) 最右边盘腿坐着一个穿着浅色图案连衣裙的绿发女孩，手里拿着一个酒杯。保持所有面孔有吸引力的动漫面孔，成熟的年轻成年女性，优雅而不是漫画。

桌子上正好有 11 个餐具、8 个可见的红酒杯、几条面包和散落的面包卷、盘子、银器、面包屑和一些金属高脚杯或杯子。温暖的圣杯灯应该照亮中心，而房间的其余部分则陷入喜怒无常的阴影中。采用绘画写实主义，高细节的动漫插画，戏剧性的明暗对比，柔和的棕色和蓝色氛围加上红色的点缀，庄重而略显颓废的气氛，超宽的全景取景，杰作品质。
items.prompt:
A dark, cinematic anime group portrait inspired by The Last Supper, set in a long stone banquet hall at night. Show exactly 11 seated or leaning female characters arranged shoulder to shoulder behind a long table covered with a white tablecloth, viewed straight on in a wide symmetrical composition. In the exact center is a blonde knightly woman in ornate blue-and-silver armor and a royal-blue dress, posed as the visual focal point with both armored arms extended along the table. In front of her sits a glowing golden chalice radiating warm light upward onto the faces and hands of the group. Behind them, three tall arched windows reveal a twilight landscape with a huge tree silhouetted against a dusky sky. The ceiling has dark wooden beams, and the side walls are lined with large shadowy framed paintings.

The 11 characters should feel like a crossover ensemble of iconic anime-style women with varied silhouettes, hairstyles, and fashion. From left to right: 1) a woman in a glossy red skintight futuristic suit, leaning forward with one hand on the table; 2) a dark-haired woman in muted military-style clothing close beside her; 3) a pale gothic girl in a black dress with long sleeves, hands lifted with delicate fingers; 4) a short blonde woman in a loose white T-shirt, casual and modern; 5) a tall red-haired woman in a white shirt standing slightly behind the others; 6) the central blonde armored knight in blue; 7) a black-haired woman in a black dress with gold accessories and a headpiece, raising one finger; 8) a glamorous woman in a red embroidered dress with long black hair; 9) a dark-haired woman in a low-cut black outfit leaning inward; 10) a teal twin-tailed virtual-idol-like girl in a sleeveless outfit; 11) a green-haired girl in a pale patterned dress seated with crossed legs at the far right, holding a wine glass. Keep all faces attractive anime faces, mature young-adult women, elegant rather than caricatured.

On the table, include exactly 11 place settings, 8 visible wine glasses with red wine, several loaves of bread and scattered rolls, plates, silverware, crumbs, and a few metallic goblets or cups. The warm chalice light should illuminate the center while the rest of the room falls into moody shadow. Use painterly realism, high-detail anime illustration, dramatic chiaroscuro, subdued brown and blue ambience with red accents, solemn yet slightly decadent atmosphere, ultra-wide panoramic framing, masterpiece quality.

From left to right: a blond ninja-inspired teenage hero in an orange-and-black outfit with a forehead protector, crouched in an attack stance and forming a glowing spinning energy orb in one hand, surrounded by orange chakra flames and several floating black spheres behind him; a muscular black-haired martial artist in an orange gi at left-center, twisting mid-strike while charging a bright blue energy sphere in his hand, wrapped in crackling blue aura and electric arcs; a lean pirate-inspired young man at right-center wearing a straw hat, sleeveless red vest, blue shorts, and sandals, lunging forward with a fierce grin, one arm extended, with white steam-like energy curling around his body; a dark-haired swordsman at far right in a flowing black-and-red checkered haori, drawing or swinging a katana with a sweeping arc of fiery red-orange energy around him. Add a massive title across the bottom foreground reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHONEN LEGENDS"} in oversized distressed brush lettering, bright yellow-gold with thick black shadows and rough torn edges, partially overlapping the characters and debris. Make it feel like a blockbuster key art poster for {argument name="franchise theme" default="legendary shonen anime crossover"}, with thunderous energy, heroic rivalry, and unstoppable momentum.
